1978.english:
In some cases our indirect interest in earning power is becoming quite substantial.  For example, note our holdings of 953,750 shares of SAFECO Corp. SAFECO probably is the best run large property and casualty insurance company in the United States.  Their underwriting abilities are simply superb, their loss reserving is conservative, and their investment policies make great sense.

SAFECO is a much better insurance operation than our own (although we believe certain segments of ours are much better than average), is better than one we could develop and, similarly, is far better than any in which we might negotiate purchase of a controlling interest.  Yet our purchase of SAFECO was made at substantially under book value.  We paid less than 100 cents on the dollar for the best company in the business, when far more than 100 cents on the dollar is being paid for mediocre companies in corporate transactions.  And there is no way to start a new operation - with necessarily uncertain prospects - at less than 100 cents on the dollar.
1978.chinese:
在某些情况下，我们间接拥有的盈利能力已经相当可观。例如，请注意我们持有SAFECO公司的953,750股。SAFECO很可能是美国经营管理最出色的大型财产及意外伤害保险公司。它的承保能力极其优秀，赔款准备金计提十分保守，投资政策也很有道理。

SAFECO的保险经营远远优于我们自己的保险业务（虽然我们相信，自己的某些部门也大大优于行业平均水平）；它比我们自己能够创建的保险业务更好，同样也远好于我们可能通过谈判取得控股权的任何保险公司。但我们买入SAFECO时的价格，却显著低于其账面价值。我们用不到每1美元账面价值1美元的价格，买到了行业中最优秀的企业；与此同时，在企业收购交易中，人们却愿意为平庸企业每1美元账面价值付出远高于1美元的价格。而要从头建立一家前景必然存在不确定性的公司，也不可能以每1美元资本不到1美元的成本来完成。

1978.english: Of course, with a minor interest we do not have the right to direct or even influence management policies of SAFECO.  But why should we wish to do this?  The record would indicate that they do a better job of managing their operations than we could do ourselves.  While there may be less excitement and prestige in sitting back and letting others do the work, we think that is all one loses by accepting a passive participation in excellent management.  Because, quite clearly, if one controlled a company run as well as SAFECO, the proper policy also would be to sit back and let management do its job.
1978.chinese: 当然，作为少数股东，我们无权决定甚至影响SAFECO的管理政策。但我们为什么要希望这样做呢？经营记录表明，它的管理者比我们自己亲自经营还做得好得多。坐在一边让别人做事，也许少了一些兴奋感和威望；但我们认为，作为优秀管理团队的被动参与者，失去的也只有这些。很显然，如果我们控制了一家经营得像SAFECO一样出色的公司，正确的政策同样是坐在一旁，让管理层把工作做好。

1978.english: Earnings attributable to the shares of SAFECO owned by Berkshire at yearend amounted to $6.1 million during 1978, but only the dividends received (about 18% of earnings) are reflected in our operating earnings.  We believe the balance, although not reportable, to be just as real in terms of eventual benefit to us as the amount distributed.  In fact, SAFECO’s retained earnings (or those of other well-run companies if they have opportunities to employ additional capital advantageously) may well eventually have a value to shareholders greater than 100 cents on the dollar.
1978.chinese: 按照伯克希尔年末所持SAFECO股份计算，1978年归属于这些股份的利润为610万美元，但只有我们收到的股息——约占这些利润的18%——计入了我们的经营利润。我们认为，其余未列入报告的利润，从最终给我们带来利益的意义上说，与已经分配的利润同样真实。事实上，SAFECO的留存利润（或者其他经营良好、能够有利地运用新增资本的企业的留存利润），最终可能让每留存1美元为股东创造超过1美元的价值。

1978.english: We are not at all unhappy when our wholly-owned businesses retain all of their earnings if they can utilize internally those funds at attractive rates.  Why should we feel differently about retention of earnings by companies in which we hold small equity interests, but where the record indicates even better prospects for profitable employment of capital? (This proposition cuts the other way, of course, in industries with low capital requirements, or if management has a record of plowing capital into projects of low profitability; then earnings should be paid out or used to repurchase shares - often by far the most attractive option for capital utilization.)
1978.chinese: 如果我们全资拥有的企业能够以有吸引力的回报率在内部使用资金，我们完全不介意它们保留全部利润。那么，对于我们只拥有少量股权、却有经营记录表明能够更有利地运用资本的企业，为什么我们要对它们保留利润采取不同态度呢？（当然，这个判断也可能反过来：如果某个行业资本需求不高，或者管理层一贯把资金投入低回报项目，就应该把利润分配给股东，或者用来回购股票——后者往往是运用资本最有吸引力的方式。）

1978.english: The aggregate level of such retained earnings attributable to our equity interests in fine companies is becoming quite substantial.  It does not enter into our reported operating earnings, but we feel it well may have equal long-term significance to our shareholders.  Our hope is that conditions continue to prevail in securities markets which allow our insurance companies to buy large amounts of underlying earning power for relatively modest outlays.  At some point market conditions undoubtedly will again preclude such bargain buying but, in the meantime, we will try to make the most of opportunities.
1978.chinese: 归属于我们所持优秀企业股票的这类留存利润，合计金额正在变得相当可观。它们不计入我们报告的经营利润，但我们觉得，从长期看，它们对于伯克希尔股东可能同样重要。我们希望证券市场继续提供这样的条件，让保险公司可以用相对不多的支出买入大量企业底层盈利能力。当然，总有一天市场环境会再次使这样的便宜货无从买起；在此之前，我们会努力充分利用现有机会。

1978.english:
Banking

Under Gene Abegg and Pete Jeffrey, the Illinois National Bank and Trust Company in Rockford continues to establish new records.  Last year’s earnings amounted to approximately 2.1% of average assets, about three times the level averaged by major banks.  In our opinion, this extraordinary level of earnings is being achieved while maintaining significantly less asset risk than prevails at most of the larger banks.

We purchased the Illinois National Bank in March 1969.  It was a first-class operation then, just as it had been ever since Gene Abegg opened the doors in 1931.  Since 1968, consumer time deposits have quadrupled, net income has tripled and trust department income has more than doubled, while costs have been closely controlled.
1978.chinese:
## 银行业务

在吉恩·阿贝格（Gene Abegg）和皮特·杰弗里（Pete Jeffrey）的管理下，位于伊利诺伊州罗克福德的伊利诺伊国民银行及信托公司（Illinois National Bank and Trust Company）继续刷新纪录。去年该行利润约相当于平均资产的2.1%，约为大型银行平均水平的三倍。在我们看来，它在取得这一非凡盈利水平的同时，资产风险还显著低于大多数大型银行。

我们于1969年3月收购伊利诺伊国民银行。当时它就是一家一流的银行，正如1931年吉恩·阿贝格创办之日起一直如此。自1968年以来，个人定期存款增长了三倍、达到原来的四倍；净利润增至三倍，信托部门收入增长超过一倍，而成本始终受到严格控制。

1978.english:
Our experience has been that the manager of an already high- cost operation frequently is uncommonly resourceful in finding new ways to add to overhead, while the manager of a tightly-run operation usually continues to find additional methods to curtail costs, even when his costs are already well below those of his competitors.  No one has demonstrated this latter ability better than Gene Abegg.

We are required to divest our bank by December 31, 1980. The most likely approach is to spin it off to Berkshire shareholders some time in the second half of 1980.
1978.chinese:
我们的经验是，原本经营成本很高的企业，其管理者经常会异常富有创意地找到增加管理费用的新方法；而一家运营精简的企业，其管理者通常还会不断寻找削减成本的新办法，即使自己的成本已经远低于竞争对手。在后一种能力方面，没有人比吉恩·阿贝格表现得更好。

根据规定，我们必须在1980年12月31日之前剥离这家银行。最有可能的办法，是在1980年下半年某个时候把银行股权分拆分配给伯克希尔股东。

1978.english:
Retailing

Upon merging with Diversified, we acquired 100% ownership of Associated Retail Stores, Inc., a chain of about 75 popular priced women’s apparel stores.  Associated was launched in Chicago on March 7, 1931 with one store, $3200, and two extraordinary partners, Ben Rosner and Leo Simon.  After Mr. Simon’s death, the business was offered to Diversified for cash in 1967.  Ben was to continue running the business - and run it, he has.

Associated’s business has not grown, and it consistently has faced adverse demographic and retailing trends.  But Ben’s combination of merchandising, real estate and cost-containment skills has produced an outstanding record of profitability, with returns on capital necessarily employed in the business often in the 20% after-tax area.
1978.chinese:
## 零售业务

通过与多元化零售公司合并，我们取得了联合零售商店公司（Associated Retail Stores, Inc.）100%的股权。这是一家经营约75家大众价位女装店的连锁企业。1931年3月7日，本·罗斯纳（Ben Rosner）和利奥·西蒙（Leo Simon）两位非凡的合伙人，在芝加哥用3,200美元和一家商店创办了这项业务。西蒙先生去世后，1967年这家公司被提出以现金出售给多元化零售公司。协议安排由本继续经营——而他确实一直把企业经营得很好。

联合零售商店的业务并没有增长，而且持续面对不利的人口结构变化和零售业趋势。但本结合了商品经营、房地产与成本控制方面的能力，使公司创造出极佳的盈利记录：在经营必需资本上取得的税后回报率，经常处于20%左右的水平。

1978.english:
Ben is now 75 and, like Gene Abegg, 81, at Illinois National and Louie Vincenti, 73, at Wesco, continues daily to bring an almost passionately proprietary attitude to the business.  This group of top managers must appear to an outsider to be an overreaction on our part to an OEO bulletin on age discrimination.  While unorthodox, these relationships have been exceptionally rewarding, both financially and personally.  It is a real pleasure to work with managers who enjoy coming to work each morning and, once there, instinctively and unerringly think like owners.  We are associated with some of the very best.

## Warren E. Buffett, Chairman

March 26, 1979
1978.chinese:
本如今75岁；如同伊利诺伊国民银行81岁的吉恩·阿贝格，以及韦斯科73岁的路易·文森蒂（Louie Vincenti）一样，他每天仍以一种近乎热情洋溢的主人翁态度经营企业。外人看着我们这班高管的年龄，恐怕会以为，我们对OEO那份反年龄歧视通告响应得过了头。虽然这种合作关系不合常规，但无论从经济上还是个人感受上，都令我们收获极大。与那些每天早上乐于上班、到了公司就自然而然且准确无误地像所有者一样思考的管理者共事，真是一件快乐的事。我们合作的，是其中最出色的一些人。

沃伦·E·巴菲特，董事长

1979年3月26日

1979.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Again, we must lead off with a few words about accounting. Since our last annual report, the accounting profession has decided that equity securities owned by insurance companies must be carried on the balance sheet at market value.  We previously have carried such equity securities at the lower of aggregate cost or aggregate market value.  Because we have large unrealized gains in our insurance equity holdings, the result of this new policy is to increase substantially both the 1978 and 1979 yearend net worth, even after the appropriate liability is established for taxes on capital gains that would be payable should equities be sold at such market valuations.
1979.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

和往年一样，我们又得先谈几句会计问题。自从上一份年报寄出之后，会计界决定，保险公司持有的股票必须按市场价值计入资产负债表。此前，我们按股票投资总成本与总市值孰低的原则计价。由于我们保险子公司的股票投资存在大额未实现收益，即使对按当前市值卖出股票时应缴纳的资本利得税确认相应负债，这项新政策仍显著提高了1978年和1979年年末的净资产。

1979.english: As you know, Blue Chip Stamps, our 60% owned subsidiary, is fully consolidated in Berkshire Hathaway’s financial statements. However, Blue Chip still is required to carry its equity investments at the lower of aggregate cost or aggregate market value, just as Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance subsidiaries did prior to this year.  Should the same equities be purchased at an identical price by an insurance subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway and by Blue Chip Stamps, present accounting principles often would require that they end up carried on our consolidated balance sheet at two different values. (That should keep you on your toes.) Market values of Blue Chip Stamps’ equity holdings are given in footnote 3 on page 18.
1979.chinese: 各位知道，我们持有60%股权的子公司蓝筹印花公司（Blue Chip Stamps），已全面并入伯克希尔的合并财务报表。不过，蓝筹印花公司仍须像伯克希尔保险子公司在本年之前所做的那样，按其股票投资总成本与总市值孰低计价。假如伯克希尔的一家保险子公司与蓝筹印花公司，以完全相同的价格买入完全相同的股票，现行会计准则往往要求它们在合并资产负债表上按两个不同的价值列示。（这下各位可得打起精神了。）蓝筹印花公司股票持仓的市场价值见第18页附注3。

1979.english:
1979 Operating Results

We continue to feel that the ratio of operating earnings (before securities gains or losses) to shareholders’ equity with all securities valued at cost is the most appropriate way to measure any single year’s operating performance.

Measuring such results against shareholders’ equity with securities valued at market could significantly distort the operating performance percentage because of wide year-to-year market value changes in the net worth figure that serves as the denominator.  For example, a large decline in securities values could result in a very low “market value” net worth that, in turn, could cause mediocre operating earnings to look unrealistically good.  Alternatively, the more successful that equity investments have been, the larger the net worth base becomes and the poorer the operating performance figure appears. Therefore, we will continue to report operating performance measured against beginning net worth, with securities valued at cost.
1979.chinese:
## 1979年经营业绩

我们仍然认为，衡量单个年度经营业绩最合适的方法，是考察经营利润（不含证券投资收益或损失）与按成本计价全部证券后的股东权益之比。

如果用按市值计价证券后的股东权益作为分母，经营业绩百分比就会受到严重扭曲，因为净资产数字可能随着证券市值逐年发生巨额变化。例如，证券价值大幅下跌，会使按“市值”计算的净资产变得很低，从而使平庸的经营利润看起来异常优秀。反过来，股票投资越成功，净资产基数就越大，所显示的经营回报率反而越差。因此，我们将继续采用按成本计价证券后的年初净资产，衡量经营业绩。

1979.english: On this basis, we had a reasonably good operating performance in 1979 - but not quite as good as that of 1978 - with operating earnings amounting to 18.6% of beginning net worth.  Earnings per share, of course, increased somewhat (about 20%) but we regard this as an improper figure upon which to focus.  We had substantially more capital to work with in 1979 than in 1978, and our performance in utilizing that capital fell short of the earlier year, even though per-share earnings rose. “Earnings per share” will rise constantly on a dormant savings account or on a U.S. Savings Bond bearing a fixed rate of return simply because “earnings” (the stated interest rate) are continuously plowed back and added to the capital base.  Thus, even a “stopped clock” can look like a growth stock if the dividend payout ratio is low.
1979.chinese: 按照这一口径，我们1979年的经营表现相当不错，但略逊于1978年：经营利润相当于年初净资产的18.6%。每股利润当然有所增加（约20%），但我们认为，不应该把这个数字作为关注重点。1979年可供我们运用的资本显著多于1978年；尽管每股利润上升了，但我们利用这些资本的成绩却不及前一年。一个几乎无人管理的储蓄账户，或一只按固定利率计息的美国储蓄债券，其“每股利润”都会不断增长，原因不过是“利润”（既定利率产生的利息）持续留存并加入资本基数。因此，只要股息支付比例很低，即使一只“停摆的钟表”也可能看起来像成长股。

1979.english: The primary test of managerial economic performance is the achievement of a high earnings rate on equity capital employed (without undue leverage, accounting gimmickry, etc.) and not the achievement of consistent gains in earnings per share.  In our view, many businesses would be better understood by their shareholder owners, as well as the general public, if managements and financial analysts modified the primary emphasis they place upon earnings per share, and upon yearly changes in that figure.
1979.chinese: 衡量管理层经济业绩的首要标准，是在所运用的股东权益资本上取得较高的盈利率（且不依赖过度杠杆、会计把戏等），而不是每股利润能否持续增长。在我们看来，如果管理者和财务分析师不再把注意力主要放在每股利润以及这个数字的年度变动上，许多企业的股东和广大公众将能更好地理解这些企业。

1979.english:
## Long Term Results

In measuring long term economic performance - in contrast to yearly performance - we believe it is appropriate to recognize fully any realized capital gains or losses as well as extraordinary items, and also to utilize financial statements presenting equity securities at market value.  Such capital gains or losses, either realized or unrealized, are fully as important to shareholders over a period of years as earnings realized in a more routine manner through operations; it is just that their impact is often extremely capricious in the short run, a characteristic that makes them inappropriate as an indicator of single year managerial performance.
1979.chinese:
## 长期业绩

与衡量单个年度不同，我们认为，评估长期经济业绩时，应当完整考虑已实现资本收益或损失以及特殊项目，并使用按市场价值列示股票的财务报表。无论已实现还是未实现，资本收益或损失在多年时间里对于股东的重要性，都不亚于日常经营实现的利润。只是它们的短期影响往往极不稳定，这个特点使它们不适合作为衡量单一年份管理业绩的指标。

1979.english: The book value per share of Berkshire Hathaway on September 30, 1964 (the fiscal yearend prior to the time that your present management assumed responsibility) was $19.46 per share.  At yearend 1979, book value with equity holdings carried at market value was $335.85 per share.  The gain in book value comes to 20.5% compounded annually.  This figure, of course, is far higher than any average of our yearly operating earnings calculations, and reflects the importance of capital appreciation of insurance equity investments in determining the overall results for our shareholders.  It probably also is fair to say that the quoted book value in 1964 somewhat overstated the intrinsic value of the enterprise, since the assets owned at that time on either a going concern basis or a liquidating value basis were not worth 100 cents on the dollar. (The liabilities were solid, however.)
1979.chinese: 1964年9月30日，也就是现任管理层接手前的那个财年末，伯克希尔·哈撒韦的每股账面价值为19.46美元。到1979年年末，按股票市值计价后，每股账面价值达到335.85美元。账面价值年复合增长率为20.5%。当然，这远高于我们每年经营利润回报率计算值的任何平均数，反映了保险公司股票投资的资本增值，在决定股东总体回报方面的重要作用。公平地说，1964年的账面价值可能还在一定程度上高估了企业的内在价值，因为当时所持资产，无论按持续经营价值还是清算价值，都值不了账面上的每1美元。（不过，负债可是一分不差的。）

1979.english: We have achieved this result while utilizing a low amount of leverage (both financial leverage measured by debt to equity, and operating leverage measured by premium volume to capital funds of our insurance business), and also without significant issuance or repurchase of shares.  Basically, we have worked with the capital with which we started.  From our textile base we, or our Blue Chip and Wesco subsidiaries, have acquired total ownership of thirteen businesses through negotiated purchases from private owners for cash, and have started six others. (It’s worth a mention that those who have sold to us have, almost without exception, treated us with exceptional honor and fairness, both at the time of sale and subsequently.)
1979.chinese: 我们是在杠杆使用水平较低的情况下取得这一结果的：无论按债务与股东权益比例衡量财务杠杆，还是按保费业务量与保险资本之比衡量经营杠杆，都不高；同时，我们没有大量增发或回购股票。基本上，我们一直在运用最初拥有的资本。从纺织业务的基础起步，我们自己或者旗下的蓝筹印花公司和韦斯科子公司，通过与私人所有者谈判、支付现金，收购了13家企业的全部权益，并从头创办了另外6家。（值得一提的是，几乎毫无例外，向我们出售企业的人无论在交易时还是交易后，都以格外正直、公平的方式对待我们。）

1979.english: But before we drown in a sea of self-congratulation, a further - and crucial - observation must be made.  A few years ago, a business whose per-share net worth compounded at 20% annually would have guaranteed its owners a highly successful real investment return.  Now such an outcome seems less certain. For the inflation rate, coupled with individual tax rates, will be the ultimate determinant as to whether our internal operating performance produces successful investment results - i.e., a reasonable gain in purchasing power from funds committed - for you as shareholders.
1979.chinese: 不过，在我们淹没于自我赞美的海洋之前，还有个关键问题必须说清楚。几年前，一家企业如果每股净资产能以20%的速度持续复合增长，几乎可以保证所有者获得极其成功的实际投资回报。如今，这样的结果却不再那么确定。原因是，通货膨胀率加上个人税率，将最终决定我们内部经营业绩能否为各位股东带来成功的投资结果——也就是投入资金的购买力能否实现合理增长。

1979.english:
Just as the original 3% savings bond, a 5% passbook savings account or an 8% U.S. Treasury Note have, in turn, been transformed by inflation into financial instruments that chew up, rather than enhance, purchasing power over their investment lives, a business earning 20% on capital can produce a negative real return for its owners under inflationary conditions not much more severe than presently prevail.

If we should continue to achieve a 20% compounded gain - not an easy or certain result by any means - and this gain is translated into a corresponding increase in the market value of Berkshire Hathaway stock as it has been over the last fifteen years, your after-tax purchasing power gain is likely to be very close to zero at a 14% inflation rate.  Most of the remaining six percentage points will go for income tax any time you wish to convert your twenty percentage points of nominal annual gain into cash.
1979.chinese:
最初票面利率3%的储蓄债券、利率5%的存折储蓄账户以及收益率8%的美国国债，先后都被通货膨胀变成了在投资期限内侵蚀、而不是增加购买力的金融工具。类似地，当通胀环境只比目前略微严峻一些时，一家资本回报率达到20%的企业，也可能使所有者获得负的实际回报。

假如我们继续实现20%的复合增长——这绝非容易，也绝非确定——并且这项增长像过去15年一样，转化为伯克希尔股票市场价值相应的上升，那么在通胀率为14%的情况下，各位税后购买力的增长很可能接近零。剩余的六个百分点中，大部分会在各位想把名义上每年20%的增值兑现为现金时，用于缴纳所得税。

1979.english: That combination - the inflation rate plus the percentage of capital that must be paid by the owner to transfer into his own pocket the annual earnings achieved by the business (i.e., ordinary income tax on dividends and capital gains tax on retained earnings) - can be thought of as an “investor’s misery index”.  When this index exceeds the rate of return earned on equity by the business, the investor’s purchasing power (real capital) shrinks even though he consumes nothing at all.  We have no corporate solution to this problem; high inflation rates will not help us earn higher rates of return on equity.
1979.chinese: 通货膨胀率加上所有者为了把企业实现的年度利润转移到自己口袋里所必须支付的资本比例——也就是股息上的普通所得税和留存利润最终实现时的资本利得税——可以合称为“投资者痛苦指数”（investor's misery index）。当这个指数高于企业所实现的股东权益回报率时，即使投资者一分钱也不消费，其购买力（实际资本）也会缩水。我们没有公司层面的办法来解决这一问题；高通胀不会帮助我们提高股东权益回报率。

1979.english: One friendly but sharp-eyed commentator on Berkshire has pointed out that our book value at the end of 1964 would have bought about one-half ounce of gold and, fifteen years later, after we have plowed back all earnings along with much blood, sweat and tears, the book value produced will buy about the same half ounce.  A similar comparison could be drawn with Middle Eastern oil.  The rub has been that government has been exceptionally able in printing money and creating promises, but is unable to print gold or create oil.
1979.chinese: 一位对伯克希尔既友好、又目光敏锐的评论者指出：1964年年末我们的每股账面价值，大致可以买半盎司黄金；十五年过去了，尽管我们留存全部利润，付出了大量血汗与眼泪，创造出来的每股账面价值仍然只能买大约半盎司黄金。用中东石油作比较，也会得出类似结果。问题在于，政府在印钞票和创造承诺方面能力非凡，却不能印出黄金，也不能创造石油。

1979.english:
We intend to continue to do as well as we can in managing the internal affairs of the business.  But you should understand that external conditions affecting the stability of currency may very well be the most important factor in determining whether there are any real rewards from your investment in Berkshire Hathaway.

## Sources of Earnings

We again present a table showing the sources of Berkshire’s earnings.  As explained last year, Berkshire owns about 60% of Blue Chip Stamps which, in turn, owns 80% of Wesco Financial Corporation.  The table shows both aggregate earnings of the various business entities, as well as Berkshire’s share.  All of the significant capital gains or losses attributable to any of the business entities are aggregated in the realized securities gain figure at the bottom of the table, and are not included in operating earnings.
1979.chinese:
我们打算继续尽最大努力管理企业内部事务。但各位需要理解，影响货币稳定性的外部条件，很可能是决定伯克希尔·哈撒韦投资能否为各位带来实际回报的最重要因素。

## 利润来源

我们再次列示伯克希尔的利润来源表。如去年所述，伯克希尔拥有蓝筹印花公司约60%的股权，后者又持有韦斯科金融公司（Wesco Financial Corporation）80%的股权。表中既列出各业务实体的整体利润，也列出伯克希尔应占的份额。所有可归属于各业务实体的重大资本利得或损失，都统一汇总在表格末尾的“已实现证券收益”项目，不计入经营利润。

1979.english: Blue Chip and Wesco are public companies with reporting requirements of their own.  On pages 37-43 of this report, we have reproduced the narrative reports of the principal executives of both companies, in which they describe 1979 operations.  Some of the numbers they mention in their reports are not precisely identical to those in the above table because of accounting and tax complexities. (The Yanomamo Indians employ only three numbers: one, two, and more than two.  Maybe their time will come.) However, the commentary in those reports should be helpful to you in understanding the underlying economic characteristics and future prospects of the important businesses that they manage.
1979.chinese: 蓝筹印花公司和韦斯科都是上市公司，各自有独立的信息披露义务。在本报告第37—43页，我们转载了两家公司主要管理者对1979年经营情况的文字报告。由于会计与税务处理复杂，他们提到的一些数字与上表并非分毫不差。（亚诺马米印第安人只使用三个数字：一、二、超过二。也许他们的时代就要来了。）不过，这些管理者的说明应有助于各位理解其经营的重要业务的经济特性与未来前景。

1979.english:
A copy of the full annual report of either company will be mailed to any shareholder of Berkshire upon request to Mr. Robert H. Bird for Blue Chip Stamps, 5801 South Eastern Avenue, Los Angeles, California 90040, or to Mrs. Bette Deckard for Wesco Financial Corporation, 315 East Colorado Boulevard, Pasadena, California 91109.

## Textiles and Retailing

The relative significance of these two areas has diminished somewhat over the years as our insurance business has grown dramatically in size and earnings.  Ben Rosner, at Associated Retail Stores, continues to pull rabbits out of the hat - big rabbits from a small hat.  Year after year, he produces very large earnings relative to capital employed - realized in cash and not in increased receivables and inventories as in many other retail businesses - in a segment of the market with little growth and unexciting demographics.  Ben is now 76 and, like our other “up-and-comers”, Gene Abegg, 82, at Illinois National and Louis Vincenti, 74, at Wesco, regularly achieves more each year.
1979.chinese:
伯克希尔股东如需其中任何一家公司的完整年报，可以向Robert H. Bird先生索取蓝筹印花公司年报，地址为Blue Chip Stamps, 5801 South Eastern Avenue, Los Angeles, California 90040；或者向Bette Deckard女士索取韦斯科金融公司年报，地址为Wesco Financial Corporation, 315 East Colorado Boulevard, Pasadena, California 91109。

## 纺织与零售业务

随着保险业务规模和盈利大幅增长，纺织和零售这两个领域的相对重要性已在多年间有所下降。联合零售商店公司的本·罗斯纳（Ben Rosner）仍在不断从帽子里变出兔子——小帽子里变出大兔子。在增长不大、人口结构趋势也不令人振奋的市场领域，他年复一年取得相对于所用资本很高的利润，而且这些利润真正变成了现金，而不像许多其他零售企业那样只变成越来越多的应收账款和存货。本现在76岁，和我们的其他“后起之秀”——伊利诺伊国民银行82岁的吉恩·阿贝格（Gene Abegg）及韦斯科74岁的路易·文森蒂（Louis Vincenti）——一样，每一年都能取得更多成绩。

1979.english: Our textile business also continues to produce some cash, but at a low rate compared to capital employed.  This is not a reflection on the managers, but rather on the industry in which they operate.  In some businesses - a network TV station, for example - it is virtually impossible to avoid earning extraordinary returns on tangible capital employed in the business.  And assets in such businesses sell at equally extraordinary prices, one thousand cents or more on the dollar, a valuation reflecting the splendid, almost unavoidable, economic results obtainable.  Despite a fancy price tag, the “easy” business may be the better route to go.
1979.chinese: 我们的纺织业务仍能产生一些现金，但相对于所用资本，回报率很低。这并不是管理者的问题，而是他们所处行业的问题。有些业务——比如一家全国性电视网的电视台——几乎不可能不在其经营所用有形资本上取得非凡回报。这些企业的资产也会以同样惊人的价格出售：每1美元账面资产价值可卖到10美元甚至更多。这种估值反映了它们能够实现的出色、近乎不可避免的经济业绩。即使标价昂贵，“容易经营”的生意仍可能是更好的选择。

1979.english: We can speak from experience, having tried the other route. Your Chairman made the decision a few years ago to purchase Waumbec Mills in Manchester, New Hampshire, thereby expanding our textile commitment.  By any statistical test, the purchase price was an extraordinary bargain; we bought well below the working capital of the business and, in effect, got very substantial amounts of machinery and real estate for less than nothing.  But the purchase was a mistake.  While we labored mightily, new problems arose as fast as old problems were tamed.
1979.chinese: 我们对此有亲身经验，因为也尝试过另一条路。几年前，你们的董事长决定收购新罕布什尔州曼彻斯特的沃姆贝克纺织厂（Waumbec Mills），进一步增加对纺织业务的投入。按照任何统计指标看，这笔收购价格都极其便宜：我们以远低于企业营运资金的价格买下公司，实际上，大量机器设备和房地产到手的价格，比白送还便宜。但这笔收购是个错误。尽管我们费尽力气，旧问题刚刚得到控制，新问题便以同样速度出现。

1979.english: Both our operating and investment experience cause us to conclude that “turnarounds” seldom turn, and that the same energies and talent are much better employed in a good business purchased at a fair price than in a poor business purchased at a bargain price.  Although a mistake, the Waumbec acquisition has not been a disaster.  Certain portions of the operation are proving to be valuable additions to our decorator line (our strongest franchise) at New Bedford, and it’s possible that we may be able to run profitably on a considerably reduced scale at Manchester.  However, our original rationale did not prove out.
1979.chinese: 无论经营经验还是投资经验都让我们得出结论：所谓“翻身”的企业，很少真能翻身。与其以便宜价格买入糟糕的企业，再投入大量精力和才华，不如以合理价格买入优秀企业，把同样的精力和才华用在那里。虽然沃姆贝克收购是个错误，但也不是灾难。其部分业务已证明有助于新贝德福德工厂的装饰面料业务（我们最强的特许经营优势）；在曼彻斯特，我们也许能以大幅缩小的规模实现盈利。不过，我们最初的收购理由并未得到验证。

1979.english:
## Insurance Underwriting

We predicted last year that the combined underwriting ratio (see definition on page 36) for the insurance industry would “move up at least a few points, perhaps enough to throw the industry as a whole into an underwriting loss position”.  That is just about the way it worked out.  The industry underwriting ratio rose in 1979 over three points, from roughly 97.4% to 100.7%. We also said that we thought our underwriting performance relative to the industry would improve somewhat in 1979 and, again, things worked out as expected.  Our own underwriting ratio actually decreased from 98.2% to 97.1%. Our forecast for 1980 is similar in one respect; again we feel that the industry’s performance will worsen by at least another few points.  However, this year we have no reason to think that our performance relative to the industry will further improve. (Don’t worry - we won’t hold back to try to validate that forecast.)
1979.chinese:
## 保险承保业务

去年我们预测，保险行业的综合承保比率（定义见原年报第36页）“至少会上升几个百分点，甚至可能足以使全行业转为承保亏损”。事实基本如此。1979年，全行业综合成本率上升了三个多百分点，从约97.4%升至100.7%。我们当时还表示，预计自己的承保表现相对于行业平均水平会在1979年略有改善，这也成为事实。我们的综合成本率实际上从98.2%下降到了97.1%。我们对1980年的预测有一方面相似：我们依然认为，全行业的表现至少还会恶化几个百分点。但今年没有理由认为，我们相对于行业的表现会继续改善。（别担心——我们可不会为了让预测应验，就故意放慢脚步。）

1979.english:
Really extraordinary results were turned in by the portion of National Indemnity Company’s insurance operation run by Phil Liesche.  Aided by Roland Miller in Underwriting and Bill Lyons in Claims, this section of the business produced an underwriting profit of $8.4 million on about $82 million of earned premiums. Only a very few companies in the entire industry produced a result comparable to this.

You will notice that earned premiums in this segment were down somewhat from those of 1978.  We hear a great many insurance managers talk about being willing to reduce volume in order to underwrite profitably, but we find that very few actually do so. Phil Liesche is an exception: if business makes sense, he writes it; if it doesn’t, he rejects it.  It is our policy not to lay off people because of the large fluctuations in work load produced by such voluntary volume changes.  We would rather have some slack in the organization from time to time than keep everyone terribly busy writing business on which we are going to lose money.  Jack Ringwalt, the founder of National Indemnity Company, instilled this underwriting discipline at the inception of the company, and Phil Liesche never has wavered in maintaining it.  We believe such strong-mindedness is as rare as it is sound - and absolutely essential to the running of a first-class casualty insurance operation.
1979.chinese:
国家赔偿保险公司由菲尔·利舍（Phil Liesche）负责的部门，取得了真正非凡的成绩。在核保工作的罗兰·米勒（Roland Miller）和理赔工作的比尔·莱昂斯（Bill Lyons）协助下，该部门以约8,200万美元的已赚保费，实现了承保利润840万美元。在整个保险行业中，能取得类似结果的公司屈指可数。

各位会注意到，这一部门的已赚保费比1978年有所下降。我们听过许多保险公司管理者说，自己愿意为了取得承保利润而减少业务量，但真正这样做的人少之又少。菲尔·利舍是例外：一笔业务如果合乎经济理性，他就承保；如果不合适，他就拒绝。我们的政策是，不会因为这种主动调整业务量导致工作量大幅波动，就裁减员工。我们宁愿组织中偶尔有一些闲置能力，也不愿让所有人忙得不可开交地承保那些最终会亏钱的业务。国家赔偿保险公司的创始人杰克·林沃尔特（Jack Ringwalt）在创办之初就确立了这种承保纪律，菲尔·利舍始终坚持不渝。我们认为，这种坚定的意志既罕见，又十分正确，而且是经营一家一流意外伤害责任保险公司绝对必要的条件。

1979.english:
John Seward continues to make solid progress at Home and Automobile Insurance Company, in large part by significantly expanding the marketing scope of that company in general liability lines.  These lines can be dynamite, but the record to date is excellent and, in John McGowan and Paul Springman, we have two cautious liability managers extending our capabilities.

Our reinsurance division, led by George Young, continues to give us reasonably satisfactory overall results after allowing for investment income, but underwriting performance remains unsatisfactory.  We think the reinsurance business is a very tough business that is likely to get much tougher.  In fact, the influx of capital into the business and the resulting softer price levels for continually increasing exposures may well produce disastrous results for many entrants (of which they may be blissfully unaware until they are in over their heads; much reinsurance business involves an exceptionally “long tail”, a characteristic that allows catastrophic current loss experience to fester undetected for many years).  It will be hard for us to be a whole lot smarter than the crowd and thus our reinsurance activity may decline substantially during the projected prolonged period of extraordinary competition.
1979.chinese:
约翰·苏厄德（John Seward）继续使家庭与汽车保险公司（Home and Automobile Insurance Company）稳步改善，其中一个重要做法，是显著扩大了公司在一般责任保险领域的市场业务范围。这类业务可能像炸药一样危险，但迄今的经营记录非常优秀。约翰·麦高恩（John McGowan）和保罗·斯普林曼（Paul Springman）是两位谨慎的责任保险管理者，他们正在帮助我们拓展能力。

乔治·杨（George Young）负责的再保险部门，考虑投资收益后的总体结果仍算比较令人满意，但承保业绩依然不理想。我们认为，再保险是一门非常艰难的生意，未来很可能变得更加艰难。事实上，大量资本涌入行业，使不断增大的风险敞口对应的保费价格持续走软，很可能让许多新进入者遭遇灾难性后果——在深陷其中之前，他们也许还会对此浑然不觉。许多再保险业务具有异常漫长的“尾部”，使眼下灾难性的赔付经历可以在多年间一直潜伏不被发现。我们很难比大多数同行聪明很多，因此，预计在持续很长一段时间的异常激烈竞争中，我们的再保险业务量可能大幅下降。

1979.english: The Homestate operation was disappointing in 1979. Excellent results again were turned in by George Billings at Texas United Insurance Company, winner of the annual award for the low loss ratio among Homestate companies, and Floyd Taylor at Kansas Fire and Casualty Company.  But several of the other operations, particularly Cornhusker Casualty Company, our first and largest Homestate operation and historically a winner, had poor underwriting results which were accentuated by data processing, administrative and personnel problems.  We have made some major mistakes in reorganizing our data processing activities, and those mistakes will not be cured immediately or without cost.  However, John Ringwalt has thrown himself into the task of getting things straightened out and we have confidence that he, aided by several strong people who recently have been brought aboard, will succeed.
1979.chinese: 1979年，地方保险公司（Homestate）的经营表现令人失望。得克萨斯联合保险公司（Texas United Insurance Company）的乔治·比林斯（George Billings），以及堪萨斯火灾与意外保险公司（Kansas Fire and Casualty Company）的弗洛伊德·泰勒（Floyd Taylor），再次取得优秀结果。乔治还获得了地方保险公司年度最低赔付率奖。但是，其他几个业务部门的承保表现不佳，特别是我们的第一家、也是规模最大的地方保险业务Cornhusker Casualty Company。它过去一向表现优秀，这次的差劲承保结果又受到数据处理、行政管理和人员问题的进一步影响。我们在重组数据处理工作时犯过一些重大错误，这些错误既不能马上纠正，也不可能不付出代价。不过，约翰·林沃尔特已全力投入整顿工作，我们相信，在最近加入的几位能力很强的同事协助下，他一定能够成功。

1979.english: Our performance in Worker’s Compensation was far, far better than we had any right to expect at the beginning of 1979.  We had a very favorable climate in California for the achievement of good results but, beyond this, Milt Thornton at Cypress Insurance Company and Frank DeNardo at National Indemnity’s California Worker’s Compensation operation both performed in a simply outstanding manner.  We have admitted - and with good reason - some mistakes on the acquisition front, but the Cypress purchase has turned out to be an absolute gem.  Milt Thornton, like Phil Liesche, follows the policy of sticking with business that he understands and wants, without giving consideration to the impact on volume.  As a result, he has an outstanding book of business and an exceptionally well functioning group of employees.  Frank DeNardo has straightened out the mess he inherited in Los Angeles in a manner far beyond our expectations, producing savings measured in seven figures.  He now can begin to build on a sound base.
1979.chinese: 工伤赔偿保险的成绩远远、远远好于我们在1979年年初有理由期待的水平。加利福尼亚州当时的行业环境十分有利于取得良好成绩；除此之外，赛普拉斯保险公司的米尔特·桑顿（Milt Thornton），以及国家赔偿保险公司加利福尼亚州工伤赔偿业务的弗兰克·德纳尔多（Frank DeNardo），也都表现得格外出色。我们承认过一些收购方面的错误，而且是有充分理由这样承认；但收购赛普拉斯最终证明是一件货真价实的宝贝。米尔特与菲尔·利舍一样，只做自己理解并且愿意承保的业务，不考虑这样做对业务量有什么影响。结果，他拥有优质的保单组合和运转格外良好的员工团队。弗兰克对洛杉矶原来那摊混乱业务的整顿，远超我们的预期，节省的成本以百万美元计。如今，他终于能够在稳固的基础上开展下一步工作。

1979.english: At yearend we entered the specialized area of surety reinsurance under the management of Chet Noble.  At least initially, this operation will be relatively small since our policy will be to seek client companies who appreciate the need for a long term “partnership” relationship with their reinsurers. We are pleased by the quality of the insurers we have attracted, and hope to add several more of the best primary writers as our financial strength and stability become better known in the surety field.
1979.chinese: 年末，我们在切特·诺布尔（Chet Noble）的管理下进入了保证保险再保险这一专业领域。至少最初阶段，业务规模会比较小，因为我们的政策是寻找那些理解有必要与再保险公司建立长期“伙伴关系”的客户公司。我们对已经吸引来的保险公司质量感到高兴，并希望随着自身财务实力和稳定性在保证保险领域更为人所知，再增加几家最优秀的直接承保公司作为客户。

1979.english: The conventional wisdom is that insurance underwriting overall will be poor in 1980, but that rates will start to firm in a year or so, leading to a turn in the cycle some time in 1981.  We disagree with this view.  Present interest rates encourage the obtaining of business at underwriting loss levels formerly regarded as totally unacceptable.  Managers decry the folly of underwriting at a loss to obtain investment income, but we believe that many will.  Thus we expect that competition will create a new threshold of tolerance for underwriting losses, and that combined ratios will average higher in the future than in the past.
1979.chinese: 保险业的普遍看法是，1980年整体承保表现将很糟糕，但保费费率大约在一年后开始趋于坚挺，行业周期将在1981年某个时候转向。我们不同意这种看法。当前利率水平鼓励保险公司即使承受过去认为完全不能接受的承保亏损，也要争取业务。管理者纷纷谴责为了获得投资收益而亏损承保的愚蠢做法，但我们认为，很多人还是会这样做。因此，我们预计竞争会为承保亏损建立新的容忍门槛，使未来的平均综合成本率高于过去。

1979.english:
To some extent, the day of reckoning has been postponed because of marked reduction in the frequency of auto accidents - probably brought on in major part by changes in driving habits induced by higher gas prices.  In our opinion, if the habits hadn’t changed, auto insurance rates would have been very little higher and underwriting results would have been much worse.  This dosage of serendipity won’t last indefinitely.

Our forecast is for an average combined ratio for the industry in the 105 area over the next five years.  While we have a high degree of confidence that certain of our operations will do considerably better than average, it will be a challenge to us to operate below the industry figure.  You can get a lot of surprises in insurance.
1979.chinese:
在一定程度上，汽车事故发生频率显著下降，推迟了行业面临清算的那一天。这种下降可能主要来自汽油价格上涨所引发的驾驶习惯变化。我们认为，如果驾驶习惯没有改变，汽车保险费率也不会高出多少，但承保结果会差得多。这样的意外好运不会永远持续。

我们预计，未来五年全行业平均综合成本率将在105左右。虽然我们很有把握，旗下某些业务会大幅优于行业平均水平，但要使公司总体成本率低于行业平均仍是一个挑战。保险业务总会给人带来许多意外。

1979.english: Nevertheless, we believe that insurance can be a very good business.  It tends to magnify, to an unusual degree, human managerial talent - or the lack of it.  We have a number of managers whose talent is both proven and growing. (And, in addition, we have a very large indirect interest in two truly outstanding management groups through our investments in SAFECO and GEICO.) Thus we expect to do well in insurance over a period of years.  However, the business has the potential for really terrible results in a single specific year.  If accident frequency should turn around quickly in the auto field, we, along with others, are likely to experience such a year.
1979.chinese: 尽管如此，我们仍相信，保险可以是一门非常好的生意。这个行业会以不同寻常的程度，放大管理者才华——或者管理能力的缺乏。我们拥有多位能力已得到证明、而且仍在不断成长的管理者。（此外，通过投资SAFECO和GEICO，我们还间接拥有两组真正杰出的管理团队相当大的权益。）因此，我们预计保险业务在多年期间会有良好表现。不过，这个行业也完全可能在某一个特定年度出现极其糟糕的结果。如果汽车事故发生频率很快逆转上升，我们与其他保险公司都可能遇到这样的一年。

1979.english:
## Insurance Investments

In recent years we have written at length in this section about our insurance equity investments.  In 1979 they continued to perform well, largely because the underlying companies in which we have invested, in practically all cases, turned in outstanding performances.  Retained earnings applicable to our insurance equity investments, not reported in our financial statements, continue to mount annually and, in aggregate, now come to a very substantial number.  We have faith that the managements of these companies will utilize those retained earnings effectively and will translate a dollar retained by them into a dollar or more of subsequent market value for us.  In part, our unrealized gains reflect this process.
1979.chinese:
## 保险投资

近几年，我们在这一节用了大量篇幅讨论保险公司的股票投资。1979年它们继续取得良好成绩，主要是因为在几乎所有投资案例中，我们所持有的底层企业都取得了杰出经营业绩。属于我们保险股票投资份额的留存利润，虽然没有计入财务报表，但每年继续增长，合计数额如今已相当可观。我们相信，这些公司的管理团队会有效运用留存利润，把他们留存的每1美元转化为我们随后获得的1美元或更多的市值。我们的部分未实现收益，正是这个过程的体现。

下面列出年末市值超过500万美元的股票投资：
