（b）Blue Chip和／或Wesco持有这些公司的股份。表中所有数字均表示伯克希尔在集团更大规模总持仓中的净权益。

从这张表可以看出，我们的基础盈利能力来源，在行业之间的分布，与从表面上观察所得出的印象相当不同。例如，我们的保险子公司拥有Kaiser Aluminum约3%的股份，以及Alcoa约1¼%的股份。我们按比例应享有的这两家公司1980年利润约为1,300万美元。（如果这些利润最终一美元不差地转化为市值增值和股息，总额还须扣除一笔可观但无法精确确定的税款；假定25%可能比较合理。）因此，在铝行业中，我们拥有的经济利益，大于几乎任何一家由我们直接控制、并且在报告中更详细讨论其经营的企业。如果我们继续持有这些股票，那么长期业绩受到铝行业未来经济状况的影响，将大于我们对大多数管理控制企业直接作出的经营决策所产生的影响。

1980.english:
GEICO Corp.

Our largest non-controlled holding is 7.2 million shares of GEICO Corp., equal to about a 33% equity interest.  Normally, an interest of this magnitude (over 20%) would qualify as an “investee” holding and would require us to reflect a proportionate share of GEICO’s earnings in our own.  However, we purchased our GEICO stock pursuant to special orders of the District of Columbia and New York Insurance Departments, which required that the right to vote the stock be placed with an independent party.  Absent the vote, our 33% interest does not qualify for investee treatment. (Pinkerton’s is a similar situation.)
1980.chinese:
## GEICO公司

我们持有的最大一项非控股投资，是GEICO公司的720万股股票，约占该公司33%的股权。通常如此高的持股比例（超过20%）应该被视为采用权益法的投资，我们就必须在自己的利润中反映GEICO按比例归属我们的利润。不过，我们购买GEICO股票时，遵照哥伦比亚特区和纽约州保险监管部门的特别命令，必须把这些股票的表决权交给独立第三方行使。由于没有表决权，我们的33%持股不能采用这种会计处理。（Pinkerton’s也有类似情形。）

1980.english:
Of course, whether or not the undistributed earnings of GEICO are picked up annually in our operating earnings figure has nothing to do with their economic value to us, or to you as owners of Berkshire.  The value of these retained earnings will be determined by the skill with which they are put to use by GEICO management.

On this score, we simply couldn’t feel better.  GEICO represents the best of all investment worlds - the coupling of a very important and very hard to duplicate business advantage with an extraordinary management whose skills in operations are matched by skills in capital allocation.
1980.chinese:
当然，GEICO未分配利润是否每年计入我们的经营利润，完全不影响这些利润对我们、或对各位伯克希尔所有者的经济价值。其留存利润究竟值多少钱，取决于GEICO管理层运用它们的能力。

在这一点上，我们再满意不过。GEICO把投资中最理想的条件凑到了一起：一项意义重大、极难复制的商业优势，与一支非凡的管理团队结合在一起；这支团队不仅善于经营，也善于资本配置。

1980.english: As you can see, our holdings cost us $47 million, with about half of this amount invested in 1976 and most of the remainder invested in 1980.  At the present dividend rate, our reported earnings from GEICO amount to a little over $3 million annually. But we estimate our share of its earning power is on the order of $20 million annually.  Thus, undistributed earnings applicable to this holding alone may amount to 40% of total reported operating earnings of Berkshire.
1980.chinese: 从表中可见，我们的GEICO持仓成本为4,700万美元，约一半资金投入于1976年，余下大部分投入于1980年。按照目前的股息发放水平，我们从GEICO确认的报告利润每年仅略高于300万美元。但我们估计，按持股比例应享有的盈利能力每年约为2,000万美元。因此，单单这项持股所对应的未分配利润，就可能相当于伯克希尔报告经营利润总额的40%。

1980.english: We should emphasize that we feel as comfortable with GEICO management retaining an estimated $17 million of earnings applicable to our ownership as we would if that sum were in our own hands.  In just the last two years GEICO, through repurchases of its own stock, has reduced the share equivalents it has outstanding from 34.2 million to 21.6 million, dramatically enhancing the interests of shareholders in a business that simply can’t be replicated.  The owners could not have been better served.
1980.chinese: 我们要强调，对GEICO管理层留存归属我们权益的约1,700万美元利润，我们和亲手掌握这笔钱一样放心。仅在过去两年，GEICO通过回购自身股份，把折算后的流通股数量从3,420万股减少到2,160万股，显著提高了股东在这项根本无法复制的业务中所占的权益。管理层不可能以更好的方式服务股东了。

1980.english: We have written in past reports about the disappointments that usually result from purchase and operation of “turnaround” businesses.  Literally hundreds of turnaround possibilities in dozens of industries have been described to us over the years and, either as participants or as observers, we have tracked performance against expectations.  Our conclusion is that, with few exceptions, when a management with a reputation for brilliance tackles a business with a reputation for poor fundamental economics, it is the reputation of the business that remains intact.
1980.chinese: 过去的报告中，我们谈到过收购和经营“扭亏为盈”企业通常令人失望的结果。多年来，来自数十个行业的数百个扭亏机会被介绍给我们；无论作为参与者还是观察者，我们都追踪过实际结果与预期的差距。我们的结论是：除极少数例外，一位以才华横溢著称的管理者，若接手一家以糟糕基本经济特性著称的企业，最终保持不变的通常是那家企业的名声。

1980.english:
GEICO may appear to be an exception, having been turned around from the very edge of bankruptcy in 1976.  It certainly is true that managerial brilliance was needed for its resuscitation, and that Jack Byrne, upon arrival in that year, supplied that ingredient in abundance.

But it also is true that the fundamental business advantage that GEICO had enjoyed - an advantage that previously had produced staggering success - was still intact within the company, although submerged in a sea of financial and operating troubles.
1980.chinese:
GEICO看起来似乎是个例外，因为它在1976年从破产边缘被挽救回来。确实，企业复苏需要卓越的管理才能，而杰克·伯恩（Jack Byrne）在那一年到任后，充分提供了这一因素。

但同样真实的是，GEICO过去享有、并曾创造惊人成功的基本商业优势，当时仍然存在，只不过被严重的财务和经营问题淹没了。

1980.english:
GEICO was designed to be the low-cost operation in an enormous marketplace (auto insurance) populated largely by companies whose marketing structures restricted adaptation.  Run as designed, it could offer unusual value to its customers while earning unusual returns for itself.  For decades it had been run in just this manner.  Its troubles in the mid-70s were not produced by any diminution or disappearance of this essential economic advantage.

GEICO’s problems at that time put it in a position analogous to that of American Express in 1964 following the salad oil scandal.  Both were one-of-a-kind companies, temporarily reeling from the effects of a fiscal blow that did not destroy their exceptional underlying economics.  The GEICO and American Express situations, extraordinary business franchises with a localized excisable cancer (needing, to be sure, a skilled surgeon), should be distinguished from the true “turnaround” situation in which the managers expect - and need - to pull off a corporate Pygmalion.
1980.chinese:
GEICO的商业设计，是在一个规模庞大的市场——汽车保险——中成为低成本经营者，而该市场多数公司的销售结构限制了它们的适应能力。如果按照原本设计经营，GEICO就能够在为客户提供非凡价值的同时，为自己创造非凡回报。几十年来，它确实一直如此运作。20世纪70年代中期出现的麻烦，并不是因为这种关键经济优势减弱或消失。

GEICO当时的处境，与1964年“色拉油丑闻”之后的美国运通类似。两者都是独一无二的公司，暂时遭到财务打击而步履蹒跚，但底层的卓越经济特性并未被摧毁。GEICO和美国运通属于拥有非凡商业特许经营优势、却患上局部可切除癌症的情形（当然，需要一位技艺高超的外科医生）；应将它们与真正意义上的“扭亏为盈”企业区分开来，后者的管理层期待、而且必须完成一场企业版的皮格马利翁式改造。

1980.english: Whatever the appellation, we are delighted with our GEICO holding which, as noted, cost us $47 million.  To buy a similar $20 million of earning power in a business with first-class economic characteristics and bright prospects would cost a minimum of $200 million (much more in some industries) if it had to be accomplished through negotiated purchase of an entire company.  A 100% interest of that kind gives the owner the options of leveraging the purchase, changing managements, directing cash flow, and selling the business.  It may also provide some excitement around corporate headquarters (less frequently mentioned).
1980.chinese: 无论怎么称呼，我们都对GEICO的持股欣喜不已。如前所述，成本为4,700万美元。如果通过谈判收购一家拥有一流经济特性、前景光明的完整企业，要取得类似每年2,000万美元的盈利能力，至少需要2亿美元（某些行业的价格远高于此）。100%拥有一家公司，也能让所有者拥有借款加杠杆、更换管理层、决定现金流用途以及出售企业的权力。它可能还会让公司总部多一些热闹（这一点较少被提及）。

1980.english: We find it perfectly satisfying that the nature of our insurance business dictates we buy many minority portions of already well-run businesses (at prices far below our share of the total value of the entire business) that do not need management change, re-direction of cash flow, or sale.  There aren’t many Jack Byrnes in the managerial world, or GEICOs in the business world.  What could be better than buying into a partnership with both of them?
1980.chinese: 我们非常满意保险业务所决定的投资方式：以远低于按整家公司价值所计算的对应权益价格，购买许多已经经营得很好的企业的一小部分股份。这些企业不需要更换管理层、重新安排现金流或出售。管理界没有多少杰克·伯恩，商业世界也没有多少GEICO。能够同时与他们成为合伙人，还有什么更好的事呢？

1980.english:
## Insurance Industry Conditions

The insurance industry’s underwriting picture continues to unfold about as we anticipated, with the combined ratio (see definition on page 37) rising from 100.6 in 1979 to an estimated 103.5 in 1980.  It is virtually certain that this trend will continue and that industry underwriting losses will mount, significantly and progressively, in 1981 and 1982.  To understand why, we recommend that you read the excellent analysis of property-casualty competitive dynamics done by Barbara Stewart of Chubb Corp. in an October 1980 paper. (Chubb’s annual report consistently presents the most insightful, candid and well- written discussion of industry conditions; you should get on the company’s mailing list.) Mrs. Stewart’s analysis may not be cheerful, but we think it is very likely to be accurate.
1980.chinese:
## 保险行业状况

保险业承保业绩的变化，大致与我们的预期一致：行业综合成本率（定义见原报告第37页）由1979年的100.6上升到1980年估计的103.5。几乎可以肯定，这一趋势会持续，1981年和1982年的行业承保亏损将逐步而显著地增加。要理解原因，我们建议各位阅读Chubb公司芭芭拉·斯图尔特（Barbara Stewart）在1980年10月撰写的财产及意外伤害保险竞争动态分析。（Chubb的年度报告始终对行业状况作出最有洞见、最坦诚、也最精彩的讨论；各位值得加入它的报告邮寄名单。）斯图尔特女士的分析未必令人振奋，但我们认为极有可能准确。

1980.english:
And, unfortunately, a largely unreported but particularly pernicious problem may well prolong and intensify the coming industry agony.  It is not only likely to keep many insurers scrambling for business when underwriting losses hit record levels - it is likely to cause them at such a time to redouble their efforts.

This problem arises from the decline in bond prices and the insurance accounting convention that allows companies to carry bonds at amortized cost, regardless of market value.  Many insurers own long-term bonds that, at amortized cost, amount to two to three times net worth.  If the level is three times, of course, a one-third shrink from cost in bond prices - if it were to be recognized on the books - would wipe out net worth.  And shrink they have.  Some of the largest and best known property- casualty companies currently find themselves with nominal, or even negative, net worth when bond holdings are valued at market. Of course their bonds could rise in price, thereby partially, or conceivably even fully, restoring the integrity of stated net worth.  Or they could fall further. (We believe that short-term forecasts of stock or bond prices are useless.  The forecasts may tell you a great deal about the forecaster; they tell you nothing about the future.)
1980.chinese:
不幸的是，还有一个尚未得到充分报道、却特别有害的问题，可能使即将到来的行业痛苦延长并加剧。它不仅可能让许多保险公司即使在承保亏损创下纪录时仍然争抢业务，甚至会促使它们进一步加大争抢力度。

这个问题源于债券价格下跌，以及保险会计允许公司不论市值如何变化，仍按摊余成本记载债券的惯例。许多保险公司持有的长期债券，按摊余成本计量时，是其净资产的两至三倍。假设倍数为三，那么债券价格相对于成本下跌三分之一，只要在账面确认，就会抹去全部净资产。现在价格确实大幅下跌了。一些规模最大、最知名的财产及意外伤害保险公司，如果把债券按市场价值计价，其净资产已经所剩无几，甚至变为负数。当然，债券价格可能回升，部分、甚至全部恢复账面净资产的真实基础；也可能继续下跌。（我们认为，预测股票或债券的短期价格没有用。预测结果可能让你非常了解预测者，却不会告诉你未来是什么样。）

1980.english: It might strike some as strange that an insurance company’s survival is threatened when its stock portfolio falls sufficiently in price to reduce net worth significantly, but that an even greater decline in bond prices produces no reaction at all.  The industry would respond by pointing out that, no matter what the current price, the bonds will be paid in full at maturity, thereby eventually eliminating any interim price decline.  It may take twenty, thirty, or even forty years, this argument says, but, as long as the bonds don’t have to be sold, in the end they’ll all be worth face value.  Of course, if they are sold even if they are replaced with similar bonds offering better relative value - the loss must be booked immediately. And, just as promptly, published net worth must be adjusted downward by the amount of the loss.
1980.chinese: 有人可能觉得奇怪：保险公司的股票投资组合如果跌幅足够大，使净资产显著缩水，就会威胁公司生存；然而债券价格即便跌得更多，行业在会计上却可以毫无反应。行业对此会解释说，不论当前市场价格如何，债券到期时都会得到全额偿付，因此任何中途价格下跌最终都会消失。按照这一说法，可能需要二十、三十甚至四十年，但只要不被迫卖出，最终所有债券都将值回面值。当然，如果卖出债券——即使目的是换入相对更有价值、但性质相似的债券——亏损就必须立即入账；公司公布的净资产也必须相应及时调减。

1980.english:
Under such circumstances, a great many investment options disappear, perhaps for decades.  For example, when large underwriting losses are in prospect, it may make excellent business logic for some insurers to shift from tax-exempt bonds into taxable bonds.  Unwillingness to recognize major bond losses may be the sole factor that prevents such a sensible move.

But the full implications flowing from massive unrealized bond losses are far more serious than just the immobilization of investment intellect.  For the source of funds to purchase and hold those bonds is a pool of money derived from policyholders and claimants (with changing faces) - money which, in effect, is temporarily on deposit with the insurer.  As long as this pool retains its size, no bonds must be sold.  If the pool of funds shrinks - which it will if the volume of business declines significantly - assets must be sold to pay off the liabilities. And if those assets consist of bonds with big unrealized losses, such losses will rapidly become realized, decimating net worth in the process.
1980.chinese:
在这种情况下，大量投资选择便会消失，甚至可能持续几十年。例如，如果预计承保将遭受重大亏损，对于一些保险公司来说，从免税债券转向应税债券，在商业上可能完全合理。但不愿确认大额债券亏损，可能成为阻止这种明智调整的唯一因素。

巨额未实现债券亏损的全部后果，却远不止让投资决策陷入停滞。因为购买和持有这些债券的资金，来自保户和索赔人（具体的人会不断变化）交给保险公司管理的资金池；从实质上说，这些钱暂时存放在保险公司。只要资金池规模不变，就无须出售债券。如果资金池收缩——而当业务量显著下降时，它就会收缩——公司便必须出售资产来偿付负债。如果出售的是账面上尚未确认巨额亏损的债券，这些亏损就会迅速成为已实现损失，并在过程中重创净资产。

1980.english:
Thus, an insurance company with a bond market value shrinkage approaching stated net worth (of which there are now many) and also faced with inadequate rate levels that are sure to deteriorate further has two options.  One option for management is to tell the underwriters to keep pricing according to the exposure involved - “be sure to get a dollar of premium for every dollar of expense cost plus expectable loss cost”.

The consequences of this directive are predictable: (a) with most business both price sensitive and renewable annually, many policies presently on the books will be lost to competitors in rather short order; (b) as premium volume shrinks significantly, there will be a lagged but corresponding decrease in liabilities (unearned premiums and claims payable); (c) assets (bonds) must be sold to match the decrease in liabilities; and (d) the formerly unrecognized disappearance of net worth will become partially recognized (depending upon the extent of such sales) in the insurer’s published financial statements.
1980.chinese:
因此，一家债券市值缩水额已接近其报告净资产的保险公司（目前有许多），又面临承保费率不足、且肯定会进一步恶化的环境，实际上只有两条路可走。

第一种选择是，管理层要求承保人员根据承担的风险定价：“费用成本与预期赔款成本合计每1美元，就务必收到1美元保费。”

这种指令的后果可以预见：（a）由于大部分保险业务对价格敏感，而且每年续保，当前许多保单会在短期内转投竞争对手；（b）随着保费规模明显下降，负债（未赚保费和应付赔款）会滞后一段时间后相应减少；（c）公司必须出售资产（债券），以匹配负债下降；（d）此前未在报表中确认的净资产损失，将随着出售范围的不同，在保险公司的公开财务报表中得到部分确认。

1980.english:
Variations of this depressing sequence involve a smaller penalty to stated net worth.  The reaction of some companies at (c) would be to sell either stocks that are already carried at market values or recently purchased bonds involving less severe losses.  This ostrich-like behavior - selling the better assets and keeping the biggest losers - while less painful in the short term, is unlikely to be a winner in the long term.

The second option is much simpler: just keep writing business regardless of rate levels and whopping prospective underwriting losses, thereby maintaining the present levels of premiums, assets and liabilities - and then pray for a better day, either for underwriting or for bond prices.  There is much criticism in the trade press of “cash flow” underwriting; i.e., writing business regardless of prospective underwriting losses in order to obtain funds to invest at current high interest rates. This second option might properly be termed “asset maintenance” underwriting - the acceptance of terrible business just to keep the assets you now have.
1980.chinese:
这种令人沮丧的过程也可能以其他形式出现，使报告净资产承担的损失看起来较小。有些公司到了（c）这一步，会选择出售已按市值入账的股票，或最近购买、亏损较轻的债券。这种鸵鸟式行为——卖掉更好的资产，把亏损最大的资产留下——虽然短期痛感较小，长期却不太可能有好结果。

第二种选择则简单得多：不管费率水平多低、预期承保亏损多么巨大，都继续承保业务，从而维持现有保费规模、资产与负债水平，然后祈求承保环境或债券价格出现转机。行业媒体经常批评“现金流承保”，即不顾预计的承保亏损而承接业务，只为获得资金，以便按当时的高利率进行投资。这第二种选择更恰当的名字，也许应该叫“维持资产的承保”——仅仅为了保住已有资产，就接受糟糕透顶的保险业务。

1980.english: Of course you know which option will be selected.  And it also is clear that as long as many large insurers feel compelled to choose that second option, there will be no better day for underwriting.  For if much of the industry feels it must maintain premium volume levels regardless of price adequacy, all insurers will have to come close to meeting those prices.  Right behind having financial problems yourself, the next worst plight is to have a large group of competitors with financial problems that they can defer by a “sell-at-any-price” policy.
1980.chinese: 当然，各位知道管理层会选择哪条路。而且显而易见，只要许多大型保险公司觉得自己必须选第二条路，行业承保环境就不会迎来好日子。因为如果行业中相当大的部分不顾价格是否足够，只求保住保费规模，那么其他保险公司也不得不报出相近价格。除了你自己出现财务问题以外，最糟糕的境遇之一，就是拥有一大群同样有财务问题的竞争对手，而它们可以靠“无论什么价都接单”的政策，暂时推迟面对问题。

1980.english: We mentioned earlier that companies that were unwilling - for any of a number of reasons, including public reaction, institutional pride, or protection of stated net worth - to sell bonds at price levels forcing recognition of major losses might find themselves frozen in investment posture for a decade or longer.  But, as noted, that’s only half of the problem. Companies that have made extensive commitments to long-term bonds may have lost, for a considerable period of time, not only many of their investment options, but many of their underwriting options as well.
1980.chinese: 前面说过，一些公司因为公众反应、机构自尊心或保护账面净资产等原因，不愿在必须确认巨额亏损的价格出售债券，可能让自己的投资姿态冻结十年甚至更久。不过，如前所述，这只是问题的一半。大量持有长期债券的公司，可能在相当长的一段时间内，不仅失去许多投资选择，还失去许多承保选择。

1980.english: Our own position in this respect is satisfactory.  We believe our net worth, valuing bonds of all insurers at amortized cost, is the strongest relative to premium volume among all large property-casualty stockholder-owned groups.  When bonds are valued at market, our relative strength becomes far more dramatic. (But lest we get too puffed up, we remind ourselves that our asset and liability maturities still are far more mismatched than we would wish and that we, too, lost important sums in bonds because your Chairman was talking when he should have been acting.)
1980.chinese: 在这方面，我们自己的处境是令人满意的。我们相信，如果各保险公司的债券都按摊余成本计价，那么相对于保费规模，伯克希尔的净资产实力在大型股东所有制财产及意外伤害保险集团中最强。如果债券改按市值计价，我们的相对实力就更加突出。（不过，为防止过度自满，我们也提醒自己，资产和负债的到期期限仍然比我们希望的更加不匹配；而且，由于各位的董事长该动手时却只顾动嘴，我们在债券上也赔了不少钱。）

1980.english:
Our abundant capital and investment flexibility will enable us to do whatever we think makes the most sense during the prospective extended period of inadequate pricing.  But troubles for the industry mean troubles for us.  Our financial strength doesn’t remove us from the hostile pricing environment now enveloping the entire property-casualty insurance industry.  It just gives us more staying power and more options.

## Insurance Operations

The National Indemnity managers, led by Phil Liesche with the usual able assistance of Roland Miller and Bill Lyons, outdid themselves in 1980.  While volume was flat, underwriting margins relative to the industry were at an all-time high.  We expect decreased volume from this operation in 1981.  But its managers will hear no complaints from corporate headquarters, nor will employment or salaries suffer.  We enormously admire the National Indemnity underwriting discipline - embedded from origin by the founder, Jack Ringwalt - and know that this discipline, if suspended, probably could not be fully regained.
1980.chinese:
充足的资本和灵活的投资选择，使我们能够在预计将长期持续的费率不足时期，采取自己认为最有意义的行动。但行业有难，我们也无法独善其身。财务实力并不会让我们摆脱整个财产及意外伤害保险行业目前面临的恶劣定价环境；它只是给予我们更强的持久力，以及更多的选择。

## 保险业务经营

1980年，以菲尔·利舍（Phil Liesche）为首，并继续得到罗兰·米勒（Roland Miller）和比尔·莱昂斯（Bill Lyons）有力协助的National Indemnity管理团队，表现甚至超过了以往的出色水平。虽然保费业务量基本持平，但相对于行业的承保利润率达到了历史最高水平。我们预计这项业务在1981年的规模会下降。不过，其管理者不会听到公司总部的抱怨，就业和薪酬也不会因此受影响。我们极其钦佩National Indemnity自创始人杰克·林沃尔特（Jack Ringwalt）以来就形成的承保纪律，也知道一旦放弃这种纪律，很可能就无法完全恢复。

1980.english:
John Seward at Home and Auto continues to make good progress in replacing a diminishing number of auto policies with volume from less competitive lines, primarily small-premium general liability.  Operations are being slowly expanded, both geographically and by product line, as warranted by underwriting results.

The reinsurance business continues to reflect the excesses and problems of the primary writers.  Worse yet, it has the potential for magnifying such excesses.  Reinsurance is characterized by extreme ease of entry, large premium payments in advance, and much-delayed loss reports and loss payments. Initially, the morning mail brings lots of cash and few claims. This state of affairs can produce a blissful, almost euphoric, feeling akin to that experienced by an innocent upon receipt of his first credit card.
1980.chinese:
Home and Auto业务的约翰·苏厄德（John Seward）继续取得良好进展：随着汽车险保单数量减少，他逐步以竞争不那么激烈的业务来替代，主要是小额保费的一般责任保险。根据承保结果，这项业务正在地理范围和产品类别两个方向上缓慢扩展。

再保险业务继续反映直接承保公司的过度竞争和问题。更糟的是，再保险甚至可能放大这些过度行为。再保险的特点是进入极为容易，保费往往提前大笔收取，而赔案报告与赔款支付则大幅延后。最初，每天早晨的邮件里带来大量现金，却很少见到索赔。这种情况会让人产生近乎狂喜的幸福感，就像一个天真的人收到人生第一张信用卡时的心情。

1980.english: The magnetic lure of such cash-generating characteristics, currently enhanced by the presence of high interest rates, is transforming the reinsurance market into “amateur night”. Without a super catastrophe, industry underwriting will be poor in the next few years.  If we experience such a catastrophe, there could be a bloodbath with some companies not able to live up to contractual commitments.  George Young continues to do a first-class job for us in this business.  Results, with investment income included, have been reasonably profitable.  We will retain an active reinsurance presence but, for the foreseeable future, we expect no premium growth from this activity.
1980.chinese: 再保险这种创造现金的特点具有强烈吸引力，如今又被高利率进一步强化，正在把再保险市场变成“业余选手之夜”。如果不发生超级灾难，未来几年行业承保业绩会很差；但若真的发生这样的灾难，则可能血流成河，一些公司甚至无法履行合同承诺。乔治·杨（George Young）仍然出色地经营着我们的再保险业务。计入投资收益后，这项业务总体获得了合理的利润。我们会继续积极参与再保险，但在可以预见的未来，不指望这一业务的保费规模增长。

1980.english: We continue to have serious problems in the Homestate operation.  Floyd Taylor in Kansas has done an outstanding job but our underwriting record elsewhere is considerably below average.  Our poorest performer has been Insurance Company of Iowa, at which large losses have been sustained annually since its founding in 1973.  Late in the fall we abandoned underwriting in that state, and have merged the company into Cornhusker Casualty.  There is potential in the homestate concept, but much work needs to be done in order to realize it.
1980.chinese: 我们的Homestate业务继续面临严重问题。堪萨斯州的弗洛伊德·泰勒（Floyd Taylor）干得非常出色，但其他地区的承保成绩明显低于平均水平。表现最差的是Insurance Company of Iowa，自1973年成立以来每年都遭受重大亏损。去年秋末，我们停止了在该州的承保，并将这家公司并入Cornhusker Casualty。Homestate这种经营理念有潜力，但要实现潜力，还有很多工作要做。

1980.english: Our Workers Compensation operation suffered a severe loss when Frank DeNardo died last year at 37. Frank instinctively thought like an underwriter.  He was a superb technician and a fierce competitor; in short order he had straightened out major problems at the California Workers Compensation Division of National Indemnity.  Dan Grossman, who originally brought Frank to us, stepped in immediately after Frank’s death to continue that operation, which now utilizes Redwood Fire and Casualty, another Berkshire subsidiary, as the insuring vehicle.
1980.chinese: 工伤赔偿保险业务在去年遭受了一项沉重损失：弗兰克·德纳尔多（Frank DeNardo）年仅37岁便去世。弗兰克天生具备承保人的思维，是一位极为出色的专业人士，也是强有力的竞争者。他很快就纠正了National Indemnity加州工伤赔偿部门的重大问题。当初将弗兰克介绍给我们的丹·格罗斯曼（Dan Grossman），在他去世后立即接手继续经营这一业务。目前，这项业务使用伯克希尔另一家子公司Redwood Fire and Casualty作为承保主体。

1980.english:
Our major Workers Compensation operation, Cypress Insurance Company, run by Milt Thornton, continues its outstanding record. Year after year Milt, like Phil Liesche, runs an underwriting operation that far outpaces his competition.  In the industry he is admired and copied, but not matched.

Overall, we look for a significant decline in insurance volume in 1981 along with a poorer underwriting result.  We expect underwriting experience somewhat superior to that of the industry but, of course, so does most of the industry.  There will be some disappointments.
1980.chinese:
我们最大的工伤赔偿保险业务Cypress Insurance Company，由米尔特·桑顿（Milt Thornton）领导，仍然保持着杰出记录。年复一年，米尔特和菲尔·利舍一样，经营着远远超越竞争对手的承保业务。在业内，他受到钦佩，也有人效仿，却无人能够企及。

总体而言，我们预计1981年保险业务量将显著下降，承保结果也会变差。我们预计自己的承保表现会略优于行业，但当然，行业里大多数公司也都作出同样的预测。有些结果会令人失望。

1980.english:
## Textile and Retail Operations

During the past year we have cut back the scope of our textile business.  Operations at Waumbec Mills have been terminated, reluctantly but necessarily.  Some equipment was transferred to New Bedford but most has been sold, or will be, along with real estate.  Your Chairman made a costly mistake in not facing the realities of this situation sooner.

At New Bedford we have reduced the number of looms operated by about one-third, abandoning some high-volume lines in which product differentiation was insignificant.  Even assuming everything went right - which it seldom did - these lines could not generate adequate returns related to investment.  And, over a full industry cycle, losses were the most likely result.
1980.chinese:
## 纺织与零售业务

过去一年，我们缩减了纺织业务的经营范围。我们不情愿、但也不得不终止Waumbec Mills的经营。部分设备转移到新贝德福德（New Bedford），大部分设备和房产已经出售或即将出售。各位的董事长没有更早面对这一现实，犯下了代价高昂的错误。

在新贝德福德，我们把正在运转的织机数量减少约三分之一，退出了一些产品差异化程度很低、但销量很大的产品线。即使一切进展顺利——事实上很少如此——这些产品线也不可能相对于投资额产生足够回报。而在一个完整的行业周期内，最有可能出现的是亏损。

1980.english: Our remaining textile operation, still sizable, has been divided into a manufacturing and a sales division, each free to do business independent of the other.  Thus, distribution strengths and mill capabilities will not be wedded to each other. We have more than doubled capacity in our most profitable textile segment through a recent purchase of used 130-inch Saurer looms. Current conditions indicate another tough year in textiles, but with substantially less capital employed in the operation.
1980.chinese: 剩余的纺织业务仍有相当规模，我们把它分成制造和销售两个部门，两者可以相互独立地开展业务。这样，分销渠道的优势与工厂生产能力就不会被硬绑在一起。最近，我们购买了一批二手的130英寸Saurer织机，使最盈利纺织细分业务的产能增加了一倍多。当前环境预示纺织业还将面临艰难的一年，不过我们在该业务中使用的资本将显著减少。

1980.english:
Ben Rosner’s record at Associated Retail Stores continues to amaze us.  In a poor retailing year, Associated’s earnings continued excellent - and those earnings all were translated into cash.  On March 7, 1981 Associated will celebrate its 50th birthday.  Ben has run the business (along with Leo Simon, his partner from 1931 to 1966) in each of those fifty years.

## Disposition of Illinois National Bank and Trust of Rockford

On December 31, 1980 we completed the exchange of 41,086 shares of Rockford Bancorp Inc. (which owns 97.7% of Illinois National Bank) for a like number of shares of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
1980.chinese:
本·罗斯纳（Ben Rosner）领导Associated Retail Stores的成绩继续让我们惊叹。在零售业不景气的一年里，Associated依然取得极佳利润，而且这些利润全部转化为现金。1981年3月7日，Associated将迎来成立50周年。在这50年中，本一直经营着这家公司，1931年至1966年间则与合伙人利奥·西蒙（Leo Simon）共同管理。

## 剥离罗克福德伊利诺伊国民银行及信托公司

1980年12月31日，我们完成了将Rockford Bancorp Inc.（持有Illinois National Bank 97.7%的股份）41,086股股票，交换同等数量伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司股票的交易。

1980.english:
Our method of exchange allowed all Berkshire shareholders to maintain their proportional interest in the Bank (except for me; I was permitted 80% of my proportional share).  They were thus guaranteed an ownership position identical to that they would have attained had we followed a more conventional spinoff approach.  Twenty-four shareholders (of our approximate 1300) chose this proportional exchange option.

We also allowed overexchanges, and thirty-nine additional shareholders accepted this option, thereby increasing their ownership in the Bank and decreasing their proportional ownership in Berkshire.  All got the full amount of Bancorp stock they requested, since the total shares desired by these thirty-nine holders was just slightly less than the number left available by the remaining 1200-plus holders of Berkshire who elected not to part with any Berkshire shares at all.  As the exchanger of last resort, I took the small balance (3% of Bancorp’s stock).  These shares, added to shares I received from my basic exchange allotment (80% of normal), gave me a slightly reduced proportional interest in the Bank and a slightly enlarged proportional interest in Berkshire.
1980.chinese:
我们设计的交换方式，使所有伯克希尔股东都能维持其在银行中按比例应享有的权益（我除外：我只获准取得正常应得比例的80%）。因此，股东获得的银行持股比例，与采用更传统的分拆方式时能够获得的比例完全相同。大约1,300名伯克希尔股东中，有24人选择了这一等比例交换方案。

我们也允许超出原比例的交换，另外39名股东选择了这种方案：他们增加在银行中的权益，相应减少在伯克希尔中的按比例持股。所有这些股东都拿到了要求数量的Bancorp股票，因为他们想要的总股数，刚好略低于其余1,200多名完全不愿交出伯克希尔股份的股东所留下的可供交换份额。作为最后的交换者，我取得了剩余的一小部分（Bancorp股份的3%）。这些股票加上我通过基本交换配额（正常份额的80%）获得的股票，使我在银行中的持股比例略有下降，而在伯克希尔中的持股比例略有提高。

1980.english:
Management of the Bank is pleased with the outcome.  Bancorp will operate as an inexpensive and uncomplicated holding company owned by 65 shareholders.  And all of those shareholders will have become Bancorp owners through a conscious affirmative decision.

Financing

In August we sold $60 million of 12 3/4% notes due August 1, 2005, with a sinking fund to begin in 1991.

The managing underwriters, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation, represented by Bill Fisher, and Chiles, Heider & Company, Inc., represented by Charlie Heider, did an absolutely first-class job from start to finish of the financing.
1980.chinese:
银行管理层对这一结果很满意。Bancorp将成为一家成本低廉、结构简单的控股公司，由65名股东拥有。而这65名股东都是经过主动、明确的选择，才成为Bancorp所有者的。

## 融资

8月，我们发行了6,000万美元、票面利率12¾%的票据，偿债基金从1991年开始运作，票据将于2005年8月1日到期。

由比尔·费希尔（Bill Fisher）代表的Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation，以及由查理·海德（Charlie Heider）代表的Chiles, Heider & Company, Inc.，从始至终都为这次融资提供了绝对一流的服务。

1980.english:
Unlike most businesses, Berkshire did not finance because of any specific immediate needs.  Rather, we borrowed because we think that, over a period far shorter than the life of the loan, we will have many opportunities to put the money to good use. The most attractive opportunities may present themselves at a time when credit is extremely expensive - or even unavailable. At such a time we want to have plenty of financial firepower.

Our acquisition preferences run toward businesses that generate cash, not those that consume it.  As inflation intensifies, more and more companies find that they must spend all funds they generate internally just to maintain their existing physical volume of business.  There is a certain mirage- like quality to such operations.  However attractive the earnings numbers, we remain leery of businesses that never seem able to convert such pretty numbers into no-strings-attached cash.
1980.chinese:
与大多数企业不同，伯克希尔融资并不是因为眼前存在某项具体资金需求。我们之所以借款，是因为相信在远短于借款期限的未来一段时间里，会有许多机会让我们妥善使用这笔钱。最有吸引力的机会，可能在信贷成本极其高昂、甚至根本无法借款的时候出现。而到那个时候，我们希望手中有充足的财务火力。

在收购选择上，我们偏好能够产生现金、而非消耗现金的企业。随着通胀加剧，越来越多公司发现，自己必须把内部产生的全部资金用掉，才能维持现有的实物业务规模。这类企业的经营带有某种海市蜃楼般的性质。无论利润数字看起来多么漂亮，对于那些似乎始终无法将漂亮数字转化成不附带额外条件的现金的企业，我们始终保持警惕。

1980.english:
Businesses meeting our standards are not easy to find. (Each year we read of hundreds of corporate acquisitions; only a handful would have been of interest to us.) And logical expansion of our present operations is not easy to implement.  But we’ll continue to utilize both avenues in our attempts to further Berkshire’s growth.

Under all circumstances we plan to operate with plenty of liquidity, with debt that is moderate in size and properly structured, and with an abundance of capital strength.  Our return on equity is penalized somewhat by this conservative approach, but it is the only one with which we feel comfortable.
1980.chinese:
符合我们标准的企业并不容易找到。（每年我们读到数百起企业收购，但其中只有少数会让我们产生兴趣。）要以符合逻辑的方式扩大现有业务，也并不容易实现。不过，我们会继续同时利用这两条途径，努力推动伯克希尔增长。

在任何情况下，我们都计划保持充分流动性，维持规模适中、结构合理的债务，并保有充足的资本实力。这种保守方式会在一定程度上压低我们的股东权益回报率，但只有这样我们才感到安心。

1980.english:
---

Gene Abegg, founder of our long-owned bank in Rockford, died on July 2, 1980 at the age of 82.  As a friend, banker and citizen, he was unsurpassed.

You learn a great deal about a person when you purchase a business from him and he then stays on to run it as an employee rather than as an owner.  Before the purchase the seller knows the business intimately, whereas you start from scratch.  The seller has dozens of opportunities to mislead the buyer - through omissions, ambiguities, and misdirection.  After the check has changed hands, subtle (and not so subtle) changes of attitude can occur and implicit understandings can evaporate.  As in the courtship-marriage sequence, disappointments are not infrequent.
1980.chinese:
* * *

长期由我们拥有的罗克福德银行的创办人吉恩·阿贝格（Gene Abegg），于1980年7月2日去世，享年82岁。无论作为朋友、银行家还是公民，他都无可匹敌。

当你从一个人手中买下一家企业，而他此后继续留任，以雇员而非所有者身份经营它时，你会了解到很多关于这个人的事情。交易前，卖方对企业了如指掌，而买方则从零开始。卖方有无数机会通过隐瞒、模糊表述或误导来欺骗买方。支票交付之后，态度上微妙或不那么微妙的变化都可能发生，原本心照不宣的约定也可能烟消云散。就像恋爱转入婚姻，失望并不罕见。

1980.english:
From the time we first met, Gene shot straight 100% of the time - the only behavior pattern he had within him.  At the outset of negotiations, he laid all negative factors face up on the table; on the other hand, for years after the transaction was completed he would tell me periodically of some previously undiscussed items of value that had come with our purchase.

Though he was already 71 years of age when he sold us the Bank, Gene subsequently worked harder for us than he had for himself.  He never delayed reporting a problem for a minute, but problems were few with Gene.  What else would you expect from a man who, at the time of the bank holiday in 1933, had enough cash on the premises to pay all depositors in full?  Gene never forgot he was handling other people’s money.  Though this fiduciary attitude was always dominant, his superb managerial skills enabled the Bank to regularly achieve the top position nationally in profitability.
1980.chinese:
从我们第一次相识起，吉恩就百分之百坦诚直率——这也是他唯一懂得的待人方式。谈判刚开始，他就把所有不利因素摊开说明；相反，在交易结束后的多年里，他却时不时告诉我一些购买时没有谈及的额外价值。

虽然吉恩在把银行卖给我们时已经71岁，但此后为我们工作的勤奋程度，甚至超过了此前为自己工作时的程度。他发现问题从不延迟片刻才报告；不过，在吉恩这里，问题很少。对于一位在1933年银行停业风潮中，竟能在银行内备有足够现金、足以向全部存款人全额付款的人，还能有什么别的期待呢？吉恩从未忘记自己管理的是别人的钱。尽管这种受托责任感始终居于首位，他非凡的管理能力也让银行经常跻身全美盈利能力最高的银行之列。

1980.english:
Gene was in charge of the Illinois National for close to fifty years - almost one-quarter of the lifetime of our country. George Mead, a wealthy industrialist, brought him in from Chicago to open a new bank after a number of other banks in Rockford had failed.  Mr. Mead put up the money and Gene ran the show.  His talent for leadership soon put its stamp on virtually every major civic activity in Rockford.

Dozens of Rockford citizens have told me over the years of help Gene extended to them.  In some cases this help was financial; in all cases it involved much wisdom, empathy and friendship.  He always offered the same to me.  Because of our respective ages and positions I was sometimes the junior partner, sometimes the senior.  Whichever the relationship, it always was a special one, and I miss it.

Warren E. Buffett February 27, 1981                         Chairman of the Board
1980.chinese:
吉恩掌管Illinois National将近50年，差不多相当于美国历史的四分之一。罗克福德几家银行倒闭后，一位富有的实业家乔治·米德（George Mead）从芝加哥请他来创办新银行。米德先生出钱，吉恩负责经营。他的领导才能很快就影响到罗克福德几乎所有重要的公民事务。

多年来，数十位罗克福德居民告诉我吉恩如何帮助他们。有时这种帮助是经济上的，但每一次都包含着智慧、同理心和友谊。他对我也一直如此。由于我们年龄和身份的差异，有时我像资历较浅的合伙人，有时又像资历较深的合伙人。不论关系如何变化，它始终是非常特殊的；我很怀念他。

沃伦·E·巴菲特  
**1981年2月27日**  
董事会主席

1981.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

February 26, 1982

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Operating earnings of $39.7 million in 1981 amounted to 15.2% of beginning equity capital (valuing securities at cost) compared to 17.8% in 1980.  Our new plan that allows stockholders to designate corporate charitable contributions (detailed later) reduced earnings by about $900,000 in 1981.  This program, which we expect to continue subject to annual evaluation of our corporate tax position, had not been initiated in 1980.
1981.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

1982年2月26日

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1981年的经营利润为3,970万美元，相当于年初股东权益资本的15.2%（证券按成本计价），而1980年的这一比例为17.8%。我们允许股东指定公司慈善捐款受赠对象的新计划（详见后文），使1981年的利润减少了约90万美元。我们预计会继续实施这一计划，但须每年评估公司的税务状况后决定。1980年尚未启动这一计划。

1981.english:
## Non-Controlled Ownership Earnings

In the 1980 annual report we discussed extensively the concept of non-controlled ownership earnings, i.e., Berkshire’s share of the undistributed earnings of companies we don’t control or significantly influence but in which we, nevertheless, have important investments. (We will be glad to make available to new or prospective shareholders copies of that discussion or others from earlier reports to which we refer in this report.) No portion of those undistributed earnings is included in the operating earnings of Berkshire.
1981.chinese:
## 非控股股权投资的收益

在1980年年报中，我们详细讨论过非控股股权投资收益这一概念，即：对于那些我们既不控制、也不具有重大影响，但持有重要投资的公司，伯克希尔按持股比例应享有的未分配利润。（对于新股东或潜在股东，如有需要，我们很乐意提供那段讨论的副本，或本报告所引用的其他往年报告内容。）这些未分配利润，没有任何部分计入伯克希尔的经营利润。

1981.english:
However, our belief is that, in aggregate, those undistributed and, therefore, unrecorded earnings will be translated into tangible value for Berkshire shareholders just as surely as if subsidiaries we control had earned, retained - and reported - similar earnings.

We know that this translation of non-controlled ownership earnings into corresponding realized and unrealized capital gains for Berkshire will be extremely irregular as to time of occurrence.  While market values track business values quite well over long periods, in any given year the relationship can gyrate capriciously.  Market recognition of retained earnings also will be unevenly realized among companies.  It will be disappointingly low or negative in cases where earnings are employed non- productively, and far greater than dollar-for-dollar of retained earnings in cases of companies that achieve high returns with their augmented capital.  Overall, if a group of non-controlled companies is selected with reasonable skill, the group result should be quite satisfactory.
1981.chinese:
不过，我们相信，总体而言，这些未分配、因而未入账的利润，会转化为伯克希尔股东实实在在的价值；其确定性，就如同我们控制的子公司赚取、留存并报告同样多的利润一样。

我们知道，这些非控股股权投资收益转化为伯克希尔相应的已实现和未实现资本利得，在发生时间上会极不规律。长期来看，市场价值能够相当好地跟随企业价值，但在任何一个特定年份，两者的关系都可能变化无常。不同公司之间，留存利润得到市场认可的程度也并不均衡。如果利润未得到有效运用，市场认可的价值可能低得令人失望，甚至为负；如果一家公司利用增加的资本取得高回报，留存的每1美元利润所创造的价值，则可能远远超过1美元。总体而言，只要选择这一组非控股公司时具备合理的判断能力，组合的结果就应当相当令人满意。

1981.english:
In aggregate, our non-controlled business interests have more favorable underlying economic characteristics than our controlled businesses.  That’s understandable; the area of choice has been far wider.  Small portions of exceptionally good businesses are usually available in the securities markets at reasonable prices.  But such businesses are available for purchase in their entirety only rarely, and then almost always at high prices.

## General Acquisition Behavior

As our history indicates, we are comfortable both with total ownership of businesses and with marketable securities representing small portions of businesses.  We continually look for ways to employ large sums in each area. (But we try to avoid small commitments - “If something’s not worth doing at all, it’s not worth doing well”.) Indeed, the liquidity requirements of our insurance and trading stamp businesses mandate major investments in marketable securities.
1981.chinese:
总体来说，我们持有的非控股企业权益，其基础经济特性优于我们控制的企业。这不难理解：前者的选择范围广得多。在证券市场上，通常可以以合理价格买到极其优秀的企业的一小部分权益。但要整体买下这样的企业，机会却十分罕见，而且价格几乎总是很高。

## 一般企业的收购行为

我们的历史表明，无论是拥有整家企业，还是持有代表企业一小部分权益的有价证券，我们都能安然自处。我们不断寻找在这两个领域投入大笔资金的机会。（但我们尽量避免小额投入——“如果一件事情根本不值得做，也就不值得把它做好。”）事实上，保险业务与交易印花券业务对流动性的要求，决定了我们必须大量投资于有价证券。

1981.english:
Our acquisition decisions will be aimed at maximizing real economic benefits, not at maximizing either managerial domain or reported numbers for accounting purposes. (In the long run, managements stressing accounting appearance over economic substance usually achieve little of either.)

Regardless of the impact upon immediately reportable earnings, we would rather buy 10% of Wonderful Business T at X per share than 100% of T at 2X per share.  Most corporate managers prefer just the reverse, and have no shortage of stated rationales for their behavior.
1981.chinese:
我们的收购决策，着眼于使真实的经济利益最大化，而非使管理疆域或会计报表上的数字最大化。（长期而言，重视会计外观甚于经济实质的管理层，通常在两方面都难有建树。）

不论对当期可报告利润有什么影响，我们宁可按每股X的价格买入优秀企业T的10%股权，也不愿按每股2X的价格买下T的100%股权。大多数公司管理者的偏好恰好相反，而且从来不缺为这种行为辩护的公开理由。

1981.english:
However, we suspect three motivations - usually unspoken - to be, singly or in combination, the important ones in most high- premium takeovers:

(1) Leaders, business or otherwise, seldom are deficient in animal spirits and often relish increased activity and challenge.  At Berkshire, the corporate pulse never beats faster than when an acquisition is in prospect.

(2) Most organizations, business or otherwise, measure themselves, are measured by others, and compensate their managers far more by the yardstick of size than by any other yardstick. (Ask a Fortune 500 manager where his corporation stands on that famous list and, invariably, the number responded will be from the list ranked by size of sales; he may well not even know where his corporation places on the list Fortune just as faithfully compiles ranking the same 500 corporations by profitability.)
1981.chinese:
然而，我们怀疑，在多数高溢价收购中，真正重要的动机，是以下三种通常不会明说的因素，单独或共同发挥作用：

（1）无论在企业还是其他组织中，领导者很少缺乏行动冲动，而且往往乐于迎接更多活动和挑战。在伯克希尔，没有什么比一项潜在收购更能让公司的脉搏加快。

（2）无论企业还是其他组织，大多数组织衡量自己、接受外界评价，以及给管理者确定报酬时，所依赖的尺度，规模都远远超过其他任何标准。（问一位《财富》500强企业管理者，他的公司在那张著名榜单上排第几，他回答的必定是按销售额排列的名次；至于《财富》同样认真编制的、这500家公司按盈利能力排列的榜单，他甚至可能不知道自己公司的名次。）

1981.english:
(3) Many managements apparently were overexposed in impressionable childhood years to the story in which the imprisoned handsome prince is released from a toad’s body by a kiss from a beautiful princess.  Consequently, they are certain their managerial kiss will do wonders for the profitability of Company T(arget).

Such optimism is essential.  Absent that rosy view, why else should the shareholders of Company A(cquisitor) want to own an interest in T at the 2X takeover cost rather than at the X market price they would pay if they made direct purchases on their own?
1981.chinese:
（3）许多管理者似乎在容易受影响的童年时期，过度沉浸于这样一个故事：美丽公主的一个吻，让被困在蟾蜍身体里的英俊王子重获自由。因此，他们确信，自己的管理之吻，也会让目标公司T（Target）的盈利能力发生奇迹。

这种乐观不可或缺。若没有这样一幅美好图景，收购公司A（Acquisitor）的股东，为什么要以2X的收购成本拥有T的权益，而不是自己直接在市场上按X的价格购买呢？

1981.english:
In other words, investors can always buy toads at the going price for toads.  If investors instead bankroll princesses who wish to pay double for the right to kiss the toad, those kisses had better pack some real dynamite.  We’ve observed many kisses but very few miracles.  Nevertheless, many managerial princesses remain serenely confident about the future potency of their kisses - even after their corporate backyards are knee-deep in unresponsive toads.

In fairness, we should acknowledge that some acquisition records have been dazzling.  Two major categories stand out.
1981.chinese:
换句话说，投资者随时都能按蟾蜍的市价买到蟾蜍。如果他们却要出钱支持公主，以双倍价格购买亲吻蟾蜍的权利，那么这些吻最好真有惊人的魔力。我们见过许多亲吻，却很少见到奇迹。即便如此，许多管理界的公主，对于自己未来亲吻的威力依然安然自信——即使公司的后院里，对亲吻毫无反应的蟾蜍已经堆得齐膝高。

公平地说，我们应该承认，有些收购业绩确实辉煌。其中有两大类尤为突出。

1981.english: The first involves companies that, through design or accident, have purchased only businesses that are particularly well adapted to an inflationary environment.  Such favored business must have two characteristics: (1) an ability to increase prices rather easily (even when product demand is flat and capacity is not fully utilized) without fear of significant loss of either market share or unit volume, and (2) an ability to accommodate large dollar volume increases in business (often produced more by inflation than by real growth) with only minor additional investment of capital.  Managers of ordinary ability, focusing solely on acquisition possibilities meeting these tests, have achieved excellent results in recent decades.  However, very few enterprises possess both characteristics, and competition to buy those that do has now become fierce to the point of being self-defeating.
1981.chinese: 第一类公司，无论有意还是偶然，收购的全是特别适应通胀环境的企业。这些得天独厚的企业必须具备两个特点：（1）能够相当轻松地提价，即使产品需求不增长、产能未充分利用，也不必担心市场份额或单位销量大幅流失；（2）只需少量追加资本投入，就能承接按金额计算的大幅业务增长——这种增长往往更多来自通胀，而非实际增长。过去几十年，一些能力普通的管理者，仅仅专注于寻找符合这些标准的收购机会，就取得了优异成绩。不过，同时拥有这两种特点的企业极少，如今争购这类企业的竞争已经激烈到可能使收购本身得不偿失的地步。

1981.english: The second category involves the managerial superstars - men who can recognize that rare prince who is disguised as a toad, and who have managerial abilities that enable them to peel away the disguise.  We salute such managers as Ben Heineman at Northwest Industries, Henry Singleton at Teledyne, Erwin Zaban at National Service Industries, and especially Tom Murphy at Capital Cities Communications (a real managerial “twofer”, whose acquisition efforts have been properly focused in Category 1 and whose operating talents also make him a leader of Category 2). From both direct and vicarious experience, we recognize the difficulty and rarity of these executives’ achievements. (So do they; these champs have made very few deals in recent years, and often have found repurchase of their own shares to be the most sensible employment of corporate capital.)
1981.chinese: 第二类是管理界的超级明星：他们能认出罕见的、伪装成蟾蜍的王子，并具备揭掉这层伪装的管理能力。我们向这些管理者致敬：西北工业公司（Northwest Industries）的本·海涅曼（Ben Heineman）、泰利达因公司（Teledyne）的亨利·辛格尔顿（Henry Singleton）、国家服务工业公司（National Service Industries）的欧文·扎班（Erwin Zaban），尤其是首都城市通信公司（Capital Cities Communications）的汤姆·墨菲（Tom Murphy）。汤姆是真正一人兼具两种才能的管理者：他的收购正确地集中于第1类企业，而经营才能又使他成为第2类管理者中的佼佼者。无论通过亲身经历，还是通过观察他人，我们都认识到这些高管的成就是多么艰难、多么罕见。（他们自己也明白；这些高手近几年很少做交易，而且常常发现，回购自己的股份才是运用公司资本最明智的办法。）

1981.english:
Your Chairman, unfortunately, does not qualify for Category 2.  And, despite a reasonably good understanding of the economic factors compelling concentration in Category 1, our actual acquisition activity in that category has been sporadic and inadequate.  Our preaching was better than our performance. (We neglected the Noah principle: predicting rain doesn’t count, building arks does.)

We have tried occasionally to buy toads at bargain prices with results that have been chronicled in past reports.  Clearly our kisses fell flat.  We have done well with a couple of princes - but they were princes when purchased.  At least our kisses didn’t turn them into toads.  And, finally, we have occasionally been quite successful in purchasing fractional interests in easily-identifiable princes at toad-like prices.
1981.chinese:
遗憾的是，各位的董事长不属于第2类。尽管对应该集中于第1类企业的经济原因有相当好的理解，我们在这类企业中的实际收购活动，却既零星又不足。我们说得比做得好。（我们忽略了诺亚原则：预测会下雨不算数，造好方舟才算。）

我们有时也曾尝试低价买进蟾蜍，结果在往年报告中已有记载。显然，我们的吻没有奏效。我们在几位王子身上做得不错——但买下他们时，他们就已经是王子了。至少，我们的亲吻没有把他们变成蟾蜍。最后，我们也曾偶尔颇为成功地以蟾蜍般的价格，买到那些很容易辨认的王子的一部分权益。

1981.english:
## Berkshire Acquisition Objectives

We will continue to seek the acquisition of businesses in their entirety at prices that will make sense, even should the future of the acquired enterprise develop much along the lines of its past.  We may very well pay a fairly fancy price for a Category 1 business if we are reasonably confident of what we are getting.  But we will not normally pay a lot in any purchase for what we are supposed to bring to the party - for we find that we ordinarily don’t bring a lot.
1981.chinese:
## 伯克希尔的收购目标

我们会继续寻找整体收购企业的机会，而且要求价格即使在被收购企业未来的发展大致延续过去轨迹的情况下，仍然合理。如果能够对买到的东西有相当把握，我们很可能愿意为第1类企业支付相当可观的价格。但通常，我们不会为自己据说能给被收购企业带来的贡献支付高价——因为我们发现，自己通常并不能带来多少。

1981.english:
During 1981 we came quite close to a major purchase involving both a business and a manager we liked very much. However, the price finally demanded, considering alternative uses for the funds involved, would have left our owners worse off than before the purchase.  The empire would have been larger, but the citizenry would have been poorer.

Although we had no success in 1981, from time to time in the future we will be able to purchase 100% of businesses meeting our standards.  Additionally, we expect an occasional offering of a major “non-voting partnership” as discussed under the Pinkerton’s heading on page 47 of this report.  We welcome suggestions regarding such companies where we, as a substantial junior partner, can achieve good economic results while furthering the long-term objectives of present owners and managers.
1981.chinese:
1981年，我们曾非常接近完成一项大额收购，涉及的企业和管理者都让我们十分喜欢。但是，考虑到相关资金的其他用途，对方最终要求的价格，会使我们的所有者在收购后比收购前更不划算。帝国会更大，子民却会更穷。

虽然1981年没有成功，未来我们仍会不时有机会买下符合标准的企业的100%股权。此外，我们也期待偶尔出现重大“无表决权合伙”机会，正如本报告第47页“平克顿公司（Pinkerton’s）”部分所讨论的那样。对于这样的公司，我们欢迎各位提供线索：我们作为持股相当可观的次要合伙人，既能获得良好经济回报，又能促进现有所有者和管理者实现长期目标。

1981.english:
Currently, we find values most easily obtained through the open-market purchase of fractional positions in companies with excellent business franchises and competent, honest managements. We never expect to run these companies, but we do expect to profit from them.

We expect that undistributed earnings from such companies will produce full value (subject to tax when realized) for Berkshire and its shareholders.  If they don’t, we have made mistakes as to either: (1) the management we have elected to join; (2) the future economics of the business; or (3) the price we have paid.
1981.chinese:
目前，我们最容易找到价值的方式，是在公开市场上购买具有优秀商业特许经营优势、并由能干而诚实的管理者经营的公司的一部分股权。我们从不指望经营这些公司，但确实指望从中获利。

我们预期，这些公司的未分配利润，会为伯克希尔及其股东创造足额价值（实现时须纳税）。如果没有做到，就说明我们在以下方面犯了错误：（1）选择与之合作的管理层；（2）企业未来的经济特性；或（3）支付的价格。

1981.english: We have made plenty of such mistakes - both in the purchase of non-controlling and controlling interests in businesses. Category (2) miscalculations are the most common.  Of course, it is necessary to dig deep into our history to find illustrations of such mistakes - sometimes as deep as two or three months back. For example, last year your Chairman volunteered his expert opinion on the rosy future of the aluminum business.  Several minor adjustments to that opinion - now aggregating approximately 180 degrees - have since been required.
1981.chinese: 我们犯过不少这样的错误，无论购买非控股权益还是控股权益都如此。第（2）类误判最常见。当然，要找这类错误的例子，必须深入挖掘我们的历史——有时要一直挖到两三个月以前。例如，去年各位的董事长曾主动发表专家意见，认为铝业前途光明。此后，这一意见需要作出若干微调——累计起来，目前大约转了180度。

1981.english:
For personal as well as more objective reasons, however, we generally have been able to correct such mistakes far more quickly in the case of non-controlled businesses (marketable securities) than in the case of controlled subsidiaries.  Lack of control, in effect, often has turned out to be an economic plus.

As we mentioned last year, the magnitude of our non-recorded “ownership” earnings has grown to the point where their total is greater than our reported operating earnings.  We expect this situation will continue.  In just four ownership positions in this category - GEICO Corporation, General Foods Corporation, R. J. Reynolds Industries, Inc. and The Washington Post Company - our share of undistributed and therefore unrecorded earnings probably will total well over $35 million in 1982.  The accounting rules that entirely ignore these undistributed earnings diminish the utility of our annual return on equity calculation, or any other single year measure of economic performance.
1981.chinese:
不过，出于个人因素以及更客观的原因，在非控股企业（有价证券）方面，我们通常能比在控股子公司方面更快地纠正这些错误。事实上，缺乏控制权，往往反而成为经济上的好处。

正如去年提到的，我们未入账的“所有者收益”已经增长到总额超过报表经营利润的程度。我们预计这种情形会继续。仅这一类别中的四项持股——盖可公司（GEICO Corporation）、通用食品公司（General Foods Corporation）、雷诺工业公司（R. J. Reynolds Industries, Inc.）和华盛顿邮报公司（The Washington Post Company）——1982年我们应享有的未分配、因而未入账利润，就很可能合计远超3,500万美元。会计规则完全忽略这些未分配利润，使我们按年度计算的股东权益回报率，或其他任何单一年度经济业绩指标，其用途都受到削弱。

1981.english:
## Long-Term Corporate Performance

In measuring long-term economic performance, equities held by our insurance subsidiaries are valued at market subject to a charge reflecting the amount of taxes that would have to be paid if unrealized gains were actually realized.  If we are correct in the premise stressed in the preceding section of this report, our unreported ownership earnings will find their way, irregularly but inevitably, into our net worth.  To date, this has been the case.
1981.chinese:
## 企业的长期业绩

衡量长期经济业绩时，我们将保险子公司持有的股票按市值计价，同时扣除假如未实现收益实际实现时须缴纳的税款。如果本报告前一节强调的前提是正确的，我们未报告的股权投资收益，就会以不规律、但不可避免的方式，进入我们的净资产。迄今为止，情况正是如此。

1981.english:
An even purer calculation of performance would involve a valuation of bonds and non-insurance held equities at market. However, GAAP accounting does not prescribe this procedure, and the added purity would change results only very slightly.  Should any valuation difference widen to significant proportions, as it has at most major insurance companies, we will report its effect to you.

On a GAAP basis, during the present management’s term of seventeen years, book value has increased from $19.46 per share to $526.02 per share, or 21.1% compounded annually.  This rate of return number is highly likely to drift downward in future years. We hope, however, that it can be maintained significantly above the rate of return achieved by the average large American corporation.
1981.chinese:
更纯粹的业绩计算，还应该把债券及非保险业务持有的股票按市值计价。不过，公认会计原则（GAAP）并不要求这样处理，而且这种更纯粹的做法只会使结果发生非常轻微的变化。如果计价差额扩大到重大的程度，像大多数大型保险公司已经出现的情况一样，我们会向各位报告其影响。

按公认会计原则计算，在现任管理层任职的17年间，每股账面价值由19.46美元增加到526.02美元，年复合增长率为21.1%。未来几年，这个回报率数字极有可能逐步下降。但我们希望，它仍能显著高于美国大型公司的平均回报率。

1981.english:
Over half of the large gain in Berkshire’s net worth during 1981 - it totaled $124 million, or about 31% - resulted from the market performance of a single investment, GEICO Corporation.  In aggregate, our market gain from securities during the year considerably outstripped the gain in underlying business values. Such market variations will not always be on the pleasant side.

In past reports we have explained how inflation has caused our apparently satisfactory long-term corporate performance to be illusory as a measure of true investment results for our owners. We applaud the efforts of Federal Reserve Chairman Volcker and note the currently more moderate increases in various price indices.  Nevertheless, our views regarding long-term inflationary trends are as negative as ever.  Like virginity, a stable price level seems capable of maintenance, but not of restoration.
1981.chinese:
1981年，伯克希尔净资产大幅增加，总额为1.24亿美元，增幅约31%；其中超过一半来自单项投资——盖可公司——的市场表现。总体而言，年内证券投资的市值增长，明显超过其基础企业价值的增长。这样的市场变化，并不总会令人愉快。

过去的报告曾解释，通胀如何使我们表面上令人满意的长期企业业绩，在衡量所有者真实投资成果时显得虚幻。我们赞赏美联储主席沃尔克（Volcker）的努力，也注意到目前各种价格指数的涨幅已经较为温和。尽管如此，我们对长期通胀趋势的看法，仍然像过去一样悲观。稳定的物价水平似乎如同贞操，可以保持，却难以恢复。

1981.english:
Despite the overriding importance of inflation in the investment equation, we will not punish you further with another full recital of our views; inflation itself will be punishment enough. (Copies of previous discussions are available for masochists.) But, because of the unrelenting destruction of currency values, our corporate efforts will continue to do a much better job of filling your wallet than of filling your stomach.

## Equity Value-Added

An additional factor should further subdue any residual enthusiasm you may retain regarding our long-term rate of return. The economic case justifying equity investment is that, in aggregate, additional earnings above passive investment returns - interest on fixed-income securities - will be derived through the employment of managerial and entrepreneurial skills in conjunction with that equity capital.  Furthermore, the case says that since the equity capital position is associated with greater risk than passive forms of investment, it is “entitled” to higher returns.  A “value-added” bonus from equity capital seems natural and certain.
1981.chinese:
尽管通胀在投资的考量中具有压倒性的重要性，我们不会再把自己的观点完整重述一遍，让各位进一步受罚；通胀本身已经足够折磨人了。（有受虐倾向的人，可以索取以前讨论的副本。）不过，由于货币价值持续不断遭到破坏，我们的企业努力，在填满各位的钱包方面，仍会远比填饱各位的肚子做得好。

## 股权资本创造的附加价值

还有一个因素，应该让各位对我们长期回报率所剩的热情进一步冷却。投资股权在经济上的理由是：总体而言，把管理和创业才能与股权资本结合起来，应能产生超出被动投资回报——即固定收益证券利息——的额外利润。此外，这种理由还认为，股权资本承担的风险高于被动投资，因此“有权”获得更高回报。由股权资本带来一份“附加价值”奖励，看起来既自然又确定。

1981.english: But is it?  Several decades back, a return on equity of as little as 10% enabled a corporation to be classified as a “good” business - i.e., one in which a dollar reinvested in the business logically could be expected to be valued by the market at more than one hundred cents.  For, with long-term taxable bonds yielding 5% and long-term tax-exempt bonds 3%, a business operation that could utilize equity capital at 10% clearly was worth some premium to investors over the equity capital employed. That was true even though a combination of taxes on dividends and on capital gains would reduce the 10% earned by the corporation to perhaps 6%-8% in the hands of the individual investor.
1981.chinese: 但真是如此吗？几十年前，股东权益回报率只要达到10%，一家公司就可以被归为“好”企业——也就是说，留在企业中再投资的每1美元，可以合理预期在市场上获得超过100美分的估值。因为，当长期应税债券收益率为5%、长期免税债券收益率为3%时，一家能够让股权资本获得10%回报的企业，显然值得投资者在其投入的股权资本之上支付一定溢价。即使股息税与资本利得税相结合，可能使公司赚得的10%回报，落到个人投资者手里时只剩6%—8%，这一点依然成立。

1981.english:
Investment markets recognized this truth.  During that earlier period, American business earned an average of 11% or so on equity capital employed and stocks, in aggregate, sold at valuations far above that equity capital (book value), averaging over 150 cents on the dollar.  Most businesses were “good” businesses because they earned far more than their keep (the return on long-term passive money).  The value-added produced by equity investment, in aggregate, was substantial.

That day is gone.  But the lessons learned during its existence are difficult to discard.  While investors and managers must place their feet in the future, their memories and nervous systems often remain plugged into the past.  It is much easier for investors to utilize historic p/e ratios or for managers to utilize historic business valuation yardsticks than it is for either group to rethink their premises daily.  When change is slow, constant rethinking is actually undesirable; it achieves little and slows response time.  But when change is great, yesterday’s assumptions can be retained only at great cost.  And the pace of economic change has become breathtaking.
1981.chinese:
投资市场认识到了这一事实。在那个较早的时期，美国企业在所用股权资本上平均赚取约11%的回报，而股票整体售价远高于该股权资本（账面价值），平均每1美元资本对应的市价超过150美分。多数企业是“好”企业，因为它们赚取的收益远远超过养活其资本所需的回报，也就是长期被动资金的回报。总体而言，股权投资创造的附加价值相当可观。

那个时代已经过去，但当年学到的经验却难以抛弃。投资者和管理者的双脚必须迈向未来，记忆和神经系统却往往仍接在过去的线路上。沿用历史市盈率，对投资者来说容易得多；沿用历史企业估值尺度，对管理者来说也一样；而每天重新思考自己的前提，则困难得多。在变化缓慢时，不断重新思考实际上并不可取，因为收效甚微，还会拖慢反应。但当变化巨大时，保留昨天的假设，就只能付出高昂代价。而如今，经济变化的速度已经快得令人屏息。

1981.english: During the past year, long-term taxable bond yields exceeded 16% and long-term tax-exempts 14%.  The total return achieved from such tax-exempts, of course, goes directly into the pocket of the individual owner.  Meanwhile, American business is producing earnings of only about 14% on equity.  And this 14% will be substantially reduced by taxation before it can be banked by the individual owner.  The extent of such shrinkage depends upon the dividend policy of the corporation and the tax rates applicable to the investor.
1981.chinese: 过去一年，长期应税债券收益率超过16%，长期免税债券收益率超过14%。当然，免税债券取得的全部回报，都直接进入个人持有者的口袋。与此同时，美国企业的股东权益回报率却只有约14%。而这14%，在个人所有者真正存入银行之前，还会被税收大幅削减。削减程度取决于公司的股息政策，以及投资者适用的税率。

1981.english: Thus, with interest rates on passive investments at late 1981 levels, a typical American business is no longer worth one hundred cents on the dollar to owners who are individuals. (If the business is owned by pension funds or other tax-exempt investors, the arithmetic, although still unenticing, changes substantially for the better.) Assume an investor in a 50% tax bracket; if our typical company pays out all earnings, the income return to the investor will be equivalent to that from a 7% tax- exempt bond.  And, if conditions persist - if all earnings are paid out and return on equity stays at 14% - the 7% tax-exempt equivalent to the higher-bracket individual investor is just as frozen as is the coupon on a tax-exempt bond.  Such a perpetual 7% tax-exempt bond might be worth fifty cents on the dollar as this is written.
1981.chinese: 因此，当被动投资利率处于1981年年末的水平时，对个人所有者而言，一家典型美国企业的价值，已经不再达到每1美元股权资本值100美分的水平。（如果所有者是养老基金或其他免税投资者，计算结果虽仍不诱人，却会明显改善。）假设一位投资者适用50%的税率：如果这家典型公司把利润全部分配，投资者得到的收入回报，就相当于一只7%的免税债券。如果这一状况持续——全部利润都分配，股东权益回报率保持14%——那么，对较高税率档的个人投资者而言，这7%的免税等值回报，就会像免税债券的票息一样被固定下来。写这封信时，这样一只永久支付7%免税利息的债券，每1美元面值或许只值50美分。

1981.english: If, on the other hand, all earnings of our typical American business are retained and return on equity again remains constant, earnings will grow at 14% per year.  If the p/e ratio remains constant, the price of our typical stock will also grow at 14% per year.  But that 14% is not yet in the pocket of the shareholder.  Putting it there will require the payment of a capital gains tax, presently assessed at a maximum rate of 20%. This net return, of course, works out to a poorer rate of return than the currently available passive after-tax rate.
1981.chinese: 另一方面，如果这家典型美国企业把全部利润留存，股东权益回报率同样保持不变，利润就会每年增长14%。如果市盈率不变，这只典型股票的价格也会每年增长14%。但这14%还没有进入股东口袋。要把钱装进口袋，还需要缴纳资本利得税，目前最高税率为20%。显然，这样得到的净回报率，低于当前可获得的被动投资税后回报率。

1981.english:
Unless passive rates fall, companies achieving 14% per year gains in earnings per share while paying no cash dividend are an economic failure for their individual shareholders.  The returns from passive capital outstrip the returns from active capital. This is an unpleasant fact for both investors and corporate managers and, therefore, one they may wish to ignore.  But facts do not cease to exist, either because they are unpleasant or because they are ignored.

Most American businesses pay out a significant portion of their earnings and thus fall between the two examples.  And most American businesses are currently “bad” businesses economically - producing less for their individual investors after-tax than the tax-exempt passive rate of return on money.  Of course, some high-return businesses still remain attractive, even under present conditions.  But American equity capital, in aggregate, produces no value-added for individual investors.
1981.chinese:
除非被动投资利率下降，否则，对于个人股东来说，一家每股利润每年增长14%、却不支付现金股息的公司，在经济上仍属失败。被动资本的回报超过了主动经营资本的回报。这对投资者和公司管理者都不是愉快的事实，因此他们可能想忽略它。但事实不会因为令人不快，或因为遭到忽略，就不复存在。

多数美国企业会分配相当一部分利润，因此处于上述两个例子之间。而在目前，多数美国企业在经济上都是“坏”企业——它们为个人投资者创造的税后回报，低于资金进行免税被动投资的回报率。当然，即使在当前条件下，一些高回报企业仍然具有吸引力。但总体而言，美国股权资本并没有为个人投资者创造附加价值。

1981.english: It should be stressed that this depressing situation does not occur because corporations are jumping, economically, less high than previously.  In fact, they are jumping somewhat higher: return on equity has improved a few points in the past decade. But the crossbar of passive return has been elevated much faster. Unhappily, most companies can do little but hope that the bar will be lowered significantly; there are few industries in which the prospects seem bright for substantial gains in return on equity.
1981.chinese: 必须强调，出现这种令人沮丧的局面，并不是因为企业在经济意义上的跳跃高度不如以前。事实上，它们还跳得稍高了一些：过去十年，股东权益回报率提高了几个百分点。但被动投资回报这根横杆，升高得更快。遗憾的是，大多数公司除了希望横杆显著降低之外，几乎无能为力；看起来有望大幅提高股东权益回报率的行业，并没有几个。

1981.english:
Inflationary experience and expectations will be major (but not the only) factors affecting the height of the crossbar in future years.  If the causes of long-term inflation can be tempered, passive returns are likely to fall and the intrinsic position of American equity capital should significantly improve. Many businesses that now must be classified as economically “bad” would be restored to the “good” category under such circumstances.

A further, particularly ironic, punishment is inflicted by an inflationary environment upon the owners of the “bad” business.  To continue operating in its present mode, such a low- return business usually must retain much of its earnings - no matter what penalty such a policy produces for shareholders.
1981.chinese:
未来几年，实际通胀经历和通胀预期，将是影响横杆高度的重要因素，但不是唯一因素。如果能抑制长期通胀的成因，被动投资回报率很可能下降，美国股权资本的内在处境就应当显著改善。在这种情况下，许多现在必须归为经济上“坏”企业的公司，会重新回到“好”企业之列。

通胀环境还会对“坏”企业的所有者施加另一种格外讽刺的惩罚。为了按现有方式继续经营，这种低回报企业通常必须留存很大一部分利润——无论这种政策会给股东造成多大的损害。

1981.english: Reason, of course, would prescribe just the opposite policy. An individual, stuck with a 5% bond with many years to run before maturity, does not take the coupons from that bond and pay one hundred cents on the dollar for more 5% bonds while similar bonds are available at, say, forty cents on the dollar.  Instead, he takes those coupons from his low-return bond and - if inclined to reinvest - looks for the highest return with safety currently available.  Good money is not thrown after bad.
1981.chinese: 当然，理性要求的恰恰是相反的政策。如果一个人被套在一只距离到期还有很多年的5%债券上，他不会拿这只债券的利息，以每1美元面值支付100美分的价格再买更多5%债券，因为市场上类似债券可能只卖每1美元面值40美分。他会把低回报债券支付的利息拿出来；如果想再投资，就寻找目前安全条件下可获得的最高回报。不能拿好钱继续填坏钱的窟窿。

1981.english: What makes sense for the bondholder makes sense for the shareholder.  Logically, a company with historic and prospective high returns on equity should retain much or all of its earnings so that shareholders can earn premium returns on enhanced capital.  Conversely, low returns on corporate equity would suggest a very high dividend payout so that owners could direct capital toward more attractive areas. (The Scriptures concur.  In the parable of the talents, the two high-earning servants are rewarded with 100% retention of earnings and encouraged to expand their operations.  However, the non-earning third servant is not only chastised - “wicked and slothful” - but also is required to redirect all of his capital to the top performer.  Matthew 25: 14-30)
1981.chinese: 对债券持有人合理的道理，对股东同样合理。逻辑上，一家过去和未来都具有较高股东权益回报率的公司，应留存大部分或全部利润，使股东能在增加的资本上获得优厚回报。相反，如果公司股权回报率低，就应当支付很高比例的股息，让所有者把资本转向更有吸引力的领域。（《圣经》也赞同。在“才干的比喻”中，两位赚钱能力强的仆人获准留存100%的收益，并受到鼓励扩大经营；第三位不赚钱的仆人，不但被斥为“又恶又懒”，还被要求把全部资本转交给表现最好的人。《马太福音》25章14—30节。）

1981.english: But inflation takes us through the looking glass into the upside-down world of Alice in Wonderland.  When prices continuously rise, the “bad” business must retain every nickel that it can.  Not because it is attractive as a repository for equity capital, but precisely because it is so unattractive, the low-return business must follow a high retention policy.  If it wishes to continue operating in the future as it has in the past - and most entities, including businesses, do - it simply has no choice.
1981.chinese: 但通胀把我们带过镜子，进入《爱丽丝梦游仙境》般颠倒的世界。物价持续上涨时，“坏”企业必须留住能留住的每一分钱。低回报企业实行高留存政策，恰恰不是因为它适合容纳股权资本，而是因为它太不适合。如果它想在未来像过去一样继续经营——大多数组织，包括企业，都希望如此——那么它根本别无选择。

1981.english: For inflation acts as a gigantic corporate tapeworm.  That tapeworm preemptively consumes its requisite daily diet of investment dollars regardless of the health of the host organism. Whatever the level of reported profits (even if nil), more dollars for receivables, inventory and fixed assets are continuously required by the business in order to merely match the unit volume of the previous year.  The less prosperous the enterprise, the greater the proportion of available sustenance claimed by the tapeworm.
1981.chinese: 因为通胀就像一条巨大的企业绦虫。不论宿主是否健康，这条绦虫都会优先吞掉自己每天所需的投资资金。不管报表利润多少，即使利润为零，企业仅仅为了维持上一年的实物业务量，也必须持续向应收账款、存货和固定资产投入更多美元。企业越不景气，绦虫吞掉的可用养分比例就越高。

1981.english: Under present conditions, a business earning 8% or 10% on equity often has no leftovers for expansion, debt reduction or “real” dividends.  The tapeworm of inflation simply cleans the plate. (The low-return company’s inability to pay dividends, understandably, is often disguised.  Corporate America increasingly is turning to dividend reinvestment plans, sometimes even embodying a discount arrangement that all but forces shareholders to reinvest.  Other companies sell newly issued shares to Peter in order to pay dividends to Paul.  Beware of “dividends” that can be paid out only if someone promises to replace the capital distributed.)
1981.chinese: 在当前条件下，一家股东权益回报率为8%或10%的企业，往往已经没有余粮可供扩张、减少债务或支付“真正的”股息。通胀这条绦虫会把盘子吃得一干二净。（低回报公司无力支付股息，往往会被掩饰起来，这不难理解。美国企业越来越多地采用股息再投资计划，有时还加入折价安排，几乎迫使股东把股息再投回公司。另一些公司则向彼得发行新股，把钱拿去向保罗支付股息。对于那种只有别人承诺补回所分配资本，才付得出来的“股息”，务必小心。）

1981.english: Berkshire continues to retain its earnings for offensive, not defensive or obligatory, reasons.  But in no way are we immune from the pressures that escalating passive returns exert on equity capital.  We continue to clear the crossbar of after- tax passive return - but barely.  Our historic 21% return - not at all assured for the future - still provides, after the current capital gain tax rate (which we expect to rise considerably in future years), a modest margin over current after-tax rates on passive money.  It would be a bit humiliating to have our corporate value-added turn negative.  But it can happen here as it has elsewhere, either from events outside anyone’s control or from poor relative adaptation on our part.
1981.chinese: 伯克希尔继续留存利润，是为了主动进取，而不是出于防御或被迫如此。不过，被动投资回报率不断上升给股权资本带来的压力，我们绝非能够免疫。我们仍能越过税后被动投资回报率这根横杆——但只是勉强越过。我们历史上21%的回报率，未来完全没有保证；按目前资本利得税率扣税后——我们预期这一税率未来几年会大幅提高——它仍比当前被动资金的税后利率高出一点。如果我们公司创造的附加价值变成负数，会有些令人难堪。但这种事在别处已经发生，在这里也可能发生；原因可能是任何人都无法控制的事件，也可能是我们相对适应得不够好。

我们的控股与非控股企业涉及的业务范围极广，在这里逐一详细评论，会使篇幅过长。本报告第34—37页的管理层讨论，以及第38—50页的文字报告，还提供了大量财务资料。不过，无论控股还是非控股业务，我们最大的领域始终是财产及意外伤害保险，而且几乎肯定还会如此，因此有必要评论这一行业的重要变化。

1981.english:
## Insurance Industry Conditions

“Forecasts”, said Sam Goldwyn, “are dangerous, particularly those about the future.” (Berkshire shareholders may have reached a similar conclusion after rereading our past annual reports featuring your Chairman’s prescient analysis of textile prospects.)

There is no danger, however, in forecasting that 1982 will be the worst year in recent history for insurance underwriting. That result already has been guaranteed by present pricing behavior, coupled with the term nature of the insurance contract.
1981.chinese:
## 保险行业状况

萨姆·戈德温（Sam Goldwyn）说过：“预测是危险的，尤其是对未来的预测。”（伯克希尔股东重新读过我们往年的年报后，或许也会有类似结论；那些报告中不乏各位董事长对纺织业前景的“先见之明”。）

不过，预测1982年将成为保险承保业务近年最糟糕的一年，并没有什么危险。当前的定价行为，加上保险合同具有固定期限这一特点，已经保证了这个结果。

1981.english: While many auto policies are priced and sold at six-month intervals - and many property policies are sold for a three-year term - a weighted average of the duration of all property- casualty insurance policies probably runs a little under twelve months.  And prices for the insurance coverage, of course, are frozen for the life of the contract.  Thus, this year’s sales contracts (“premium written” in the parlance of the industry) determine about one-half of next year’s level of revenue (“premiums earned”).  The remaining half will be determined by sales contracts written next year that will be about 50% earned in that year.  The profitability consequences are automatic: if you make a mistake in pricing, you have to live with it for an uncomfortable period of time.
1981.chinese: 虽然许多汽车保险每六个月定价销售一次，许多财产保险的期限则为三年，但全部财产及意外伤害保险保单的加权平均期限，大概略低于十二个月。当然，保险保障的价格，在合同存续期间是固定的。因此，今年销售的合同——行业称为“签单保费”（premiums written）——会决定明年收入，即“已赚保费”（premiums earned）的大约一半。另一半，则由明年签订的销售合同决定，这些合同的保费约有50%会在明年赚取。对盈利能力的后果是自动发生的：如果定价犯了错误，你就得在一段令人难受的时间里承受它。

1981.english: Note in the table below the year-over-year gain in industry- wide premiums written and the impact that it has on the current and following year’s level of underwriting profitability.  The result is exactly as you would expect in an inflationary world. When the volume gain is well up in double digits, it bodes well for profitability trends in the current and following year.  When the industry volume gain is small, underwriting experience very shortly will get worse, no matter how unsatisfactory the current level.
1981.chinese: 请看下表中全行业签单保费的同比增长，以及它对当年和次年承保盈利水平的影响。在通胀世界里，结果正如所料。当业务金额增幅较高、达到两位数时，当年和次年的盈利趋势通常较好。当行业业务金额增长很小时，不管当前业绩已经多么不理想，承保表现很快都会继续恶化。
