As Pogo would say, “The future isn’t what it used to be.” Current pricing practices promise devastating results, particularly if the respite from major natural disasters that the industry has enjoyed in recent years should end.  For underwriting experience has been getting worse in spite of good luck, not because of bad luck.  In recent years hurricanes have stayed at sea and motorists have reduced their driving.  They won’t always be so obliging.
1981.chinese:
资料来源：Best’s Aggregates and Averages。

用漫画人物波戈（Pogo）的话说，“未来已经不是从前的未来了。”目前的定价做法，预示着灾难性的结果；如果近年来行业幸运地没有遭遇重大自然灾害的局面告终，结果尤其如此。*因为承保表现是在运气好的情况下变差的，而不是因为运气不好。*近几年，飓风一直停留在海上，驾车者也减少了行驶里程。他们不会永远这样配合。

1981.english:
And, of course the twin inflations, monetary and “social” (the tendency of courts and juries to stretch the coverage of policies beyond what insurers, relying upon contract terminology and precedent, had expected), are unstoppable.  Costs of repairing both property and people - and the extent to which these repairs are deemed to be the responsibility of the insurer - will advance relentlessly.

Absent any bad luck (catastrophes, increased driving, etc.), an immediate industry volume gain of at least 10% per year probably is necessary to stabilize the record level of underwriting losses that will automatically prevail in mid-1982. (Most underwriters expect incurred losses in aggregate to rise at least 10% annually; each, of course, counts on getting less than his share.) Every percentage point of annual premium growth below the 10% equilibrium figure quickens the pace of deterioration. Quarterly data in 1981 underscore the conclusion that a terrible underwriting picture is worsening at an accelerating rate.
1981.chinese:
当然，货币通胀与“社会通胀”这双重通胀也势不可挡。所谓社会通胀，是指法院和陪审团往往把保单的保障范围扩大到保险公司依据合同文字和判例原本预期的范围之外。修复财产和治疗人员的成本，以及这些费用被认定应由保险公司承担的范围，都会持续上升。

即使没有任何坏运气，例如灾难、驾车增加等，行业的业务金额也很可能必须立即实现每年至少10%的增长，才能使1982年年中必然出现的创纪录承保亏损稳定下来。（多数承保人预期，全行业已发生赔款每年至少增长10%；当然，每一家都指望自己承担的份额会低于应有份额。）年度保费增幅每低于10%这一平衡点一个百分点，恶化速度就会进一步加快。1981年的季度数据表明，本来已经糟糕透顶的承保局面，正在加速恶化。

1981.english: In the 1980 annual report we discussed the investment policies that have destroyed the integrity of many insurers’ balance sheets, forcing them to abandon underwriting discipline and write business at any price in order to avoid negative cash flow.  It was clear that insurers with large holdings of bonds valued, for accounting purposes, at nonsensically high prices would have little choice but to keep the money revolving by selling large numbers of policies at nonsensically low prices. Such insurers necessarily fear a major decrease in volume more than they fear a major underwriting loss.
1981.chinese: 1980年年报中，我们讨论过一些投资政策如何损害了许多保险公司资产负债表的真实可靠性，迫使它们放弃承保纪律，以任何价格接单，避免现金流转负。显而易见，那些大量持有债券、却为会计目的把债券按高得荒谬的价格入账的保险公司，几乎别无选择，只能以低得荒谬的价格大量销售保单，让资金不断周转。这样的保险公司，必然更害怕业务量大幅下降，而不是承保巨亏。

1981.english:
But, unfortunately, all insurers are affected; it’s difficult to price much differently than your most threatened competitor.  This pressure continues unabated and adds a new motivation to the others that drive many insurance managers to push for business; worship of size over profitability, and the fear that market share surrendered never can be regained.

Whatever the reasons, we believe it is true that virtually no major property-casualty insurer - despite protests by the entire industry that rates are inadequate and great selectivity should be exercised - has been willing to turn down business to the point where cash flow has turned significantly negative. Absent such a willingness, prices will remain under severe pressure.
1981.chinese:
但遗憾的是，所有保险公司都会受到影响；你的定价，很难与你处境最危险的竞争对手相差太大。这种压力丝毫没有减弱，还为推动许多保险管理者争抢业务的其他动机又添了一条。其他动机包括：崇尚规模甚于盈利，以及担心放弃的市场份额再也夺不回来。

无论原因是什么，我们认为，事实是：尽管全行业都在抱怨费率不足、主张必须严格挑选业务，但实际上，几乎没有一家大型财产及意外伤害保险公司，愿意拒绝业务到使现金流显著转负的程度。只要不愿这样做，价格就会继续承受严重压力。

1981.english:
Commentators continue to talk of the underwriting cycle, usually implying a regularity of rhythm and a relatively constant midpoint of profitability Our own view is different.  We believe that very large, although obviously varying, underwriting losses will be the norm for the industry, and that the best underwriting years in the future decade may appear substandard against the average year of the past decade.

We have no magic formula to insulate our controlled insurance companies against this deteriorating future.  Our managers, particularly Phil Liesche, Bill Lyons, Roland Miller, Floyd Taylor and Milt Thornton, have done a magnificent job of swimming against the tide.  We have sacrificed much volume, but have maintained a substantial underwriting superiority in relation to industry-wide results.  The outlook at Berkshire is for continued low volume.  Our financial position offers us maximum flexibility, a very rare condition in the property- casualty insurance industry.  And, at some point, should fear ever prevail throughout the industry, our financial strength could become an operational asset of immense value.
1981.chinese:
评论者还在谈论承保周期，通常暗示它存在规律的节奏，而且盈利能力的中点相对稳定。我们的看法不同。我们相信，金额非常大、尽管会有明显波动的承保亏损，将成为行业常态；未来十年里最好的承保年份，与过去十年的平均年份相比，可能仍会显得不够好。

我们没有什么神奇公式，能让旗下控股保险公司免受这种日益恶化的前景影响。我们的管理者，尤其是菲尔·利舍（Phil Liesche）、比尔·莱昂斯（Bill Lyons）、罗兰·米勒（Roland Miller）、弗洛伊德·泰勒（Floyd Taylor）和米尔特·桑顿（Milt Thornton），在逆流而行中干得极其出色。我们牺牲了大量业务，却保住了相对于全行业显著领先的承保表现。伯克希尔未来的业务量预计仍会偏低。我们的财务状况给予我们最大的灵活性，这在财产及意外伤害保险业中非常罕见。而一旦某个时候恐惧笼罩整个行业，我们的财务实力，就可能成为价值极大的经营资产。

1981.english:
We believe that GEICO Corporation, our major non-controlled business operating in this field, is, by virtue of its extreme and improving operating efficiency, in a considerably more protected position than almost any other major insurer.  GEICO is a brilliantly run implementation of a very important business idea.

## Shareholder Designated Contributions

Our new program enabling shareholders to designate the recipients of corporate charitable contributions was greeted with extraordinary enthusiasm.  A copy of the letter sent October 14, 1981 describing this program appears on pages 51-53.  Of 932,206 shares eligible for participation (shares where the name of the actual owner appeared on our stockholder record), 95.6% responded.  Even excluding Buffet-related shares, the response topped 90%.
1981.chinese:
我们认为，盖可公司是我们在这一领域的重要非控股企业。凭借极高且仍在改善的经营效率，它的防御地位比几乎任何其他大型保险公司都好得多。盖可把一个极为重要的商业构想，付诸了管理出色的实践。

## 股东指定的慈善捐款

我们允许股东指定公司慈善捐款受赠对象的新计划，受到极其热烈的欢迎。介绍这一计划的1981年10月14日来信副本，见本报告第51—53页。在有资格参与的932,206股股份中，即实际所有者姓名出现在我们股东名册上的股份，95.6%作出了回应。即使剔除巴菲特相关股份，回应率仍超过90%。

1981.english: In addition, more than 3% of our shareholders voluntarily wrote letters or notes, all but one approving of the program. Both the level of participation and of commentary surpass any shareholder response we have witnessed, even when such response has been intensively solicited by corporate staff and highly paid professional proxy organizations.  In contrast, your extraordinary level of response occurred without even the nudge of a company-provided return envelope.  This self-propelled behavior speaks well for the program, and speaks well for our shareholders.
1981.chinese: 此外，超过3%的股东主动写来信件或便条，除一封外，全部赞同这项计划。无论参与率还是评论数量，都超过了我们见过的任何股东回应，即使是在公司员工和收费高昂的专业代理投票机构大力征集意见时，也没有出现过这样的反应。相比之下，各位这次非同寻常的回应，甚至没有靠公司附上一只回邮信封来推动。这种自发行为，既说明计划不错，也说明我们的股东不错。

1981.english: Apparently the owners of our corporation like both possessing and exercising the ability to determine where gifts of their funds shall be made.  The “father-knows-best” school of corporate governance will be surprised to find that none of our shareholders sent in a designation sheet with instructions that the officers of Berkshire - in their superior wisdom, of course - make the decision on charitable funds applicable to his shares. Nor did anyone suggest that his share of our charitable funds be used to match contributions made by our corporate directors to charities of the directors’ choice (a popular, proliferating and non-publicized policy at many large corporations).
1981.chinese: 显然，我们公司的所有者，既喜欢拥有决定其资金捐赠去向的权利，也喜欢行使这一权利。奉行“父亲最懂”的公司治理学派，会惊讶地发现：没有一位股东在交回指定表格时，要求伯克希尔高管——当然，凭借他们更高明的智慧——代为决定归属于其股份的慈善资金去向。也没有人建议，把自己那份慈善资金用于配捐公司董事向其自行选择的慈善机构所作的捐款；这种做法在许多大公司相当流行、越来越普遍，却鲜为人知。

1981.english:
All told, $1,783,655 of shareholder-designed contributions were distributed to about 675 charities.  In addition, Berkshire and subsidiaries continue to make certain contributions pursuant to local level decisions made by our operating managers.

There will be some years, perhaps two or three out of ten, when contributions by Berkshire will produce substandard tax deductions - or none at all.  In those years we will not effect our shareholder designated charitable program.  In all other years we expect to inform you about October 10th of the amount per share that you may designate.  A reply form will accompany the notice, and you will be given about three weeks to respond with your designation.  To qualify, your shares must be registered in your own name or the name of an owning trust, corporation, partnership or estate, if applicable, on our stockholder list of September 30th, or the Friday preceding if such date falls on a Saturday or Sunday.
1981.chinese:
总计1,783,655美元的股东指定捐款，分配给约675家慈善机构。此外，伯克希尔及其子公司，仍会按照经营管理者在当地作出的决定，进行某些捐款。

有些年份，也许十年中有两三年，伯克希尔的捐款所能获得的税前扣除效果会低于正常水平，或根本无法获得扣除。在这些年份，我们不会实施股东指定慈善捐款计划。在其他年份，我们预计会在10月10日前后通知各位，每股可以指定的捐款金额。通知会附回函表格，给予各位约三周时间回复指定对象。*要取得资格，股份必须在我们9月30日的股东名册上，以各位本人，或相应持股信托、公司、合伙企业或遗产的名义登记；如果该日为星期六或星期日，则以此前的星期五为准。*

1981.english: Our only disappointment with this program in 1981 was that some of our shareholders, through no fault of their own, missed the opportunity to participate.  The Treasury Department ruling allowing us to proceed without tax uncertainty was received early in October.  The ruling did not cover participation by shareholders whose stock was registered in the name of nominees, such as brokers, and additionally required that the owners of all designating shares make certain assurances to Berkshire.  These assurances could not be given us in effective form by nominee holders.
1981.chinese: 1981年，这项计划唯一让我们失望的，是一些股东并无过错，却错过了参与机会。我们在10月初才收到财政部的裁定，使计划能够在没有税务不确定性的情况下实施。该裁定并不涵盖以经纪商等代名人名义登记股票的股东，还要求所有参与指定捐款的股份所有者，向伯克希尔作出某些保证。代名持有人无法以有效形式代为作出这些保证。

1981.english:
Under these circumstances, we attempted to communicate with all of our owners promptly (via the October 14th letter) so that, if they wished, they could prepare themselves to participate by the November 13th record date.  It was particularly important that this information be communicated promptly to stockholders whose holdings were in nominee name, since they would not be eligible unless they took action to re-register their shares before the record date.

Unfortunately, communication to such non-record shareholders could take place only through the nominees.  We therefore strongly urged those nominees, mostly brokerage houses, to promptly transmit our letter to the real owners.  We explained that their failure to do so could deprive such owners of an important benefit.
1981.chinese:
在这种情况下，我们试图通过10月14日的信，迅速联系所有股东，使有意参与者能够在11月13日的登记日前做好准备。对于以代名人名义持股的股东，及时传达信息尤其重要，因为除非在登记日前采取行动，把股票重新登记，否则他们就没有资格。

遗憾的是，要与这些不在名册上的实际股东沟通，只能通过代名人。因此，我们强烈敦促这些大多为证券经纪公司的代名持有人，尽快把信转交实际所有者。我们解释说，不这样做，可能使这些所有者丧失一项重要利益。

1981.english:
The results from our urgings would not strengthen the case for private ownership of the U.S. Postal Service.  Many of our shareholders never heard from their brokers (as some shareholders told us after reading news accounts of the program).  Others were forwarded our letter too late for action.

One of the largest brokerage houses claiming to hold stock for sixty of its clients (about 4% of our shareholder population), apparently transmitted our letter about three weeks after receipt - too late for any of the sixty to participate. (Such lassitude did not pervade all departments of that firm; it billed Berkshire for mailing services within six days of that belated and ineffectual action.)
1981.chinese:
我们这番敦促的结果，并不能为美国邮政应当私有化的主张增添说服力。许多股东从未收到经纪商的任何消息；一些股东在从新闻报道中得知计划后，把这一情况告诉了我们。另一些人收到转来的信时，已经来不及采取行动。

规模最大的证券经纪公司之一，声称代60名客户持有股票，约占我们股东人数的4%。它似乎在收到信约三周后才转寄，结果这60人没有一人来得及参与。（这样的懒散倒没有遍及该公司的所有部门；在那次迟到而无效的行动之后六天内，它就向伯克希尔开出了邮寄服务账单。）

1981.english:
We recite such horror stories for two reasons: (1) if you wish to participate in future designated contribution programs, be sure to have your stock registered in your name well before September 30th; and (2) even if you don’t care to participate and prefer to leave your stock in nominee form, it would be wise to have at least one share registered in your own name.  By so doing, you can be sure that you will be notified of any important corporate news at the same time as all other shareholders.

The designated-contributions idea, along with many other ideas that have turned out well for us, was conceived by Charlie Munger, Vice Chairman of Berkshire and Chairman of Blue Chip. Irrespective of titles, Charlie and I work as partners in managing all controlled companies.  To almost a sinful degree, we enjoy our work as managing partners.  And we enjoy having you as our financial partners.

Warren E. Buffett Chairman of the Board
1981.chinese:
我们讲述这些糟糕经历，有两个原因：（1）如果各位希望参与今后的指定捐款计划，务必远在9月30日之前，就把股票登记在自己名下；（2）即使各位不想参与，宁愿继续以代名形式持股，最好也至少有一股登记在自己名下。这样，就能确保与其他所有股东同时收到公司的重要消息。

指定捐款的想法，与许多其他后来证明对我们很有帮助的想法一样，都出自查理·芒格（Charlie Munger）。他是伯克希尔副董事长兼蓝筹印花公司董事长。不论头衔如何，查理和我在管理全部控股公司时，始终作为合伙人合作。我们享受担任管理合伙人的工作，几乎到了令人觉得有罪的程度。我们也很高兴，有各位作为我们的财务合伙人。

沃伦·E·巴菲特

董事会主席

1982.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

March 3, 1983

To the Stockholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Operating earnings of $31.5 million in 1982 amounted to only 9.8% of beginning equity capital (valuing securities at cost), down from 15.2% in 1981 and far below our recent high of 19.4% in 1978.  This decline largely resulted from:

(1) a significant deterioration in insurance underwriting results;

(2) a considerable expansion of equity capital without a corresponding growth in the businesses we operate directly; and
1982.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

1983年3月3日

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1982年的经营利润为3,150万美元，仅相当于年初股东权益资本的9.8%（证券按成本计价），低于1981年的15.2%，也远低于我们近年在1978年达到的19.4%高点。这一下降主要源于：

（1）保险承保业绩显著恶化；

（2）股东权益资本大幅增加，但我们直接经营的企业没有相应增长；以及

1982.english:
(3) a continually-enlarging commitment of our resources to investment in partially-owned, nonoperated businesses; accounting rules dictate that a major part of our pro-rata share of earnings from such businesses must be excluded from Berkshire’s reported earnings.

It was only a few years ago that we told you that the operating earnings/equity capital percentage, with proper allowance for a few other variables, was the most important yardstick of single-year managerial performance.  While we still believe this to be the case with the vast majority of companies, we believe its utility in our own case has greatly diminished. You should be suspicious of such an assertion.  Yardsticks seldom are discarded while yielding favorable readings.  But when results deteriorate, most managers favor disposition of the yardstick rather than disposition of the manager.
1982.chinese:
（3）我们投入部分持股、但不参与经营的企业的资源不断增加；会计规则要求，我们按比例应享有的这类企业利润，有很大一部分必须排除在伯克希尔的报表利润之外。

就在几年前，我们还告诉各位，适当考虑其他几个变量后，经营利润与股东权益资本的比率，是衡量单一年度管理业绩最重要的尺度。虽然我们仍相信，对绝大多数公司来说确实如此，但在我们自己的情况下，这个指标的用途已经大幅减弱。各位应该对这种说法抱有怀疑。衡量尺度给出好看读数时，很少会被抛弃；但当结果恶化时，大多数管理者宁愿抛弃尺度，也不愿抛弃管理者。

1982.english:
To managers faced with such deterioration, a more flexible measurement system often suggests itself: just shoot the arrow of business performance into a blank canvas and then carefully draw the bullseye around the implanted arrow.  We generally believe in pre-set, long-lived and small bullseyes.  However, because of the importance of item (3) above, further explained in the following section, we believe our abandonment of the operating earnings/equity capital bullseye to be warranted.

## Non-Reported Ownership Earnings
1982.chinese:
面对业绩恶化，管理者常会想到一种更灵活的衡量办法：先把经营业绩这支箭射向空白画布，再围着已经插在画布上的箭，小心画出靶心。我们通常主张，靶心应该预先设定、长期不变，而且要小。不过，由于上述第（3）项的重要性——下一节还会进一步说明——我们认为，放弃经营利润／股东权益资本这个靶心，是有理由的。

## 未计入报表的所有者收益

1982.english:
The appended financial statements reflect “accounting” earnings that generally include our proportionate share of earnings from any underlying business in which our ownership is at least 20%.  Below the 20% ownership figure, however, only our share of dividends paid by the underlying business units is included in our accounting numbers; undistributed earnings of such less-than-20%-owned businesses are totally ignored.

There are a few exceptions to this rule; e.g., we own about 35% of GEICO Corporation but, because we have assigned our voting rights, the company is treated for accounting purposes as a less- than-20% holding.  Thus, dividends received from GEICO in 1982 of $3.5 million after tax are the only item included in our “accounting”earnings.  An additional $23 million that represents our share of GEICO’s undistributed operating earnings for 1982 is totally excluded from our reported operating earnings.  If GEICO had earned less money in 1982 but had paid an additional $1 million in dividends, our reported earnings would have been larger despite the poorer business results.  Conversely, if GEICO had earned an additional $100 million - and retained it all - our reported earnings would have been unchanged.  Clearly “accounting” earnings can seriously misrepresent economic reality.
1982.chinese:
随附财务报表反映的是“会计”利润。一般而言，对于我们持股至少20%的被投资企业，会计利润包括按持股比例应享有的利润。但持股低于20%时，会计数字中只计入我们应得的被投资企业已支付股息；这些持股不足20%的企业的未分配利润，则完全忽略。

这一规则有少数例外。例如，我们持有盖可公司（GEICO Corporation）约35%的股份，但由于已经让渡表决权，会计上仍将其作为持股不足20%的投资处理。因此，1982年从盖可收到的税后350万美元股息，是计入我们“会计”利润的唯一项目。另外2,300万美元，即我们应享有的盖可1982年未分配经营利润，则完全排除在报表经营利润之外。如果盖可1982年赚的钱更少，却多支付100万美元股息，尽管企业经营结果更差，我们报告的利润反而会更高。反过来，如果盖可多赚1亿美元，并全部留存，我们的报表利润也不会改变。显然，“会计”利润可能严重歪曲经济实质。

1982.english: We prefer a concept of “economic” earnings that includes all undistributed earnings, regardless of ownership percentage.  In our view, the value to all owners of the retained earnings of a business enterprise is determined by the effectiveness with which those earnings are used - and not by the size of one’s ownership percentage.  If you have owned .01 of 1% of Berkshire during the past decade, you have benefited economically in full measure from your share of our retained earnings, no matter what your accounting system.  Proportionately, you have done just as well as if you had owned the magic 20%.  But if you have owned 100% of a great many capital-intensive businesses during the decade, retained earnings that were credited fully and with painstaking precision to you under standard accounting methods have resulted in minor or zero economic value.  This is not a criticism of accounting procedures.  We would not like to have the job of designing a better system.  It’s simply to say that managers and investors alike must understand that accounting numbers are the beginning, not the end, of business valuation.
1982.chinese: 我们更认同“经济”利润这一概念：不论持股比例如何，都包括按权益应享有的全部未分配利润。在我们看来，企业留存利润对全部所有者的价值，取决于这些利润运用得是否有效，而不是某一所有者的持股比例。假如过去十年，各位一直持有伯克希尔0.01%的股份，无论采用什么会计制度，都已经从经济上充分享受到自己那份留存利润的好处。按比例计算，效果与持有那神奇的20%完全一样。但假如过去十年，各位拥有许多资本密集型企业的100%股权，按标准会计方法完整而精确地归属于各位的留存利润，最终创造的经济价值却可能很小，甚至为零。这不是批评会计程序；我们也不愿承担设计更好制度的工作。我们只是想说，无论管理者还是投资者，都必须理解：会计数字是企业估值的起点，而不是终点。

1982.english:
In most corporations, less-than-20% ownership positions are unimportant (perhaps, in part, because they prevent maximization of cherished reported earnings) and the distinction between accounting and economic results we have just discussed matters little.  But in our own case, such positions are of very large and growing importance.  Their magnitude, we believe, is what makes our reported operating earnings figure of limited significance.

In our 1981 annual report we predicted that our share of undistributed earnings from four of our major non-controlled holdings would aggregate over $35 million in 1982.  With no change in our holdings of three of these companies - GEICO, General Foods and The Washington Post - and a considerable increase in our ownership of the fourth, R. J. Reynolds Industries, our share of undistributed 1982 operating earnings of this group came to well over $40 million.  This number - not reflected at all in our earnings - is greater than our total reported earnings, which include only the $14 million in dividends received from these companies.  And, of course, we have a number of smaller ownership interests that, in aggregate, had substantial additional undistributed earnings.
1982.chinese:
在多数公司中，持股不足20%的投资并不重要，或许部分原因是，这种持股不利于把备受珍视的报表利润最大化。因此，刚才讨论的会计结果与经济结果之间的差别，影响不大。但在我们这里，这类持股极其重要，而且重要性还在上升。我们认为，正是它们的规模，使报表经营利润这个数字的意义受到限制。

1981年年报中，我们预计，四项主要非控股投资中，我们应享有的未分配利润，在1982年将合计超过3,500万美元。其中三家公司——盖可、通用食品（General Foods）和华盛顿邮报（The Washington Post）——的持股没有改变；第四家雷诺工业公司（R. J. Reynolds Industries）的持股则大幅增加。最终，这组公司1982年的未分配经营利润中，我们应享有的份额远超4,000万美元。这一金额完全没有反映在我们的利润里，却超过了全部报表利润；报表中只计入从这几家公司收到的1,400万美元股息。当然，我们还有若干规模较小的持股，它们合计还产生了相当可观的其他未分配利润。

1982.english: We attach real significance to the general magnitude of these numbers, but we don’t believe they should be carried to ten decimal places.  Realization by Berkshire of such retained earnings through improved market valuations is subject to very substantial, but indeterminate, taxation.  And while retained earnings over the years, and in the aggregate, have translated into at least equal market value for shareholders, the translation has been both extraordinarily uneven among companies and irregular and unpredictable in timing.
1982.chinese: 我们非常重视这些数字的大致规模，但不认为应该把它们算到小数点后十位。伯克希尔通过市值提高来实现这些留存利润时，须承担相当可观、但金额尚不确定的税款。而且，虽然多年合计来看，留存利润已为股东转化为至少等额的市值，不同公司之间的转化程度却极不均衡，发生时间也不规则、难以预测。

1982.english: However, this very unevenness and irregularity offers advantages to the value-oriented purchaser of fractional portions of businesses.  This investor may select from almost the entire array of major American corporations, including many far superior to virtually any of the businesses that could be bought in their entirety in a negotiated deal.  And fractional-interest purchases can be made in an auction market where prices are set by participants with behavior patterns that sometimes resemble those of an army of manic-depressive lemmings.
1982.chinese: 不过，恰恰是这种不均衡和不规则，为以价值为导向、购买企业部分权益的投资者提供了优势。他可以从几乎所有美国大型公司中挑选，其中许多公司的素质，远远优于几乎任何能够通过谈判整体买下的企业。而且，购买部分权益可以在竞价市场进行，价格由市场参与者决定；这些人的行为模式，有时像一大群患有躁郁症的旅鼠。

1982.english: Within this gigantic auction arena, it is our job to select businesses with economic characteristics allowing each dollar of retained earnings to be translated eventually into at least a dollar of market value.  Despite a lot of mistakes, we have so far achieved this goal.  In doing so, we have been greatly assisted by Arthur Okun’s patron saint for economists - St. Offset.  In some cases, that is, retained earnings attributable to our ownership position have had insignificant or even negative impact on market value, while in other major positions a dollar retained by an investee corporation has been translated into two or more dollars of market value.  To date, our corporate over- achievers have more than offset the laggards.  If we can continue this record, it will validate our efforts to maximize “economic” earnings, regardless of the impact upon “accounting” earnings.
1982.chinese: 在这座巨大的拍卖场里，我们的工作，是挑选具有这样一种经济特性的企业：留存的每1美元利润，最终都能转化为至少1美元市值。尽管犯过许多错误，我们迄今实现了这一目标。为此，我们得到阿瑟·奥肯（Arthur Okun）所说的经济学家守护神——“抵销圣人”（St. Offset）——的很大帮助。也就是说，在某些投资中，归属于我们所持权益的留存利润，对市值的影响微不足道，甚至为负；而在另一些主要持股中，被投资公司留存的每1美元，则转化为2美元或更多市值。迄今为止，表现超群的企业，其贡献已充分抵销落后企业的拖累。如果能够延续这一记录，就证明我们努力追求“经济”利润最大化是值得的，不论它对“会计”利润有什么影响。

1982.english:
Satisfactory as our partial-ownership approach has been, what really makes us dance is the purchase of 100% of good businesses at reasonable prices.  We’ve accomplished this feat a few times (and expect to do so again), but it is an extraordinarily difficult job - far more difficult than the purchase at attractive prices of fractional interests.

As we look at the major acquisitions that others made during 1982, our reaction is not envy, but relief that we were non- participants.  For in many of these acquisitions, managerial intellect wilted in competition with managerial adrenaline The thrill of the chase blinded the pursuers to the consequences of the catch.  Pascal’s observation seems apt: “It has struck me that all men’s misfortunes spring from the single cause that they are unable to stay quietly in one room.”
1982.chinese:
尽管部分持股的方法令人满意，真正让我们欢欣起舞的，还是以合理价格买下优秀企业的100%股权。这种壮举，我们完成过几次，也期待再次做到；但它极其困难，远比以有吸引力的价格购买部分权益困难。

看着其他公司在1982年进行的那些重大收购，我们的反应并非羡慕，而是庆幸自己没有参与。因为在许多收购中，管理者的理智，在与肾上腺素的较量中败下阵来。追逐的刺激，使追逐者看不见捕获之后的后果。帕斯卡（Pascal）的一句话似乎十分贴切：“我发现，人类所有不幸都源自同一个原因：他们无法安静地待在一个房间里。”

1982.english: (Your Chairman left the room once too often last year and almost starred in the Acquisition Follies of 1982.  In retrospect, our major accomplishment of the year was that a very large purchase to which we had firmly committed was unable to be completed for reasons totally beyond our control.  Had it come off, this transaction would have consumed extraordinary amounts of time and energy, all for a most uncertain payoff.  If we were to introduce graphics to this report, illustrating favorable business developments of the past year, two blank pages depicting this blown deal would be the appropriate centerfold.)
1982.chinese: （去年，各位的董事长多走出了一次房间，差一点成为《1982年收购闹剧》的主角。回头看，我们那一年的最大成就，是一项已经明确承诺参与的巨额收购，由于完全无法控制的原因而未能完成。如果交易成功，它会消耗异乎寻常的大量时间和精力，回报却极不确定。如果我们在年报中加入图画，展示过去一年的有利经营变化，那么，用两张空白页描绘这笔告吹的交易，最适合作为跨页中心插图。）

1982.english: Our partial-ownership approach can be continued soundly only as long as portions of attractive businesses can be acquired at attractive prices.  We need a moderately-priced stock market to assist us in this endeavor.  The market, like the Lord, helps those who help themselves.  But, unlike the Lord, the market does not forgive those who know not what they do.  For the investor, a too-high purchase price for the stock of an excellent company can undo the effects of a subsequent decade of favorable business developments.
1982.chinese: 只有在能够以有吸引力的价格买到有吸引力的企业部分权益时，我们的部分持股方法才能稳健延续。要做好这件事，我们需要一个价格适中的股票市场。市场如同上帝，会帮助那些自助的人；但与上帝不同，市场不会宽恕那些不知道自己在做什么的人。对于投资者而言，买入一家优秀公司的股票时支付过高价格，可能抵销此后整整十年企业良好发展的成果。

1982.english: Should the stock market advance to considerably higher levels, our ability to utilize capital effectively in partial- ownership positions will be reduced or eliminated.  This will happen periodically: just ten years ago, at the height of the two-tier market mania (with high-return-on-equity businesses bid to the sky by institutional investors), Berkshire’s insurance subsidiaries owned only $18 million in market value of equities, excluding their interest in Blue Chip Stamps.  At that time, such equity holdings amounted to about 15% of our insurance company investments versus the present 80%.  There were as many good businesses around in 1972 as in 1982, but the prices the stock market placed upon those businesses in 1972 looked absurd.  While high stock prices in the future would make our performance look good temporarily, they would hurt our long-term business prospects rather than help them.  We currently are seeing early traces of this problem.
1982.chinese: 如果股市升到高得多的水平，我们通过部分持股有效运用资本的能力，就会降低，甚至消失。这种情况会周期性出现：仅仅十年前，在“双层市场”狂热最盛时，机构投资者把高股东权益回报率企业的价格炒到天上，伯克希尔保险子公司持有的股票，扣除蓝筹印花公司（Blue Chip Stamps）的权益后，市值仅为1,800万美元。当时，这些股票约占保险公司投资的15%，而现在是80%。1972年，优秀企业的数量与1982年一样多，但1972年股市给这些企业的定价，在我们看来荒谬至极。未来高股价虽然会让我们的短期业绩看起来漂亮，却会损害而不是帮助长期经营前景。眼下，我们已经看到了这一问题的早期迹象。

1982.english:
## Long-Term Corporate Performance

Our gain in net worth during 1982, valuing equities held by our insurance subsidiaries at market value (less capital gain taxes payable if unrealized gains were actually realized) amounted to $208 million.  On a beginning net worth base of $519 million, the percentage gain was 40%.

During the 18-year tenure of present management, book value has grown from $19.46 per share to $737.43 per share, or 22.0% compounded annually.  You can be certain that this percentage will diminish in the future.  Geometric progressions eventually forge their own anchors.
1982.chinese:
## 企业的长期业绩

1982年，我们的净资产增加了2.08亿美元；其中，保险子公司持有的股票按市值计价，并扣除了假如未实现收益实际实现时须支付的资本利得税。相对于5.19亿美元的年初净资产，增幅为40%。

在现任管理层任职的18年间，每股账面价值从19.46美元增长到737.43美元，年复合增长率为22.0%。各位可以确信，未来这个百分比会下降。几何级数的增长，最终会为自己铸成沉重的锚。

1982.english:
Berkshire’s economic goal remains to produce a long-term rate of return well above the return achieved by the average large American corporation.  Our willingness to purchase either partial or total ownership positions in favorably-situated businesses, coupled with reasonable discipline about the prices we are willing to pay, should give us a good chance of achieving our goal.

Again this year the gain in market valuation of partially- owned businesses outpaced the gain in underlying economic value of those businesses.  For example, $79 million of our $208 million gain is attributable to an increased market price for GEICO.  This company continues to do exceptionally well, and we are more impressed than ever by the strength of GEICO’s basic business idea and by the management skills of Jack Byrne. (Although not found in the catechism of the better business schools, “Let Jack Do It” works fine as a corporate creed for us.)
1982.chinese:
伯克希尔的经济目标，仍然是取得明显高于美国大型公司平均回报的长期回报率。我们愿意购买处境有利的企业的部分或全部权益，同时对所愿支付的价格保持合理纪律，这应当使我们有相当好的机会实现目标。

今年，我们部分持股企业的市值增长，再一次超过了其基础经济价值的增长。例如，2.08亿美元的净资产增额中，有7,900万美元来自盖可股价上涨。这家公司继续表现得极其出色；我们对其基本商业构想的力量，以及杰克·伯恩（Jack Byrne）的管理才能，比以往任何时候都更加赞赏。（虽然较好的商学院教材里找不到，“让杰克去做”作为我们的企业信条，却十分管用。）

1982.english:
However, GEICO’s increase in market value during the past two years has been considerably greater than the gain in its intrinsic business value, impressive as the latter has been.  We expected such a favorable variation at some point, as the perception of investors converged with business reality.  And we look forward to substantial future gains in underlying business value accompanied by irregular, but eventually full, market recognition of such gains.

Year-to-year variances, however, cannot consistently be in our favor.  Even if our partially-owned businesses continue to perform well in an economic sense, there will be years when they perform poorly in the market.  At such times our net worth could shrink significantly.  We will not be distressed by such a shrinkage; if the businesses continue to look attractive and we have cash available, we simply will add to our holdings at even more favorable prices.
1982.chinese:
不过，过去两年，尽管盖可内在企业价值的增长已经令人印象深刻，其市值增长仍然高出了很多。随着投资者认识逐渐接近企业实际，我们本来就预期，这种有利的差异会在某个时候出现。我们也期待，基础企业价值在未来大幅增加，市场则以不规则、但最终充分的方式，认可这些增值。

然而，年度之间的偏差不可能始终对我们有利。即使我们部分持股的企业继续在经济上表现良好，也会有一些年份，它们在市场上的表现很差。届时，我们的净资产可能显著缩水。我们不会因此苦恼；如果企业仍然有吸引力，而且我们有可用现金，就会以更加有利的价格增持。

1982.english: I believe you will find the Blue Chip chronicle of developments in the Buffalo newspaper situation particularly interesting.  There are now only 14 cities in the United States with a daily newspaper whose weekday circulation exceeds that of the Buffalo News.  But the real story has been the growth in Sunday circulation.  Six years ago, prior to introduction of a Sunday edition of the News, the long-established Courier-Express, as the only Sunday newspaper published in Buffalo, had circulation of 272,000.  The News now has Sunday circulation of 367,000, a 35% gain - even though the number of households within the primary circulation area has shown little change during the six years.  We know of no city in the United States with a long history of seven-day newspaper publication in which the percentage of households purchasing the Sunday newspaper has grown at anything like this rate.  To the contrary, in most cities household penetration figures have grown negligibly, or not at all.  Our key managers in Buffalo - Henry Urban, Stan Lipsey, Murray Light, Clyde Pinson, Dave Perona and Dick Feather - deserve great credit for this unmatched expansion in Sunday readership.
1982.chinese: 我相信，蓝筹印花公司对布法罗报业变化的记述，会使各位特别感兴趣。目前，全美国只有14座城市，拥有工作日发行量超过《布法罗新闻报》（Buffalo News）的日报。但真正值得说的是星期日发行量的增长。六年前，在《新闻报》推出星期日版之前，历史悠久的《信使快报》（Courier-Express）作为布法罗唯一的星期日报纸，发行量为272,000份。现在，《新闻报》的星期日发行量已达367,000份，增加35%；而这六年里，主要发行区域的家庭户数几乎没有变化。我们不知道，在美国任何一座长期实行每周七天出报的城市，购买星期日报纸的家庭比例曾达到过这样的增长速度。相反，多数城市的家庭渗透率，几乎没有增长，或完全不增长。布法罗的主要管理者——亨利·厄本（Henry Urban）、斯坦·利普西（Stan Lipsey）、默里·莱特（Murray Light）、克莱德·平森（Clyde Pinson）、戴夫·佩罗纳（Dave Perona）和迪克·费瑟（Dick Feather）——应当因这种无与伦比的星期日读者扩张而获得高度赞扬。
