1985.english: An equal attraction at Scott Fetzer is Ralph Schey, its CEO for nine years.  When Ralph took charge, the company had 31 businesses, the result of an acquisition spree in the 1960s.  He disposed of many that did not fit or had limited profit potential, but his focus on rationalizing the original potpourri was not so intense that he passed by World Book when it became available for purchase in 1978.  Ralph’s operating and capital- allocation record is superb, and we are delighted to be associated with him.
1985.chinese: 同样吸引我们的，还有担任首席执行官九年的拉尔夫·谢伊。他接手时，公司因20世纪60年代收购热潮，拥有31项业务。他卖掉许多不适合或利润潜力有限的业务，但也没因一心整理这堆大杂烩，就错过1978年世界图书可供收购的机会。拉尔夫经营与资本配置的记录都很出色，我们很高兴与他合作。

1985.english: The history of the Scott Fetzer acquisition is interesting, marked by some zigs and zags before we became involved.  The company had been an announced candidate for purchase since early 1984.  A major investment banking firm spent many months canvassing scores of prospects, evoking interest from several. Finally, in mid-1985 a plan of sale, featuring heavy participation by an ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan), was approved by shareholders.  However, as difficulty in closing followed, the plan was scuttled.
1985.chinese: 收购斯科特与费策的过程很有意思，在我们介入之前，已曲折多次。公司自1984年初，就公开列为待售对象。一家大型投资银行花了数月，接触数十个潜在买家，引来几家兴趣。最终，1985年年中，股东批准一项出售方案，员工持股计划（ESOP）大量参与其中；但交割遇到困难，方案后来告吹。

1985.english:
I had followed this corporate odyssey through the newspapers.  On October 10, well after the ESOP deal had fallen through, I wrote a short letter to Ralph, whom I did not know.  I said we admired the company’s record and asked if he might like to talk.  Charlie and I met Ralph for dinner in Chicago on October 22 and signed an acquisition contract the following week.

The Scott Fetzer acquisition, plus major growth in our insurance business, should push revenues above $2 billion in 1986, more than double those of 1985.
1985.chinese:
我一直通过报纸追踪这场企业版《奥德赛》。10月10日，员工持股计划交易失败已久，我写了一封短信给并不认识的拉尔夫，说我们赞赏公司的成绩，问他愿不愿意谈谈。10月22日，查理与我在芝加哥和他共进晚餐，下一周就签了收购合同。

收购斯科特与费策，加上保险业务大幅增长，应使1986年收入超过20亿美元，达到1985年的两倍多。

1985.english:
Miscellaneous

The Scott Fetzer purchase illustrates our somewhat haphazard approach to acquisitions.  We have no master strategy, no corporate planners delivering us insights about socioeconomic trends, and no staff to investigate a multitude of ideas presented by promoters and intermediaries.  Instead, we simply hope that something sensible comes along - and, when it does, we act.

To give fate a helping hand, we again repeat our regular “business wanted” ad.  The only change from last year’s copy is in (1): because we continue to want any acquisition we make to have a measurable impact on Berkshire’s financial results, we have raised our minimum profit requirement.
1985.chinese:
## 其他事项

收购斯科特与费策，说明我们的收购方式颇有些随缘：没有总战略，没有公司规划师向我们传授社会经济趋势的洞见，也没有团队去调查推销者和中间人递来的大量主意。我们只是希望，合乎道理的机会会来；来了，就行动。

为了帮命运一把，我们再登一次惯常的“求购企业”广告。与去年相比，唯一变化在第（1）项：我们仍希望任何收购都能对伯克希尔财务结果产生可衡量的影响，所以提高了最低利润要求。

1985.english: Here’s what we’re looking for: (1) large purchases (at least $10 million of after-tax earnings), (2) demonstrated consistent earning power (future projections are of little interest to us, nor are “turn-around” situations), (3) businesses earning good returns on equity while employing little or no debt, (4) management in place (we can’t supply it), (5) simple businesses (if there’s lots of technology, we won’t understand it), (6) an offering price (we don’t want to waste our time or that of the seller by talking, even preliminarily, about a transaction when price is unknown).
1985.chinese:
我们寻找：

（1）大额收购（税后利润至少1000万美元）；

（2）已经证明的持续盈利能力（我们对未来预测兴趣不大，对“扭亏为盈”的故事也一样）；

（3）几乎不借债或完全不借债，却有良好股东权益回报的企业；

（4）现成的管理层（我们提供不了）；

（5）简单的生意（若技术太多，我们就看不懂）；

（6）明确的报价（价格不明就谈交易，哪怕初谈，我们也不愿浪费自己和卖方时间）。

1985.english: We will not engage in unfriendly takeovers.  We can promise complete confidentiality and a very fast answer - customarily within five minutes - as to whether we’re interested.  We prefer to buy for cash, but will consider issuance of stock when we receive as much in intrinsic business value as we give.  Indeed, following recent advances in the price of Berkshire stock, transactions involving stock issuance may be quite feasible.  We invite potential sellers to check us out by contacting people with whom we have done business in the past.  For the right business - and the right people - we can provide a good home.
1985.chinese: 我们不做敌意收购。我们承诺完全保密，并极快回答有没有兴趣，通常不超过五分钟。我们偏好现金收购；但若得到的企业内在价值不少于付出的，也会考虑发行股票。事实上，最近伯克希尔股价上涨后，发行股票的交易可能相当可行。欢迎潜在卖方向过去与我们交易过的人打听我们。对合适的企业和合适的人，我们能提供一个好归宿。

1985.english:
On the other hand, we frequently get approached about acquisitions that don’t come close to meeting our tests: new ventures, turnarounds, auction-like sales, and the ever-popular (among brokers) “I’m-sure-something-will-work-out-if-you-people- get-to-know-each-other”.  None of these attracts us in the least.

---

Besides being interested in the purchases of entire businesses as described above, we are also interested in the negotiated purchase of large, but not controlling, blocks of stock, as in our Cap Cities purchase.  Such purchases appeal to us only when we are very comfortable with both the economics of the business and the ability and integrity of the people running the operation.  We prefer large transactions: in the unusual case we might do something as small as $50 million (or even smaller), but our preference is for commitments many times that size.
1985.chinese:
另一方面，常有人来谈完全不符合标准的收购：新创企业、困境反转、拍卖式出售，以及经纪人百说不厌的“只要你们互相认识，肯定能谈出点什么”。这些全都丝毫不吸引我们。

* * *

除了上述整家公司收购，我们也有兴趣协商买入大笔但不控股的股票，就像大都会那笔。只有对企业经济特性，以及经营者的能力与诚信都十分放心，这类购买才吸引我们。我们偏好大交易：极少数情况下，可能做5000万美元这么小的，甚至更小；但我们更喜欢投入其数倍的金额。

1985.english:
---

About 96.8% of all eligible shares participated in Berkshire’s 1985 shareholder-designated contributions program. Total contributions made through the program were $4 million, and 1,724 charities were recipients.  We conducted a plebiscite last year in order to get your views about this program, as well as about our dividend policy.  (Recognizing that it’s possible to influence the answers to a question by the framing of it, we attempted to make the wording of ours as neutral as possible.) We present the ballot and the results in the Appendix on page 69. I think it’s fair to summarize your response as highly supportive of present policies and your group preference - allowing for the tendency of people to vote for the status quo - to be for increasing the annual charitable commitment as our asset values build.
1985.chinese:
* * *

伯克希尔1985年股东指定捐赠计划，约96.8%的合资格股份参与，共捐出400万美元，惠及1,724家慈善机构。去年，我们进行了一次全体征询投票，了解各位对这项计划及股息政策的看法。（知道问题措辞可能影响答案，我们尽量保持中立。）第69页附录列有选票与结果。我认为，公允的概括是：各位高度支持现行政策；考虑到人们倾向投票维持现状的因素，整体偏好仍是，随着资产价值增长，提高年度慈善捐赠额。

1985.english:
We urge new shareholders to read the description of our shareholder-designated contributions program that appears on pages 66 and 67.  If you wish to participate in future programs, we strongly urge that you immediately make sure that your shares are registered in the name of the actual owner, not in “street” name or nominee name.  Shares not so registered on September 30, 1986 will be ineligible for the 1986 program.

---

Five years ago we were required by the Bank Holding Company Act of 1969 to dispose of our holdings in The Illinois National Bank and Trust Company of Rockford, Illinois.  Our method of doing so was unusual: we announced an exchange ratio between stock of Rockford Bancorp Inc. (the Illinois National’s holding company) and stock of Berkshire, and then let each of our shareholders - except me - make the decision as to whether to exchange all, part, or none of his Berkshire shares for Rockford shares.  I took the Rockford stock that was left over and thus my own holding in Rockford was determined by your decisions.  At the time I said, “This technique embodies the world’s oldest and most elementary system of fairly dividing an object.  Just as when you were a child and one person cut the cake and the other got first choice, I have tried to cut the company fairly, but you get first choice as to which piece you want.”
1985.chinese:
请新股东阅读第66与67页对股东指定捐赠计划的说明。如希望参与今后计划，我们强烈建议，立即确认股票登记在实际所有者名下，而非券商代持或其他名义持有人名下。1986年9月30日未如此登记的股份，不得参加1986年计划。

* * *

五年前，根据1969年《银行控股公司法》，我们必须处置伊利诺伊州罗克福德市伊利诺伊国民银行及信托公司的持股。我们采用了一个不寻常办法：公布该银行控股公司罗克福德银行公司股票与伯克希尔股票的交换比例，让除我以外的每位股东，自行决定把全部或部分伯克希尔股票换成罗克福德股票，或者一股也不换。剩下的罗克福德股票全归我，因此我最终持有多少，由各位决定。当时我说：“这种方法体现了世上最古老、最简单的公平分物办法。小时候，一个人切蛋糕，另一个先挑；我已尽量把公司切得公平，但哪块先归您，由您先选。”

1985.english:
Last fall Illinois National was sold.  When Rockford’s liquidation is completed, its shareholders will have received per-share proceeds about equal to Berkshire’s per-share intrinsic value at the time of the bank’s sale.  I’m pleased that this five-year result indicates that the division of the cake was reasonably equitable.

Last year I put in a plug for our annual meeting, and you took me up on the invitation.  Over 250 of our more than 3,000 registered shareholders showed up.  Those attending behaved just as those present in previous years, asking the sort of questions you would expect from intelligent and interested owners.  You can attend a great many annual meetings without running into a crowd like ours. (Lester Maddox, when Governor of Georgia, was criticized regarding the state’s abysmal prison system.  “The solution”, he said, “is simple.  All we need is a better class of prisoners.” Upgrading annual meetings works the same way.)
1985.chinese:
去年秋天，伊利诺伊国民银行已出售。罗克福德清算完成时，股东每股累计所得，会约等于银行出售时伯克希尔每股内在价值。这五年的结果表明，蛋糕分得相当公平，我很高兴。

去年，我为股东年会打了个广告，各位欣然应邀。3000多名登记股东中，超过250人到场。他们与往年参会者一样，提出聪明而关心企业的所有者应有的问题。参加许多许多家年会，也未必碰到像我们这样的听众。（莱斯特·马多克斯任佐治亚州州长时，因州监狱制度糟糕而受批评。他说：“办法很简单，我们只需要一批素质更好的囚犯。”提高年会质量，原理相同。）

1985.english:
I hope you come to this year’s meeting, which will be held on May 20 in Omaha.  There will be only one change: after 48 years of allegiance to another soft drink, your Chairman, in an unprecedented display of behavioral flexibility, has converted to the new Cherry Coke.  Henceforth, it will be the Official Drink of the Berkshire Hathaway Annual Meeting.

And bring money: Mrs. B promises to have bargains galore if you will pay her a visit at The Nebraska Furniture Mart after the meeting.

Warren E. Buffett Chairman of the Board

March 4, 1986
1985.chinese:
希望各位参加今年5月20日在奥马哈举行的年会。只有一项变化：忠于另一种汽水48年后，各位的董事长以前所未有的行为灵活性，改喝新款樱桃可乐了。今后，它将成为伯克希尔·哈撒韦股东年会的官方饮料。

还请带上钱：B夫人保证，若年会后各位去内布拉斯加家具卖场看她，那里有大把便宜货。

沃伦·E.巴菲特

董事长

1986年3月4日

1986.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Our gain in net worth during 1986 was $492.5 million, or 26.1%.  Over the last 22 years (that is, since present management took over), our per-share book value has grown from $19.46 to $2,073.06, or 23.3% compounded annually.  Both the numerator and denominator are important in the per-share book value calculation: during the 22-year period our corporate net worth has increased 10,600% while shares outstanding have increased less than 1%.
1986.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1986年，我们的净资产增加了4.925亿美元，增幅为26.1%。过去22年，也就是现任管理层接手以来，每股账面价值从19.46美元增长到2,073.06美元，年复合增长率为23.3%。计算每股账面价值时，分子和分母同样重要：在这22年里，公司的净资产增加了10,600%，而发行在外的股份数量增加不到1%。

1986.english:
In past reports I have noted that book value at most companies differs widely from intrinsic business value - the number that really counts for owners.  In our own case, however, book value has served for more than a decade as a reasonable if somewhat conservative proxy for business value.  That is, our business value has moderately exceeded our book value, with the ratio between the two remaining fairly steady.

The good news is that in 1986 our percentage gain in business value probably exceeded the book value gain.  I say "probably" because business value is a soft number: in our own case, two equally well-informed observers might make judgments more than 10% apart.
1986.chinese:
我在以往的报告中指出，许多公司的账面价值与企业内在价值——对所有者而言真正重要的数字——存在很大差异。不过，就伯克希尔而言，十多年来，账面价值一直是企业价值一个合理、但略显保守的替代指标。也就是说，我们的企业价值略高于账面价值，两者之间的比率一直相当稳定。

好消息是，1986年我们的企业价值增长率很可能超过了账面价值增长率。我说“很可能”，是因为企业价值并不是一个能够精确确定的数字：即使两位观察者掌握同样充分的信息，他们对我们企业价值的判断也可能相差10%以上。

1986.english: A large measure of our improvement in business value relative to book value reflects the outstanding performance of key managers at our major operating businesses.  These managers - the Blumkins, Mike Goldberg, the Heldmans, Chuck Huggins, Stan Lipsey, and Ralph Schey - have over the years improved the earnings of their businesses dramatically while, except in the case of insurance, utilizing little additional capital.  This accomplishment builds economic value, or "Goodwill," that does not show up in the net worth figure on our balance sheet, nor in our per-share book value.  In 1986 this unrecorded gain was substantial.
1986.chinese: 企业价值相对于账面价值的改善，很大程度上来自主要经营业务中几位关键管理者的出色表现。多年来，布卢姆金家族、迈克·戈德伯格、赫尔德曼家族、查克·哈金斯、斯坦·利普西和拉尔夫·谢伊显著提高了各自企业的盈利，而且除保险业务之外，几乎没有使用多少新增资本。这一成就创造了经济价值，也就是“商誉”（Goodwill），却没有反映在资产负债表的净资产数字中，也没有体现在每股账面价值中。1986年，这种未入账的价值增长相当可观。

1986.english:
So much for the good news.  The bad news is that my performance did not match that of our managers.  While they were doing a superb job in running our businesses, I was unable to skillfully deploy much of the capital they generated.

Charlie Munger, our Vice Chairman, and I really have only two jobs.  One is to attract and keep outstanding managers to run our various operations.  This hasn’t been all that difficult. Usually the managers came with the companies we bought, having demonstrated their talents throughout careers that spanned a wide variety of business circumstances.  They were managerial stars long before they knew us, and our main contribution has been to not get in their way.  This approach seems elementary: if my job were to manage a golf team - and if Jack Nicklaus or Arnold Palmer were willing to play for me - neither would get a lot of directives from me about how to swing.
1986.chinese:
好消息说完了。坏消息是，我的表现没有赶上这些管理者。当他们把企业经营得非常出色时，我却没能把他们创造的大量资本有效地配置出去。

查理·芒格——我们的副董事长——和我实际上只有两项工作。第一项，是吸引并留住优秀的经理人，让他们经营我们的各项业务。这件事并不十分困难。通常，这些经理人在我们收购企业时就已经在那里，且已在经历各种商业环境的漫长职业生涯中证明了自己的才干。他们在认识我们之前很久，就是管理领域的明星；而我们的主要贡献，就是不妨碍他们施展本领。这个方法似乎十分简单：假如我的工作是管理一支高尔夫球队，而杰克·尼克劳斯或阿诺德·帕尔默愿意替我打球，我可不会对他们怎样挥杆指手画脚。

1986.english:
Some of our key managers are independently wealthy (we hope they all become so), but that poses no threat to their continued interest: they work because they love what they do and relish the thrill of outstanding performance.  They unfailingly think like owners (the highest compliment we can pay a manager) and find all aspects of their business absorbing.

(Our prototype for occupational fervor is the Catholic tailor who used his small savings of many years to finance a pilgrimage to the Vatican.  When he returned, his parish held a special meeting to get his first-hand account of the Pope.  "Tell us," said the eager faithful, "just what sort of fellow is he?" Our hero wasted no words: "He’s a forty-four, medium.")
1986.chinese:
我们的一些重要经理人本身就十分富有（我们希望他们人人都能如此），但这丝毫不会削弱他们继续工作的兴趣：他们工作，是因为热爱自己所做的事，也享受创造出色业绩的兴奋感。他们始终像所有者那样思考——这是我们能给予管理者的最高赞誉——并且对业务的方方面面充满兴趣。

（我们心目中职业热情的典范，是一位天主教裁缝。他用多年积攒下来的少量储蓄，去梵蒂冈朝圣。回来后，教区专门开会，请他介绍对教皇的第一手印象。迫不及待的教友问：“告诉我们，教皇究竟是个怎样的人？”这位仁兄言简意赅地答道：“他穿44码，中等身材。”）

1986.english:
Charlie and I know that the right players will make almost any team manager look good.  We subscribe to the philosophy of Ogilvy & Mather’s founding genius, David Ogilvy: "If each of us hires people who are smaller than we are, we shall become a company of dwarfs.  But, if each of us hires people who are bigger than we are, we shall become a company of giants."

A by-product of our managerial style is the ability it gives us to easily expand Berkshire’s activities.  We’ve read management treatises that specify exactly how many people should report to any one executive, but they make little sense to us. When you have able managers of high character running businesses about which they are passionate, you can have a dozen or more reporting to you and still have time for an afternoon nap. Conversely, if you have even one person reporting to you who is deceitful, inept or uninterested, you will find yourself with more than you can handle.  Charlie and I could work with double the number of managers we now have, so long as they had the rare qualities of the present ones.
1986.chinese:
查理和我知道，只要队员选得对，几乎任何球队经理看起来都会很出色。我们信奉奥美广告创始天才大卫·奥格威的理念：“如果我们每个人都雇用比自己矮小的人，我们就会成为一家侏儒公司；但如果我们每个人都雇用比自己高大的人，我们就会成为一家巨人公司。”

我们的管理风格还有一个附带好处：它使伯克希尔很容易扩大业务范围。我们读过一些管理学著作，明确规定一个主管究竟应该管理多少名直接下属，但那些规定在我们看来意义不大。如果管理各项业务的都是才干出众、品格高尚、又热爱事业的人，即便有十几位甚至更多经理人向你直接汇报，你下午仍然有时间睡个午觉。反过来，如果向你汇报的人中有一个不诚实、无能或缺乏兴趣，你就会忙得不可开交。只要新加入者具有现有经理人的罕见品质，查理和我即使管理两倍数量的经理人，也完全应付得来。

1986.english:
We intend to continue our practice of working only with people whom we like and admire.  This policy not only maximizes our chances for good results, it also ensures us an extraordinarily good time.  On the other hand, working with people who cause your stomach to churn seems much like marrying for money - probably a bad idea under any circumstances, but absolute madness if you are already rich.

The second job Charlie and I must handle is the allocation of capital, which at Berkshire is a considerably more important challenge than at most companies.  Three factors make that so: we earn more money than average; we retain all that we earn; and, we are fortunate to have operations that, for the most part, require little incremental capital to remain competitive and to grow. Obviously, the future results of a business earning 23% annually and retaining it all are far more affected by today’s capital allocations than are the results of a business earning 10% and distributing half of that to shareholders.  If our retained earnings - and those of our major investees, GEICO and Capital Cities/ABC, Inc. - are employed in an unproductive manner, the economics of Berkshire will deteriorate very quickly.  In a company adding only, say, 5% to net worth annually, capital- allocation decisions, though still important, will change the company’s economics far more slowly.
1986.chinese:
我们打算继续只与自己喜欢和钦佩的人共事。这个原则不仅最大限度地增加了取得好结果的机会，也让我们工作得格外愉快。反过来，与那些让你胃里翻江倒海的人共事，颇像为了钱而结婚——无论什么情况下都大概不是好主意；如果你本来就富有，那更是彻头彻尾的疯狂。

查理和我必须承担的第二项工作，是资本配置。在伯克希尔，这是一项比大多数公司更重要得多的挑战，原因有三：我们赚的钱高于平均水平；我们把赚到的钱全部留下；而且幸运的是，我们大部分业务维持竞争力和实现增长，几乎不需要投入多少新增资本。

显然，一家每年赚取23%回报并把利润全部留存的企业，其未来业绩受今天资本配置决策的影响，要远远大于一家每年赚取10%回报、却把其中一半分给股东的企业。如果我们的留存利润，以及主要被投资公司盖可和Capital Cities/ABC公司的留存利润，被投入不能创造效益的用途，伯克希尔的经济特性就会迅速恶化。相比之下，一家净资产每年只增加5%的企业，即使资本配置决策同样重要，它对经济特性的改变也会缓慢得多。

1986.english:
Capital allocation at Berkshire was tough work in 1986.  We did make one business acquisition - The Fechheimer Bros. Company, which we will discuss in a later section.  Fechheimer is a company with excellent economics, run by exactly the kind of people with whom we enjoy being associated.  But it is relatively small, utilizing only about 2% of Berkshire’s net worth.

Meanwhile, we had no new ideas in the marketable equities field, an area in which once, only a few years ago, we could readily employ large sums in outstanding businesses at very reasonable prices.  So our main capital allocation moves in 1986 were to pay off debt and stockpile funds.  Neither is a fate worse than death, but they do not inspire us to do handsprings either.  If Charlie and I were to draw blanks for a few years in our capital-allocation endeavors, Berkshire’s rate of growth would slow significantly.
1986.chinese:
1986年，伯克希尔的资本配置工作很困难。我们确实收购了一家企业——费希海默兄弟公司（The Fechheimer Bros. Company），稍后会单独介绍。费希海默经济特性优秀，管理者也正是我们喜欢共事的人。但它的规模相对较小，只使用了伯克希尔净资产的大约2%。

与此同时，在上市股票投资领域，我们没有发现任何新的好主意。就在几年前，我们还可以很容易地把大笔资金，以十分合理的价格投入优秀企业。因此，1986年我们主要的资本配置行动，是偿还债务和积累资金。这两件事倒也不至于生不如死，但也无法让我们兴奋得翻跟头。如果查理和我在未来几年资本配置方面始终毫无收获，伯克希尔的增长速度就会显著放缓。

1986.english: We will continue to look for operating businesses that meet our tests and, with luck, will acquire such a business every couple of years.  But an acquisition will have to be large if it is to help our performance materially.  Under current stock market conditions, we have little hope of finding equities to buy for our insurance companies.  Markets will change significantly - you can be sure of that and some day we will again get our turn at bat.  However, we haven’t the faintest idea when that might happen.
1986.chinese: 我们会继续寻找符合标准的经营性企业，希望运气好时，每隔一两年能够收购一家。不过，要对伯克希尔的业绩产生实质性影响，收购对象必须规模很大。在当前的股市环境下，我们几乎不指望为保险公司买到合适的股票。市场一定会发生重大变化——对此你可以确信——总有一天又会轮到我们挥棒。但究竟何时到来，我们一点头绪也没有。

1986.english: It can’t be said too often (although I’m sure you feel I’ve tried) that, even under favorable conditions, our returns are certain to drop substantially because of our enlarged size.  We have told you that we hope to average a return of 15% on equity and we maintain that hope, despite some negative tax law changes described in a later section of this report.  If we are to achieve this rate of return, our net worth must increase $7.2 billion in the next ten years.  A gain of that magnitude will be possible only if, before too long, we come up with a few very big (and good) ideas.  Charlie and I can’t promise results, but we do promise you that we will keep our efforts focused on our goals.
1986.chinese: 有一点再怎么强调也不为过（尽管我相信你们觉得我已经试得够努力了）：即使外部条件有利，由于规模已经扩大，我们的回报率也必然明显下降。我们曾告诉各位，希望股东权益回报率平均达到15%；尽管税法出现了本报告后面将提到的若干不利变化，我们仍然保持这一希望。要达到15%的回报率，未来十年我们的净资产必须增加72亿美元。如此巨大的增长，只有在不久之后想出几个真正重大、而且优秀的投资主意，才有可能实现。查理和我不能保证结果，但可以向各位保证，我们会始终围绕目标努力。

1986.english:
## Sources of Reported Earnings

The table on the next page shows the major sources of Berkshire’s reported earnings.  This table differs in several ways from the one presented last year.  We have added four new lines of business because of the Scott Fetzer and Fechheimer acquisitions. In the case of Scott Fetzer, the two major units acquired were World Book and Kirby, and each is presented separately.  Fourteen other businesses of Scott Fetzer are aggregated in Scott Fetzer - Diversified Manufacturing.  SF Financial Group, a credit company holding both World Book and Kirby receivables, is included in "Other." This year, because Berkshire is so much larger, we also have eliminated separate reporting for several of our smaller businesses.
1986.chinese:
## 财报利润的来源

下一页的表格列示了伯克希尔财报利润的主要来源。它与去年的表格有几处不同。由于收购了斯科特与费策（Scott Fetzer）和费希海默，我们增加了四条业务项目。在斯科特与费策的收购中，世界图书百科全书（World Book）和柯比（Kirby）是两大主要业务，因此分别列示。斯科特与费策的其他14项业务合并在“斯科特与费策——多元制造业”项下。持有世界图书和柯比应收账款的信贷公司SF金融集团归入“其他”。此外，由于伯克希尔规模已经大得多，今年我们也不再单独报告一些较小的业务。

1986.english:
In the table, amortization of Goodwill is not charged against the specific businesses but, for reasons outlined in the Appendix to my letter in the 1983 Annual Report, is aggregated as a separate item. (A Compendium of earlier letters, including the Goodwill discussion, is available upon request.) Both the Scott Fetzer and Fechheimer acquisitions created accounting Goodwill, which is why the amortization charge for Goodwill increased in 1986.

Additionally, the Scott Fetzer acquisition required other major purchase-price accounting adjustments, as prescribed by generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).  The GAAP figures, of course, are the ones used in our consolidated financial statements.  But, in our view, the GAAP figures are not necessarily the most useful ones for investors or managers. Therefore, the figures shown for specific operating units are earnings before purchase-price adjustments are taken into account.  In effect, these are the earnings that would have been reported by the businesses if we had not purchased them.
1986.chinese:
表中，商誉摊销没有分摊到具体业务，而是作为独立项目汇总列示，原因已在1983年年报致股东信的附录中说明。（如有需要，我们可以提供收录早年信件及商誉讨论的汇编。）收购斯科特与费策和费希海默都形成了会计商誉，因此1986年的商誉摊销费用有所增加。

此外，按照公认会计原则（GAAP）的规定，收购斯科特与费策还要求进行其他重大的购买价格会计调整。我们当然在合并财务报表中使用GAAP数字，但在我们看来，GAAP数字并不一定对投资者或管理者最有用。因此，下表中各经营单位的利润，均按购买价格调整前的口径列示。实际上，它们就是假设我们没有收购这些企业时，这些企业本来会报告的利润。

1986.english:
A discussion of our reasons for preferring this form of presentation is in the Appendix to this letter.  This Appendix will never substitute for a steamy novel and definitely is not required reading.  However, I know that among our 6,000 shareholders there are those who are thrilled by my essays on accounting - and I hope that both of you enjoy the Appendix.

In the Business Segment Data on pages 41-43 and in the Management’s Discussion section on pages 45-49, you will find much additional information about our businesses.  I urge you to read those sections, as well as Charlie Munger’s letter to Wesco shareholders, describing the various businesses of that subsidiary, which starts on page 50.
1986.chinese:
本信附录解释了我们为什么更喜欢这种列示方式。附录绝不可能代替一本热辣小说，也绝对不是必读内容。不过，我知道我们6000名股东中，总有人会为我的会计论文兴奋不已——希望你们两位都能喜欢这篇附录。

关于我们的业务，第41至43页的分部数据和第45至49页的管理层讨论还有大量补充信息。我鼓励各位阅读这些章节，以及从第50页开始的查理·芒格致韦斯科股东信，其中介绍了那家子公司的各项业务。

1986.english:
As you can see, operating earnings substantially improved during 1986.  Some of the improvement came from the insurance operation, whose results I will discuss in a later section. Fechheimer also will be discussed separately.  Our other major businesses performed as follows:

o Operating results at The Buffalo News continue to reflect a truly superb managerial job by Stan Lipsey.  For the third year in a row, man-hours worked fell significantly and other costs were closely controlled.  Consequently, our operating margins improved materially in 1986, even though our advertising rate increases were well below those of most major newspapers.
1986.chinese:
如各位所见，1986年的经营利润显著改善。一部分改善来自保险业务，我会在后面的章节讨论。费希海默也会单独介绍。其他主要业务的表现如下。

**布法罗新闻报。** 布法罗新闻报的经营业绩继续体现了斯坦·利普西极其出色的管理。连续第三年，员工工作总工时显著下降，其他成本也受到严格控制。因此，虽然1986年我们的广告费率涨幅远低于多数大型报纸，经营利润率仍然明显提高。

1986.english:
Our cost-control efforts have in no way reduced our commitment to news.  We continue to deliver a 50% "news hole" (the portion of the total space in the paper devoted to news), a higher percentage, we believe, than exists at any dominant newspaper in this country of our size or larger.

The average news hole at papers comparable to the News is about 40%.  The difference between 40% and 50% is more important than it might first seem: a paper with 30 pages of ads and a 40% news hole delivers 20 pages of news a day, whereas our paper matches 30 pages of ads with 30 pages of news.  Therefore, given ad pages equal in number, we end up delivering our readers no less than 50% more news.
1986.chinese:
我们的成本控制工作丝毫没有削弱对新闻内容的投入。我们继续把报纸总版面的50%留给新闻内容；在我们看来，这一比例高于美国所有规模与我们相当或更大的占主导地位报纸。

类似规模报纸平均只有约40%的版面用于新闻。40%和50%之间的差异，比乍看之下重要得多：假设一份报纸每天刊登30页广告，新闻版面占40%，它就会提供20页新闻；而我们的报纸在刊登30页广告的同时，还提供30页新闻。因此，在广告页数相同的情况下，我们提供给读者的新闻内容至少多出50%。

1986.english: We believe this heavy commitment to news is one of the reasons The Buffalo News has the highest weekday penetration rate (the percentage of households in the paper’s primary marketing area purchasing it each day) among any of the top 50 papers in the country.  Our Sunday penetration, where we are also number one, is even more impressive.  Ten years ago, the only Sunday paper serving Buffalo (the Courier-Express) had circulation of 271,000 and a penetration ratio of about 63%.  The Courier- Express had served the area for many decades and its penetration ratio - which was similar to those existing in many metropolitan markets - was thought to be a "natural" one, accurately reflecting the local citizenry’s appetite for a Sunday product.
1986.chinese: 我们认为，对新闻内容的大量投入，是布法罗新闻报在全国前50大报纸中，工作日市场渗透率最高的原因之一。所谓渗透率，是指报纸主要销售区域内，每天购买该报的家庭所占的比例。我们的星期日版在这项指标上同样位居第一，而且优势更加突出。十年前，布法罗唯一的星期日报纸《信使快报》（Courier-Express）发行量为27.1万份，市场渗透率约63%。这份报纸服务当地几十年，其渗透率与许多大都市市场接近，因此人们曾认为63%是一种“自然”水平，准确反映了当地居民对星期日报纸的需求。

1986.english:
Our Sunday paper was started in late 1977.  It now has a penetration ratio of 83% and sells about 100,000 copies more each Sunday than did the Courier-Express ten years ago - even though population in our market area has declined during the decade.  In recent history, no other city that has long had a local Sunday paper has experienced a penetration gain anywhere close to Buffalo’s.

Despite our exceptional market acceptance, our operating margins almost certainly have peaked.  A major newsprint price increase took effect at the end of 1986, and our advertising rate increases in 1987 will again be moderate compared to those of the industry.  However, even if margins should materially shrink, we would not reduce our news-hole ratio.
1986.chinese:
我们的星期日版于1977年末创办。如今，它的市场渗透率达到83%，每个星期日的销量比十年前《信使快报》高出约10万份——尽管这十年里，我们市场区域的人口还在下降。近代报业史上，其他长期拥有本地星期日报纸的城市，没有哪一个经历过接近布法罗这样的渗透率提升。

尽管我们的市场接受程度非同寻常，经营利润率几乎肯定已经达到顶峰。1986年末新闻纸价格大幅上涨，而1987年我们的广告费率涨幅仍将低于行业通常水平。不过，即使利润率明显下降，我们也不会降低新闻版面比例。

1986.english: As I write this, it has been exactly ten years since we purchased The News.  The financial rewards it has brought us have far exceeded our expectations and so, too, have the non-financial rewards.  Our respect for the News - high when we bought it - has grown consistently ever since the purchase, as has our respect and admiration for Murray Light, the editor who turns out the product that receives such extraordinary community acceptance. The efforts of Murray and Stan, which were crucial to the News during its dark days of financial reversals and litigation, have not in the least been lessened by prosperity.  Charlie and I are grateful to them.
1986.chinese: 写下这些文字时，距离我们收购《布法罗新闻报》恰好已有十年。它带来的财务回报远远超过预期，非财务回报同样如此。我们收购时就非常尊重这家报纸，此后这种尊重不断增加；我们对主编默里·莱特的尊敬和钦佩也是如此，正是他负责制作如此受到社区欢迎的产品。在新闻报经历财务挫折和诉讼的艰难岁月里，默里和斯坦的努力至关重要；企业进入繁荣时期后，他们的投入丝毫没有减少。查理和我感谢他们。

1986.english: o The amazing Blumkins continue to perform business miracles at Nebraska Furniture Mart.  Competitors come and go (mostly go), but Mrs. B. and her progeny roll on.  In 1986 net sales increased 10.2% to $132 million.  Ten years ago sales were $44 million and, even then, NFM appeared to be doing just about all of the business available in the Greater Omaha Area.  Given NFM’s remarkable dominance, Omaha’s slow growth in population and the modest inflation rates that have applied to the goods NFM sells, how can this operation continue to rack up such large sales gains?  The only logical explanation is that the marketing territory of NFM’s one-and-only store continues to widen because of its ever-growing reputation for rock-bottom everyday prices and the broadest of selections.  In preparation for further gains, NFM is expanding the capacity of its warehouse, located a few hundred yards from the store, by about one-third.
1986.chinese: **内布拉斯加家具卖场。** 令人惊叹的布卢姆金家族继续在内布拉斯加家具卖场创造商业奇迹。竞争对手来来去去（大多是去），而B夫人和她的后代一直向前。1986年净销售额增长10.2%，达到1.32亿美元。十年前，销售额只有4400万美元，而当时人们已经觉得家具城几乎做尽了大奥马哈地区所有能做的生意。考虑到家具城惊人的市场统治地位、奥马哈人口增长缓慢，以及所售商品的温和通胀，为什么业务还能持续实现如此强劲的销售增长？唯一合理的解释是：由于“每天最低价”和品类最齐全的声誉不断增强，这家独一无二门店的市场覆盖范围仍在扩大。为迎接进一步增长，家具城正在把距离门店几百码的仓库容量扩大约三分之一。

1986.english:
Mrs. B, Chairman of Nebraska Furniture Mart, continues at age 93 to outsell and out-hustle any manager I’ve ever seen. She’s at the store seven days a week, from opening to close. Competing with her represents a triumph of courage over judgment.

It’s easy to overlook what I consider to be the critical lesson of the Mrs. B saga: at 93, Omaha based Board Chairmen have yet to reach their peak.  Please file this fact away to consult before you mark your ballot at the 2024 annual meeting of Berkshire.
1986.chinese:
家具城董事长B夫人现年93岁，仍然比我见过的任何管理者都更会卖货、更能拼命。她每周七天都在店里，从开门一直待到关门。要与她竞争，真是勇气战胜判断力的典范。

人们很容易忽略B夫人故事中我认为最重要的教训：奥马哈的董事长到了93岁，尚未达到事业巅峰。请各位把这个事实记下来，等到2024年伯克希尔股东大会投票时再拿出来参考。

1986.english: o At See’s, sales trends improved somewhat from those of recent years.  Total pounds sold rose about 2%. (For you chocaholics who like to fantasize, one statistic: we sell over 12,000 tons annually.) Same-store sales, measured in pounds, were virtually unchanged.  In the previous six years, same store poundage fell, and we gained or maintained poundage volume only by adding stores.  But a particularly strong Christmas season in 1986 stemmed the decline.  By stabilizing same-store volume and making a major effort to control costs, See’s was able to maintain its excellent profit margin in 1986 though it put through only minimal price increases.  We have Chuck Huggins, our long-time manager at See’s, to thank for this significant achievement.
1986.chinese: **喜诗糖果。** 喜诗的销售趋势比近几年略有改善。总销售重量增长约2%。（对于喜欢幻想的巧克力爱好者，提供一个数字：我们每年卖出的糖果超过1.2万吨。）以重量衡量的同店销量基本没有变化。过去六年里，同店销售重量一直下降；我们只有不断开新店，才能增加或维持销售总量。不过，1986年圣诞季特别强劲，阻止了下降趋势。由于同店销量得以稳定，又大力控制成本，尽管售价只作了极小幅度上调，喜诗仍在1986年保持了出色的利润率。为此，我们要感谢长期管理喜诗的查克·哈金斯。

1986.english: See’s has a one-of-a-kind product "personality" produced by a combination of its candy’s delicious taste and moderate price, the company’s total control of the distribution process, and the exceptional service provided by store employees.  Chuck rightfully measures his success by the satisfaction of our customers, and his attitude permeates the organization.  Few major retailing companies have been able to sustain such a customer-oriented spirit, and we owe Chuck a great deal for keeping it alive and well at See’s.
1986.chinese: 喜诗拥有一种独特的产品“个性”，来自几个因素的结合：糖果美味、价格适中、公司完全掌控分销过程，以及门店员工提供的卓越服务。查克理所当然地把客户满意度作为衡量成功的标准，这种态度也渗透到整个组织。能够长期保持如此以客户为中心精神的大型零售企业寥寥无几；喜诗能够维持这一精神，查克功不可没。

1986.english:
See’s profits should stay at about their present level.  We will continue to increase prices very modestly, merely matching prospective cost increases.

o World Book is the largest of 17 Scott Fetzer operations that joined Berkshire at the beginning of 1986.  Last year I reported to you enthusiastically about the businesses of Scott Fetzer and about Ralph Schey, its manager.  A year’s experience has added to my enthusiasm for both.  Ralph is a superb businessman and a straight shooter.  He also brings exceptional versatility and energy to his job: despite the wide array of businesses that he manages, he is on top of the operations, opportunities and problems of each.  And, like our other managers, Ralph is a real pleasure to work with.  Our good fortune continues.
1986.chinese:
喜诗的利润预计将维持在当前水平附近。我们会继续非常谨慎地提高售价，基本只用于抵消预期的成本上涨。

**世界图书百科全书。** 世界图书是1986年初加入伯克希尔的斯科特与费策旗下17项业务中规模最大的一项。去年，我曾热情介绍斯科特与费策的业务及其经理人拉尔夫·谢伊。一年的实践，让我对两者更加欣赏。拉尔夫是非常出色的商人，也是一个坦率诚实的人。他还具有非凡的适应能力和精力：尽管管理着种类繁多的业务，却对每一项业务的经营、机会和问题都了如指掌。而且，和我们的其他经理人一样，与拉尔夫共事非常愉快。我们的好运还在继续。

1986.english:
World Book’s unit volume increased for the fourth consecutive year, with encyclopedia sales up 7% over 1985 and 45% over 1982.  Childcraft’s unit sales also grew significantly.

World Book continues to dominate the U.S. direct-sales encyclopedia market - and for good reasons.  Extraordinarily well-edited and priced at under 5 cents per page, these books are a bargain for youngster and adult alike.  You may find one editing technique interesting: World Book ranks over 44,000 words by difficulty.  Longer entries in the encyclopedia include only the most easily comprehended words in the opening sections, with the difficulty of the material gradually escalating as the exposition proceeds.  As a result, youngsters can easily and profitably read to the point at which subject matter gets too difficult, instead of immediately having to deal with a discussion that mixes up words requiring college-level comprehension with others of fourth-grade level.
1986.chinese:
世界图书的单位销量连续第四年增长，百科全书销量比1985年增长7%，比1982年增长45%。Childcraft的销量也显著增加。

世界图书继续主导美国的百科全书直销市场，而且原因充分。这套百科全书编辑质量极高，每页售价不到5美分，对年轻人和成年人都物有所值。有一种编辑技巧，也许各位会感兴趣：世界图书把超过4.4万个词按难度分级。百科全书较长条目的开头，只使用最容易理解的词汇，随着叙述推进，内容难度逐步提高。结果，年轻读者能够轻松、有效地阅读到自己尚可理解的程度，而不必一开始就面对把大学程度词汇与小学四年级词汇混在一起的论述。

1986.english:
Selling World Book is a calling.  Over one-half of our active salespeople are teachers or former teachers, and another 5% have had experience as librarians.  They correctly think of themselves as educators, and they do a terrific job.  If you don’t have a World Book set in your house, I recommend one.

o Kirby likewise recorded its fourth straight year of unit volume gains.  Worldwide, unit sales grew 4% from 1985 and 33% from 1982.  While the Kirby product is more expensive than most cleaners, it performs in a manner that leaves cheaper units far behind ("in the dust," so to speak).  Many 30- and 40-year-old Kirby cleaners are still in active duty.  If you want the best, you buy a Kirby.
1986.chinese:
销售世界图书是一项使命。我们活跃的销售人员中，超过半数是教师或曾任教师，另有5%有图书管理员工作经验。他们认为自己是教育工作者，这种认识完全正确，而且他们的工作十分出色。如果你家里还没有一套世界图书，我推荐你买一套。

**柯比。** 柯比同样连续第四年实现单位销量增长。全球销量比1985年增长4%，比1982年增长33%。柯比吸尘器比多数产品都贵，但其表现让便宜产品远远落后（可以说被“甩在尘土里”）。许多三四十年前生产的柯比吸尘器至今仍在正常工作。如果你想买最好的，那就买柯比。

1986.english:
Some companies that historically have had great success in direct sales have stumbled in recent years.  Certainly the era of the working woman has created new challenges for direct sales organizations.  So far, the record shows that both Kirby and World Book have responded most successfully.

The businesses described above, along with the insurance operation and Fechheimer, constitute our major business units. The brevity of our descriptions is in no way meant to diminish the importance of these businesses to us.  All have been discussed in past annual reports and, because of the tendency of Berkshire owners to stay in the fold (about 98% of the stock at the end of each year is owned by people who were owners at the start of the year), we want to avoid undue repetition of basic facts.  You can be sure that we will immediately report to you in detail if the underlying economics or competitive position of any of these businesses should materially change.  In general, the businesses described in this section can be characterized as having very strong market positions, very high returns on capital employed, and the best of operating managements.
1986.chinese:
有些历史上在直销领域非常成功的企业，近几年遭遇挫折。毫无疑问，职业女性越来越普遍的时代给直销组织带来了新的挑战。到目前为止，柯比和世界图书的业绩表明，它们都很好地应对了这些挑战。

上述业务，加上保险和费希海默，构成了我们的主要经营单位。介绍简短，绝不表示我们认为它们不重要。过去的年报已经介绍过这些业务，而且伯克希尔股东往往长期持有股份（每年末约98%的股票仍由年初的股东持有），因此我们不想过多重复基本事实。各位可以确信，如果任何业务的基本经济特性或竞争地位出现重大变化，我们一定会立即详细报告。总的来说，本节介绍的业务具有非常强的市场地位、非常高的投入资本回报率，以及最优秀的经营管理团队。

1986.english:
The Fechheimer Bros. Co.

Every year in Berkshire’s annual report I include a description of the kind of business that we would like to buy. This "ad" paid off in 1986.

On January 15th of last year I received a letter from Bob Heldman of Cincinnati, a shareholder for many years and also Chairman of Fechheimer Bros.  Until I read the letter, however, I did not know of either Bob or Fechheimer.  Bob wrote that he ran a company that met our tests and suggested that we get together, which we did in Omaha after their results for 1985 were compiled.
1986.chinese:
## 费希海默兄弟公司

每一年，我都会在伯克希尔年报中写明我们希望收购什么样的企业。1986年，这则“广告”收到了成效。

去年1月15日，我收到来自辛辛那提的鲍勃·赫尔德曼的信。他是一位持股多年的股东，也是费希海默兄弟公司的董事长。不过，读到这封信之前，我既不认识鲍勃，也不了解费希海默。他来信说，自己经营的企业符合我们的标准，建议我们见一面。待该公司1985年的财务业绩整理完成后，我们就在奥马哈会面。

1986.english:
He filled me in on a little history: Fechheimer, a uniform manufacturing and distribution business, began operations in 1842.  Warren Heldman, Bob’s father, became involved in the business in 1941 and his sons, Bob and George (now President), along with their sons, subsequently joined the company.  Under the Heldmans’ management, the business was highly successful.

In 1981 Fechheimer was sold to a group of venture capitalists in a leveraged buy out (an LBO), with management retaining an equity interest.  The new company, as is the case with all LBOS, started with an exceptionally high debt/equity ratio.  After the buy out, however, operations continued to be very successful.  So by the start of last year debt had been paid down substantially and the value of the equity had increased dramatically.  For a variety of reasons, the venture capitalists wished to sell and Bob, having dutifully read Berkshire’s annual reports, thought of us.
1986.chinese:
鲍勃向我介绍了一些历史：费希海默是一家制服制造与分销企业，创办于1842年。鲍勃的父亲沃伦·赫尔德曼于1941年进入公司，此后他的儿子鲍勃和乔治（现任总裁），以及再下一代家庭成员也陆续加入。在赫尔德曼家族管理下，这家企业非常成功。

1981年，费希海默通过杠杆收购（LBO）的方式出售给一群风险资本投资者，管理层保留部分股权。像所有杠杆收购一样，新公司的债务与权益比例起初异常高。不过，收购后经营依然非常成功。因此，到去年年初，债务已明显下降，股权价值则大幅增加。由于各种原因，风险资本投资者希望出售，鲍勃认真读过伯克希尔年报，便想到了我们。

1986.english:
Fechheimer is exactly the sort of business we like to buy. Its economic record is superb; its managers are talented, high- grade, and love what they do; and the Heldman family wanted to continue its financial interest in partnership with us. Therefore, we quickly purchased about 84% of the stock for a price that was based upon a $55 million valuation for the entire business.

The circumstances of this acquisition were similar to those prevailing in our purchase of Nebraska Furniture Mart: most of the shares were held by people who wished to employ funds elsewhere; family members who enjoyed running their business wanted to continue both as owners and managers; several generations of the family were active in the business, providing management for as far as the eye can see; and the managing family wanted a purchaser who would not re-sell, regardless of price, and who would let the business be run in the future as it had been in the past.  Both Fechheimer and NFM were right for us, and we were right for them.
1986.chinese:
费希海默正是我们喜欢收购的那种企业。它的经济业绩极佳，管理者有才干、品格高尚、热爱工作；赫尔德曼家族也希望继续保留经济利益，与我们成为合伙人。因此，我们很快以整家公司估值5500万美元为基础，买入约84%的股份。

这次收购的情形与我们购买内布拉斯加家具卖场很相似：多数股份由希望把资金用于其他地方的人持有；热爱经营企业的家族成员希望继续担任所有者和管理者；家族中有几代人从事这门生意，管理人才在可预见的将来都不会断档；管理家族希望找到一位无论出价多高都不会再把企业转卖、并允许企业继续按照过去方式经营的买家。费希海默和家具城都适合我们，我们也适合它们。

1986.english: You may be amused to know that neither Charlie nor I have been to Cincinnati, headquarters for Fechheimer, to see their operation. (And, incidentally, it works both ways: Chuck Huggins, who has been running See’s for 15 years, has never been to Omaha.) If our success were to depend upon insights we developed through plant inspections, Berkshire would be in big trouble. Rather, in considering an acquisition, we attempt to evaluate the economic characteristics of the business - its competitive strengths and weaknesses - and the quality of the people we will be joining.  Fechheimer was a standout in both respects.  In addition to Bob and George Heldman, who are in their mid-60s - spring chickens by our standards - there are three members of the next generation, Gary, Roger and Fred, to insure continuity.
1986.chinese: 也许各位会觉得有趣：查理和我都没去过费希海默总部所在地辛辛那提，也没有现场参观过它的业务。（顺便说一句，反过来也是一样：管理喜诗糖果已有15年的查克·哈金斯，从来没有去过奥马哈。）如果我们的成功要依靠工厂参观中得到的洞见，伯克希尔可就麻烦大了。相反，在考虑收购时，我们努力评价的是企业的经济特性——它的竞争优势和劣势——以及即将成为伙伴的人是否优秀。费希海默在这两方面都十分出色。除了六十五岁上下、按照我们的标准还算“小青年”的鲍勃和乔治·赫尔德曼之外，下一代还有加里、罗杰和弗雷德三位成员，可以保证经营的连续性。

1986.english:
As a prototype for acquisitions, Fechheimer has only one drawback: size.  We hope our next acquisition is at least several times as large but a carbon copy in all other respects.  Our threshold for minimum annual after-tax earnings of potential acquisitions has been moved up to $10 million from the $5 million level that prevailed when Bob wrote to me.

Flushed with success, we repeat our ad.  If you have a business that fits, call me or, preferably, write.
1986.chinese:
作为理想收购对象的典型，费希海默只有一个缺点：规模太小。我们希望下一次收购的规模至少达到它的几倍，其他方面则最好完全一样。潜在收购对象的最低年度税后利润门槛，已经从鲍勃写信时的500万美元提高到1000万美元。

在这次成功的鼓舞下，我们再次刊登广告。如果你拥有符合条件的企业，请给我打电话；最好还是写信。

1986.english: Here’s what we’re looking for: (1) large purchases (at least $10 million of after-tax earnings), (2) demonstrated consistent earning power (future projections are of little interest to us, nor are "turn-around" situations), (3) businesses earning good returns on equity while employing little or no debt. (4) management in place (we can’t supply it), (5) simple businesses (if there’s lots of technology, we won’t understand it), (6) an offering price (we don’t want to waste our time or that of the seller by talking, even preliminarily, about a transaction when price is unknown).
1986.chinese:
**我们寻找的是：**

1. 大型收购对象（税后利润至少1000万美元）；
2. 已经得到证实的、持续稳定的盈利能力（我们对未来预测或“扭亏为盈”的项目兴趣不大）；
3. 几乎不依赖债务，仍能取得良好股东权益回报的企业；
4. 现成的管理团队（我们无法提供管理团队）；
5. 简单易懂的业务（如果涉及大量技术，我们就无法理解）；
6. 明确的报价（若价格未知，我们不愿浪费双方时间，哪怕只是初步讨论）。

1986.english: We will not engage in unfriendly takeovers.  We can promise complete confidentiality and a very fast answer - customarily within five minutes - as to whether we’re interested.  We prefer to buy for cash, but will consider issuing stock when we receive as much in intrinsic business value as we give.  Indeed, following recent advances in the price of Berkshire stock, transactions involving stock issuance may be quite feasible.  We invite potential sellers to check us out by contacting people with whom we have done business in the past.  For the right business - and the right people - we can provide a good home.
1986.chinese: 我们不会进行敌意收购。我们可以保证完全保密，并且非常迅速地回答是否感兴趣——通常只要五分钟。我们更喜欢用现金收购，但如果得到的企业内在价值不低于我们付出的伯克希尔股票的内在价值，也会考虑发行股票支付。事实上，随着最近伯克希尔股价上涨，涉及发行股票的交易可能相当可行。欢迎潜在卖家向我们过去的交易伙伴了解我们的信誉。对于合适的企业和合适的人，我们可以提供一个好归宿。

1986.english:
On the other hand, we frequently get approached about acquisitions that don’t come close to meeting our tests: new ventures, turnarounds, auction-like sales, and the ever-popular (among brokers) "I’m-sure-something-will-work-out-if-you-people- get-to-know-each-other." None of these attracts us in the least.

---

Besides being interested in the purchases of entire businesses as described above, we are also interested in the negotiated purchase of large, but not controlling, blocks of stock, as in our Cap Cities purchase.  Such purchases appeal to us only when we are very comfortable with both the economics of the business and the ability and integrity of the people running the operation.  We prefer large transactions: in the unusual case we might do something as small as $50 million (or even smaller), but our preference is for commitments many times that size.
1986.chinese:
另一方面，我们也经常接到明显不符合标准的收购邀请：新创企业、扭亏项目、拍卖式出售，以及经纪人最喜欢的那种“我敢肯定，只要你们先认识认识，总能谈出点什么来”。这些都丝毫吸引不了我们。

* * *

除了上述对整家企业的收购，我们也有兴趣通过协商购买大宗但不具有控制权的股份，例如我们对Capital Cities公司的投资。只有当我们对企业的经济特性，以及管理者的能力和诚信都非常有把握时，这种交易才有吸引力。我们喜欢大额交易；在特殊情况下也许会做小到5000万美元（甚至更少）的项目，但更喜欢金额达到这一数字数倍的投资。

1986.english:
## Insurance Operations

We present our usual table of industry figures, expanded this year to include data about incurred losses and the GNP inflation index.  The contrast in 1986 between the growth in premiums and growth in incurred losses will show you why underwriting results for the year improved materially:

```text
                              Statutory
          Yearly Change    Combined Ratio    Yearly Change   Inflation Rate
           in Premiums   After Policyholder   in Incurred     Measured by
           Written (%)        Dividends        Losses (%)   GNP Deflator (%)
          -------------  ------------------  -------------  ----------------
1981 .....     3.8              106.0             6.5             9.7
1982 .....     4.4              109.8             8.4             6.4
1983 .....     4.6              112.0             6.8             3.9
1984 .....     9.2              117.9            16.9             3.8
1985 .....    22.1              116.5            16.1             3.3
1986 (Est.)   22.6              108.5            15.5             2.6
```

## Source: Best’s Insurance Management Reports

The combined ratio represents total insurance costs (losses incurred plus expenses) compared to revenue from premiums: a ratio below 100 indicates an underwriting profit, and one above 100 indicates a loss.  When the investment income that an insurer earns from holding on to policyholders’ funds ("the float") is taken into account, a combined ratio in the 107-112 range typically produces an overall break-even result, exclusive of earnings on the funds provided by shareholders.
1986.chinese:
数据来源：Best’s Insurance Management Reports。

综合成本率表示保险总成本（已发生赔款加费用）与保费收入的比率：低于100意味着承保盈利，高于100意味着承保亏损。如果再考虑保险公司持有保单持有人资金（即“浮存金”）取得的投资收益，综合成本率处于107至112之间时，通常能够实现整体盈亏平衡；这里不包括股东提供的资本所赚取的收益。

1986.english: The math of the insurance business, encapsulated by the table, is not very complicated.  In years when the industry’s annual gain in revenues (premiums) pokes along at 4% or 5%, underwriting losses are sure to mount.  This is not because auto accidents, fires, windstorms and the like are occurring more frequently, nor has it lately been the fault of general inflation.  Today, social and judicial inflation are the major culprits; the cost of entering a courtroom has simply ballooned. Part of the jump in cost arises from skyrocketing verdicts, and part from the tendency of judges and juries to expand the coverage of insurance policies beyond that contemplated by the insurer when the policies were written.  Seeing no let-up in either trend, we continue to believe that the industry’s revenues must grow at close to 10% annually for it to just hold its own in terms of profitability, even though general inflation may be running only 2% - 4%.
1986.chinese: 这张表所概括的保险业算术并不复杂。当行业年度收入（保费）增长只有4%或5%时，承保亏损肯定会扩大。这并非因为汽车事故、火灾、风暴等更频繁发生，近来也不是一般通货膨胀所致。如今，社会和司法方面的通胀是主要原因；走进法庭的代价简直飞涨。一方面，判决赔偿额急剧增加；另一方面，法官和陪审团倾向于把保险合同的保障范围扩大到保险公司当初承保时没有设想到的程度。由于看不到这两种趋势缓和的迹象，我们仍认为，即使一般通胀率只有2%至4%，保险行业保费收入也需要每年增长接近10%，才能大致维持原有的盈利能力。

1986.english: In 1986, as noted, the industry’s premium volume soared even faster than loss costs.  Consequently, the underwriting loss of the industry fell dramatically.  In last year’s report we predicted this sharp improvement but also predicted that prosperity would be fleeting.  Alas, this second prediction is already proving accurate.  The rate of gain in the industry’s premium volume has slowed significantly (from an estimated 27.1% in 1986’s first quarter, to 23.5% in the second, to 21.8% in the third, to 18.7% in the fourth), and we expect further slowing in 1987.  Indeed, the rate of gain may well fall below my 10% "equilibrium" figure by the third quarter.
1986.chinese: 如上所述，1986年行业保费增长甚至超过了赔付成本增长。因此，行业的承保亏损大幅下降。在去年的报告里，我们预测到了这种明显改善，也预测繁荣不会持久。唉，第二个预测如今已开始应验。行业保费增长速度显著放缓：1986年第一季度估计为27.1%，第二季度23.5%，第三季度21.8%，第四季度18.7%；我们预计1987年还会进一步放缓。事实上，到第三季度，增长率很可能跌破我所说的10%“均衡”水平。

1986.english: Nevertheless, underwriting results in 1987, assuming they are not dragged down by a major natural catastrophe, will again improve materially because price increases are recognized in revenues on a lagged basis.  In effect, the good news in earnings follows the good news in prices by six to twelve months.  But the improving trend in earnings will probably end by late 1988 or early 1989.  Thereafter the industry is likely to head south in a hurry.
1986.chinese: 尽管如此，只要没有重大自然灾害拖累，1987年的承保结果仍会显著改善，因为保费提价需要经过一段时间才会反映到收入中。实际上，盈利改善会比价格改善晚六至十二个月。但盈利的上升趋势很可能到1988年末或1989年初就会结束，此后行业可能迅速走下坡路。

1986.english: Pricing behavior in the insurance industry continues to be exactly what can be expected in a commodity-type business.  Only under shortage conditions are high profits achieved, and such conditions don’t last long.  When the profit sun begins to shine, long-established insurers shower investors with new shares in order to build capital.  In addition, newly-formed insurers rush to sell shares at the advantageous prices available in the new- issue market (prices advantageous, that is, to the insiders promoting the company but rarely to the new shareholders).  These moves guarantee future trouble: capacity soars, competitive juices flow, and prices fade.
1986.chinese: 保险行业的定价行为，完全符合人们对商品型业务的预期。只有供给短缺时，企业才可能取得高利润，而这种局面不会持续太久。当利润的阳光开始普照时，经营已久的保险公司便向投资者大量发行新股，以扩充资本。同时，新成立的保险公司也急着趁新股市场价格有利时上市筹资（当然，“有利”是对发起公司的内部人而言，对新股东却很少如此）。这些举动注定会招来未来的麻烦：承保能力猛增，竞争愈发激烈，价格随之下降。

1986.english:
It’s interesting to observe insurance leaders beseech their colleagues to behave in a more "statesmanlike" manner when pricing policies.  "Why," they ask, "can’t we learn from history, even out the peaks and valleys, and consistently price to make reasonable profits?" What they wish, of course, is pricing that resembles, say, that of The Wall Street journal, whose prices are ample to start with and rise consistently each year.

Such calls for improved behavior have all of the efficacy of those made by a Nebraska corn grower asking his fellow growers, worldwide, to market their corn with more statesmanship.  What’s needed is not more statesmen, but less corn.  By raising large amounts of capital in the last two years, the insurance industry has, to continue our metaphor, vastly expanded its plantings of corn.  The resulting increase in "crop" - i.e., the proliferation of insurance capacity - will have the same effect on prices and profits that surplus crops have had since time immemorial.
1986.chinese:
观察保险行业领袖恳请同行在定价时表现得更有“政治家风范”，倒也有趣。他们问：“为什么我们不能从历史中吸取教训，平抑周期起伏，始终制定能够获得合理利润的价格？”他们真正希望的，当然是像《华尔街日报》那样的定价：起点就足够高，而且每年稳步上涨。

这种呼吁，与内布拉斯加州一位玉米种植者要求全世界其他玉米农民在销售玉米时表现得更有“政治家风范”，效果差不多。需要的不是更多政治家，而是更少玉米。过去两年，保险行业筹集了大量资本，沿用这个比喻，就是大幅扩大了玉米种植面积。由此增加的“收成”——也就是保险承保能力的急剧扩张——对价格和利润的影响，会与自古以来农产品丰收过剩时的情况一样。

1986.english:
Our own insurance operation did well in 1986 and is also likely to do well in 1987.  We have benefited significantly from industry conditions.  But much of our prosperity arises from the efforts and ability of Mike Goldberg, manager of all insurance operations.

Our combined ratio (on a statutory basis and excluding structured settlements and financial reinsurance) fell from 111 in 1985 to 103 in 1986.  In addition, our premium growth has been exceptional: although final figures aren’t available, I believe that over the past two years we were the fastest growing company among the country’s top 100 insurers.  Some of our growth, it is true, came from our large quota-share contract with Fireman’s Fund, described in last year’s report and updated in Charlie’s letter on page 54.  But even if the premiums from that contract are excluded from the calculation, we probably still ranked first in growth.
1986.chinese:
我们自己的保险业务1986年表现良好，1987年也很可能继续如此。行业环境确实让我们受益良多，但很大一部分成绩还来自管理全部保险业务的迈克·戈德伯格的努力和能力。

我们的综合成本率（按法定口径，剔除结构性和解及金融再保险）从1985年的111下降到1986年的103。此外，保费增长异常出色：虽然最终数字尚未出炉，但我相信，过去两年我们是全美前100大保险公司中增长最快的一家。诚然，部分增长来自去年年报介绍过、查理在第54页的信中更新的大额Fireman’s Fund比例再保险合同。但即便排除该合同的保费，我们的增长率仍然很可能排名第一。

1986.english: Interestingly, we were the slowest-growing large insurer in the years immediately preceding 1985.  In fact, we shrank - and we will do so again from time to time in the future.  Our large swings in volume do not mean that we come and go from the insurance marketplace.  Indeed, we are its most steadfast participant, always standing ready, at prices we believe adequate, to write a wide variety of high-limit coverages.  The swings in our volume arise instead from the here-today, gone- tomorrow behavior of other insurers.  When most insurers are "gone," because their capital is inadequate or they have been frightened by losses, insureds rush to us and find us ready to do business.  But when hordes of insurers are "here," and are slashing prices far below expectable costs, many customers naturally leave us in order to take advantage of the bargains temporarily being offered by our competition.
1986.chinese: 有意思的是，在1985年之前的几年里，我们却是增长最慢的大型保险公司。事实上，我们的业务量还出现了收缩；未来我们也会不时如此。保费规模大幅起伏，不表示我们时而进入、时而退出保险市场。恰恰相反，我们是市场上最坚定的参与者：只要价格在我们看来足够合理，我们随时准备承保各种高保额风险。我们业务量的变化，反映的其实是其他保险公司今天在场、明天离场的行为。当多数保险公司因为资本不足或被亏损吓退而“不在场”时，投保人涌向我们，发现我们仍然准备开展业务。而当大批保险公司“都在场”，竞相把价格压到远低于可预期成本的水平时，许多客户自然会离开我们，去享受竞争对手暂时提供的便宜保险。

1986.english: Our firmness on prices works no hardship on the consumer: he is being bombarded by attractively priced insurance offers at those times when we are doing little business.  And it works no hardship on our employees: we don’t engage in layoffs when we experience a cyclical slowdown at one of our generally-profitable insurance operations.  This no-layoff practice is in our self- interest.  Employees who fear that large layoffs will accompany sizable reductions in premium volume will understandably produce scads of business through thick and thin (mostly thin).
1986.chinese: 我们坚持价格纪律，并不会让消费者吃亏：在我们业务量很少的时期，他们正被各种价格诱人的保险报价包围。这也不会让员工为难：在总体盈利的保险业务因周期性原因出现规模下降时，我们不会裁员。坚持不裁员，也符合我们的自身利益。如果员工担心保费收入一旦大幅下降，就会出现大规模裁员，他们自然会不论行情好坏（通常是坏的时候）都拼命拉来大量业务。

1986.english: The trends in National Indemnity’s traditional business - the writing of commercial auto and general liability policies through general agents - suggest how gun-shy other insurers became for a while and how brave they are now getting.  In the last quarter of 1984, NICO’s monthly volume averaged $5 million, about what it had been running for several years.  By the first quarter of 1986, monthly volume had climbed to about $35 million. In recent months, a sharp decline has set in.  Monthly volume is currently about $20 million and will continue to fall as new competitors surface and prices are cut.  Ironically, the managers of certain major new competitors are the very same managers that just a few years ago bankrupted insurers that were our old competitors.  Through state-mandated guaranty funds, we must pay some of the losses these managers left unpaid, and now we find them writing the same sort of business under a new name.  C’est la guerre.
1986.chinese: 国民赔偿保险公司（National Indemnity，简称NICO）的传统业务——通过总代理承保商业汽车险和一般责任险——显示了其他保险公司一度多么胆怯，而现在又开始多么大胆。1984年第四季度，NICO月均保费量约500万美元，过去几年一直差不多如此。到了1986年第一季度，月均业务量升至约3500万美元。最近几个月，业务量又急剧下降，目前约为每月2000万美元，随着新竞争对手出现和价格下跌，还会继续下降。讽刺的是，一些主要新竞争者的管理者，正是几年前把我们那些老竞争对手经营到破产的同一批人。由于各州强制设立的担保基金，我们必须替他们当年留下的部分未付赔款买单；如今，他们又换了个名字，开始承保同样的业务。战争就是如此（C’est la guerre）。

1986.english: The business we call "large risks" expanded significantly during 1986, and will be important to us in the future.  In this operation, we regularly write policies with annual premiums of $1 - $3 million, or even higher.  This business will necessarily be highly volatile - both in volume and profitability - but our premier capital position and willingness to write large net lines make us a very strong force in the market when prices are right. On the other hand, our structured settlement business has become near-dormant because present prices make no sense to us.
1986.chinese: 我们称为“大型风险”的业务在1986年显著扩张，未来也会很重要。这类业务经常签发每年保费100万至300万美元甚至更高的保单。无论业务量还是利润，这门生意必然高度波动。但当价格合理时，我们领先的资本实力以及愿意自行承担大额净风险的态度，使我们成为市场上一支强大的力量。另一方面，由于当前价格在我们看来毫无道理，结构性和解业务几乎陷入停顿。

1986.english: The 1986 loss reserve development of our insurance group is chronicled on page 46.  The figures show the amount of error in our yearend 1985 liabilities that a year of settlements and further evaluation has revealed.  As you can see, what I told you last year about our loss liabilities was far from true - and that makes three years in a row of error.  If the physiological rules that applied to Pinocchio were to apply to me, my nose would now draw crowds.
1986.chinese: 保险集团1986年赔款准备金的后续发展情况，见第46页。那些数字揭示了经过一年的赔款结算和进一步评估，我们在1985年末确认的负债究竟错了多少。如各位所见，去年我告诉大家的赔付负债情况，与事实相去甚远——而且这已经是连续第三年估计错误。如果匹诺曹身上的生理规律也适用于我，如今我的鼻子恐怕已经能吸引人群围观了。

1986.english:
When insurance executives belatedly establish proper reserves, they often speak of "reserve strengthening," a term that has a rather noble ring to it.  They almost make it sound as if they are adding extra layers of strength to an already-solid balance sheet.  That’s not the case: instead the term is a euphemism for what should more properly be called "correction of previous untruths" (albeit non-intentional ones).

We made a special effort at the end of 1986 to reserve accurately.  However, we tried just as hard at the end of 1985. Only time will tell whether we have finally succeeded in correctly estimating our insurance liabilities.
1986.chinese:
保险公司高管事后补足准备金时，经常称之为“加强准备金”（reserve strengthening），这个说法听起来颇为高尚。他们几乎把它说成是在已经坚实的资产负债表上再增加几层保护。事实并非如此：这个词不过是一个委婉说法，更准确的名称应当是“纠正过去的不实陈述”（尽管并非故意）。

1986年末，我们特别努力地准确计提准备金。但1985年末，我们也同样努力过。究竟这次是否终于正确估计了保险负债，只有时间能够证明。

1986.english: Despite the difficulties we have had in reserving and the commodity economics of the industry, we expect our insurance business to both grow and make significant amounts of money - but progress will be distinctly irregular and there will be major unpleasant surprises from time to time.  It’s a treacherous business and a wary attitude is essential.  We must heed Woody Allen: "While the lamb may lie down with the lion, the lamb shouldn’t count on getting a whole lot of sleep."
1986.chinese: 尽管准备金估计很困难，保险业也具有商品型业务的经济特性，我们仍预计保险业务能够增长并创造可观利润——不过进展将明显不平稳，不时还会出现重大的意外坏消息。这是一门险象环生的生意，必须保持警惕。我们应该听听伍迪·艾伦的话：“小羊或许能够与狮子躺在一起，但小羊可别指望睡得多安稳。”

1986.english:
In our insurance operations we have an advantage in attitude, we have an advantage in capital, and we are developing an advantage in personnel.  Additionally, I like to think we have some long-term edge in investing the float developed from policyholder funds.  The nature of the business suggests that we will need all of these advantages in order to prosper.

---

GEICO Corporation, 41% owned by Berkshire, had an outstanding year in 1986.  Industrywide, underwriting experience in personal lines did not improve nearly as much as it did in commercial lines.  But GEICO, writing personal lines almost exclusively, improved its combined ratio to 96.9 and recorded a 16% gain in premium volume.  GEICO also continued to repurchase its own shares and ended the year with 5.5% fewer shares outstanding than it had at the start of the year.  Our share of GEICO’s premium volume is over $500 million, close to double that of only three years ago.  GEICO’s book of business is one of the best in the world of insurance, far better indeed than Berkshire’s own book.
1986.chinese:
在保险业务中，我们的态度具有优势，资本具有优势，人员优势也正在形成。此外，我愿意相信，我们在投资保单持有人资金形成的浮存金方面也有一些长期优势。这门生意的性质表明，要想繁荣发展，我们需要上述全部优势。

* * *

伯克希尔持有41%股份的盖可公司（GEICO）在1986年表现极其出色。在整个行业中，个人保险业务承保结果的改善远不及商业保险业务。但几乎只承保个人保险的盖可，却将综合成本率改善至96.9，同时保费收入增长16%。盖可继续回购自己的股票，年末流通股份数量比年初减少5.5%。按我们的持股比例计算，盖可对应的保费规模已超过5亿美元，几乎是三年前的两倍。盖可的保险业务组合在整个保险行业中堪称最优秀的之一，事实上远胜于伯克希尔自身的保险组合。

1986.english:
The most important ingredient in GEICO’s success is rock- bottom operating costs, which set the company apart from literally hundreds of competitors that offer auto insurance.  The total of GEICO’s underwriting expense and loss adjustment expense in 1986 was only 23.5% of premiums.  Many major companies show percentages 15 points higher than that.  Even such huge direct writers as Allstate and State Farm incur appreciably higher costs than does GEICO.

The difference between GEICO’s costs and those of its competitors is a kind of moat that protects a valuable and much- sought-after business castle.  No one understands this moat- around-the-castle concept better than Bill Snyder, Chairman of GEICO.  He continually widens the moat by driving down costs still more, thereby defending and strengthening the economic franchise.  Between 1985 and 1986, GEICO’s total expense ratio dropped from 24.1% to the 23.5% mentioned earlier and, under Bill’s leadership, the ratio is almost certain to drop further. If it does - and if GEICO maintains its service and underwriting standards - the company’s future will be brilliant indeed.
1986.chinese:
盖可成功最重要的因素，是极低的经营成本。正是这一点，使它与数百家提供汽车保险的竞争对手区分开来。1986年，盖可的承保业务费用和理赔处理费用合计仅占保费的23.5%。许多大型保险公司这一比例要高出15个百分点。即使是好事达（Allstate）和州立农场（State Farm）这样规模庞大的直销保险公司，成本也明显高于盖可。

盖可与竞争对手之间的成本差距，就像一条护城河，保护着一座价值不菲、人人垂涎的商业城堡。没有人比盖可董事长比尔·斯奈德更理解这种“城堡周围的护城河”理念。他不断进一步压低成本、拓宽护城河，从而保护并强化公司的经济特许经营权。1985年至1986年，盖可总费用率从24.1%下降到前面所说的23.5%；在比尔领导下，这一比例几乎肯定还会进一步降低。如果确实如此，而且盖可能够保持服务和承保标准，那么公司的未来将非常光明。

1986.english: The second stage of the GEICO rocket is fueled by Lou Simpson, Vice Chairman, who has run the company’s investments since late 1979.  Indeed, it’s a little embarrassing for me, the fellow responsible for investments at Berkshire, to chronicle Lou’s performance at GEICO.  Only my ownership of a controlling block of Berkshire stock makes me secure enough to give you the following figures, comparing the overall return of the equity portfolio at GEICO to that of the Standard & Poor’s 500:
1986.chinese: 盖可这枚火箭的第二级助推器，是副董事长卢·辛普森。他从1979年末开始负责公司的投资。实际上，由我这个负责伯克希尔投资的人来记录卢在盖可的成绩，多少有点难为情。只有因为我控制着伯克希尔的一大块股份，才有足够的安全感向各位公布下面这些数字，将盖可股票组合的总回报与标准普尔500指数进行比较：

1986.english:
These are not only terrific figures but, fully as important, they have been achieved in the right way.  Lou has consistently invested in undervalued common stocks that, individually, were unlikely to present him with a permanent loss and that, collectively, were close to risk-free.

In sum, GEICO is an exceptional business run by exceptional managers.  We are fortunate to be associated with them.

## Marketable Securities

During 1986, our insurance companies purchased about $700 million of tax-exempt bonds, most having a maturity of 8 to 12 years.  You might think that this commitment indicates a considerable enthusiasm for such bonds.  Unfortunately, that’s not so: at best, the bonds are mediocre investments.  They simply seemed the least objectionable alternative at the time we bought them, and still seem so. (Currently liking neither stocks nor bonds, I find myself the polar opposite of Mae West as she declared: "I like only two kinds of men - foreign and domestic.")
1986.chinese:
这些数字不仅出色，同样重要的是，它们来自正确的投资方式。卢始终投资于价值被低估的普通股；这些股票单独来看，不太可能让他遭受永久性损失，而作为一个整体，风险则非常接近于零。

总而言之，盖可是一家非凡的企业，由非凡的经理人经营。能够成为他们的伙伴，我们十分幸运。

## 可交易证券

1986年，我们的保险公司买入了约7亿美元的免税债券，大多数期限为8至12年。各位也许会以为，这意味着我们非常喜欢这些债券。遗憾的是，并非如此：充其量，它们只是平庸的投资。只是在买入时，它们似乎是最不令人讨厌的选择；如今看仍然如此。（目前股票和债券我都不喜欢，这恰好与梅·韦斯特的话完全相反。她说：“我只喜欢两类男人——外国男人和本国男人。”）

1986.english:
We must, of necessity, hold marketable securities in our insurance companies and, as money comes in, we have only five directions to go: (1) long-term common stock investments; (2) long-term fixed-income securities; (3) medium-term fixed-income securities; (4) short-term cash equivalents; and (5) short-term arbitrage commitments.

Common stocks, of course, are the most fun.  When conditions are right that is, when companies with good economics and good management sell well below intrinsic business value - stocks sometimes provide grand-slam home runs.  But we currently find no equities that come close to meeting our tests.  This statement in no way translates into a stock market prediction: we have no idea - and never have had - whether the market is going to go up, down, or sideways in the near- or intermediate term future.
1986.chinese:
我们的保险公司必须持有可交易证券。随着资金流入，我们只有五个方向可选：（1）长期普通股投资；（2）长期固定收益证券；（3）中期固定收益证券；（4）短期现金等价物；（5）短期套利交易。

普通股投资当然最有意思。当条件适合时——也就是说，经济特性优秀、管理层优秀的企业，其股票价格远低于企业内在价值——股票投资有时能打出满垒本垒打。但目前，我们找不到任何接近我们标准的股票。这绝不表示我们在预测股票市场：对于近期或中期股市将上涨、下跌还是横盘，我们不知道，也从来不知道。

1986.english: What we do know, however, is that occasional outbreaks of those two super-contagious diseases, fear and greed, will forever occur in the investment community.  The timing of these epidemics will be unpredictable.  And the market aberrations produced by them will be equally unpredictable, both as to duration and degree.  Therefore, we never try to anticipate the arrival or departure of either disease.  Our goal is more modest: we simply attempt to be fearful when others are greedy and to be greedy only when others are fearful.
1986.chinese: 不过，我们确实知道，投资界永远会不时爆发两种传染性极强的疾病：恐惧和贪婪。这些“疫情”何时发生无法预测，由它们造成的市场异常究竟持续多久、幅度多大，也同样无法预测。因此，我们从不试图预料这两种疾病何时到来或消退。我们的目标更谦逊：只是努力在别人贪婪时恐惧，只有在别人恐惧时才贪婪。

1986.english:
As this is written, little fear is visible in Wall Street. Instead, euphoria prevails - and why not?  What could be more exhilarating than to participate in a bull market in which the rewards to owners of businesses become gloriously uncoupled from the plodding performances of the businesses themselves. Unfortunately, however, stocks can’t outperform businesses indefinitely.

Indeed, because of the heavy transaction and investment management costs they bear, stockholders as a whole and over the long term must inevitably underperform the companies they own. If American business, in aggregate, earns about 12% on equity annually, investors must end up earning significantly less.  Bull markets can obscure mathematical laws, but they cannot repeal them.
1986.chinese:
写下这些文字时，华尔街几乎看不到恐惧。取而代之的是一片狂热——而这也难怪。参与一场牛市，企业所有者获得的回报光彩夺目地脱离了企业本身缓慢的经营表现，还有什么能比这更让人兴奋呢？但不幸的是，股票不可能永远跑赢企业本身。

事实上，由于沉重的交易成本和投资管理成本，所有股东作为一个整体，从长期来看，回报必然低于他们所持有的企业。如果美国企业整体每年取得约12%的股东权益回报，投资者最终所得一定会明显低于这个水平。牛市能够遮蔽数学规律，却无法废除它们。

1986.english: The second category of investments open to our insurance companies is long-term bonds.  These are unlikely to be of interest to us except in very special situations, such as the Washington Public Power Supply System #1, #2 and #3 issues, discussed in our 1984 report. (At yearend, we owned WPPSS issues having an amortized cost of $218 million and a market value of $310 million, paying us $31.7 million in annual tax-exempt income.) Our aversion to long-term bonds relates to our fear that we will see much higher rates of inflation within the next decade.  Over time, the behavior of our currency will be determined by the behavior of our legislators.  This relationship poses a continuing threat to currency stability - and a corresponding threat to the owners of long-term bonds.
1986.chinese: 我们的保险公司可以选择的第二类投资是长期债券。除了非常特殊的情形，例如1984年报告讨论过的华盛顿公共电力供应系统（WPPSS）1号、2号和3号债券，我们一般不会对这类债券感兴趣。（年末，我们持有的WPPSS债券摊余成本为2.18亿美元，市值3.10亿美元，每年提供3170万美元免税收入。）我们厌恶长期债券，是因为担心未来十年出现明显更高的通胀率。长期来看，我们货币的表现将取决于立法者的行为。这种关系持续威胁着货币稳定性，也就相应威胁着长期债券持有人。

1986.english:
We continue to periodically employ money in the arbitrage field.  However, unlike most arbitrageurs, who purchase dozens of securities each year, we purchase only a few.  We restrict ourselves to large deals that have been announced publicly and do not bet on the come.  Therefore, our potential profits are apt to be small; but, with luck, our disappointments will also be few.

Our yearend portfolio shown below includes one arbitrage commitment, Lear-Siegler.  Our balance sheet also includes a receivable for $145 million, representing the money owed us (and paid a few days later) by Unilever, then in the process of purchasing Chesebrough-Ponds, another of our arbitrage holdings. Arbitrage is an alternative to Treasury Bills as a short-term parking place for money - a choice that combines potentially higher returns with higher risks.  To date, our returns from the funds committed to arbitrage have been many times higher than they would have been had we left those funds in Treasury Bills. Nonetheless, one bad experience could change the scorecard markedly.
1986.chinese:
我们仍然不时将资金投入套利领域。不过，与每年买入几十种证券的大多数套利者不同，我们每年只做少数几笔。我们只参与已经公开宣布的大型交易，不押注尚未公布的事情。因此，我们可能赚到的利润不大；但愿由此带来的失望也比较少。

下面列示的年末投资组合中，有一笔套利交易是Lear-Siegler。资产负债表里还有一笔1.45亿美元的应收款，这是联合利华收购我们另一项套利持仓Chesebrough-Ponds时欠我们的款项，几天后已经支付。套利是短期停放资金时国库券的一种替代选择：潜在回报较高，风险也较高。迄今为止，我们套利资金取得的回报，是把资金放在国库券中所能取得回报的许多倍。不过，一次糟糕的经历就可能显著改变这份成绩单。

1986.english: We also, though it takes some straining, currently view medium-term tax-exempt bonds as an alternative to short-term Treasury holdings.  Buying these bonds, we run a risk of significant loss if, as seems probable, we sell many of them well before maturity.  However, we believe this risk is more than counter-balanced first, by the much higher after-tax returns currently realizable from these securities as compared to Treasury Bills and second, by the possibility that sales will produce an overall profit rather than a loss.  Our expectation of a higher total return, after allowing for the possibility of loss and after taking into account all tax effects, is a relatively close call and could well be wrong.  Even if we sell our bonds at a fairly large loss, however, we may end up reaping a higher after-tax return than we would have realized by repeatedly rolling over Treasury Bills.
1986.chinese: 我们目前也勉强把中期免税债券视作短期美国国债的替代选择。买入这些债券，会使我们承担重大损失风险，因为我们很可能在到期前很久就卖掉其中许多债券。不过，我们认为，有两个因素足以抵消这一风险：第一，相较国库券，这些证券目前提供的税后收益高得多；第二，出售时也有可能总体实现盈利，而非亏损。考虑潜在损失以及全部税收影响之后，我们对更高总回报的预期其实相当勉强，也完全可能判断错误。即便出售债券时发生较大亏损，最终得到的税后回报仍可能高于不断滚动投资国库券的结果。

1986.english: In any event, you should know that our expectations for both the stocks and bonds we now hold are exceptionally modest, given current market levels.  Probably the best thing that could happen to us is a market in which we would choose to sell many of our bond holdings at a significant loss in order to re-allocate funds to the far-better equity values then very likely to exist.  The bond losses I am talking about would occur if high interest rates came along; the same rates would probably depress common stocks considerably more than medium-term bonds.
1986.chinese: 无论如何，各位应当知道，鉴于当前市场价格水平，我们对现有股票和债券持仓的预期都极其有限。对我们而言，最好的事情也许是市场出现这样一种局面：我们愿意以相当大的亏损卖出许多债券，然后把资金重新配置到届时很可能便宜得多的股票上。我说的债券亏损会出现在利率大幅上升时；而同样的利率变化，很可能使普通股的跌幅远大于中期债券。

1986.english:
We show below our 1986 yearend net holdings in marketable equities. All positions with a market value of over $25 million are listed, and the interests attributable to minority shareholdings of Wesco Financial Corp. and Nebraska Furniture Mart are excluded.

```text

                                                    (000s omitted)

  6,850,000    GEICO Corporation ..............    45,713      674,725
  2,379,200    Handy & Harman .................    27,318       46,989
    489,300    Lear Siegler, Inc. .............    44,064       44,587
```
