We should note that we expect to keep permanently our three primary holdings, Capital Cities/ABC, Inc., GEICO Corporation, and The Washington Post.  Even if these securities were to appear significantly overpriced, we would not anticipate selling them, just as we would not sell See’s or Buffalo Evening News if someone were to offer us a price far above what we believe those businesses are worth.

This attitude may seem old-fashioned in a corporate world in which activity has become the order of the day.  The modern manager refers to his "portfolio" of businesses - meaning that all of them are candidates for "restructuring" whenever such a move is dictated by Wall Street preferences, operating conditions or a new corporate "concept." (Restructuring is defined narrowly, however: it extends only to dumping offending businesses, not to dumping the officers and directors who bought the businesses in the first place.  "Hate the sin but love the sinner" is a theology as popular with the Fortune 500 as it is with the Salvation Army.)
1986.chinese:
需要指出的是，我们打算永久持有三项最主要的投资：Capital Cities/ABC、盖可和华盛顿邮报。即使这些证券看起来明显高估，我们也不打算出售它们，正如即使有人出价远高于我们认为的价值，我们也不会卖掉喜诗糖果或《布法罗晚报》一样。

在如今这个热衷行动的企业世界里，这种态度也许显得过时。现代管理者谈论自己的企业“组合”——意思是，只要华尔街偏好、经营条件或某个新的企业“理念”发生变化，任何一家企业都可能成为“重组”的候选对象。（不过，“重组”的含义很狭窄：只包括甩掉不合心意的业务，不包括甩掉当初买下这些业务的高管和董事。“憎恨罪行，热爱罪人”这套神学，在《财富》500强企业中和救世军里同样受欢迎。）

1986.english:
Investment managers are even more hyperkinetic: their behavior during trading hours makes whirling dervishes appear sedated by comparison.  Indeed, the term "institutional investor" is becoming one of those self-contradictions called an oxymoron, comparable to "jumbo shrimp," "lady mudwrestler" and "inexpensive lawyer."

Despite the enthusiasm for activity that has swept business and financial America, we will stick with our ‘til-death-do-us- part policy. It’s the only one with which Charlie and I are comfortable, it produces decent results, and it lets our managers and those of our investees run their businesses free of distractions.
1986.chinese:
投资经理人甚至更加好动：交易时段里他们的表现，简直让旋转苦行僧看起来都像服了镇静剂。事实上，“机构投资者”正在变成一种自相矛盾的修辞说法，跟“巨型小虾”“淑女泥地摔跤手”和“廉价律师”差不多。

尽管整个美国商业界和金融界都掀起了崇尚行动的热潮，我们仍会坚持“至死不渝”的持有政策。这是查理和我唯一感到自在的方式，它带来不错的结果，也让我们的经理人和被投资企业的管理者免受不必要的干扰，专心经营业务。

1986.english:
NHP, Inc.

Last year we paid $23.7 million for about 50% of NHP, Inc., a developer, syndicator, owner and manager of multi-family rental housing.  Should all executive stock options that have been authorized be granted and exercised, our equity interest will decline to slightly over 45%.

NHP, Inc. has a most unusual genealogy.  In 1967, President Johnson appointed a commission of business and civic leaders, led by Edgar Kaiser, to study ways to increase the supply of multifamily housing for low- and moderate-income tenants. Certain members of the commission subsequently formed and promoted two business entities to foster this goal.  Both are now owned by NHP, Inc. and one operates under unusual ground rules: three of its directors must be appointed by the President, with the advice and consent of the Senate, and it is also required by law to submit an annual report to the President.
1986.chinese:
## NHP公司

去年，我们支付2370万美元，买入NHP公司约50%的股份。这家公司从事多户租赁住宅的开发、合伙项目组织、所有权持有和物业管理。如果所有已经批准的管理人员股票期权都得到授予并行权，我们的持股比例将下降至略高于45%。

NHP公司的来历很不寻常。1967年，约翰逊总统任命了一个由工商界和社会领袖组成、埃德加·凯泽担任主席的委员会，研究如何增加面向中低收入租户的多户住宅供给。委员会的部分成员随后组建并推动成立了两家企业，以促进这一目标的实现。如今，两家企业都归NHP所有，其中一家必须按照特殊规则经营：三名董事必须由总统提名、经参议院建议与同意后任命；法律还要求该公司每年向总统提交年度报告。

1986.english: Over 260 major corporations, motivated more by the idea of public service than profit, invested $42 million in the two original entities, which promptly began, through partnerships, to develop government-subsidized rental property.  The typical partnership owned a single property and was largely financed by a non-recourse mortgage.  Most of the equity money for each partnership was supplied by a group of limited partners who were primarily attracted by the large tax deductions that went with the investment.  NHP acted as general partner and also purchased a small portion of each partnership’s equity.
1986.chinese: 260多家大型企业主要出于公共服务而非盈利的动机，向最初的两家企业投入4200万美元。这两家企业很快通过合伙企业开发政府补贴的出租物业。典型的合伙企业只拥有一处物业，资金主要来自无追索权抵押贷款。每个合伙企业所需的权益资本，大部分由一组有限合伙人提供，他们主要看中投资附带的大额税收抵扣。NHP担任普通合伙人，同时购买每个合伙企业的一小部分股权。

1986.english:
The Government’s housing policy has, of course, shifted and NHP has necessarily broadened its activities to include non- subsidized apartments commanding market-rate rents.  In addition, a subsidiary of NHP builds single-family homes in the Washington, D.C. area, realizing revenues of about $50 million annually.

NHP now oversees about 500 partnership properties that are located in 40 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico, and that include about 80,000 housing units.  The cost of these properties was more than $2.5 billion and they have been well maintained.  NHP directly manages about 55,000 of the housing units and supervises the management of the rest.  The company’s revenues from management are about $16 million annually, and growing.
1986.chinese:
当然，政府的住房政策后来发生变化，NHP也不得不扩大业务范围，包括按市场租金出租的非补贴公寓。此外，NHP一家子公司在华盛顿特区周边兴建独栋住宅，每年实现约5000万美元收入。

目前，NHP监管约500处合伙企业物业，分布在40个州、哥伦比亚特区和波多黎各，共包括约8万套住宅。这些物业的建造成本超过25亿美元，维护状况良好。NHP直接管理约5.5万套住宅，并监督其余住宅的管理工作。公司每年的物业管理收入约1600万美元，而且仍在增长。

1986.english:
In addition to the equity interests it purchased upon the formation of each partnership, NHP owns varying residual interests that come into play when properties are disposed of and distributions are made to the limited partners.  The residuals on many of NHP’s "deep subsidy" properties are unlikely to be of much value.  But residuals on certain other properties could prove quite valuable, particularly if inflation should heat up.

The tax-oriented syndication of properties to individuals has been halted by the Tax Reform Act of 1986.  In the main, NHP is currently trying to develop equity positions or significant residual interests in non-subsidized rental properties of quality and size (typically 200 to 500 units).  In projects of this kind, NHP usually works with one or more large institutional investors or lenders.  NHP will continue to seek ways to develop low- and moderate-income apartment housing, but will not likely meet success unless government policy changes.
1986.chinese:
除了在各合伙企业成立时购买的股权，NHP还持有比例不等的剩余权益，在物业出售并向有限合伙人分配收益时，这些权益会发挥作用。NHP许多“深度补贴”物业的剩余权益可能价值不大。但另一些物业的剩余权益可能相当有价值，特别是在通胀重新升温的情况下。

1986年税制改革法案终止了以税收优惠为主要卖点、向个人投资者组织销售物业合伙权益的做法。目前，NHP主要努力在不享受补贴、质量较高且规模较大的出租物业项目（通常为200至500套住宅）中建立股权地位或重要剩余权益。在这类项目中，NHP通常与一个或多个大型机构投资者或贷款人合作。NHP会继续探索开发中低收入公寓住宅的方法，但除非政府政策发生变化，否则不太可能取得成功。

1986.english:
Besides ourselves, the large shareholders in NHP are Weyerhauser (whose interest is about 25%) and a management group led by Rod Heller, chief executive of NHP.  About 60 major corporations also continue to hold small interests, none larger than 2%.

Taxation

The Tax Reform Act of 1986 affects our various businesses in important and divergent ways.  Although we find much to praise in the Act, the net financial effect for Berkshire is negative: our rate of increase in business value is likely to be at least moderately slower under the new law than under the old.  The net effect for our shareholders is even more negative: every dollar of increase in per-share business value, assuming the increase is accompanied by an equivalent dollar gain in the market value of Berkshire stock, will produce 72 cents of after-tax gain for our shareholders rather than the 80 cents produced under the old law. This result, of course, reflects the rise in the maximum tax rate on personal capital gains from 20% to 28%.
1986.chinese:
除我们之外，NHP的大股东还有持股约25%的惠好公司（Weyerhaeuser），以及NHP首席执行官罗德·赫勒领导的管理团队。此外，约60家大型企业仍持有少量股份，单家持股均不超过2%。

## 税收

1986年税制改革法案以重要而不同的方式影响我们的各项业务。虽然我们认为这部法案有许多值得赞扬之处，但总体财务影响对伯克希尔不利：在新法律下，我们企业价值的增长速度很可能至少略低于旧法下的水平。对股东的净影响更加不利：如果每股企业价值增加1美元，同时伯克希尔股价也相应增加1美元，那么股东税后收益将只有72美分，而旧法下是80美分。这当然是因为个人资本利得最高税率从20%提高到了28%。

1986.english:
Here are the main tax changes that affect Berkshire:

o The tax rate on corporate ordinary income is scheduled to decrease from 46% in 1986 to 34% in 1988.  This change obviously affects us positively - and it also has a significant positive effect on two of our three major investees, Capital Cities/ABC and The Washington Post Company.

I say this knowing that over the years there has been a lot of fuzzy and often partisan commentary about who really pays corporate taxes - businesses or their customers.  The argument, of course, has usually turned around tax increases, not decreases.  Those people resisting increases in corporate rates frequently argue that corporations in reality pay none of the taxes levied on them but, instead, act as a sort of economic pipeline, passing all taxes through to consumers.  According to these advocates, any corporate-tax increase will simply lead to higher prices that, for the corporation, offset the increase. Having taken this position, proponents of the "pipeline" theory must also conclude that a tax decrease for corporations will not help profits but will instead flow through, leading to correspondingly lower prices for consumers.
1986.chinese:
以下是影响伯克希尔的主要税法变化。

**企业普通所得税率下降。** 企业普通所得税率计划从1986年的46%降至1988年的34%。这一变化显然对我们有利，也对我们三大主要被投资企业中的两家——Capital Cities/ABC和华盛顿邮报——产生显著积极影响。

我这么说，是知道这些年关于究竟谁真正承担企业税负——企业还是消费者——存在大量含糊其辞、往往带有党派色彩的评论。当然，争论通常围绕增税，而不是减税。反对提高企业税率的人经常声称，企业实际上没有承担政府向它们征收的任何税，而是像一条经济上的管道，把全部税负转嫁给消费者。按照这种看法，企业税每增加一点，企业就会相应提高售价，使税负增加得到抵消。持这种“管道理论”的人也必须得出相应结论：降低企业税率不会增加企业利润，而是会向下传导，带来消费者支付价格的相应下降。

1986.english:
Conversely, others argue that corporations not only pay the taxes levied upon them, but absorb them also.  Consumers, this school says, will be unaffected by changes in corporate rates.

What really happens?  When the corporate rate is cut, do Berkshire, The Washington Post, Cap Cities, etc., themselves soak up the benefits, or do these companies pass the benefits along to their customers in the form of lower prices?  This is an important question for investors and managers, as well as for policymakers.
1986.chinese:
相反，另一些人认为，企业不仅依法缴纳税款，也真正承担税负。按照这种观点，企业税率变化不会影响消费者。

现实究竟如何？当企业税率下降时，是伯克希尔、华盛顿邮报、Capital Cities等公司自己把好处收入囊中，还是把利益通过降低价格传递给客户？这对投资者、管理者和政策制定者都是一个重要问题。

1986.english:
Our conclusion is that in some cases the benefits of lower corporate taxes fall exclusively, or almost exclusively, upon the corporation and its shareholders, and that in other cases the benefits are entirely, or almost entirely, passed through to the customer.  What determines the outcome is the strength of the corporation’s business franchise and whether the profitability of that franchise is regulated.

For example, when the franchise is strong and after-tax profits are regulated in a relatively precise manner, as is the case with electric utilities, changes in corporate tax rates are largely reflected in prices, not in profits.  When taxes are cut, prices will usually be reduced in short order.  When taxes are increased, prices will rise, though often not as promptly.
1986.chinese:
我们的结论是，在某些情况下，企业税率下降的好处全部或几乎全部归企业及其股东所有；另一些情况下，好处全部或几乎全部转移给消费者。决定结果的因素，是企业商业特许经营权的强弱，以及这种特许经营权的盈利水平是否受到监管。

例如，当一家企业具有强大的特许经营权，而且税后利润受到相当精确的监管——电力公用事业就是如此——企业税率变化主要反映在价格而不是利润中。税率下降后，价格通常很快下降；税率提高时，价格也会上涨，只是通常不会那么迅速。

1986.english: A similar result occurs in a second arena - in the price- competitive industry, whose companies typically operate with very weak business franchises.  In such industries, the free market "regulates" after-tax profits in a delayed and irregular, but generally effective, manner.  The marketplace, in effect, performs much the same function in dealing with the price- competitive industry as the Public Utilities Commission does in dealing with electric utilities.  In these industries, therefore, tax changes eventually affect prices more than profits.
1986.chinese: 第二种情况发生在价格竞争激烈、企业通常只有很弱商业特许经营权的行业。在这样的行业，自由市场以滞后、不规则但总体有效的方式“监管”税后利润。事实上，面对价格竞争行业时，市场发挥的作用，与公用事业委员会面对电力公司时发挥的作用大致相同。因此，在这类行业，税制变化最终对价格的影响通常大于对利润的影响。

1986.english:
In the case of unregulated businesses blessed with strong franchises, however, it’s a different story:  the corporation and its shareholders are then the major beneficiaries of tax cuts.  These companies benefit from a tax cut much as the electric company would if it lacked a regulator to force down prices.

Many of our businesses, both those we own in whole and in part, possess such franchises.  Consequently, reductions in their taxes largely end up in our pockets rather than the pockets of our customers.  While this may be impolitic to state, it is impossible to deny.  If you are tempted to believe otherwise, think for a moment of the most able brain surgeon or lawyer in your area.  Do you really expect the fees of this expert (the local "franchise-holder" in his or her specialty) to be reduced now that the top personal tax rate is being cut from 50% to 28%?
1986.chinese:
但是，对于那些没有受到监管、又拥有强大特许经营权的企业，情况就不同了：企业及其股东是减税的主要受益者。这些公司从减税中受益的方式，就像电力公司如果没有监管机构迫使它降低价格时会得到的好处一样。

我们全资或部分持有的许多企业，都拥有这样的特许经营权。因此，税负降低带来的好处，在很大程度上进入我们的口袋，而不是客户的口袋。这样说可能不太符合政治礼仪，却是无法否认的事实。如果你想相信另一种说法，不妨想想当地最出色的脑外科医生或律师——他或她是本专业的本地“特许经营权持有人”。如今个人所得税最高税率从50%降至28%，你真的指望这位专家降低收费吗？

1986.english: Your joy at our conclusion that lower rates benefit a number of our operating businesses and investees should be severely tempered, however, by another of our convictions: scheduled 1988 tax rates, both individual and corporate, seem totally unrealistic to us.  These rates will very likely bestow a fiscal problem on Washington that will prove incompatible with price stability.  We believe, therefore, that ultimately - within, say, five years - either higher tax rates or higher inflation rates are almost certain to materialize.  And it would not surprise us to see both.
1986.chinese: 不过，各位听到我们认为减税有利于许多经营企业和被投资公司，也不应过于高兴，因为我们还有另一项判断：计划于1988年实施的个人和企业税率，在我们看来完全不现实。这些税率很可能给华盛顿带来财政问题，而这种问题最终将与物价稳定难以相容。因此，我们认为，最终——比如五年内——几乎肯定会出现更高的税率或更高的通胀率。两者同时出现，我们也不会惊讶。

1986.english: o Corporate capital gains tax rates have been increased from 28% to 34%, effective in 1987.  This change will have an important adverse effect on Berkshire because we expect much of our gain in business value in the future, as in the past, to arise from capital gains.  For example, our three major investment holdings - Cap Cities, GEICO, and Washington Post - at yearend had a market value of over $1.7 billion, close to 75% of the total net worth of Berkshire, and yet they deliver us only about $9 million in annual income.  Instead, all three retain a very high percentage of their earnings, which we expect to eventually deliver us capital gains.
1986.chinese: **企业资本利得税率提高。** 企业资本利得税率自1987年起从28%上升至34%。这一变化将对伯克希尔造成重大不利影响，因为我们预计，与过去一样，未来企业价值的很大一部分增长将来自资本利得。例如，年末我们持有的三大主要投资——Capital Cities、盖可和华盛顿邮报——市值超过17亿美元，接近伯克希尔总净资产的75%，但每年给我们带来的收入只有约900万美元。相反，这三家公司都保留了很大比例的利润，我们预计这些利润最终会给我们带来资本利得。

1986.english: The new law increases the rate for all gains realized in the future, including the unrealized gains that existed before the law was enacted.  At yearend, we had $1.2 billion of such unrealized gains in our equity investments.  The effect of the new law on our balance sheet will be delayed because a GAAP rule stipulates that the deferred tax liability applicable to unrealized gains should be stated at last year’s 28% tax rate rather than the current 34% rate.  This rule is expected to change soon.  The moment it does, about $73 million will disappear from our GAAP net worth and be added to the deferred tax account.
1986.chinese: 新法提高了未来所有已实现资本利得适用的税率，包括法案通过前已经存在的未实现收益。年末，我们的股票投资中有12亿美元这样的未实现收益。新法对资产负债表的影响会延后体现，因为一条GAAP规定要求，与未实现收益有关的递延所得税负债仍按上一年的28%税率计算，而不是现行的34%。预计这条规定很快会修改。一旦修改，约7300万美元将从我们的GAAP净资产中消失，并计入递延税款账户。

1986.english: o Dividend and interest income received by our insurance companies will be taxed far more heavily under the new law. First, all corporations will be taxed on 20% of the dividends they receive from other domestic corporations, up from 15% under the old law.  Second, there is a change concerning the residual 80% that applies only to property/casualty companies: 15% of that residual will be taxed if the stocks paying the dividends were purchased after August 7, 1986.  A third change, again applying only to property/casualty companies, concerns tax-exempt bonds: interest on bonds purchased by insurers after August 7, 1986 will only be 85% tax-exempt.
1986.chinese: **保险公司股息和利息收入税负加重。** 在新法下，保险公司收到的股息和利息收入将承担明显更重的税负。首先，所有企业必须将从其他美国国内企业收到股息的20%纳入应税收入，旧法为15%。其次，一项只适用于财产意外险公司的变化涉及其余80%的部分：如果支付股息的股票是在1986年8月7日之后购买的，那么这剩余80%中的15%也要缴税。第三项同样只适用于财产意外险公司的变化涉及免税债券：保险公司在1986年8月7日之后购买的债券，其利息只有85%能够免税。

1986.english:
The last two changes are very important.  They mean that our income from the investments we make in future years will be significantly lower than would have been the case under the old law.  My best guess is that these changes alone will eventually reduce the earning power of our insurance operation by at least 10% from what we could previously have expected.

o The new tax law also materially changes the timing of tax payments by property/casualty insurance companies.  One new rule requires us to discount our loss reserves in our tax returns, a change that will decrease deductions and increase taxable income. Another rule, to be phased in over six years, requires us to include 20% of our unearned premium reserve in taxable income.
1986.chinese:
后两项变化非常重要。这意味着，与旧法相比，我们未来几年新投资取得的收入将明显减少。我最好的估计是，单是这些变化，最终就会使保险业务的盈利能力比以前预期的水平至少下降10%。

**保险公司缴税时间提前。** 新税法还显著改变了财产意外险公司缴税的时间。一项新规则要求，我们在纳税申报中把赔款准备金折现，这将减少税前扣除额并增加应税收入。另一项规则将在六年内逐步实施，要求我们把未到期保费准备金的20%计入应税收入。

1986.english: Neither rule changes the amount of the annual tax accrual in our reports to you, but each materially accelerates the schedule of payments.  That is, taxes formerly deferred will now be front- ended, a change that will significantly cut the profitability of our business.  An analogy will suggest the toll: if, upon turning 21, you were required to immediately pay tax on all income you were due to receive throughout your life, both your lifetime wealth and your estate would be a small fraction of what they would be if all taxes on your income were payable only when you died.
1986.chinese: 这两项规定都不会改变我们向各位报告的年度所得税费用计提总额，但都会显著提前实际缴税时间。也就是说，过去能够递延的税款，现在必须提前支付，这将大幅削弱业务盈利能力。打个比方，你就会知道代价有多大：假如你在21岁生日那天，就必须立即缴清未来一生中全部应得收入的税款，那么你的终生财富和遗产，都只会是在去世时才需要支付全部所得税情况下的一小部分。

1986.english:
Attentive readers may spot an inconsistency in what we say. Earlier, discussing companies in price-competitive industries, we suggested that tax increases or reductions affect these companies relatively little, but instead are largely passed along to their customers.  But now we are saying that tax increases will affect profits of Berkshire’s property/casualty companies even though they operate in an intensely price-competitive industry.

The reason this industry is likely to be an exception to our general rule is that not all major insurers will be working with identical tax equations.  Important differences will exist for several reasons: a new alternative minimum tax will materially affect some companies but not others; certain major insurers have huge loss carry-forwards that will largely shield their income from significant taxes for at least a few years; and the results of some large insurers will be folded into the consolidated returns of companies with non-insurance businesses.  These disparate conditions will produce widely varying marginal tax rates in the property/casualty industry.  That will not be the case, however, in most other price-competitive industries, such as aluminum, autos and department stores, in which the major players will generally contend with similar tax equations.
1986.chinese:
细心的读者也许会发现，我们的说法似乎存在矛盾。前面讨论价格竞争行业时，我们认为增税或减税对这类企业影响相对不大，税负变化主要传递给客户。但现在，我们又认为增税会影响伯克希尔财产意外险公司的利润，尽管它们处于竞争极其激烈的行业。

保险业可能成为我们一般规律的例外，原因是并非所有大型保险公司面对相同的税收计算方式。重要差异来自多个方面：新的替代性最低税会明显影响某些公司，却不会影响另一些；一些大型保险公司有巨额可结转亏损，至少在未来几年能在很大程度上保护其收入免受高额税负影响；还有一些大型保险公司的业绩，将合并计入拥有非保险业务的母公司的纳税申报。这些不同情况会使财产意外险行业各公司的边际税率相差很大。而在铝业、汽车、百货商店等其他多数价格竞争行业中，主要参与者面临的税收计算方式一般比较相似。

1986.english:
The absence of a common tax calculus for property/casualty companies means that the increased taxes falling on the industry will probably not be passed along to customers to the degree that they would in a typical price-competitive industry.  Insurers, in other words, will themselves bear much of the new tax burdens.

o A partial offset to these burdens is a "fresh start" adjustment that occurred on January 1, 1987 when our December 31, 1986 loss reserve figures were converted for tax purposes to the newly-required discounted basis. (In our reports to you, however, reserves will remain on exactly the same basis as in the past - undiscounted except in special cases such as structured settlements.) The net effect of the "fresh start" is to give us a double deduction: we will get a tax deduction in 1987 and future years for a portion of our-incurred-but-unpaid insurance losses that have already been fully deducted as costs in 1986 and earlier years.
1986.chinese:
财产意外险公司没有共同统一的税收计算方式，意味着新增税负很可能不像普通价格竞争行业那样充分转嫁给消费者。换句话说，保险公司自己将承担新税负的很大一部分。

**“重新起算”调整。** 上述负担有一项部分抵消因素：1987年1月1日，我们将1986年12月31日的赔款准备金用于税务计算时，转换为新规定的折现口径，由此产生一项“重新起算”（fresh start）调整。（不过，在我们向股东提供的报告中，除结构性和解等特殊情况外，准备金仍会像过去一样按未折现口径计算。）“重新起算”的净效果，是允许我们获得重复扣除：某些已经在1986年或以前年度作为费用全额扣除、却仍未支付的保险赔款，将在1987年及以后年度再次获得部分税前扣除。

1986.english: The increase in net worth that is produced by this change is not yet reflected in our financial statements.  Rather, under present GAAP rules (which may be changed), the benefit will flow into the earnings statement and, consequently, into net worth over the next few years by way of reduced tax charges.  We expect the total benefit from the fresh-start adjustment to be in the $30 - $40 million range.  It should be noted, however, that this is a one-time benefit, whereas the negative impact of the other insurance-related tax changes is not only ongoing but, in important respects, will become more severe as time passes.
1986.chinese: 这一变化造成的净资产增加，尚未反映在我们的财务报表中。相反，按照现行GAAP规则（未来可能修改），这一好处会在未来几年通过所得税费用减少，进入利润表，进而增加净资产。我们预计，重新起算调整带来的总收益在3000万至4000万美元之间。不过，需要指出的是，这只是一项一次性收益；而其他保险相关税制变化的负面影响不仅会持续，而且在重要方面还会随着时间推移变得更加严重。

1986.english: o The General Utilities Doctrine was repealed by the new tax law. This means that in 1987 and thereafter there will be a double tax on corporate liquidations, one at the corporate level and another at the shareholder level.  In the past, the tax at the corporate level could be avoided, If Berkshire, for example, were to be liquidated - which it most certainly won’t be - shareholders would, under the new law, receive far less from the sales of our properties than they would have if the properties had been sold in the past, assuming identical prices in each sale.  Though this outcome is theoretical in our case, the change in the law will very materially affect many companies. Therefore, it also affects our evaluations of prospective investments.  Take, for example, producing oil and gas businesses, selected media companies, real estate companies, etc. that might wish to sell out.  The values that their shareholders can realize are likely to be significantly reduced simply because the General Utilities Doctrine has been repealed - though the companies’ operating economics will not have changed adversely at all.  My impression is that this important change in the law has not yet been fully comprehended by either investors or managers.
1986.chinese: **废除General Utilities原则。** 新税法废除了General Utilities税法原则（General Utilities Doctrine）。这意味着1987年及以后，企业清算将受到双重征税：公司层面一次，股东层面另一次。过去，公司层面的税负可以避免。例如，假设伯克希尔被清算——这当然绝不会发生——在其他出售价格完全相同的情况下，新法下股东从资产出售中得到的钱，会远少于按旧法出售时的所得。对我们来说，这只是理论上的情况，但法律变化将对许多公司造成非常重大影响，因此也会影响我们对潜在投资的估值。比如，某些准备出售的石油和天然气生产企业、媒体公司、房地产公司等，仅仅因为General Utilities原则被废除，股东最终可实现的价值就可能明显下降——尽管这些公司的经营经济特性丝毫没有恶化。我感觉投资者和管理者还没有充分理解这项重要修法。

1986.english:
This section of our report has been longer and more complicated than I would have liked.  But the changes in the law are many and important, particularly for property/casualty insurers.  As I have noted, the new law will hurt Berkshire’s results, but the negative impact is impossible to quantify with any precision.

Miscellaneous

We bought a corporate jet last year.  What you have heard about such planes is true: they are very expensive and a luxury in situations like ours where little travel to out-of-the-way places is required.  And planes not only cost a lot to operate, they cost a lot just to look at.  Pre-tax, cost of capital plus depreciation on a new $15 million plane probably runs $3 million annually.  On our own plane, bought for $850,000 used, such costs run close to $200,000 annually.
1986.chinese:
报告的这一部分比我原来希望的更长、更复杂。但法律变化既多又重要，对财产意外险公司尤其如此。正如我指出的，新法将损害伯克希尔的业绩，但负面影响无法精确量化。

## 其他事项

去年，我们买了一架公司公务机。各位听说的关于这种飞机的事情都是真的：它们非常昂贵，而像我们这样很少需要去偏远地方出差的公司，使用它是一种奢侈。不仅运营飞机要花很多钱，光是拥有一架飞机、把它停在那里也很费钱。对于一架价值1500万美元的新飞机，税前的资金成本加折旧，每年大约需要300万美元。我们买的是一架85万美元的二手飞机，相应成本每年接近20万美元。

1986.english: Cognizant of such figures, your Chairman, unfortunately, has in the past made a number of rather intemperate remarks about corporate jets.  Accordingly, prior to our purchase, I was forced into my Galileo mode.  I promptly experienced the necessary "counter-revelation" and travel is now considerably easier - and considerably costlier - than in the past.  Whether Berkshire will get its money’s worth from the plane is an open question, but I will work at achieving some business triumph that I can (no matter how dubiously) attribute to it.  I’m afraid Ben Franklin had my number.  Said he: "So convenient a thing it is to be a reasonable creature, since it enables one to find or make a reason for everything one has a mind to do."
1986.chinese: 我当然知道这些数字。可惜的是，身为各位的董事长，我过去曾对公司公务机发表过不少相当不克制的评论。因此，在买飞机之前，我不得不进入“伽利略模式”。我迅速获得了必要的“反向启示”，如今出行比过去方便得多——也昂贵得多。伯克希尔能否从这架飞机上获得物有所值的回报，仍是个未知数。不过，我会努力取得某项经营上的胜利，然后把功劳（不管理由多么牵强）归于这架飞机。恐怕本杰明·富兰克林早就看透了我。他说：“人真是一种方便的理性动物，因为凡是自己想做的事，总能找到或编造出一个理由。”

1986.english:
About 97% of all eligible shares participated in Berkshire’s 1986 shareholder-designated contributions program.  Contributions made through the program were $4 million, and 1,934 charities were recipients.

We urge new shareholders to read the description of our shareholder-designated contributions program that appears on pages 58 and 59.  If you wish to participate in future programs, we strongly urge that you immediately make sure your shares are registered in the name of the actual owner, not in "street" name or nominee name.  Shares not so registered on September 30, 1987 will be ineligible for the 1987 program.
1986.chinese:
1986年，符合资格的股份中约有97%参加了伯克希尔的股东指定捐赠计划。通过这一计划捐赠了400万美元，共有1934家慈善机构获得资助。

我们敦促新股东阅读第58和59页对股东指定捐赠计划的说明。如果希望参加未来的计划，请立即确认所持股份登记在实际所有人名下，而不是登记在经纪商的“街名”或其他代持人名下。到1987年9月30日仍未以此方式登记的股份，将没有资格参加1987年的计划。

1986.english:
---

Last year almost 450 people attended our shareholders’ meeting, up from about 250 the year before (and from about a dozen ten years ago).  I hope you can join us on May 19th in Omaha.  Charlie and I like to answer owner-related questions and I can promise you that our shareholders will pose many good ones.  Finishing up the questions may take quite a while - we had about 65 last year so you should feel free to leave once your own have been answered.
1986.chinese:
* * *

去年，参加股东大会的人数接近450人，高于前一年的约250人（十年前则只有十来人）。希望各位在5月19日来奥马哈与我们相聚。查理和我喜欢回答与企业所有者有关的问题，而且我可以保证，股东们会提出许多好问题。问题回答完可能需要很久——去年约有65个问题——所以自己的问题得到回答后，各位可以随时离开。

1986.english: Last year, after the meeting, one shareholder from New Jersey and another from New York went to the Furniture Mart, where each purchased a $5,000 Oriental rug from Mrs. B. (To be precise, they purchased rugs that might cost $10,000 elsewhere for which they were charged about $5,000.) Mrs. B was pleased - but not satisfied - and she will be looking for you at the store after this year’s meeting.  Unless our shareholders top last year’s record, I’ll be in trouble.  So do me (and yourself) a favor, and go see her.
1986.chinese: 去年股东大会结束后，一位来自新泽西州的股东和另一位来自纽约州的股东去了家具城，分别花5000美元，从B夫人那里买了一张东方地毯。（准确地说，他们各自用约5000美元，买到了在别处可能售价1万美元的地毯。）B夫人很高兴，但并不满足；今年会后她还会在店里等着各位。如果我们的股东今年不能打破去年的销售纪录，我可要有麻烦了。所以，请帮我一个忙（也帮你自己一个忙），去看看她吧。

1986.english:
Warren E. Buffett February 27, 1987                        Chairman of the Board

*（1）至（4）表示本节后文讨论的项目。*

各位大概已经猜到了，O公司和N公司其实是同一家企业——斯科特与费策（Scott Fetzer）。O（Old，即“旧”）栏展示的是假如我们没有收购该公司，它在1986年按照公认会计原则（GAAP）本应报告的利润；N（New，即“新”）栏则展示了被伯克希尔收购之后，斯科特与费策实际报告的GAAP利润。

需要强调的是，两栏反映的是完全相同的经济现实——销售额、工资、税收等都相同。两家“公司”也为所有者创造完全相同的现金。不同的只有会计处理方法。

1986.english:
So, fellow philosophers, which column presents truth? Upon which set of numbers should managers and investors focus?

Before we tackle those questions, let's look at what produces the disparity between O and N. We will simplify our discussion in some respects, but the simplification should not produce any inaccuracies in analysis or conclusions.

The contrast between O and N comes about because we paid an amount for Scott Fetzer that was different from its stated net worth. Under GAAP, such differences - such premiums or discounts - must be accounted for by "purchase-price adjustments." In Scott Fetzer's case, we paid $315 million for net assets that were carried on its books at $172.4 million. So we paid a premium of $142.6 million.
1986.chinese:
那么，各位哲学家，哪一栏代表真实情况？管理者和投资者应该重点关注哪一组数字？

讨论这些问题之前，先看看O和N之间的差异是怎样产生的。我们会在某些方面简化讨论，但这些简化不应影响分析或结论的准确性。

O与N之间的差异，源于我们为斯科特与费策支付的收购价格，与其原来列示的净资产价值不同。按照GAAP，这种差额——无论是溢价还是折价——都必须通过“购买价格调整”进行会计处理。我们为斯科特与费策支付3.15亿美元，而其账面净资产只有1.724亿美元，因此支付的溢价为1.426亿美元。

1986.english: The first step in accounting for any premium paid is to adjust the carrying value of current assets to current values. In practice, this requirement usually does not affect receivables, which are routinely carried at current value, but often affects inventories. Because of a $22.9 million LIFO reserve and other accounting intricacies, Scott Fetzer's inventory account was carried at a $37.3 million discount from current value. So, making our first accounting move, we used $37.3 million of our $142.6 million premium to increase the carrying value of the inventory.
1986.chinese: 处理收购溢价的第一步，是把流动资产的账面金额调整为当前价值。实践中，应收账款通常已按当前价值列示，因而这一要求很少影响应收账款，但经常影响存货。由于存在2290万美元的后进先出法（LIFO）储备及其他会计上的复杂因素，斯科特与费策存货的账面价值比其当前价值低3730万美元。因此，我们首先用1.426亿美元收购溢价中的3730万美元调高存货的账面价值。

1986.english: Assuming any premium is left after current assets are adjusted, the next step is to adjust fixed assets to current value. In our case, this adjustment also required a few accounting acrobatics relating to deferred taxes. Since this has been billed as a simplified discussion, I will skip the details and give you the bottom line: $68.0 million was added to fixed assets and $13.0 million was eliminated from deferred tax liabilities. After making this $81.0 million adjustment, we were left with $24.3 million of premium to allocate.
1986.chinese: 如果调整流动资产后仍有溢价余额，下一步便是把固定资产调整为当前价值。对我们来说，这一步还涉及与递延所得税有关的若干会计“杂技”。既然本节号称要简化说明，我就跳过细节，直接讲结果：固定资产增加6800万美元，递延所得税负债减少1300万美元。完成这项合计8100万美元的调整后，我们还有2430万美元溢价尚待分配。

1986.english:
Had our situation called for them two steps would next have been required: the adjustment of intangible assets other than Goodwill to current fair values, and the restatement of liabilities to current fair values, a requirement that typically affects only long-term debt and unfunded pension liabilities. In Scott Fetzer's case, however, neither of these steps was necessary.

The final accounting adjustment we needed to make, after recording fair market values for all assets and liabilities, was the assignment of the residual premium to Goodwill (technically known as "excess of cost over the fair value of net assets acquired"). This residual amounted to $24.3 million. Thus, the balance sheet of Scott Fetzer immediately before the acquisition, which is summarized below in column O, was transformed by the purchase into the balance sheet shown in column N. In real terms, both balance sheets depict the same assets and liabilities - but, as you can see, certain figures differ significantly.
1986.chinese:
如果我们的情况需要，下一步还应完成两项工作：把除商誉以外的无形资产调整到当前公允价值，以及把负债重估到当前公允价值；后一要求通常只影响长期债务和未筹资的养老金负债。不过，斯科特与费策无需进行这两项调整。

在所有资产和负债均按公允市值入账之后，我们最后需要作出的会计调整，就是把剩余溢价分配给商誉（其技术名称为“收购成本超过所取得净资产公允价值的部分”）。这部分余额为2430万美元。于是，收购前斯科特与费策的资产负债表——下表O栏所示——由于这次收购，转换成了N栏所示的资产负债表。从经济实质看，两张表反映的是同样的资产和负债，但可以看到，某些金额出现了相当大的变化。

The higher balance sheet figures shown in column N produce the lower income figures shown in column N of the earnings statement presented earlier. This is the result of the asset write-ups and of the fact that some of the written-up assets must be depreciated or amortized. The higher the asset figure, the higher the annual depreciation or amortization charge to earnings must be. The charges that flowed to the earnings statement because of the balance sheet write-ups were numbered in the statement of earnings shown earlier:
1986.chinese: N栏资产负债表中的资产金额较高，导致前面利润表中N栏的利润数字较低。原因是资产被调高入账价值后，其中一部分需要进行折旧或摊销。资产金额越高，每年计入利润表的折旧或摊销费用也越高。前面利润表中标注编号的费用，就是资产价值调增后产生的项目：

1986.english:
$4,979,000 for non-cash inventory costs resulting, primarily, from reductions that Scott Fetzer made in its inventories during 1986; charges of this kind are apt to be small or non-existent in future years.

$5,054,000 for extra depreciation attributable to the write-up of fixed assets; a charge approximating this amount will probably be made annually for 12 more years.

$595,000 for amortization of Goodwill; this charge will be made annually for 39 more years in a slightly larger amount because our purchase was made on January 6 and, therefore, the 1986 figure applies to only 98% of the year.
1986.chinese:
（1）**497.9万美元**非现金存货成本，主要由于斯科特与费策在1986年减少了存货。这类费用在未来年度可能很少甚至不会发生。

（2）**505.4万美元**额外折旧，来自固定资产价值调增。此后约12年，每年可能仍将发生数额相近的费用。

（3）**59.5万美元**商誉摊销。此后39年，每年都会发生略高于这一数字的摊销费用，因为我们是在1月6日完成收购，所以1986年的金额只涵盖全年约98%的期间。

1986.english:
$998,000 for deferred-tax acrobatics that are beyond my ability to explain briefly (or perhaps even non-briefly); a charge approximating this amount will probably be made annually for 12 more years.

It is important to understand that none of these newly-created accounting costs, totaling $11.6 million, are deductible for income tax purposes. The "new" Scott Fetzer pays exactly the same tax as the "old" Scott Fetzer would have, even though the GAAP earnings of the two entities differ greatly. And, in respect to operating earnings, that would be true in the future also. However, in the unlikely event that Scott Fetzer sells one of its businesses, the tax consequences to the "old" and "new" company might differ widely.
1986.chinese:
（4）**99.8万美元**递延所得税方面的会计“杂技”，我无法用简短文字解释（甚至写得很长也未必解释得清）。此后约12年，每年可能出现数额相近的费用。

必须理解，上述新产生的会计费用合计1160万美元，在计算所得税时均不可税前扣除。“新”斯科特与费策支付的税款，与没有被收购时的“旧”斯科特与费策完全一样，尽管两者的GAAP利润差异很大。未来的经营利润也是如此。不过，在不大可能发生的情况下，如果斯科特与费策出售其中一项业务，那么“旧”公司和“新”公司的税务后果可能相差很大。

1986.english: By the end of 1986 the difference between the net worth of the "old" and "new" Scott Fetzer had been reduced from $142.6 million to $131.0 million by means of the extra $11.6 million that was charged to earnings of the new entity. As the years go by, similar charges to earnings will cause most of the premium to disappear, and the two balance sheets will converge. However, the higher land values and most of the higher inventory values that were established on the new balance sheet will remain unless land is disposed of or inventory levels are further reduced.
1986.chinese: 到1986年末，由于“新”公司利润中额外计入1160万美元费用，“旧”“新”斯科特与费策之间的净资产差额，已从1.426亿美元下降到1.31亿美元。随着时间推移，类似费用会使大部分溢价逐渐消失，两张资产负债表也会趋于接近。不过，新资产负债表中调高的土地价值，以及大部分调高的存货价值，将继续存在，除非土地被出售或存货水平进一步下降。

1986.english:
---

What does all this mean for owners? Did the shareholders of Berkshire buy a business that earned $40.2 million in 1986 or did they buy one earning $28.6 million? Were those $11.6 million of new charges a real economic cost to us? Should investors pay more for the stock of Company O than of Company N? And, if a business is worth some given multiple of earnings, was Scott Fetzer worth considerably more the day before we bought it than it was worth the following day?
1986.chinese:
* * *

所有这些对企业所有者意味着什么？伯克希尔的股东买到的，究竟是一家1986年赚取4020万美元的企业，还是一家只赚2860万美元的企业？新出现的1160万美元费用，对我们而言是真实的经济成本吗？投资者应该为O公司股票支付比N公司更高的价格吗？如果企业的价值是利润的某个倍数，那么斯科特与费策在我们收购前一天，真的比收购后一天值钱得多吗？

1986.english: If we think through these questions, we can gain some insights about what may be called "owner earnings." These represent (a) reported earnings plus (b) depreciation, depletion, amortization, and certain other non-cash charges such as Company N's items (1) and (4) less ( c) the average annual amount of capitalized expenditures for plant and equipment, etc. that the business requires to fully maintain its long-term competitive position and its unit volume. (If the business requires additional working capital to maintain its competitive position and unit volume, the increment also should be included in ( c) . However, businesses following the LIFO inventory method usually do not require additional working capital if unit volume does not change.)
1986.chinese: 仔细思考这些问题，可以帮助我们理解一种可以称为**“所有者收益”（Owner Earnings）**的指标。它包括：（a）报告利润，加上（b）折旧、折耗、摊销及某些其他非现金费用，例如N公司的项目（1）和（4）；再减去（c）为充分维持企业长期竞争地位和现有单位销量，厂房、设备等所需的平均年度资本化支出。（如果维持竞争地位和单位销量还需要增加营运资本，那么增加额也应计入（c）。不过，采用后进先出法（LIFO）核算存货的企业，如果单位销量不变，通常不需要增加营运资本。）

1986.english: Our owner-earnings equation does not yield the deceptively precise figures provided by GAAP, since( c) must be a guess - and one sometimes very difficult to make. Despite this problem, we consider the owner earnings figure, not the GAAP figure, to be the relevant item for valuation purposes - both for investors in buying stocks and for managers in buying entire businesses. We agree with Keynes's observation: "I would rather be vaguely right than precisely wrong."
1986.chinese: 我们的所有者收益公式，无法像GAAP那样给出看似精确的数字，因为（c）必须通过估算得出，而且有时非常难以估计。尽管存在这一困难，我们仍认为，对于投资者购买股票，以及管理者收购整家企业的估值工作，相关的指标是所有者收益，而不是GAAP利润。我们赞同凯恩斯的看法：“我宁愿大致正确，也不愿精确地错误。”

1986.english:
The approach we have outlined produces "owner earnings" for Company O and Company N that are identical, which means valuations are also identical, just as common sense would tell you should be the case. This result is reached because the sum of (a) and (b) is the same in both columns O and N, and because( c) is necessarily the same in both cases.

And what do Charlie and I, as owners and managers, believe is the correct figure for the owner earnings of Scott Fetzer? Under current circumstances, we believe ( c) is very close to the "old" company's (b) number of $8.3 million and much below the "new" company's (b) number of $19.9 million. Therefore, we believe that owner earnings are far better depicted by the reported earnings in the O column than by those in the N column. In other words, we feel owner earnings of Scott Fetzer are considerably larger than the GAAP figures that we report.
1986.chinese:
按照我们提出的方法，O公司和N公司的所有者收益完全相同，因此估值也相同；这正是常识告诉我们的结果。之所以如此，是因为两栏的（a）与（b）之和相同，而（c）也必然相同。

那么，作为所有者和管理者，查理和我认为斯科特与费策的所有者收益究竟是多少？在目前情况下，我们认为（c）非常接近“旧”公司（b）的830万美元，而且远低于“新”公司（b）的1990万美元。因此，我们认为，O栏报告的利润能够比N栏更好地反映所有者收益。换言之，斯科特与费策的所有者收益明显高于我们按GAAP报告的利润。

1986.english: That is obviously a happy state of affairs. But calculations of this sort usually do not provide such pleasant news. Most managers probably will acknowledge that they need to spend something more than (b) on their businesses over the longer term just to hold their ground in terms of both unit volume and competitive position. When this imperative exists - that is, when ( c) exceeds (b) - GAAP earnings overstate owner earnings. Frequently this overstatement is substantial. The oil industry has in recent years provided a conspicuous example of this phenomenon. Had most major oil companies spent only (b) each year, they would have guaranteed their shrinkage in real terms.
1986.chinese: 这当然是令人高兴的情况。不过，这类计算通常不会带来如此令人愉快的消息。多数管理者大概都会承认，从较长期来看，企业为了维持现有单位销量和竞争地位，需要投入的金额会超过（b）。当这种情况存在，即（c）大于（b）时，GAAP利润就高估了所有者收益，而且高估幅度往往相当可观。近年来，石油行业提供了一个明显的例子。如果大多数大型石油公司每年仅投入相当于（b）的资金，那么它们实际上已经注定会在实际规模上萎缩。

1986.english: All of this points up the absurdity of the "cash flow" numbers that are often set forth in Wall Street reports. These numbers routinely include (a) plus (b) - but do not subtract ( c) . Most sales brochures of investment bankers also feature deceptive presentations of this kind. These imply that the business being offered is the commercial counterpart of the Pyramids - forever state-of-the-art, never needing to be replaced, improved or refurbished. Indeed, if all U.S. corporations were to be offered simultaneously for sale through our leading investment bankers - and if the sales brochures describing them were to be believed - governmental projections of national plant and equipment spending would have to be slashed by 90%.
1986.chinese: 这一切表明，华尔街报告中经常列示的“现金流”数字有多么荒谬。这类数字通常包括（a）加（b），却不扣除（c）。投资银行的多数销售材料也喜欢使用这种容易误导人的列示方法。它们暗示被出售的企业就像商业世界里的金字塔，永远处于最先进状态，永远不需要更换、改进或翻修。事实上，如果美国所有公司同时通过主要投资银行出售，而投资银行宣传册中的数字又都可信，那么政府对全国厂房设备投资的预测就得减少90%。

1986.english: "Cash Flow", true, may serve as a shorthand of some utility in descriptions of certain real estate businesses or other enterprises that make huge initial outlays and only tiny outlays thereafter. A company whose only holding is a bridge or an extremely long-lived gas field would be an example. But "cash flow" is meaningless in such businesses as manufacturing, retailing, extractive companies, and utilities because, for them, ( c) is always significant. To be sure, businesses of this kind may in a given year be able to defer capital spending. But over a five- or ten-year period, they must make the investment - or the business decays.
1986.chinese: 诚然，在某些房地产企业或其他需要巨额初始投资、之后只需要少量后续投资的业务中，“现金流”可以作为一种有用的简写方式。例如，一家仅拥有一座桥梁或一处使用寿命极长的天然气田的公司。但对于制造业、零售业、资源开采企业及公用事业来说，仅仅使用这种“现金流”数字并无意义，因为这些企业的（c）始终很重要。的确，这类企业可以在某一年推迟资本支出，但在五年或十年的时间里，它们必须作出必要投资，否则业务就会衰退。

1986.english: Why, then, are "cash flow" numbers so popular today? In answer, we confess our cynicism: we believe these numbers are frequently used by marketers of businesses and securities in attempts to justify the unjustifiable (and thereby to sell what should be the unsalable). When (a) - that is, GAAP earnings - looks by itself inadequate to service debt of a junk bond or justify a foolish stock price, how convenient it becomes for salesmen to focus on (a) + (b). But you shouldn't add (b) without subtracting ( c) : though dentists correctly claim that if you ignore your teeth they'll go away, the same is not true for ( c) . The company or investor believing that the debt-servicing ability or the equity valuation of an enterprise can be measured by totaling (a) and (b) while ignoring ( c) is headed for certain trouble.
1986.chinese: 既然如此，为什么今天“现金流”数字如此流行？对此，我们承认自己有些愤世嫉俗：我们认为，出售企业和证券的人经常利用这些数字，企图为无法辩护的事情辩护（从而卖出本来不该卖得出去的东西）。当（a）——即GAAP利润——本身不足以偿付垃圾债券的债务，或不足以支持愚蠢的股票价格时，销售人员把重点转向（a）加（b），实在太方便了。但不能只加回（b），却不扣除（c）。牙医说得没错：如果你不理会自己的牙齿，牙齿终究会离你而去；（c）却不会因为你不理会它就消失。凡是认为把（a）与（b）相加、忽略（c），就可以衡量企业偿债能力或股权价值的公司或投资者，注定会遇到麻烦。

1986.english:
---

To sum up: in the case of both Scott Fetzer and our other businesses, we feel that (b) on an historical-cost basis - i.e., with both amortization of intangibles and other purchase-price adjustments excluded - is quite close in amount to ( c) . (The two items are not identical, of course. For example, at See's we annually make capitalized expenditures that exceed depreciation by $500,000 to $1 million, simply to hold our ground competitively.) Our conviction about this point is the reason we show our amortization and other purchase-price adjustment items separately in the table on page 8 and is also our reason for viewing the earnings of the individual businesses as reported there as much more closely approximating owner earnings than the GAAP figures.
1986.chinese:
* * *

总而言之，就斯科特与费策以及我们的其他企业来说，我们认为按照历史成本计算的（b）——也就是排除无形资产摊销及其他购买价格调整后的金额——与（c）非常接近。（当然，两者并不完全相同。例如，喜诗糖果每年的资本化支出，比折旧高出50万至100万美元，仅仅是为了维持竞争地位。）正因为我们持有这一判断，才会在第8页的表格中把摊销及其他购买价格调整费用单独列示；也正因为如此，我们认为表中各经营企业列示的利润，比GAAP数字更接近所有者收益。

1986.english:
Questioning GAAP figures may seem impious to some. After all, what are we paying the accountants for if it is not to deliver us the "truth" about our business. But the accountants' job is to record, not to evaluate. The evaluation job falls to investors and managers.

Accounting numbers, of course, are the language of business and as such are of enormous help to anyone evaluating the worth of a business and tracking its progress. Charlie and I would be lost without these numbers: they invariably are the starting point for us in evaluating our own businesses and those of others. Managers and owners need to remember, however, that accounting is but an aid to business thinking, never a substitute for it.
1986.chinese:
对GAAP数字提出质疑，在某些人看来或许有些大不敬。毕竟，如果会计师不负责向我们揭示企业的“真相”，我们付钱给他们是为了什么？但会计师的职责是**记录**，不是**评价**。评价的工作属于投资者和管理者。

会计数字当然是商业语言，因此对任何评价企业价值、追踪企业进展的人都有巨大帮助。没有这些数字，查理和我根本无从下手：无论评价我们自己的企业还是其他企业，我们总是从会计数字开始。但管理者和所有者必须记住，会计只是商业思考的辅助工具，永远不能代替商业思考。

1987.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Our gain in net worth during 1987 was $464 million, or 19.5%.  Over the last 23 years (that is, since present management took over), our per-share book value has grown from $19.46 to $2,477.47, or at a rate of 23.1% compounded annually.

What counts, of course, is the rate of gain in per-share business value, not book value.  In many cases, a corporation's book value and business value are almost totally unrelated.  For example, just before they went bankrupt, LTV and Baldwin-United published yearend audits showing their book values to be $652 million and $397 million, respectively.  Conversely, Belridge Oil was sold to Shell in 1979 for $3.6 billion although its book value was only $177 million.
1987.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1987年，我们的净资产增加了4.64亿美元，增幅为19.5%。过去23年，也就是现任管理层接手以来，每股账面价值从19.46美元增长到2,477.47美元，年复合增长率为23.1%。

当然，真正重要的是每股企业价值的增长率，而不是账面价值的增长率。很多情况下，公司的账面价值和企业价值几乎毫无关系。例如，LTV和Baldwin-United在破产前不久公布的年末审计报告，分别显示账面价值为6.52亿美元和3.97亿美元。与之相反，1979年贝尔里奇石油公司（Belridge Oil）被出售给壳牌公司时，成交价为36亿美元，而账面价值只有1.77亿美元。

1987.english:
At Berkshire, however, the two valuations have tracked rather closely, with the growth rate in business value over the last decade moderately outpacing the growth rate in book value. This good news continued in 1987.

Our premium of business value to book value has widened for two simple reasons: We own some remarkable businesses and they are run by even more remarkable managers.

You have a right to question that second assertion.  After all, CEOs seldom tell their shareholders that they have assembled a bunch of turkeys to run things.  Their reluctance to do so makes for some strange annual reports.  Oftentimes, in his shareholders' letter, a CEO will go on for pages detailing corporate performance that is woefully inadequate.  He will nonetheless end with a warm paragraph describing his managerial comrades as "our most precious asset." Such comments sometimes make you wonder what the other assets can possibly be.
1987.chinese:
不过，在伯克希尔，这两种估值一直比较接近。过去十年，企业价值增长率略高于账面价值增长率。1987年，这一好消息仍在延续。

企业价值相对账面价值的溢价进一步扩大，原因有两个，很简单：我们拥有一些非凡的企业，而经营它们的管理者更加非凡。

各位有理由质疑我的第二个说法。毕竟，首席执行官很少会告诉股东，自己找来了一群蠢材管理企业。这种不情愿，催生出不少奇怪的年报。有时，首席执行官在致股东信中花上许多页描述惨不忍睹的公司业绩，最后却用一段温情的话，将身边的管理同僚称作“我们最宝贵的资产”。这种话有时不免让人好奇：那公司的其他资产究竟得有多糟？

1987.english:
At Berkshire, however, my appraisal of our operating managers is, if anything, understated.  To understand why, first take a look at page 7, where we show the earnings (on an historical-cost accounting basis) of our seven largest non- financial units:  Buffalo News, Fechheimer, Kirby, Nebraska Furniture Mart, Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Group, See's Candies, and World Book.  In 1987, these seven business units had combined operating earnings before interest and taxes of $180 million.

By itself, this figure says nothing about economic performance.  To evaluate that, we must know how much total capital - debt and equity - was needed to produce these earnings. Debt plays an insignificant role at our seven units: Their net interest expense in 1987 was only $2 million.  Thus, pre-tax earnings on the equity capital employed by these businesses amounted to $178 million.  And this equity - again on an historical-cost basis - was only $175 million.
1987.chinese:
但在伯克希尔，我对经营管理者的评价如果有什么偏差，那也是说得不够好。要理解原因，请先看年报第7页，那里列出了我们七家最大的非金融业务单位按历史成本会计基础计算的利润：布法罗新闻报、费希海默、柯比、内布拉斯加家具卖场、斯科特与费策制造集团、喜诗糖果和世界图书百科全书。1987年，这七家业务单位合计实现息税前经营利润1.80亿美元。

单看这个数字，还无法说明经济业绩。要作出判断，我们必须知道，为创造这些利润，总共需要使用多少资本——包括债务和股权资本。这七家企业的债务作用微乎其微，1987年净利息支出只有200万美元。因此，这些业务所使用股权资本对应的税前利润为1.78亿美元。而按历史成本计算，股权资本仅为1.75亿美元。

1987.english: If these seven business units had operated as a single company, their 1987 after-tax earnings would have been approximately $100 million - a return of about 57% on equity capital.  You'll seldom see such a percentage anywhere, let alone at large, diversified companies with nominal leverage.  Here's a benchmark: In its 1988 Investor's Guide issue, Fortune reported that among the 500 largest industrial companies and 500 largest service companies, only six had averaged a return on equity of over 30% during the previous decade.  The best performer among the 1000 was Commerce Clearing House at 40.2%.
1987.chinese: 假如这七家业务单位作为一家独立公司经营，1987年的税后利润大约为1亿美元，相当于股权资本回报率约57%。如此之高的比例很少见，更不用说是在杠杆水平极低的大型多元化企业中。这里有一个参照：在1988年的《投资者指南》专刊中，《财富》杂志报告称，在最大的500家工业企业和500家服务企业中，只有六家在此前十年实现了平均超过30%的股东权益回报率；其中表现最好的是Commerce Clearing House，为40.2%。

1987.english: Of course, the returns that Berkshire earns from these seven units are not as high as their underlying returns because, in aggregate, we bought the businesses at a substantial premium to underlying equity capital.  Overall, these operations are carried on our books at about $222 million above the historical accounting values of the underlying assets.  However, the managers of the units should be judged by the returns they achieve on the underlying assets; what we pay for a business does not affect the amount of capital its manager has to work with. (If, to become a shareholder and part owner of Commerce Clearing House, you pay, say, six times book value, that does not change CCH's return on equity.)
1987.chinese: 当然，伯克希尔从这七家业务取得的回报率，没有它们底层经营回报率那么高，因为总体上，我们买下这些企业时支付的价格，显著高于它们的基础股权资本。合计来看，这些业务在我们账上的入账价值，比其底层资产的历史会计价值高约2.22亿美元。不过，评价经营管理者，应当依据他们在实际经营资产上取得的回报；我们为购买企业支付了多少，并不改变管理者可以运用的资本数量。（假设你为了成为Commerce Clearing House的股东和部分所有者，以六倍账面价值买入股票，这并不会改变该公司的股东权益回报率。）

1987.english: Three important inferences can be drawn from the figures I have cited.  First, the current business value of these seven units is far above their historical book value and also far above the value at which they are carried on Berkshire's balance sheet. Second, because so little capital is required to run these businesses, they can grow while concurrently making almost all of their earnings available for deployment in new opportunities. Third, these businesses are run by truly extraordinary managers. The Blumkins, the Heldmans, Chuck Huggins, Stan Lipsey, and Ralph Schey all meld unusual talent, energy and character to achieve exceptional financial results.
1987.chinese: 从上述数字中，可以得出三个重要结论。第一，这七家业务目前的企业价值，远远高于其历史账面价值，也远远高于伯克希尔资产负债表对它们记录的价值。第二，由于经营这些业务只需要很少的资本，它们能够一边增长，一边几乎将全部利润用于其他新机会。第三，经营这些企业的人才确实卓越。布卢姆金家族、赫尔德曼家族、查克·哈金斯、斯坦·利普西和拉尔夫·谢伊，融合了非凡的才能、精力和品格，创造出卓越的财务业绩。

1987.english:
For good reasons, we had very high expectations when we joined with these managers.  In every case, however, our experience has greatly exceeded those expectations.  We have received far more than we deserve, but we are willing to accept such inequities. (We subscribe to the view Jack Benny expressed upon receiving an acting award: "I don't deserve this, but then, I have arthritis and I don't deserve that either.")

Beyond the Sainted Seven, we have our other major unit, insurance, which I believe also has a business value well above the net assets employed in it.  However, appraising the business value of a property-casualty insurance company is a decidedly imprecise process.  The industry is volatile, reported earnings oftentimes are seriously inaccurate, and recent changes in the Tax Code will severely hurt future profitability.  Despite these problems, we like the business and it will almost certainly remain our largest operation.  Under Mike Goldberg's management, the insurance business should treat us well over time.
1987.chinese:
有充分的理由让我们在与这些管理者合作时抱有很高期望。但在每一个案例中，实际经历都大大超出了预期。我们得到的远远超过应得的，不过我们乐意接受这样的不公平。（我们赞同杰克·本尼获颁表演奖时的说法：“我不配得这个奖，但我还患有关节炎，我也不该得那个呀。”）

除了这“神圣七杰”，我们还有另一项主要业务——保险。我认为，它的企业价值也远高于所运用的净资产。不过，对财产及意外伤害保险公司的企业价值进行估计，注定是一项非常不精确的工作。行业波动很大，报告利润往往存在严重误差，而最近的税法变化又将严重损害未来盈利能力。尽管存在这些问题，我们仍然喜欢这门生意；它几乎肯定会继续是我们规模最大的业务。在迈克·戈德伯格的管理下，保险业务长期应当能为我们带来良好结果。

1987.english: With managers like ours, my partner, Charlie Munger, and I have little to do with operations. in fact, it is probably fair to say that if we did more, less would be accomplished.  We have no corporate meetings, no corporate budgets, and no performance reviews (though our managers, of course, oftentimes find such procedures useful at their operating units).  After all, what can we tell the Blumkins about home furnishings, or the Heldmans about uniforms?
1987.chinese: 有了这样的管理者，我的合伙人查理·芒格和我几乎不需要插手经营。实际上，恐怕可以公允地说，我们做得越多，完成的事情反而越少。我们不开集团会议，不制定集团预算，也不进行集团层面的绩效考核（当然，我们的管理者经常发现这些程序在各自业务单位很有用）。毕竟，我们能告诉布卢姆金家族多少家具经营的道理，又能告诉赫尔德曼家族多少制服经营的道理呢？

1987.english: Our major contribution to the operations of our subsidiaries is applause.  But it is not the indiscriminate applause of a Pollyanna.  Rather it is informed applause based upon the two long careers we have spent intensively observing business performance and managerial behavior.  Charlie and I have seen so much of the ordinary in business that we can truly appreciate a virtuoso performance.  Only one response to the 1987 performance of our operating managers is appropriate: sustained, deafening applause.
1987.chinese: 我们对各子公司经营的主要贡献就是鼓掌。但这不是一个盲目乐观者不分青红皂白的掌声，而是建立在我们长期、密切观察企业经营业绩与管理者行为的两段职业经历之上的知情喝彩。查理和我见过太多平庸的商业表现，因此真正懂得欣赏大师级的演出。面对1987年经营管理者的成绩，只有一种回应恰如其分：持续而震耳欲聋的掌声。

1987.english:
## Sources of Reported Earnings

The table on the following page shows the major sources of Berkshire's reported earnings.  In the table, amortization of Goodwill and other major purchase-price accounting adjustments are not charged against the specific businesses to which they apply but, instead, are aggregated and shown separately.  In effect, this procedure presents the earnings of our businesses as they would have been reported had we not purchased them.  In appendixes to my letters in the 1983 and 1986 annual reports, I explained why this form of presentation seems to us to be more useful to investors and managers than the standard GAAP presentation, which makes purchase-price adjustments on a business-by business basis.  The total net earnings we show in the table are, of course, identical to the GAAP figures in our audited financial statements.
1987.chinese:
## 财报利润的来源

下一页表格列出了伯克希尔报告利润的主要来源。表格没有将商誉摊销及其他重大收购价款会计调整分摊到具体业务，而是集中单独列示。实际上，这种处理方式展示的是：如果我们当初没有购买这些企业，它们本会报告怎样的利润。我在1983年和1986年年报致股东信的附录中解释过，为什么我们认为这种列示方式，比按照公认会计原则（GAAP）逐项对各业务进行收购价款调整，对投资者和管理者更有用。当然，表中的净利润总额，与经审计财务报表中的GAAP数据完全一致。

1987.english:
In the Business Segment Data on pages 36-38 and in the Management's Discussion section on pages 40-44 you will find much additional information about our businesses.  In these sections you will also find our segment earnings reported on a GAAP basis. I urge you to read that material, as well as Charlie Munger's letter to Wesco shareholders, describing the various businesses of that subsidiary, which starts on page 45.

Gypsy Rose Lee announced on one of her later birthdays: "I have everything I had last year; it's just that it's all two inches lower." As the table shows, during 1987 almost all of our businesses aged in a more upbeat way.

There's not a lot new to report about these businesses - and that's good, not bad.  Severe change and exceptional returns usually don't mix.  Most investors, of course, behave as if just the opposite were true.  That is, they usually confer the highest price-earnings ratios on exotic-sounding businesses that hold out the promise of feverish change.  That prospect lets investors fantasize about future profitability rather than face today's business realities.  For such investor-dreamers, any blind date is preferable to one with the girl next door, no matter how desirable she may be.
1987.chinese:
吉卜赛·罗丝·李在一次晚年生日时说：“去年我拥有的一切，今年一样不缺，只不过全都往下垂了两英寸。”从这张表可以看到，我们几乎所有业务在1987年的“变老”方式都乐观得多。

关于这些业务，实在没有太多新情况可报告——这是好事，不是坏事。剧烈变化与超额回报通常很难共存。当然，大多数投资者的行为仿佛恰好相反：他们通常愿意给那些名字听起来新奇、承诺快速变化的企业最高的市盈率。这种前景让投资者可以幻想未来的利润，而不必面对今天的商业现实。对这类爱做梦的投资者来说，再有吸引力的邻家姑娘，也不如一场不知对方是谁的相亲。

1987.english: Experience, however, indicates that the best business returns are usually achieved by companies that are doing something quite similar today to what they were doing five or ten years ago.  That is no argument for managerial complacency. Businesses always have opportunities to improve service, product lines, manufacturing techniques, and the like, and obviously these opportunities should be seized.  But a business that constantly encounters major change also encounters many chances for major error.  Furthermore, economic terrain that is forever shifting violently is ground on which it is difficult to build a fortress-like business franchise.  Such a franchise is usually the key to sustained high returns.
1987.chinese: 然而，经验表明，最好的企业回报通常来自那些今天所做的事情，与五年或十年前颇为相似的公司。这并不是主张管理层安于现状。企业总有机会改善服务、产品系列、制造工艺等，显然应该抓住这些机会。但经常遭遇重大变化的企业，也经常面临犯下重大错误的机会。此外，在不断剧烈变动的经济地形上，很难建立堡垒般的商业特许经营优势。而这种优势通常是持续高回报的关键。

1987.english:
The Fortune study I mentioned earlier supports our view. Only 25 of the 1,000 companies met two tests of economic excellence - an average return on equity of over 20% in the ten years, 1977 through 1986, and no year worse than 15%.  These business superstars were also stock market superstars: During the decade, 24 of the 25 outperformed the S&P 500.

The Fortune champs may surprise you in two respects.  First, most use very little leverage compared to their interest-paying capacity.  Really good businesses usually don't need to borrow. Second, except for one company that is "high-tech" and several others that manufacture ethical drugs, the companies are in businesses that, on balance, seem rather mundane.  Most sell non- sexy products or services in much the same manner as they did ten years ago (though in larger quantities now, or at higher prices, or both).  The record of these 25 companies confirms that making the most of an already strong business franchise, or concentrating on a single winning business theme, is what usually produces exceptional economics.
1987.chinese:
此前提到的《财富》研究支持了我们的观点。在1,000家企业中，只有25家同时满足两个卓越经营条件：1977年至1986年十年间平均股东权益回报率超过20%，且没有任何一年的回报率低于15%。这些商业明星也同样是股市明星：十年间，25家中有24家跑赢了标普500指数。

这些《财富》榜上的优胜者，可能在两个方面出乎意料。首先，相对于其支付利息的能力，它们大多使用很少的杠杆。真正优秀的企业通常不需要借债。其次，除了其中一家“高科技”公司和另外几家生产处方药的公司，其余公司的业务总体看起来相当平凡。它们多数出售毫不性感的产品或服务，方式和十年前基本相同（只是销量更大、价格更高，或者两者兼有）。这25家公司的记录证实，充分发挥既有强大商业特许经营优势，或者专注于一个成功的业务主题，通常能够创造卓越的经济成果。

1987.english:
Berkshire's experience has been similar.  Our managers have produced extraordinary results by doing rather ordinary things - but doing them exceptionally well.  Our managers protect their franchises, they control costs, they search for new products and markets that build on their existing strengths and they don't get diverted.  They work exceptionally hard at the details of their businesses, and it shows.

Here's an update:

o Agatha Christie, whose husband was an archaeologist, said that was the perfect profession for one's spouse: "The older you become, the more interested they are in you." It is students of business management, not archaeologists, who should be interested in Mrs. B (Rose Blumkin), the 94-year-old chairman of Nebraska Furniture Mart.
1987.chinese:
伯克希尔的经历与此相似。我们的管理者通过做非常普通的事情——但把它们做得格外出色——取得了非凡业绩。他们保护自己的竞争优势，控制成本，寻找能够建立在既有优势之上的新产品和新市场，并且不分心。他们异常勤奋地关注各自业务的细节，效果显而易见。

下面介绍一些最新情况。

**内布拉斯加家具卖场。** 阿加莎·克里斯蒂的丈夫是一位考古学家，她说这就是完美的配偶职业：“你年纪越大，他对你越感兴趣。”真正应该对B夫人——94岁的内布拉斯加家具卖场董事长罗丝·布卢姆金——感兴趣的，不是考古学家，而是研究企业管理的人。

1987.english: Fifty years ago Mrs. B started the business with $500, and today NFM is far and away the largest home furnishings store in the country.  Mrs. B continues to work seven days a week at the job from the opening of each business day until the close.  She buys, she sells, she manages - and she runs rings around the competition.  It's clear to me that she's gathering speed and may well reach her full potential in another five or ten years. Therefore, I've persuaded the Board to scrap our mandatory retirement-at-100 policy. (And it's about time:  With every passing year, this policy has seemed sillier to me.)
1987.chinese: 50年前，B夫人用500美元创办了这家企业。如今，内布拉斯加家具卖场是美国规模遥遥领先的家居用品单店。B夫人仍然每周工作七天，每天从开门忙到关门。她采购、销售、管理，把竞争对手远远甩在身后。我看得很清楚，她还在加速，再过五年或十年，大概就能发挥全部潜力。因此，我已经说服董事会废除我们“满100岁必须退休”的规定。（早该这样了：这些年过去，我越来越觉得这项规定荒唐。）

1987.english: Net sales of NFM were $142.6 million in 1987, up 8% from 1986.  There's nothing like this store in the country, and there's nothing like the family Mrs. B has produced to carry on: Her son Louie, and his three boys, Ron, Irv and Steve, possess the business instincts, integrity and drive of Mrs. B. They work as a team and, strong as each is individually, the whole is far greater than the sum of the parts.
1987.chinese: 1987年，家具城净销售额为1.426亿美元，比1986年增长8%。全国找不到另一家这样的商店，也找不到另一个这样的家族来继承事业。B夫人的儿子卢伊和他的三个儿子罗恩、欧文、史蒂夫，拥有她的商业直觉、正直品格和干劲。他们协同工作；虽然每个人单独都很强，整个团队的力量却远大于部分之和。

1987.english:
The superb job done by the Blumkins benefits us as owners, but even more dramatically benefits NFM's customers.  They saved about $30 million in 1987 by buying from NFM.  In other words, the goods they bought would have cost that much more if purchased elsewhere.

You'll enjoy an anonymous letter I received last August: "Sorry to see Berkshire profits fall in the second quarter.  One way you may gain back part of your lost. (sic) Check the pricing at The Furniture Mart.  You will find that they are leaving 10% to 20% on the table.  This additional profit on $140 million of sells (sic) is $28 million.  Not small change in anyone's pocket! Check out other furniture, carpet, appliance and T.V. dealers. Your raising prices to a reasonable profit will help.  Thank you. /signed/ A Competitor."
1987.chinese:
布卢姆金家族的出色工作让我们这些所有者受益，但让家具城顾客受益更多。1987年，顾客从家具城购买商品，节省了大约3,000万美元。换句话说，如果到别处购买同样的东西，他们需要多花这么多钱。

你们一定会喜欢去年8月我收到的一封匿名信：“很遗憾看到伯克希尔第二季度利润下降。你可能有办法把损失赚回一部分。去检查一下家具城的定价。你会发现，他们把10%到20%的利润白白留在桌上。按1.4亿美元的销售额计算，多出来的利润就是2,800万美元。对任何人来说都不是小钱！看看其他家具、地毯、电器和电视经销商的价格吧。把价格提高到合理利润水平，会对你有帮助。谢谢。——一位竞争对手。”

〔译注：英文原件在这封来信的lost和sells之后，各保留一个sic（原文如此）标记，提示来信用词有误。〕

1987.english:
NFM will continue to grow and prosper by following Mrs. B's maxim:  "Sell cheap and tell the truth."

o Among dominant papers of its size or larger, the Buffalo News continues to be the national leader in two important ways: (1) its weekday and Sunday penetration rate (the percentage of households in the paper's primary market area that purchase it); and (2) its "news-hole" percentage (the portion of the paper devoted to news).

It may not be coincidence that one newspaper leads in both categories: an exceptionally "newsrich" product makes for broad audience appeal, which in turn leads to high penetration.  Of course, quantity must be matched by quality.  This not only means good reporting and good writing; it means freshness and relevance.  To be indispensable, a paper must promptly tell its readers many things they want to know but won't otherwise learn until much later, if ever.
1987.chinese:
家具城将继续遵循B夫人的格言发展壮大：“卖得便宜，说实话。”

**布法罗新闻报。** 在规模相当或更大的主导性报纸中，布法罗新闻报继续在两个重要方面位居全美第一：（1）工作日版和周日版的家庭渗透率，即主要市场区域内购买报纸的家庭比例；（2）“新闻版面比例”，即报纸总版面中用于新闻报道的部分。

同一家报纸在这两方面都领先，也许不是巧合：信息丰富的报纸对读者具有广泛吸引力，进而产生高渗透率。当然，数量必须与质量相匹配。这不仅意味着优秀的采访和写作，还意味着及时与相关。报纸要成为生活中不可或缺的东西，就必须迅速告诉读者许多他们想知道、但不通过报纸就要晚得多才能知道甚至永远不知道的事情。

1987.english:
At the News, we put out seven fresh editions every 24 hours, each one extensively changed in content.  Here's a small example that may surprise you: We redo the obituary page in every edition of the News, or seven times a day.  Any obituary added runs through the next six editions until the publishing cycle has been completed.

It's vital, of course, for a newspaper to cover national and international news well and in depth.  But it is also vital for it to do what only a local newspaper can: promptly and extensively chronicle the personally-important, otherwise- unreported details of community life.  Doing this job well requires a very broad range of news - and that means lots of space, intelligently used.
1987.chinese:
在《新闻报》，每24小时我们出版七个不同的新版次，每一版内容都会有大量更新。举个可能让你吃惊的小例子：讣告版每版都重新编排，也就是每天七次。任何新增加的讣告都会继续出现在接下来的六个版次，直到这一轮出版周期完成。

当然，报纸必须全面深入地报道国内外新闻。但同样重要的是，它必须做好只有地方报纸才能做的事：迅速、广泛地记录社区生活中对居民有个人意义、又没有其他渠道报道的细节。做好这项工作需要丰富的新闻内容，也就意味着需要大量且有效利用的版面。

1987.english:
Our news hole was about 50% in 1987, just as it has been year after year.  If we were to cut it to a more typical 40%, we would save approximately $4 million annually in newsprint costs. That interests us not at all - and it won't interest us even if, for one reason or another, our profit margins should significantly shrink.

Charlie and I do not believe in flexible operating budgets, as in "Non-direct expenses can be X if revenues are Y, but must be reduced if revenues are Y - 5%." Should we really cut our news hole at the Buffalo News, or the quality of product and service at See's, simply because profits are down during a given year or quarter?  Or, conversely, should we add a staff economist, a corporate strategist, an institutional advertising campaign or something else that does Berkshire no good simply because the money currently is rolling in?
1987.chinese:
1987年，我们用于新闻的版面约占50%，与多年来一样。如果将其降到较常见的40%，每年可以节省约400万美元新闻纸成本。我们对此毫无兴趣——即使未来由于某种原因利润率显著下降，我们也不会有兴趣。

查理和我不相信那种随着收入上下浮动的经营预算，例如：“收入为Y时，非直接费用可为X；若收入下降5%，费用必须跟着降低。”难道某个季度或年份利润下降，我们就应该缩减《布法罗新闻报》的新闻版面，或者降低喜诗糖果的产品和服务质量吗？反过来，难道因为当前利润滚滚而来，就应该增加一个经济学家、一个公司战略专家、一场机构广告宣传，或者其他对伯克希尔毫无帮助的东西吗？

1987.english: That makes no sense to us.  We neither understand the adding of unneeded people or activities because profits are booming, nor the cutting of essential people or activities because profitability is shrinking.  That kind of yo-yo approach is neither business-like nor humane.  Our goal is to do what makes sense for Berkshire's customers and employees at all times, and never to add the unneeded. ("But what about the corporate jet?" you rudely ask.  Well, occasionally a man must rise above principle.)
1987.chinese: 我们认为这毫无道理。我们不理解为什么利润大增时就要增加不需要的人和活动，也不理解为什么利润减少时就要削减必需的人和活动。这种忽上忽下的做法既不符合商业理性，也不符合人情。我们的目标，是始终做对伯克希尔的客户和员工有意义的事，永远不增加没有必要的东西。（“那公务机呢？”你无礼地问。唉，一个人偶尔总得超越自己的原则。）

1987.english:
Although the News' revenues have grown only moderately since 1984, superb management by Stan Lipsey, its publisher, has produced excellent profit growth.  For several years, I have incorrectly predicted that profit margins at the News would fall. This year I will not let vou down: Margins will, without question, shrink in 1988 and profit may fall as well. Skyrocketing newsprint costs will be the major cause.

o Fechheimer Bros. Company is another of our family businesses - and, like the Blumkins, what a family.  Three generations of Heldmans have for decades consistently, built the sales and profits of this manufacturer and distributor of uniforms.  In the year that Berkshire acquired its controlling interest in Fechheimer - 1986 - profits were a record.  The Heldmans didn't slow down after that.  Last year earnings increased substantially and the outlook is good for 1988.
1987.chinese:
尽管自1984年以来《新闻报》的收入增长温和，在发行人斯坦·利普西的卓越管理下，利润却增长出色。过去几年，我一直错误地预测《新闻报》的利润率会下降。今年我绝不会让大家失望：1988年的利润率毫无疑问会下降，利润也可能减少。新闻纸成本暴涨是主要原因。

**费希海默兄弟公司。** 这是我们的另一家家族企业；和布卢姆金家族一样，多么出色的一家人！赫尔德曼家族三代人数十年来持续增加这家制服制造和经销公司的销售额与利润。1986年伯克希尔取得控制权时，公司利润创下纪录。此后赫尔德曼家族并未放慢脚步，去年利润进一步大幅增长，1988年前景良好。

1987.english:
There's nothing magic about the Uniform business; the only magic is in the Heldmans.  Bob, George, Gary, Roger and Fred know the business inside and out, and they have fun running it.  We are fortunate to be in partnership with them.

o Chuck Huggins continues to set new records at See's, just as he has ever since we put him in charge on the day of our purchase some 16 years ago.  In 1987, volume hit a new high at slightly Under 25 million pounds.  For the second year in a row, moreover, same-store sales, measured in pounds, were virtually unchanged. In case you are wondering, that represents improvement: In each of the previous six years, same-store sales had fallen.
1987.chinese:
制服生意没什么神奇的地方，唯一神奇的是赫尔德曼家族。鲍勃、乔治、加里、罗杰和弗雷德对业务了如指掌，而且乐在其中。能够与他们合作，是我们的幸运。

**喜诗糖果。** 自从约16年前我们买下公司并让查克·哈金斯负责经营以来，他不断创造新纪录。1987年，糖果销售量创下新高，略低于2,500万磅。而且，连续第二年，以重量衡量的同店销量几乎没有变化。如果你觉得奇怪，请记住，这其实是一种改善：此前六年，同店销量年年下降。

1987.english:
Although we had a particularly strong 1986 Christmas season, we racked up better store-for-store comparisons in the 1987 Christmas season than at any other time of the year.  Thus, the seasonal factor at See's becomes even more extreme.  In 1987, about 85% of our profit was earned during December.

Candy stores are fun to visit, but most have not been fun for their owners.  From what we can learn, practically no one besides See's has made significant profits in recent years from the operation of candy shops.  Clearly, Chuck's record at See's is not due to a rising industry tide.  Rather, it is a one-of-a- kind performance.
1987.chinese:
尽管1986年的圣诞销售季特别强劲，1987年圣诞季的同店比较表现仍好于一年中的任何其他时期。因此，喜诗的季节性更为突出：1987年约85%的利润是在12月赚取的。

糖果店逛起来令人愉快，但对多数店主来说，经营它们并不愉快。据我们所知，近几年除了喜诗，几乎没有其他糖果店赚到可观利润。显然，查克在喜诗的成绩并非来自行业整体向上的潮流，而是一种独一无二的表现。

1987.english:
His achievement requires an excellent product - which we have - but it also requires genuine affection for the customer. Chuck is 100% customer-oriented, and his attitude sets the tone for the rest of the See's organization.

```text
     Here's an example of Chuck in action: At See's we regularly
add new pieces of candy to our mix and also cull a few to keep
our product line at about 100 varieties.  Last spring we selected
14 items for elimination.  Two, it turned out, were badly missed
by our customers, who wasted no time in letting us know what they
thought of our judgment: "A pox on all in See's who participated
in the abominable decision...;" "May your new truffles melt in
transit, may they sour in people's mouths, may your costs go up
and your profits go down...;" "We are investigating the
possibility of obtaining a mandatory injunction requiring you to
supply...;" You get the picture.  In all, we received many hundreds of
letters.
```
1987.chinese:
他的成就离不开我们确实拥有的优质产品，但也离不开对顾客真诚的关爱。查克百分之百以顾客为中心，他的态度为整个喜诗组织定下了基调。

举个查克的实际例子：喜诗经常增加新口味，也淘汰一些旧品种，以便将产品数量维持在约100种。去年春天，我们决定淘汰14种糖果。结果其中两种让顾客非常想念，顾客毫不迟疑地来信告诉我们，对这项判断有多么不满：“愿所有参与这一可恶决定的喜诗员工都遭殃……”“愿你们的新松露巧克力在运输途中融化、在顾客口中变酸，愿你们成本上升、利润下降……”“我们正在研究申请强制性禁令，要求你们继续供应……”大概可以想象来信的内容。我们总共收到了几百封这样的信。

1987.english:
```text
Chuck not only reintroduced the pieces, he turned this
miscue into an opportunity.  Each person who had written got a
complete and honest explanation in return.  Said Chuck's letter:
"Fortunately, when I make poor decisions, good things often
happen as a result...;" And with the letter went a special gift
certificate.
```

See's increased prices only slightly in the last two years. In 1988 we have raised prices somewhat more, though still moderately.  To date, sales have been weak and it may be difficult for See's to improve its earnings this year.
1987.chinese:
查克不仅恢复了这两种糖果，还把这次失误转变为一个机会。每一位来信者都收到了完整坦诚的回复。查克在信中写道：“幸运的是，当我作出糟糕决定时，往往也会因此发生一些好事……”随信还附上一张特别赠送的礼券。

过去两年，喜诗的提价幅度都很小。1988年，我们提高价格的幅度稍大一些，但仍然温和。迄今销售疲弱，今年喜诗的利润可能难以增长。

1987.english:
o World Book, Kirby, and the Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Group are all under the management of Ralph Schey.  And what a lucky thing for us that they are.  I told you last year that Scott Fetzer performance in 1986 had far exceeded the expectations that Charlie and I had at the time of our purchase.  Results in 1987 were even better.  Pre-tax earnings rose 10% while average capital employed declined significantly.

Ralph's mastery of the 19 businesses for which he is responsible is truly amazing, and he has also attracted some outstanding managers to run them.  We would love to find a few additional units that could be put under Ralph's wing.
1987.chinese:
**世界图书、柯比与斯科特与费策制造集团。** 这三项业务都由拉尔夫·谢伊管理。对我们来说，这是何等幸运。去年我告诉各位，斯科特与费策1986年的经营业绩大大超过了查理和我收购时的预期。1987年的结果更好：税前利润增长10%，而平均占用资本却显著下降。

拉尔夫掌控着19家不同企业，熟练程度令人惊叹；他还吸引了一批杰出的经理人经营这些企业。我们很希望再找到几家业务，放到他的羽翼之下。

1987.english: The businesses of Scott Fetzer are too numerous to describe in detail.  Let's just update you on one of our favorites: At the end of 1987, World Book introduced its most dramatically-revised edition since 1962.  The number of color photos was increased from 14,000 to 24,000; over 6,000 articles were revised; 840 new contributors were added.  Charlie and I recommend this product to you and your family, as we do World Book's products for younger children, Childcraft and Early World of Learning.
1987.chinese: 斯科特与费策旗下业务太多，无法一一详细介绍。这里更新我们最喜欢的业务之一：1987年末，《世界图书百科全书》推出了自1962年以来修订幅度最大的一版。彩色照片从14,000幅增加到24,000幅，修订了超过6,000篇条目，新增840名撰稿人。查理和我向各位及家人推荐这套产品，也推荐面向年幼儿童的Childcraft和Early World of Learning。

1987.english:
In 1987, World Book unit sales in the United States increased for the fifth consecutive year.  International sales and profits also grew substantially.  The outlook is good for Scott Fetzer operations in aggregate, and for World Book in particular.

## Insurance Operations

Shown below is an updated version of our usual table presenting key figures for the insurance industry:

```text
                              Statutory
          Yearly Change    Combined Ratio    Yearly Change   Inflation Rate
           in Premiums   After Policyholder   in Incurred     Measured by
           Written (%)        Dividends        Losses (%)   GNP Deflator (%)
          -------------  ------------------  -------------  ----------------
1981 .....     3.8              106.0             6.5              9.6
1982 .....     4.4              109.8             8.4              6.4
1983 .....     4.6              112.0             6.8              3.8
1984 .....     9.2              117.9            16.9              3.7
1985 .....    22.1              116.3            16.1              3.2
1986 (Rev.)   22.2              108.0            13.5              2.6
1987 (Est.)    8.7              104.7             6.8              3.0
```

## Source:  Best's Insurance Management Reports

The combined ratio represents total insurance costs (losses incurred plus expenses) compared to revenue from premiums: A ratio below 100 indicates an underwriting profit, and one above 100 indicates a loss.  When the investment income that an insurer earns from holding on to policyholders' funds ("the float") is taken into account, a combined ratio in the 107-111 range typically produces an overall break-even result, exclusive of earnings on the funds provided by shareholders.
1987.chinese:
资料来源：Best's Insurance Management Reports。

综合成本率是保险总成本（已发生赔款加费用）与保费收入之比。低于100表示承保盈利，高于100则表示承保亏损。把保险公司持有保户资金——即“浮存金”——所得的投资收益考虑进来后，综合成本率在107—111之间，通常可以使整体结果大致盈亏平衡；这里不包括股东投入资金所产生的收益。

1987.english: The math of the insurance business, encapsulated by the table, is not very complicated.  In years when the industry's annual gain in revenues (premiums) pokes along at 4% or 5%, underwriting losses are sure to mount.  That is not because auto accidents, fires, windstorms and the like are occurring more frequently, nor has it lately been the fault of general inflation.  Today, social and judicial inflation are the major culprits; the cost of entering a courtroom has simply ballooned. Part of the jump in cost arises from skyrocketing verdicts, and part from the tendency of judges and juries to expand the coverage of insurance policies beyond that contemplated by the insurer when the policies were written.  Seeing no let-up in either trend, we continue to believe that the industry's revenues must grow at about 10% annually for it to just hold its own in terms of profitability, even though general inflation may be running at a considerably lower rate.
1987.chinese: 上表所包含的保险行业算术并不复杂。当行业每年保费收入的增长慢吞吞地维持在4%或5%时，承保亏损必然扩大。这不是因为汽车事故、火灾、风暴之类发生得更频繁了，近来也并非一般物价上涨所致。当下的主要原因是社会与司法层面的成本膨胀：进入法庭的代价大幅上升。这一成本飞涨，一部分来自判赔金额急剧增加，一部分来自法官和陪审团倾向于扩大保险合同的保障范围，使之超出保险公司签发保单时的预期。由于看不到这两种趋势缓和，我们仍然认为，即使一般通胀率远低于这一数字，整个行业的收入仍须每年增长约10%，才能勉强保持现有盈利水平。

1987.english:
The strong revenue gains of 1985-87 almost guaranteed the industry an excellent underwriting performance in 1987 and, indeed, it was a banner year.  But the news soured as the quarters rolled by:  Best's estimates that year-over-year volume increases were 12.9%, 11.1%, 5.7%, and 5.6%. In 1988, the revenue gain is certain to be far below our 10% "equilibrium" figure.  Clearly, the party is over.

However, earnings will not immediately sink.  A lag factor exists in this industry: Because most policies are written for a one-year term, higher or lower insurance prices do not have their full impact on earnings until many months after they go into effect.  Thus, to resume our metaphor, when the party ends and the bar is closed, you are allowed to finish your drink.  If results are not hurt by a major natural catastrophe, we predict a small climb for the industry's combined ratio in 1988, followed by several years of larger increases.
1987.chinese:
1985—1987年的强劲收入增长，几乎保证了1987年整个保险业承保表现出色；事实上，这确实是一个丰收年。但随着季度推进，消息逐渐转坏：Best's估计，1987年四个季度保费收入同比增幅分别为12.9%、11.1%、5.7%和5.6%。1988年的收入增长肯定会远低于我们认为的10%“均衡”水平。显然，宴会已经结束了。

不过，利润不会立即下降。这个行业存在滞后效应：多数保单期限为一年，所以保险价格上涨或下降，要经过数月才能充分体现在利润中。继续用宴会作比喻：宴会结束、酒吧关门后，你仍可以把杯中的酒喝完。如果不发生重大自然灾害，我们预计1988年行业综合成本率会小幅上升，随后几年上升幅度更大。

1987.english:
The insurance industry is cursed with a set of dismal economic characteristics that make for a poor long-term outlook: hundreds of competitors, ease of entry, and a product that cannot be differentiated in any meaningful way.  In such a commodity- like business, only a very low-cost operator or someone operating in a protected, and usually small, niche can sustain high profitability levels.

When shortages exist, however, even commodity businesses flourish.  The insurance industry enjoyed that kind of climate for a while but it is now gone.  One of the ironies of capitalism is that most managers in commodity industries abhor shortage conditions - even though those are the only circumstances permitting them good returns.  Whenever shortages appear, the typical manager simply can't wait to expand capacity and thereby plug the hole through which money is showering upon him.  This is precisely what insurance managers did in 1985-87, confirming again Disraeli's observation: "What we learn from history is that we do not learn from history."
1987.chinese:
保险业受到一组糟糕的经济特性困扰，长期前景不佳：竞争者数以百计，进入门槛低，产品也无法作出有意义的差异化。在这种近似大宗商品的业务中，只有成本极低的经营者，或处于受保护、通常规模不大的利基市场中的企业，才能持续维持较高盈利水平。

不过，一旦出现供给短缺，即使是大宗商品式的企业也会兴旺。保险业曾短暂享受这种环境，现在已经结束。资本主义的一大讽刺是，大宗商品行业的大多数管理者都痛恨短缺，尽管只有短缺才让他们有机会赚取高回报。一旦出现短缺，典型的管理者就迫不及待地扩大产能，堵住利润正像雨点一样从中落下的那个缺口。1985—1987年保险业管理者所做的，恰恰就是这件事，再次验证了迪斯雷利的观察：“我们从历史中学到的，就是我们从历史中学不到教训。”

1987.english: At Berkshire, we work to escape the industry's commodity economics in two ways. First, we differentiate our product by our financial strength, which exceeds that of all others in the industry.  This strength, however, is limited in its usefulness. It means nothing in the personal insurance field:  The buyer of an auto or homeowners policy is going to get his claim paid even if his insurer fails (as many have).  It often means nothing in the commercial insurance arena: When times are good, many major corporate purchasers of insurance and their brokers pay scant attention to the insurer's ability to perform under the more adverse conditions that may exist, say, five years later when a complicated claim is finally resolved.
