(Out of sight, out of mind - and, later on, maybe out-of-pocket.)
1987.chinese: 在伯克希尔，我们试图从两方面摆脱保险行业的大宗商品经济特性。首先，通过我们超过业内所有其他公司的财务实力，使产品具有区别。但这种实力的作用有限。在个人保险领域，它没有什么意义：汽车险或房屋险购买者，即使保险公司倒闭（而且已有许多公司倒闭），仍会获得赔付。在商业保险领域，财务实力也经常不起作用：当市场景气时，许多大型企业保险购买者及其经纪人，很少关心保险公司五年后能否兑现承诺——那时一项复杂索赔才可能最终结清，而经营环境可能已经恶化。（眼不见，心不烦——随后可能连赔款都拿不到。）

1987.english: Periodically, however, buyers remember Ben Franklin's observation that it is hard for an empty sack to stand upright and recognize their need to buy promises only from insurers that have enduring financial strength.  It is then that we have a major competitive advantage.  When a buyer really focuses on whether a $10 million claim can be easily paid by his insurer five or ten years down the road, and when he takes into account the possibility that poor underwriting conditions may then coincide with depressed financial markets and defaults by reinsurer, he will find only a few companies he can trust. Among those, Berkshire will lead the pack.
1987.chinese: 不过，保险购买者有时会想起本杰明·富兰克林的观察：空麻袋很难直立起来，于是意识到，应当只向拥有长期雄厚财务实力的保险公司购买承诺。到了这种时候，我们便拥有重大竞争优势。当购买者真正考虑五年或十年后，保险公司能否轻松支付一笔1,000万美元的赔款，并且考虑届时不利的承保环境，可能恰好与金融市场低迷、再保险公司违约同时出现时，他会发现值得信赖的公司寥寥无几，而伯克希尔将在其中居于领先地位。

1987.english: Our second method of differentiating ourselves is the total indifference to volume that we maintain.  In 1989, we will be perfectly willing to write five times as much business as we write in 1988 - or only one-fifth as much.  We hope, of course, that conditions will allow us large volume.  But we cannot control market prices.  If they are unsatisfactory, we will simply do very little business.  No other major insurer acts with equal restraint.
1987.chinese: 我们使自己与众不同的第二种办法，是对保费业务量保持完全不在乎的态度。1989年，我们完全愿意承保1988年的五倍业务，也完全愿意只承保五分之一。当然，我们希望市场条件允许我们承保大量业务，但市场价格不受我们控制。如果价格不令人满意，我们就几乎不做业务。其他大型保险公司没有一家像我们这样克制。

1987.english: Three conditions that prevail in insurance, but not in most businesses, allow us our flexibility.  First, market share is not an important determinant of profitability: In this business, in contrast to the newspaper or grocery businesses, the economic rule is not survival of the fattest.  Second, in many sectors of insurance, including most of those in which we operate, distribution channels are not proprietary and can be easily entered: Small volume this year does not preclude huge volume next year.  Third, idle capacity - which in this industry largely means people - does not result in intolerable costs.  In a way that industries such as printing or steel cannot, we can operate at quarter-speed much of the time and still enjoy long-term prosperity.
1987.chinese: 保险业有三个条件，使我们能够拥有这种灵活性，而多数行业并不具备。首先，市场份额不是决定盈利的重要因素：不同于报纸业或食品杂货业，这一行业遵循的经济规则不是“最胖者生存”。其次，在保险业的许多领域，包括我们经营的大多数业务，销售渠道不是某家公司的专属财产，进入也相对容易：今年业务量很少，并不妨碍明年业务量很大。第三，闲置产能——在这个行业里主要意味着人员——不会造成无法承受的成本。我们可以在大部分时间以四分之一速度运转，同时依然保持长期繁荣；印刷和钢铁等行业则难以做到。

1987.english: We follow a price-based-on-exposure, not-on-competition policy because it makes sense for our shareholders.  But we're happy to report that it is also pro-social.  This policy means that we are always available, given prices that we believe are adequate, to write huge volumes of almost any type of property- casualty insurance.  Many other insurers follow an in-and-out approach.  When they are "out" - because of mounting losses, capital inadequacy, or whatever - we are available.  Of course, when others are panting to do business we are also available - but at such times we often find ourselves priced above the market.  In effect, we supply insurance buyers and brokers with a large reservoir of standby capacity.
1987.chinese: 我们坚持按照承担的风险敞口而非竞争对手的报价定价，因为这样做符合股东利益。令人高兴的是，这种政策也有利于社会。它意味着，只要价格在我们看来充分合理，我们始终愿意为几乎任何类型的财产及意外伤害风险提供大规模保障。许多其他保险公司采取时进时出的方式；当它们因为损失增加、资本不足或其他原因退出时，我们仍然在场。当然，当其他公司争先恐后地抢业务时，我们也仍在场，只不过通常发现自己报价高于市场。实际上，我们向保险购买者和经纪人提供了一个庞大的备用承保能力储备库。

1987.english: One story from mid-1987 illustrates some consequences of our pricing policy:  One of the largest family-owned insurance brokers in the country is headed by a fellow who has long been a shareholder of Berkshire.  This man handles a number of large risks that are candidates for placement with our New York office. Naturally, he does the best he can for his clients.  And, just as naturally, when the insurance market softened dramatically in 1987 he found prices at other insurers lower than we were willing to offer.  His reaction was, first, to place all of his business elsewhere and, second, to buy more stock in Berkshire.  Had we been really competitive, he said, we would have gotten his insurance business but he would not have bought our stock.
1987.chinese: 1987年年中的一个故事可以说明这种定价政策的结果。美国规模最大的家族所有保险经纪公司之一，由一位长期持有伯克希尔股票的人掌管。他经手许多大型风险，都可能交由我们纽约办公室承保。他当然尽力为客户争取最好的条件。1987年，保险市场价格大幅走软，他发现其他保险公司的报价低于我们愿意提供的报价。他的反应分为两步：先把全部保险业务交给其他公司，然后买入更多伯克希尔股票。他说，如果我们真的非常有竞争力，就会拿到他的保险业务，但他不会增持我们的股票。

1987.english: Berkshire's underwriting experience was excellent in 1987, in part because of the lag factor discussed earlier.  Our combined ratio (on a statutory basis and excluding structured settlements and financial reinsurance) was 105.  Although the ratio was somewhat less favorable than in 1986, when it was 103, our profitability improved materially in 1987 because we had the use of far more float.  This trend will continue to run in our favor: Our ratio of float to premium volume will increase very significantly during the next few years.  Thus, Berkshire's insurance profits are quite likely to improve during 1988 and 1989, even though we expect our combined ratio to rise.
1987.chinese: 伯克希尔1987年的承保表现出色，部分得益于前面讨论过的滞后效应。我们的综合成本率（按法定会计口径，并剔除结构化赔偿和金融再保险）为105。虽然比1986年的103略差，但1987年的盈利能力却显著提高，因为我们持有和使用的浮存金远远更多。这个趋势将继续对我们有利：未来几年，浮存金相对于保费业务量的比例将大幅提高。因此，尽管预计综合成本率会上升，伯克希尔的保险利润在1988年和1989年仍很可能改善。

1987.english:
Our insurance business has also made some important non- financial gains during the last few years.  Mike Goldberg, its manager, has assembled a group of talented professionals to write larger risks and unusual coverages.  His operation is now well equipped to handle the lines of business that will occasionally offer us major opportunities.

Our loss reserve development, detailed on pages 41-42, looks better this year than it has previously.  But we write lots of "long-tail" business - that is, policies generating claims that often take many years to resolve.  Examples would be product liability, or directors and officers liability coverages.  With a business mix like this, one year of reserve development tells you very little.
1987.chinese:
过去几年，我们的保险业务在非财务方面也取得重大进展。经理迈克·戈德伯格组织起一支人才出众的专业团队，能够承保更大的风险和特殊保障。这项业务如今已经准备好，在相关保险品种不时出现重大机会时及时行动。

第41—42页详细列示的赔款准备金后续发展数据，今年看来比过去好一些。不过，我们承保了大量“长尾”业务，也就是索赔往往需要多年才能结清的保险。例如产品责任保险、董事及高级管理人员责任保险。对于这种业务组合，仅看一年的准备金后续发展，几乎说明不了什么。

1987.english: You should be very suspicious of any earnings figures reported by insurers (including our own, as we have unfortunately proved to you in the past).  The record of the last decade shows that a great many of our best-known insurers have reported earnings to shareholders that later proved to be wildly erroneous.  In most cases, these errors were totally innocent: The unpredictability of our legal system makes it impossible for even the most conscientious insurer to come close to judging the eventual cost of long-tail claims.
1987.chinese: 各位应当对保险公司（包括我们自己）的所有报告利润保持高度怀疑——很不幸，我们过去已经向各位证明了这一点。过去十年的记录显示，许多最知名的保险公司向股东报告的利润，后来证明存在严重错误。多数情况下，这些错误完全是无意的：司法制度的不可预测性，使得即使最认真负责的保险公司，也不可能接近准确地判断长尾索赔最终要花多少钱。

1987.english: Nevertheless, auditors annually certify the numbers given them by management and in their opinions unqualifiedly state that these figures "present fairly" the financial position of their clients.  The auditors use this reassuring language even though they know from long and painful experience that the numbers so certified are likely to differ dramatically from the true earnings of the period.  Despite this history of error, investors understandably rely upon auditors' opinions.  After all, a declaration saying that "the statements present fairly" hardly sounds equivocal to the non-accountant.
1987.chinese: 然而，审计师每年仍然为管理层提供的数字出具审计意见，并毫无保留地宣称，这些数字“公允反映”了客户的财务状况。审计师使用这种令人安心的措辞，尽管他们从长期痛苦经验中知道，得到认证的数字很可能与该期间真实利润相差巨大。尽管存在这些误差历史，投资者依然可以理解地信赖审计意见。毕竟，“财务报表公允反映”听起来，对非会计专业人士而言几乎没有保留余地。

1987.english: The wording in the auditor's standard opinion letter is scheduled to change next year.  The new language represents improvement, but falls far short of describing the limitations of a casualty-insurer audit.  If it is to depict the true state of affairs, we believe the standard opinion letter to shareholders of a property-casualty company should read something like: "We have relied upon representations of management in respect to the liabilities shown for losses and loss adjustment expenses, the estimate of which, in turn, very materially affects the earnings and financial condition herein reported.  We can express no opinion about the accuracy of these figures.  Subject to that important reservation, in our opinion, etc."
1987.chinese: 审计报告中的标准措辞定于明年改变。新措辞是改进，但仍远远不足以描述财产及意外伤害保险公司审计工作的局限。如果要真实反映情况，我们认为这类公司的标准审计意见应该类似于：“对于所列已发生赔款及理赔处理费用负债，我们依赖管理层提供的陈述；这项估计又会对本报告所列利润及财务状况产生重大影响。我们无法对这些数字的准确性发表意见。除这一重大保留事项外，我们认为……”

1987.english:
If lawsuits develop in respect to wildly inaccurate financial statements (which they do), auditors will definitely say something of that sort in court anyway.  Why should they not be forthright about their role and its limitations from the outset?

We want to emphasize that we are not faulting auditors for their inability to accurately assess loss reserves (and therefore earnings).  We fault them only for failing to publicly acknowledge that they can't do this job.
1987.chinese:
如果因严重失实的财务报表而发生诉讼（这种情况确实会发生），审计师到了法庭上肯定会说出类似的话。那么，他们为什么不从一开始就坦诚说明自己的角色和局限？

我们要强调，并不是责怪审计师无法准确估计赔款准备金（因而也无法准确估计利润）。我们责怪的，仅仅是他们不愿公开承认自己做不到这一点。

1987.english: From all appearances, the innocent mistakes that are constantly made in reserving are accompanied by others that are deliberate.  Various charlatans have enriched themselves at the expense of the investing public by exploiting, first, the inability of auditors to evaluate reserve figures and, second, the auditors' willingness to confidently certify those figures as if they had the expertise to do so.  We will continue to see such chicanery in the future.  Where "earnings" can be created by the stroke of a pen, the dishonest will gather.  For them, long-tail insurance is heaven.  The audit wording we suggest would at least serve to put investors on guard against these predators.
1987.chinese: 从各种迹象来看，准备金估计中不断发生的无意错误，也伴随着一些蓄意造假的行为。某些骗子利用审计师无法评价准备金数字、却又愿意充满信心地为这些数字背书的情况，牺牲投资大众的利益，使自己变得富有。未来我们还会看到这样的骗术。在“利润”可以一挥笔就造出来的地方，不诚实的人自然会聚集。对他们来说，长尾保险简直就是天堂。我们建议的审计措辞，至少可以提醒投资者警惕这些掠夺者。

1987.english: The taxes that insurance companies pay - which increased materially, though on a delayed basis, upon enactment of the Tax Reform Act of 1986 - took a further turn for the worse at the end of 1987.  We detailed the 1986 changes in last year's report.  We also commented on the irony of a statute that substantially increased 1987 reported earnings for insurers even as it materially reduced both their long-term earnings potential and their business value.  At Berkshire, the temporarily-helpful "fresh start" adjustment inflated 1987 earnings by $8.2 million.
1987.chinese: 1986年税制改革法案生效后，保险公司缴纳的税款已经显著增加，只是增加的影响存在滞后。1987年末，情况进一步恶化。我们在去年的报告中详细介绍了1986年的变化，也评论过一个讽刺的结果：新法律大幅提高了保险公司1987年的报告利润，却显著降低了长期盈利潜力和企业价值。伯克希尔的“重新起算”（fresh start）调整暂时使1987年报告利润增加了820万美元。

1987.english:
In our opinion, the 1986 Act was the most important economic event affecting the insurance industry over the past decade.  The 1987 Bill further reduced the intercorporate dividends-received credit from 80% to 70%, effective January 1, 1988, except for cases in which the taxpayer owns at least 20% of an investee.

Investors who have owned stocks or bonds through corporate intermediaries other than qualified investment companies have always been disadvantaged in comparison to those owning the same securities directly.  The penalty applying to indirect ownership was greatly increased by the 1986 Tax Bill and, to a lesser extent, by the 1987 Bill, particularly in instances where the intermediary is an insurance company.  We have no way of offsetting this increased level of taxation.  It simply means that a given set of pre-tax investment returns will now translate into much poorer after-tax results for our shareholders.
1987.chinese:
在我们看来，1986年的法案是过去十年影响保险业最重要的经济事件。1987年的法案进一步将公司间股息收入的税前扣除比例从80%降到70%，自1988年1月1日起生效，但纳税人持有被投资企业至少20%股权的情形除外。

投资者通过符合条件的投资公司以外的公司中介持有股票或债券，与直接持有同一证券相比，一直存在税收劣势。1986年税法显著加重了间接持有的税收负担，1987年的法案又使其略有加重，尤其是在中介机构为保险公司时。我们无法抵消这种税负的提高。这只意味着，同样的税前投资回报，如今转化为伯克希尔股东税后回报时，会显著减少。

1987.english: All in all, we expect to do well in the insurance business, though our record is sure to be uneven.  The immediate outlook is for substantially lower volume but reasonable earnings improvement.  The decline in premium volume will accelerate after our quota-share agreement with Fireman's Fund expires in 1989. At some point, likely to be at least a few years away, we may see some major opportunities, for which we are now much better prepared than we were in 1985.
1987.chinese: 总而言之，我们预计保险业务会表现良好，尽管业绩肯定不平稳。眼下的前景是：业务量大幅下降，但利润仍有望合理改善。1989年我们与Fireman's Fund的比例再保险合同终止后，保费业务量下降将加速。未来某个时候——可能至少要再过几年——我们也许会遇到重大机会，到那时，我们的准备将远胜于1985年。

1987.english:
## Marketable Securities - Permanent Holdings

Whenever Charlie and I buy common stocks for Berkshire's insurance companies (leaving aside arbitrage purchases, discussed later) we approach the transaction as if we were buying into a private business.  We look at the economic prospects of the business, the people in charge of running it, and the price we must pay.  We do not have in mind any time or price for sale. Indeed, we are willing to hold a stock indefinitely so long as we expect the business to increase in intrinsic value at a satisfactory rate.  When investing, we view ourselves as business analysts - not as market analysts, not as macroeconomic analysts, and not even as security analysts.
1987.chinese:
## 可交易证券——永久持有的投资

每当查理和我通过伯克希尔的保险公司购买普通股（不包括后文讨论的套利交易）时，我们都像在购买一家私人企业的部分权益一样看待这笔交易。我们分析企业的经济前景、管理经营的人，以及我们必须支付的价格。我们从不预先设定何时卖出或卖出价格。事实上，只要我们预计一家企业的内在价值能够以令人满意的速度增长，我们就愿意无限期持有其股票。投资时，我们把自己视为企业分析师——不是市场分析师，不是宏观经济分析师，甚至也不是证券分析师。

1987.english:
Our approach makes an active trading market useful, since it periodically presents us with mouth-watering opportunities.  But by no means is it essential: a prolonged suspension of trading in the securities we hold would not bother us any more than does the lack of daily quotations on World Book or Fechheimer. Eventually, our economic fate will be determined by the economic fate of the business we own, whether our ownership is partial or total.

Ben Graham, my friend and teacher, long ago described the mental attitude toward market fluctuations that I believe to be most conducive to investment success.  He said that you should imagine market quotations as coming from a remarkably accommodating fellow named Mr. Market who is your partner in a private business.  Without fail, Mr. Market appears daily and names a price at which he will either buy your interest or sell you his.
1987.chinese:
我们的方式使活跃的交易市场变得有用，因为它不时会提供让我们垂涎欲滴的机会。但活跃市场绝非必需：即使我们持有的证券长期停止交易，也没有每日行情报价，我们也不会比没有世界图书或费希海默的每日报价更困扰。最终，不论拥有的是一部分还是全部，我们的经济命运都由所拥有企业的经济命运决定。

我的朋友兼老师本杰明·格雷厄姆，早已描述了一种对待市场波动的心理态度。我相信这种态度最有利于投资成功。他说，你应该把市场报价想象成来自一个特别乐于配合的家伙，名叫“市场先生”（Mr. Market）。他是你在一家私人企业里的合伙人。每天，他都会准时出现，报出一个价格，愿意按这个价格买下你的权益，或者把他的权益卖给你。

1987.english: Even though the business that the two of you own may have economic characteristics that are stable, Mr. Market's quotations will be anything but.  For, sad to say, the poor fellow has incurable emotional problems.  At times he feels euphoric and can see only the favorable factors affecting the business.  When in that mood, he names a very high buy-sell price because he fears that you will snap up his interest and rob him of imminent gains. At other times he is depressed and can see nothing but trouble ahead for both the business and the world.  On these occasions he will name a very low price, since he is terrified that you will unload your interest on him.
1987.chinese: 尽管你们共同拥有的企业，经济特性可能相当稳定，“市场先生”的报价却绝非如此。可怜的是，这家伙有无法治愈的情绪问题。有时他兴高采烈，只看得到影响企业的有利因素。在这种心情下，他会报出很高的买卖价格，因为担心你抢先买走他的股份，独享马上就要到来的收益。另一些时候，他情绪低落，觉得企业和世界的前景一片黯淡。这时他报出极低的价格，因为他害怕你把权益卖给他。

1987.english:
Mr. Market has another endearing characteristic: He doesn't mind being ignored.  If his quotation is uninteresting to you today, he will be back with a new one tomorrow.  Transactions are strictly at your option.  Under these conditions, the more manic- depressive his behavior, the better for you.

But, like Cinderella at the ball, you must heed one warning or everything will turn into pumpkins and mice: Mr. Market is there to serve you, not to guide you.  It is his pocketbook, not his wisdom, that you will find useful.  If he shows up some day in a particularly foolish mood, you are free to either ignore him or to take advantage of him, but it will be disastrous if you fall under his influence.  Indeed, if you aren't certain that you understand and can value your business far better than Mr. Market, you don't belong in the game.  As they say in poker, "If you've been in the game 30 minutes and you don't know who the patsy is, you're the patsy."
1987.chinese:
“市场先生”还有另一个讨人喜欢的特点：他一点不介意你无视他。如果今天的报价对你没有吸引力，明天他会带着新报价回来。是否交易，完全由你决定。在这种条件下，他的情绪越是大起大落，对你越有利。

不过，像舞会上的灰姑娘一样，你必须留意一条警告，否则一切都会变成南瓜和老鼠：“市场先生”是来为你服务的，不是来指导你的。你能够利用的是他的钱包，而不是他的智慧。如果有一天他表现得特别愚蠢，你完全可以不理他，或者利用他；但如果反而受到他的情绪影响，后果将十分糟糕。事实上，如果你不能确信自己比“市场先生”更了解、也更善于评估这家企业，那么你就不应该参与这场游戏。正如扑克牌桌上的说法：“如果你已经玩了30分钟，还不知道谁是冤大头，那冤大头就是你。”

1987.english:
Ben's Mr. Market allegory may seem out-of-date in today's investment world, in which most professionals and academicians talk of efficient markets, dynamic hedging and betas.  Their interest in such matters is understandable, since techniques shrouded in mystery clearly have value to the purveyor of investment advice.  After all, what witch doctor has ever achieved fame and fortune by simply advising "Take two aspirins"?

The value of market esoterica to the consumer of investment advice is a different story.  In my opinion, investment success will not be produced by arcane formulae, computer programs or signals flashed by the price behavior of stocks and markets. Rather an investor will succeed by coupling good business judgment with an ability to insulate his thoughts and behavior from the super-contagious emotions that swirl about the marketplace.  In my own efforts to stay insulated, I have found it highly useful to keep Ben's Mr. Market concept firmly in mind.
1987.chinese:
在今天的投资界，大多数专业人士与学者谈论的是有效市场、动态对冲和贝塔系数。与之相比，本·格雷厄姆的“市场先生”寓言似乎有些过时。他们对这些东西感兴趣可以理解：笼罩着神秘感的技巧，对提供投资建议的人显然有商业价值。毕竟，哪个巫医能只靠一句“吃两片阿司匹林”就名利双收呢？

但这些玄奥的市场理论，对投资建议的消费者有多大价值，则是另一回事。在我看来，投资成功并不来自艰深公式、计算机程序或股票与市场价格走势闪现的信号。投资者取得成功，需要把良好的商业判断，与将自己的思想和行为隔离于市场中极具传染性的情绪之外的能力结合起来。我自己努力保持这种隔离时，一直发现牢牢记住本的“市场先生”概念极有帮助。

1987.english: Following Ben's teachings, Charlie and I let our marketable equities tell us by their operating results - not by their daily, or even yearly, price quotations - whether our investments are successful.  The market may ignore business success for a while, but eventually will confirm it.  As Ben said: "In the short run, the market is a voting machine but in the long run it is a weighing machine." The speed at which a business's success is recognized, furthermore, is not that important as long as the company's intrinsic value is increasing at a satisfactory rate. In fact, delayed recognition can be an advantage: It may give us the chance to buy more of a good thing at a bargain price.
1987.chinese: 遵循本的教导，查理和我让所持股票背后的企业通过经营业绩——而不是通过每天甚至每年的股价——告诉我们投资是否成功。市场也许会暂时忽视企业成功，但最终一定会确认它。正如本所说：“短期看，市场是一台投票机；长期看，它是一台称重机。”而且，只要公司的内在价值正以令人满意的速度增长，其成功被市场认可得有多快，并不那么重要。事实上，确认越晚有时越好，因为我们可能有机会以便宜价格买入更多优秀资产。

1987.english:
Sometimes, of course, the market may judge a business to be more valuable than the underlying facts would indicate it is.  In such a case, we will sell our holdings.  Sometimes, also, we will sell a security that is fairly valued or even undervalued because we require funds for a still more undervalued investment or one we believe we understand better.

We need to emphasize, however, that we do not sell holdings just because they have appreciated or because we have held them for a long time. (Of Wall Street maxims the most foolish may be "You can't go broke taking a profit.") We are quite content to hold any security indefinitely, so long as the prospective return on equity capital of the underlying business is satisfactory, management is competent and honest, and the market does not overvalue the business.
1987.chinese:
当然，有时市场会给企业一个高于基本事实所支持的估值。这种情况下，我们会卖出持股。有时我们也会卖出估值合理、甚至低估的证券，因为需要资金投入另一项被低估得更多，或者我们认为自己理解得更好的投资。

不过，我们必须强调：我们不会仅仅因为持股已经上涨，或者持有时间很长就卖出。（华尔街最愚蠢的格言之一，恐怕就是“获利了结永远不会让你破产”。）只要基础企业的未来股权资本回报前景令人满意，管理层能干且诚实，市场也没有对企业高估，我们就完全愿意无限期持有任何证券。

1987.english: However, our insurance companies own three marketable common stocks that we would not sell even though they became far overpriced in the market.  In effect, we view these investments exactly like our successful controlled businesses - a permanent part of Berkshire rather than merchandise to be disposed of once Mr. Market offers us a sufficiently high price.  To that, I will add one qualifier: These stocks are held by our insurance companies and we would, if absolutely necessary, sell portions of our holdings to pay extraordinary insurance losses.  We intend, however, to manage our affairs so that sales are never required.
1987.chinese: 不过，我们的保险公司持有三只可交易普通股，即使其市价涨到远远高于内在价值，我们也不会卖出。事实上，我们完全像看待成功的控股企业一样看待这些投资：它们是伯克希尔的永久组成部分，而不是等“市场先生”报出高价时就可以出售的商品。但我要加上一项限定：这些股票由保险公司持有；如确有必要，为支付异常巨额的保险损失，我们可能卖出部分股份。不过，我们打算安排好财务状况，让这种出售永远不成为必需。

1987.english: A determination to have and to hold, which Charlie and I share, obviously involves a mixture of personal and financial considerations.  To some, our stand may seem highly eccentric. (Charlie and I have long followed David Oglivy's advice: "Develop your eccentricities while you are young.  That way, when you get old, people won't think you're going ga-ga.") Certainly, in the transaction-fixated Wall Street of recent years, our posture must seem odd: To many in that arena, both companies and stocks are seen only as raw material for trades.
1987.chinese: 查理和我共同坚持的“拥有并持有”决心，显然混合了个人与财务两方面的考虑。有些人也许觉得我们十分古怪。（查理和我很早就听从大卫·奥格威的建议：“年轻时就培养自己的怪癖。这样等老了，别人就不会以为你疯了。”）尤其在近些年痴迷交易的华尔街，这种态度一定显得奇怪：在许多人眼里，企业和股票不过是可供交易的原材料。

1987.english: Our attitude, however, fits our personalities and the way we want to live our lives.  Churchill once said, "You shape your houses and then they shape you." We know the manner in which we wish to be shaped.  For that reason, we would rather achieve a return of X while associating with people whom we strongly like and admire than realize 110% of X by exchanging these relationships for uninteresting or unpleasant ones.  And we will never find people we like and admire more than some of the main participants at the three companies - our permanent holdings - shown below:
1987.chinese: 但我们的态度符合自己的性格，也符合我们希望如何生活。丘吉尔曾说：“我们塑造房屋，随后房屋塑造我们。”我们知道自己希望被塑造成什么样。因此，比起为了与无趣或令人不快的人合作而获得110%的X回报，我们宁愿与非常喜欢和敬重的人合作，只获得X回报。而且，在以下三家永久持股企业的主要参与者中，我们再也找不到更令我们喜欢和敬重的人了。

1987.english: We really don't see many fundamental differences between the purchase of a controlled business and the purchase of marketable holdings such as these.  In each case we try to buy into businesses with favorable long-term economics.  Our goal is to find an outstanding business at a sensible price, not a mediocre business at a bargain price.  Charlie and I have found that making silk purses out of silk is the best that we can do; with sow's ears, we fail.
1987.chinese: 我们确实看不到购买控股企业，与购买上述可交易持股之间有什么根本区别。在两种情况下，我们都力求买入具有良好长期经济特性的企业。我们的目标是在合理价格买到卓越企业，而不是以便宜价格买到平庸企业。查理和我发现，我们的能力只能把丝绸做成丝绸钱包；如果原料是猪耳朵，我们就做不出来。

1987.english:
(It must be noted that your Chairman, always a quick study, required only 20 years to recognize how important it was to buy good businesses.  In the interim, I searched for "bargains" - and had the misfortune to find some.  My punishment was an education in the economics of short-line farm implement manufacturers, third-place department stores, and New England textile manufacturers.)

Of course, Charlie and I may misread the fundamental economics of a business.  When that happens, we will encounter problems whether that business is a wholly-owned subsidiary or a marketable security, although it is usually far easier to exit from the latter. (Indeed, businesses can be misread:  Witness the European reporter who, after being sent to this country to profile Andrew Carnegie, cabled his editor, "My God, you'll never believe the sort of money there is in running libraries.")
1987.chinese:
（必须指出，各位的董事长一向学得很快，只花了20年就认识到购买优秀企业有多么重要。在这段时间里，我四处寻找“便宜货”，不幸地真的找到了一些。惩罚便是：我被迫学习了产品线较窄的农机制造商、排名第三的百货商店以及新英格兰纺织企业的经济特性。）

当然，查理和我也可能误判一家企业的根本经济特性。发生这种情况时，无论它是一家全资子公司，还是一只可交易股票，我们都会遭遇麻烦，尽管通常卖出后者要容易得多。（企业确实可能被误判：有位欧洲记者被派来美国为安德鲁·卡内基写人物报道，结果发电报给编辑说：“天哪，你绝对想不到经营图书馆能赚这么多钱！”）

1987.english: In making both control purchases and stock purchases, we try to buy not only good businesses, but ones run by high-grade, talented and likeable managers.  If we make a mistake about the managers we link up with, the controlled company offers a certain advantage because we have the power to effect change.  In practice, however, this advantage is somewhat illusory: Management changes, like marital changes, are painful, time- consuming and chancy.  In any event, at our three marketable-but permanent holdings, this point is moot:  With Tom Murphy and Dan Burke at Cap Cities, Bill Snyder and Lou Simpson at GEICO, and Kay Graham and Dick Simmons at The Washington Post, we simply couldn't be in better hands.
1987.chinese: 无论购买控股企业还是股票，我们不仅要购买好的企业，也要与品格高尚、才华出众、令人喜欢的管理者合作。如果对管理者判断失误，控股企业有一个优势：我们拥有更换管理层的权力。但实际中，这种优势有些虚幻：更换管理层和更换配偶一样痛苦、耗时且充满不确定性。无论如何，在我们这三项永久持有的上市公司中，这个问题根本不存在：Capital Cities的汤姆·墨菲和丹·伯克、GEICO的比尔·斯奈德和卢·辛普森、华盛顿邮报的凯·格雷厄姆和迪克·西蒙斯，都是再好不过的管理者。

1987.english: I would say that the controlled company offers two main advantages.  First, when we control a company we get to allocate capital, whereas we are likely to have little or nothing to say about this process with marketable holdings.  This point can be important because the heads of many companies are not skilled in capital allocation.  Their inadequacy is not surprising.  Most bosses rise to the top because they have excelled in an area such as marketing, production, engineering, administration or, sometimes, institutional politics.
1987.chinese: 我认为，控股企业相对于可交易少数股权投资，主要有两项优势。第一，控制一家企业后，我们能够决定资本配置；对于上市公司少数持股，我们通常几乎无权参与这一过程。这很重要，因为许多公司负责人并不擅长资本配置。这种不足并不奇怪：多数管理者之所以升至最高职位，是因为他们擅长营销、生产、工程、行政管理，有时则是擅长公司内部政治。

1987.english:
Once they become CEOs, they face new responsibilities.  They now must make capital allocation decisions, a critical job that they may have never tackled and that is not easily mastered.  To stretch the point, it's as if the final step for a highly- talented musician was not to perform at Carnegie Hall but, instead, to be named Chairman of the Federal Reserve.

The lack of skill that many CEOs have at capital allocation is no small matter: After ten years on the job, a CEO whose company annually retains earnings equal to 10% of net worth will have been responsible for the deployment of more than 60% of all the capital at work in the business.
1987.chinese:
一旦成为首席执行官，他们就面对新的职责：必须作出资本配置决策。这是一项至关重要、但他们可能从未处理过，也不容易掌握的工作。夸张一点说，这就像一位才华横溢的音乐家，本以为事业巅峰是在卡内基音乐厅演出，结果最后一步却是被任命为美联储主席。

许多CEO缺乏资本配置能力，绝非小事。如果一家企业每年留存相当于净资产10%的利润，那么一位在任十年的CEO，就会负责配置企业实际运用的全部资本中超过60%的部分。

1987.english:
CEOs who recognize their lack of capital-allocation skills (which not all do) will often try to compensate by turning to their staffs, management consultants, or investment bankers. Charlie and I have frequently observed the consequences of such "help." On balance, we feel it is more likely to accentuate the capital-allocation problem than to solve it.

In the end, plenty of unintelligent capital allocation takes place in corporate America. (That's why you hear so much about "restructuring.") Berkshire, however, has been fortunate.  At the companies that are our major non-controlled holdings, capital has generally been well-deployed and, in some cases, brilliantly so.
1987.chinese:
意识到自己缺乏资本配置能力的CEO（当然，并非人人都能意识到），往往试图借助内部幕僚、管理顾问或投资银行家弥补。查理和我经常看到这种“帮助”的后果。总体而言，我们觉得这种帮助更可能加重资本配置问题，而不是解决它。

最终，美国企业界发生了大量不明智的资本配置。（这就是为什么你听到那么多“重组”的原因。）伯克希尔则很幸运：在我们主要的非控股投资企业中，资本总体配置得很好，有些案例甚至堪称杰出。

1987.english: The second advantage of a controlled company over a marketable security has to do with taxes.  Berkshire, as a corporate holder, absorbs some significant tax costs through the ownership of partial positions that we do not when our ownership is 80%, or greater.  Such tax disadvantages have long been with us, but changes in the tax code caused them to increase significantly during the past year.  As a consequence, a given business result can now deliver Berkshire financial results that are as much as 50% better if they come from an 80%-or-greater holding rather than from a lesser holding.
1987.chinese: 控股企业相较上市少数股权的第二项优势与税收有关。作为公司股东，持有较小比例的股权会让伯克希尔承担相当可观的税收成本；当持股达到80%或以上时，这些成本则不存在。这样的税收劣势由来已久，但上一年的税法变化显著扩大了它。因此，同样的经营结果，如果来自持股80%或以上的企业，而不是持股比例更低的企业，为伯克希尔创造的财务结果最多可能好50%。

1987.english: The disadvantages of owning marketable securities are sometimes offset by a huge advantage:  Occasionally the stock market offers us the chance to buy non-controlling pieces of extraordinary businesses at truly ridiculous prices - dramatically below those commanded in negotiated transactions that transfer control.  For example, we purchased our Washington Post stock in 1973 at $5.63 per share, and per-share operating earnings in 1987 after taxes were $10.30.  Similarly, Our GEICO stock was purchased in 1976, 1979 and 1980 at an average of $6.67 per share, and after-tax operating earnings per share last year were $9.01. In cases such as these, Mr. Market has proven to be a mighty good friend.
1987.chinese: 不过，上市证券投资的这些缺点有时会被一个巨大优势抵消：股票市场偶尔让我们能够以荒唐便宜的价格，购买卓越企业的少数股权，远低于通过谈判取得控制权时的价格。例如，我们1973年买入华盛顿邮报股票的成本是每股5.63美元，而1987年该公司每股税后经营利润达到10.30美元。同样，我们分别在1976、1979和1980年买入GEICO，平均成本每股6.67美元，而它去年的每股税后经营利润为9.01美元。在这样的案例中，“市场先生”确实是个极好的朋友。

1987.english:
An interesting accounting irony overlays a comparison of the reported financial results of our controlled companies with those of the permanent minority holdings listed above.  As you can see, those three stocks have a market value of over $2 billion.  Yet they produced only $11 million in reported after-tax earnings for Berkshire in 1987.

Accounting rules dictate that we take into income only the dividends these companies pay us - which are little more than nominal - rather than our share of their earnings, which in 1987 amounted to well over $100 million.  On the other hand, accounting rules provide that the carrying value of these three holdings - owned, as they are, by insurance companies - must be recorded on our balance sheet at current market prices.  The result: GAAP accounting lets us reflect in our net worth the up- to-date underlying values of the businesses we partially own, but does not let us reflect their underlying earnings in our income account.
1987.chinese:
对比控股企业与上述永久少数股权投资的报告财务结果，还有一个有趣的会计讽刺。如表所示，这三项股票的市值超过20亿美元，但1987年为伯克希尔贡献的报告税后利润只有1,100万美元。

会计规则规定，我们只能把这些企业支付给我们的股息——数额非常小——计入利润，而不能计入我们按持股比例应享有的盈利；1987年，后者远远超过1亿美元。另一方面，会计规则又要求，保险公司持有的这三项投资必须按当前市场价格列示在资产负债表上。结果就是：GAAP允许我们在净资产中体现这些部分持有企业的最新基础价值，却不允许在损益表中体现它们的底层盈利。

1987.english:
In the case of our controlled companies, just the opposite is true.  Here, we show full earnings in our income account but never change asset values on our balance sheet, no matter how much the value of a business might have increased since we purchased it.

Our mental approach to this accounting schizophrenia is to ignore GAAP figures and to focus solely on the future earning power of both our controlled and non-controlled businesses. Using this approach, we establish our own ideas of business value, keeping these independent from both the accounting values shown on our books for controlled companies and the values placed by a sometimes foolish market on our partially-owned companies. It is this business value that we hope to increase at a reasonable (or, preferably, unreasonable) rate in the years ahead.
1987.chinese:
对于控股企业，情况恰好相反。我们在损益表中报告它们的全部利润，却从不因其自收购以来价值增长而调整资产负债表上的资产价值。

面对这种会计上的“人格分裂”，我们的思考方法是忽略GAAP数字，而只关注控股与非控股企业未来的盈利能力。按照这一方法，我们建立自己对企业价值的判断，使其既不依赖控股企业账面记录的会计价值，也不依赖有时愚蠢的市场给部分持有企业标出的价格。未来我们希望以合理的（或者最好是不合理地高的）速度增长的，正是这种企业价值。

1987.english:
## Marketable Securities - Other

In addition to our three permanent common stock holdings, we hold large quantities of marketable securities in our insurance companies.  In selecting these, we can choose among five major categories: (1) long-term common stock investments, (2) medium- term fixed-income securities, (3) long-term fixed income securities, (4) short-term cash equivalents, and (5) short-term arbitrage commitments.

We have no particular bias when it comes to choosing from these categories.  We just continuously search among them for the highest after-tax returns as measured by "mathematical expectation," limiting ourselves always to investment alternatives we think we understand.  Our criteria have nothing to do with maximizing immediately reportable earnings; our goal, rather, is to maximize eventual net worth.
1987.chinese:
## 可交易证券——其他投资

除了三项永久持有的普通股外，我们的保险公司还持有大量可交易证券。选择这些投资时，我们可以考虑五大类：（1）长期普通股投资；（2）中期固定收益证券；（3）长期固定收益证券；（4）短期现金等价物；（5）短期套利投资。

在这些类别之间，我们没有特别偏好。我们只是在所有类别中持续寻找按照“数学期望值”衡量、税后收益最高的投资，同时始终把自己限制在能够理解的投资选择内。我们的标准与尽量提高立即可报告的利润毫无关系；我们的目标是尽量提高最终净资产。

1987.english:
o Let's look first at common stocks.  During 1987 the stock market was an area of much excitement but little net movement: The Dow advanced 2.3% for the year.  You are aware, of course, of the roller coaster ride that produced this minor change.  Mr. Market was on a manic rampage until October and then experienced a sudden, massive seizure.

We have "professional" investors, those who manage many billions, to thank for most of this turmoil.  Instead of focusing on what businesses will do in the years ahead, many prestigious money managers now focus on what they expect other money managers to do in the days ahead.  For them, stocks are merely tokens in a game, like the thimble and flatiron in Monopoly.
1987.chinese:
**普通股。** 先来看普通股。1987年的股市十分热闹，但全年净变动很小：道琼斯指数全年上涨2.3%。当然，各位都知道，这个小小的涨幅背后经历了怎样的过山车。10月之前，“市场先生”一直处于狂躁状态，随后突然发生了一场严重的抽搐。

这场混乱的大部分“功劳”，应当归于那些管理数十亿美元资金的“专业”投资者。如今，许多声望显赫的资金管理者关注的，不再是企业未来几年会做出怎样的成绩，而是预测其他基金经理未来几天会怎么做。在他们眼中，股票只是游戏的筹码，就像大富翁棋盘里的顶针和熨斗。

1987.english: An extreme example of what their attitude leads to is "portfolio insurance," a money-management strategy that many leading investment advisors embraced in 1986-1987.  This strategy - which is simply an exotically-labeled version of the small speculator's stop-loss order dictates that ever increasing portions of a stock portfolio, or their index-future equivalents, be sold as prices decline.  The strategy says nothing else matters: A downtick of a given magnitude automatically produces a huge sell order.  According to the Brady Report, $60 billion to $90 billion of equities were poised on this hair trigger in mid- October of 1987.
1987.chinese: 这种态度导致的一个极端例子，就是许多著名投资顾问在1986—1987年间采用的“投资组合保险”（portfolio insurance）策略。这种策略不过是给小投机者的止损单换了个玄妙的名字：它要求随着价格下降，卖出股票组合中越来越大的比例，或者卖出对应的股指期货。策略规定，其他事情一概不重要：只要市场下跌达到某个幅度，马上自动发出巨额卖单。据布雷迪报告，1987年10月中旬，有600亿至900亿美元股票处在这种随时可以扣动的扳机之下。

1987.english: If you've thought that investment advisors were hired to invest, you may be bewildered by this technique.  After buying a farm, would a rational owner next order his real estate agent to start selling off pieces of it whenever a neighboring property was sold at a lower price?  Or would you sell your house to whatever bidder was available at 9:31 on some morning merely because at 9:30 a similar house sold for less than it would have brought on the previous day?
1987.chinese: 如果你原以为聘请投资顾问是为了进行投资，看到这种技术大概会莫名其妙。一个理性的人买下一座农场，难道接下来会要求房地产经纪人，只要附近另一块土地以较低价格成交，就开始出售自己农场的一部分？或者，只因为上午9点30分一栋类似房屋的成交价低于前一天能卖出的价格，你就会在9点31分把自己的房子卖给当时随便哪个出价者吗？

1987.english: Moves like that, however, are what portfolio insurance tells a pension fund or university to make when it owns a portion of enterprises such as Ford or General Electric.  The less these companies are being valued at, says this approach, the more vigorously they should be sold.  As a "logical" corollary, the approach commands the institutions to repurchase these companies - I'm not making this up - once their prices have rebounded significantly.  Considering that huge sums are controlled by managers following such Alice-in-Wonderland practices, is it any surprise that markets sometimes behave in aberrational fashion?
1987.chinese: 但当养老基金或大学持有福特、通用电气这样的企业部分权益时，“投资组合保险”要求它们做的，恰恰就是这种事。按照这一方法，这些公司的估值越低，就应该越卖力地卖出。根据同样“合理”的逻辑，这种方法又要求机构在价格显著反弹之后重新买入这些公司——我可没有编故事。考虑到如此巨额的资金由遵循这种“爱丽丝梦游仙境”式规则的管理者掌控，市场有时表现反常，又有什么奇怪呢？

1987.english: Many commentators, however, have drawn an incorrect conclusion upon observing recent events: They are fond of saying that the small investor has no chance in a market now dominated by the erratic behavior of the big boys.  This conclusion is dead wrong: Such markets are ideal for any investor - small or large - so long as he sticks to his investment knitting.  Volatility caused by money managers who speculate irrationally with huge sums will offer the true investor more chances to make intelligent investment moves.  He can be hurt by such volatility only if he is forced, by either financial or psychological pressures, to sell at untoward times.
1987.chinese: 不过，许多评论员看到最近的事件后得出了错误结论。他们喜欢说，如今市场由大机构的反复无常行为主导，小投资者根本没有机会。这一结论完全错了：只要坚持自己的投资本分，这样的市场对任何真正的投资者——无论大小——都是理想的。那些用巨额资金进行非理性投机的基金经理造成的波动，会为真正的投资者提供更多作出明智投资决定的机会。只有当投资者因为财务压力或心理压力，被迫在不合适的时候出售，才会真正受到这种波动的伤害。

1987.english: At Berkshire, we have found little to do in stocks during the past few years.  During the break in October, a few stocks fell to prices that interested us, but we were unable to make meaningful purchases before they rebounded.  At yearend 1987 we had no major common stock investments (that is, over $50 million) other than those we consider permanent or arbitrage holdings. However, Mr. Market will offer us opportunities - you can be sure of that - and, when he does, we will be willing and able to participate.
1987.chinese: 过去几年，我们在股票市场上几乎无事可做。10月暴跌时，有几只股票跌到了我们感兴趣的价格，但还没来得及买入足够大的数量，它们就反弹了。1987年末，除了我们视为永久持有的投资和套利持仓，我们没有其他重大普通股投资（即单项超过5,000万美元）。不过，“市场先生”一定会给我们提供机会——这一点可以确信——到时候，我们愿意，也有能力参与。

1987.english:
o In the meantime, our major parking place for money is medium-term tax-exempt bonds, whose limited virtues I explained in last year's annual report.  Though we both bought and sold some of these bonds in 1987, our position changed little overall, holding around $900 million.  A large portion of our bonds are "grandfathered" under the Tax Reform Act of 1986, which means they are fully tax-exempt.  Bonds currently purchased by insurance companies are not.

As an alternative to short-term cash equivalents, our medium-term tax-exempts have - so far served us well.  They have produced substantial extra income for us and are currently worth a bit above our cost.  Regardless of their market price, we are ready to dispose of our bonds whenever something better comes along.
1987.chinese:
**中期免税债券。** 与此同时，我们主要将资金停放在中期免税债券中；我已在去年的年报中解释过它们有限的优点。尽管1987年我们买入并卖出了一些此类债券，总体持仓变化不大，仍在9亿美元左右。我们所持债券的大部分受1986年税法的既有条款保护，这意味着它们完全免税；如今保险公司新买入的债券则不再享有这一待遇。

作为短期现金等价物的替代品，我们的中期免税债券迄今表现不错。它们为我们带来了可观的额外收入，目前市值也略高于成本。无论债券市价如何，只要出现更好的机会，我们都准备卖出。

1987.english:
o We continue to have an aversion to long-term bonds (and may be making a serious mistake by not disliking medium-term bonds as well).  Bonds are no better than the currency in which they are denominated, and nothing we have seen in the past year - or past decade - makes us enthusiastic about the long-term future of U.S. currency.

Our enormous trade deficit is causing various forms of "claim checks" - U.S. government and corporate bonds, bank deposits, etc. - to pile up in the hands of foreigners at a distressing rate.  By default, our government has adopted an approach to its finances patterned on that of Blanche DuBois, of A Streetcar Named Desire, who said, "I have always depended on the kindness of strangers." In this case, of course, the "strangers" are relying on the integrity of our claim checks although the plunging dollar has already made that proposition expensive for them.
1987.chinese:
**长期债券。** 我们继续不喜欢长期债券（甚至可能犯了严重错误，因为我们也许应该连中期债券都不喜欢）。债券的质量不会高于其计价货币的质量。过去一年，乃至过去十年，我们没有看到任何能让我们对美元长期前景充满热情的迹象。

巨额贸易逆差正使各种形式的“索款凭证”——美国政府和企业债券、银行存款等等——以令人忧虑的速度积聚到外国人手中。事实上，我们的政府已经仿效《欲望号街车》中布兰奇·杜波依斯的理财方式，她说过：“我一直依赖陌生人的善意。”当然，在这里，陌生人依赖的是我们这些索款凭证的可靠性，尽管美元暴跌已经让他们为这种依赖付出了昂贵代价。

1987.english: The faith that foreigners are placing in us may be misfounded.  When the claim checks outstanding grow sufficiently numerous and when the issuing party can unilaterally determine their purchasing power, the pressure on the issuer to dilute their value by inflating the currency becomes almost irresistible.  For the debtor government, the weapon of inflation is the economic equivalent of the "H" bomb, and that is why very few countries have been allowed to swamp the world with debt denominated in their own currency.  Our past, relatively good record for fiscal integrity has let us break this rule, but the generosity accorded us is likely to intensify, rather than relieve, the eventual pressure on us to inflate.  If we do succumb to that pressure, it won't be just the foreign holders of our claim checks who will suffer.  It will be all of us as well.
1987.chinese: 外国人给予我们的信任可能站不住脚。当未偿付索款凭证越来越多，而发行人又能单方面决定它们的购买力时，发行人通过通货膨胀稀释其价值的压力，最终几乎无法抗拒。对于负债政府来说，通胀武器在经济上的威力相当于氢弹；正因如此，极少有国家被允许以本国货币计价的债务淹没世界。我们过去相对良好的财政信誉使美国成为例外，但各国给予我们的慷慨待遇，恐怕最终会加剧而不是减轻促使我们制造通胀的压力。如果我们真的屈服，受害的不只是持有这些索款凭证的外国人，我们所有人都会遭殃。

1987.english: Of course, the U.S. may take steps to stem our trade deficit well before our position as a net debtor gets out of hand. (In that respect, the falling dollar will help, though unfortunately it will hurt in other ways.) Nevertheless, our government's behavior in this test of its mettle is apt to be consistent with its Scarlett O'Hara approach generally: "I'll think about it tomorrow." And, almost inevitably, procrastination in facing up to fiscal problems will have inflationary consequences.
1987.chinese: 当然，美国可能在净债务国地位失控之前采取措施遏制贸易逆差。（在这方面，美元下跌会有帮助，虽然在其他方面它会造成损害。）但面对这一考验，我们政府的行为恐怕仍会符合其一贯的斯嘉丽·奥哈拉式风格：“明天再想办法。”而拖延应对财政问题，几乎不可避免地会带来通胀后果。

1987.english:
Both the timing and the sweep of those consequences are unpredictable.  But our inability to quantify or time the risk does not mean we should ignore it.  While recognizing the possibility that we may be wrong and that present interest rates may adequately compensate for the inflationary risk, we retain a general fear of long-term bonds.

We are, however, willing to invest a moderate portion of our funds in this category if we think we have a significant edge in a specific security.  That willingness explains our holdings of the Washington Public Power Supply Systems #1, #2 and #3 issues, discussed in our 1984 report.  We added to our WPPSS position during 1987.  At yearend, we had holdings with an amortized cost of $240 million and a market value of $316 million, paying us tax-exempt income of $34 million annually.
1987.chinese:
这些后果何时到来、有多大范围，无法预测。但我们不能量化或无法把握风险发生的时间，并不等于可以忽略风险。虽然承认自己可能判断错误，也承认当前利率可能已经充分补偿通胀风险，我们仍然普遍担忧长期债券。

不过，如果认为自己在某只特定证券上拥有显著的优势，我们仍愿意将适量资金投入这一类别。这解释了为什么我们持有1984年年报讨论过的华盛顿公共供电系统（WPPSS）第1、2、3号项目债券。1987年，我们增加了这类持仓。年末债券摊余成本2.40亿美元，市值3.16亿美元，每年提供3,400万美元免税收入。

1987.english:
o We continued to do well in arbitrage last year, though - or perhaps because - we operated on a very limited scale.  We enter into only a few arbitrage commitments each year and restrict ourselves to large transactions that have been publicly announced.  We do not participate in situations in which green- mailers are attempting to put a target company "in play."

We have practiced arbitrage on an opportunistic basis for decades and, to date, our results have been quite good.  Though we've never made an exact calculation, I believe that overall we have averaged annual pre-tax returns of at least 25% from arbitrage.  I'm quite sure we did better than that in 1987.  But it should be emphasized that a really bad experience or two - such as many arbitrage operations suffered in late 1987 - could change the figures dramatically.
1987.chinese:
**套利。** 去年我们的套利继续表现良好——也许恰恰是因为我们只在非常有限的规模上操作。每年我们只作出少量套利投资，并且限定在已经公开宣布的大型交易。对于那些试图通过“绿票讹诈”（greenmail）把目标企业推入收购交易的情况，我们不参与。

几十年来，我们一直机会性地从事套利交易，迄今结果相当不错。虽然没有做过精确计算，但我相信，整体而言，套利投资的税前年化回报率至少达到25%。我几乎确信1987年的回报率高于此数。不过必须强调，一两次特别糟糕的经历——就像许多套利业务在1987年末遭遇的那样——就可能让这些数字发生巨大变化。

1987.english:
Our only $50 million-plus arbitrage position at yearend 1987 was 1,096,200 shares of Allegis, with a cost of $76 million and a market value of $78 million.

o We had two other large holdings at yearend that do not fit precisely into any of our five categories.  One was various Texaco, Inc. bonds with short maturities, all purchased after Texaco went into bankruptcy.  Were it not for the extraordinarily strong capital position of our insurance companies, it would be inappropriate for us to buy defaulted bonds.  At prices prevailing after Texaco's bankruptcy filing, however, we regarded these issues as by far the most attractive bond investment available to us.
1987.chinese:
1987年末，我们唯一超过5,000万美元的套利头寸，是Allegis的1,096,200股股票，成本7,600万美元，市值7,800万美元。

**两项特殊持仓。** 年末我们还有两笔大型持仓，并不完全符合上述五个类别中的任何一种。其中一笔是德士古公司（Texaco）几种期限较短的债券，全部在德士古申请破产保护后买入。如果不是我们的保险公司拥有极其雄厚的资本，购买已经违约的债券对我们来说并不合适。但按照德士古破产申请之后的市场价格，我们认为这些债券是当时吸引力远超其他选择的债券投资。

1987.english:
On a worst-case basis with respect to the Pennzoil litigation, we felt the bonds were likely to be worth about what we paid for them.  Given a sensible settlement, which seemed likely, we expected the bonds to be worth considerably more.  At yearend our Texaco bonds were carried on our books at $104 million and had a market value of $119 million.

By far our largest - and most publicized - investment in 1987 was a $700 million purchase of Salomon Inc 9% preferred stock.  This preferred is convertible after three years into Salomon common stock at $38 per share and, if not converted, will be redeemed ratably over five years beginning October 31, 1995. From most standpoints, this commitment fits into the medium-term fixed-income securities category.  In addition, we have an interesting conversion possibility.
1987.chinese:
即使假设与Pennzoil诉讼有关的最坏情况，我们仍认为这些债券的价值很可能大致等于买入成本。如果能够达成合理和解——在我们看来这很可能——债券价值将高出成本不少。年末德士古债券在我们账上的价值为1.04亿美元，市值为1.19亿美元。

1987年我们规模最大、也最受公众关注的投资，是以7亿美元买入所罗门公司（Salomon Inc.）9%股息率的优先股。这些优先股三年后可以按每股38美元的价格转换为所罗门普通股；如果不转换，则从1995年10月31日起，分五年按比例赎回。大多数角度看，这笔投资属于中期固定收益证券，此外还附带一个有意思的转换权。

1987.english:
We, of course, have no special insights regarding the direction or future profitability of investment banking.  By their nature, the economics of this industry are far less predictable than those of most other industries in which we have major Commitments.  This unpredictability is one of the reasons why our participation is in the form of a convertible preferred.

What we do have a strong feeling about is the ability and integrity of John Gutfreund, CEO of Salomon Inc.  Charlie and I like, admire and trust John.  We first got to know him in 1976 when he played a key role in GEICO's escape from near-bankruptcy. Several times since, we have seen John steer clients away from transactions that would have been unwise, but that the client clearly wanted to make - even though his advice provided no fee to Salomon and acquiescence would have delivered a large fee. Such service-above-self behavior is far from automatic in Wall Street.
1987.chinese:
当然，我们对于投资银行业未来的发展方向和盈利能力，并没有特殊洞察。就其性质而言，这一行业的经济特性远不如我们主要投资的多数其他行业可预测。这种不可预测性，也是我们以可转换优先股形式参与的原因之一。

但对于所罗门首席执行官约翰·古特弗罗恩德的能力和正直品格，我们非常有信心。查理和我喜欢、敬佩并信任约翰。我们最初在1976年认识他，当时他在GEICO从濒临破产的局面中脱身的过程中发挥了重要作用。此后，我们多次看到约翰劝客户不要进行不明智的交易，即使客户明显很想做，而他的建议不会给所罗门带来任何手续费；如果顺从客户意愿，却能赚到大笔费用。这种把客户利益放在自己利益之上的行为，在华尔街远非理所当然。

1987.english:
For the reasons Charlie outlines on page 50, at yearend we valued our Salomon investment at 98% of par, $14 million less than our cost.  However, we believe there is a reasonable likelihood that a leading, high-quality capital-raising and market-making operation can average good returns on equity.  If so, our conversion right will eventually prove to be valuable.

Two further comments about our investments in marketable securities are appropriate.  First, we give you our usual warning: Our holdings have changed since yearend and will continue to do so without notice.
1987.chinese:
基于查理在第50页阐述的理由，年末我们将所罗门投资估值为面值的98%，比成本低1,400万美元。不过，我们认为，一家处于领先地位、品质优良的融资与做市机构，有相当可能取得不错的平均股东权益回报率。如果如此，我们拥有的转换权最终就会有价值。

关于可交易证券投资，还有两件事需要说明。第一，我们照例提醒各位：自年末以来，我们的持仓已经变化，而且还会继续变化，恕不另行通知。

1987.english: The second comment is related: During 1987, as in some earlier years, there was speculation in the press from time to time about our purchase or sale of various securities.  These stories were sometimes true, sometimes partially true, and other times completely untrue.  Interestingly, there has been no correlation between the size and prestige of the publication and the accuracy of the report.  One dead-wrong rumor was given considerable prominence by a major national magazine, and another leading publication misled its readers by writing about an arbitrage position as if it were a long-term investment commitment. (In not naming names, I am observing the old warning that it's not wise to pick fights with people who buy ink by the barrel.)
1987.chinese: 第二点与此有关：1987年和此前一些年份一样，媒体不时猜测伯克希尔正在买入或卖出某些证券。这些报道有时属实，有时部分属实，有时完全错误。有趣的是，刊物的规模和声誉与报道的准确性没有任何相关关系。一家全国性大杂志显著报道了一则完全错误的传言，另一家重要刊物则把我们的套利持仓错误地写成长期投资承诺。（这里不点名，是遵循一句古老忠告：不要随便与那些按桶购买印刷油墨的人吵架。）

1987.english:
You should understand that we simply don't comment in any way on rumors, whether they are true or false.  If we were to deny the incorrect reports and refuse comment on the correct ones, we would in effect be commenting on all.

In a world in which big investment ideas are both limited and valuable, we have no interest in telling potential competitors what we are doing except to the extent required by law.  We certainly don't expect others to tell us of their investment ideas.  Nor would we expect a media company to disclose news of acquisitions it was privately pursuing or a journalist to tell his competitors about stories on which he is working or sources he is using.
1987.chinese:
各位应当理解，无论传言是真是假，我们一律不发表评论。如果否认错误报道，却对正确报道拒绝置评，实际上就等于对所有传言作出了评论。

在重大投资机会既稀少又有价值的世界里，除法律要求外，我们无意向潜在竞争者透露自己的行动。我们当然也不会期待其他人告诉我们他们的投资想法。同样，我们也不会期待一家媒体公司公开正在秘密洽谈的收购，或者一名记者告诉竞争对手自己正在追踪的新闻或使用的消息来源。

1987.english: I find it uncomfortable when friends or acquaintances mention that they are buying X because it has been reported - incorrectly - that Berkshire is a buyer.  However, I do not set them straight.  If they want to participate in whatever Berkshire actually is buying, they can always purchase Berkshire stock. But perhaps that is too simple.  Usually, I suspect, they find it more exciting to buy what is being talked about.  Whether that strategy is more profitable is another question.
1987.chinese: 朋友或熟人偶尔告诉我，他们因为据称伯克希尔正在买入某只股票而也买入了它，而实际上有关报道是错误的。听到这种话，我会感到不自在，但也不会纠正他们。如果他们希望参与伯克希尔真正买入的东西，随时可以买伯克希尔股票。只不过，那样也许太简单了。我怀疑，他们通常觉得买入市场正在谈论的东西更刺激。至于这种策略是否更赚钱，则是另一回事。

1987.english:
Financing

Shortly after yearend, Berkshire sold two issues of debentures, totaling $250 million.  Both issues mature in 2018 and will be retired at an even pace through sinking fund operations that begin in 1999.  Our overall interest cost, after allowing for expenses of issuance, is slightly over 10%.  Salomon was our investment banker, and its service was excellent.

Despite our pessimistic views about inflation, our taste for debt is quite limited.  To be sure, it is likely that Berkshire could improve its return on equity by moving to a much higher, though still conventional, debt-to-business-value ratio.  It's even more likely that we could handle such a ratio, without problems, under economic conditions far worse than any that have prevailed since the early 1930s.
1987.chinese:
## 融资

年末不久，伯克希尔发行了两批债券，总额2.50亿美元。两批债券均在2018年到期，并从1999年开始通过偿债基金安排均匀偿还。计入发行费用后，我们的综合利息成本略高于10%。所罗门担任本次发行的投资银行，服务非常出色。

尽管我们对通胀持悲观观点，却非常克制地使用债务。当然，如果我们把债务相对企业价值的比例提高到更高、但仍属常见的水平，伯克希尔的股东权益回报率很可能会提高。而且，即使在比20世纪30年代初以来任何时候都更恶劣的经济环境下，我们很可能也可以毫无问题地承受这种债务比例。

1987.english:
But we do not wish it to be only likely that we can meet our obligations; we wish that to be certain.  Thus we adhere to policies - both in regard to debt and all other matters - that will allow us to achieve acceptable long-term results under extraordinarily adverse conditions, rather than optimal results under a normal range of conditions.

Good business or investment decisions will eventually produce quite satisfactory economic results, with no aid from leverage.  Therefore, it seems to us to be both foolish and improper to risk what is important (including, necessarily, the welfare of innocent bystanders such as policyholders and employees) for some extra returns that are relatively unimportant.  This view is not the product of either our advancing age or prosperity: Our opinions about debt have remained constant.
1987.chinese:
但我们希望自己能够履行义务，不只是“很可能”，而是“确定”。因此，在债务及所有其他事务上，我们都坚持采取一种政策：即使遭遇极端不利的环境，也能取得可以接受的长期结果，而不是只在通常环境下追求最优表现。

良好的企业经营或投资决策，最终不借助杠杆也能产生十分令人满意的经济结果。所以，为了一点相对不重要的额外收益，去冒险押上真正重要的东西（其中必然包括保户和员工等无辜旁观者的福祉），在我们看来既愚蠢又不适当。这种观点并不是年龄渐长或日渐富裕之后才产生的：我们对债务的看法始终没有改变。

1987.english: However, we are not phobic about borrowing. (We're far from believing that there is no fate worse than debt.) We are willing to borrow an amount that we believe - on a worst-case basis - will pose no threat to Berkshire's well-being.  Analyzing what that amount might be, we can look to some important strengths that would serve us well if major problems should engulf our economy: Berkshire's earnings come from many diverse and well- entrenched businesses; these businesses seldom require much capital investment; what debt we have is structured well; and we maintain major holdings of liquid assets.  Clearly, we could be comfortable with a higher debt-to-business-value ratio than we now have.
1987.chinese: 不过，我们并非对借债抱有恐惧症。（我们远非认为世上没有比欠债更糟的命运。）只要我们相信，即使按照最坏情况分析，某个借款规模也不会威胁伯克希尔的安稳，我们就愿意借入。估算这个规模时，可以考虑几项有助于我们在重大经济危机中维持实力的优势：伯克希尔的利润来自许多不同且根基稳固的企业；这些企业通常不需要大量资本投资；现有债务结构安排良好；我们还持有大量流动性资产。显然，即使债务与企业价值之比高于目前水平，我们也能放心。

1987.english: One further aspect of our debt policy deserves comment: Unlike many in the business world, we prefer to finance in anticipation of need rather than in reaction to it.  A business obtains the best financial results possible by managing both sides of its balance sheet well.  This means obtaining the highest-possible return on assets and the lowest-possible cost on liabilities.  It would be convenient if opportunities for intelligent action on both fronts coincided.  However, reason tells us that just the opposite is likely to be the case: Tight money conditions, which translate into high costs for liabilities, will create the best opportunities for acquisitions, and cheap money will cause assets to be bid to the sky.  Our conclusion:  Action on the liability side should sometimes be taken independent of any action on the asset side.
1987.chinese: 债务政策还有一个方面值得说明：与商界许多人不同，我们喜欢在需要资金之前就完成融资，而不是等需要资金时才采取行动。一家企业如果能够同时管理好资产负债表的两边，就能取得尽可能好的财务结果。这意味着在资产端争取尽可能高的回报，在负债端争取尽可能低的成本。如果这两方面的有利时机能够同时出现，当然很方便。但理性告诉我们，情况更可能恰恰相反：资金紧张、负债成本高昂的时候，往往会出现最好的收购机会；而资金便宜的时候，资产价格通常被抬得很高。因此，我们的结论是：有时负债端应该独立于资产端采取行动。

1987.english: Alas, what is "tight" and "cheap" money is far from clear at any particular time.  We have no ability to forecast interest rates and - maintaining our usual open-minded spirit - believe that no one else can.  Therefore, we simply borrow when conditions seem non-oppressive and hope that we will later find intelligent expansion or acquisition opportunities, which - as we have said - are most likely to pop up when conditions in the debt market are clearly oppressive.  Our basic principle is that if you want to shoot rare, fast-moving elephants, you should always carry a loaded gun.
1987.chinese: 遗憾的是，在任何特定时刻，究竟什么叫“资金紧张”，什么叫“资金便宜”，远非一目了然。我们没有预测利率的能力——保持一贯的开放态度，我们相信别人也没有。因此，只要融资条件看来并不苛刻，我们就借入资金，希望以后找到明智的扩张或收购机会；正如我们所说，这种机会最可能出现在债务市场条件明显苛刻的时候。我们的基本原则是：如果你想猎取罕见而行动迅速的大象，就应该始终带着上膛的猎枪。

1987.english: Our fund-first, buy-or-expand-later policy almost always penalizes near-term earnings.  For example, we are now earning about 6 1/2% on the $250 million we recently raised at 10%, a disparity that is currently costing us about $160,000 per week. This negative spread is unimportant to us and will not cause us to stretch for either acquisitions or higher-yielding short-term instruments.  If we find the right sort of business elephant within the next five years or so, the wait will have been worthwhile.
1987.chinese: 我们“先筹钱、后收购或扩张”的政策，几乎总会损害短期利润。例如，我们不久前以10%的成本借来的2.50亿美元，目前只能赚到约6.5%的收益；这一负利差每周让我们付出约16万美元。这点差额对我们并不重要，也不会促使我们勉强进行收购，或追逐收益率更高的短期投资工具。如果未来五年左右找到合适的企业“大象”，此前的等待就会物有所值。

1987.english:
Miscellaneous

We hope to buy more businesses that are similar to the ones we have, and we can use some help.  If you have a business that fits the following criteria, call me or, preferably, write.

Here's what we're looking for:

(1) large purchases (at least $10 million of after-tax earnings),

(2) demonstrated consistent earning power (future projections are of little interest to us, nor are "turnaround" situations),

(3) businesses earning good returns on equity while employing little or no debt,
1987.chinese:
## 其他事项

我们希望继续收购与现有业务相似的企业，也希望得到各位帮助。如果你拥有符合以下标准的企业，请打电话给我，或者更好的是给我写信。

我们的要求如下：

（1）规模较大的收购（税后利润至少1,000万美元）；

（2）已经证明具有持续稳定的盈利能力（我们对未来预测兴趣不大，也不考虑“扭亏为盈”的企业）；

（3）使用很少或不使用债务，却能够取得较高的股东权益回报率；

1987.english:
(4) management in place (we can't supply it),

(5) simple businesses (if there's lots of technology, we won't understand it),

(6) an offering price (we don't want to waste our time or that of the seller by talking, even preliminarily, about a transaction when price is unknown).

We will not engage in unfriendly takeovers.  We can promise complete confidentiality and a very fast answer - customarily within five minutes - as to whether we're interested.  We prefer to buy for cash, but will consider issuing stock when we receive as much in intrinsic business value as we give.  We invite potential sellers to check us out by contacting people with whom we have done business in the past.  For the right business - and the right people - we can provide a good home.
1987.chinese:
（4）已有管理团队（我们无法提供）；

（5）业务简单（技术成分太多，我们就不懂了）；

（6）明确的出售价格（如果价格还不清楚，我们不愿意在交易的初步谈判中浪费彼此的时间）。

我们不会进行敌意收购。我们保证完全保密，并且通常能在五分钟内迅速答复是否感兴趣。我们更愿意用现金购买，但只要收到的内在企业价值至少与交出的价值相当，也愿意考虑发行股票。我们邀请潜在卖方联系过去与我们交易过的人，了解我们。对于合适的企业和合适的人，我们可以提供一个很好的归宿。

1987.english:
On the other hand, we frequently get approached about acquisitions that don't come close to meeting our tests: new ventures, turnarounds, auction-like sales, and the ever-popular (among brokers) "I'm-sure-something-will-work-out-if-you-people- get-to-know-each-other." None of these attracts us in the least.

Besides being interested in the purchases of entire businesses as described above, we are also interested in the negotiated purchase of large, but not controlling, blocks of stock comparable to those we hold in Cap Cities and Salomon.  We have a special interest in purchasing convertible preferreds as a long-term investment, as we did at Salomon.
1987.chinese:
另一方面，我们经常接到完全不符合上述条件的收购提议：新创企业、扭亏转型企业、拍卖式出售，以及经纪人特别喜欢的那种“只要你们先认识一下，我确信总会有办法达成交易”。这些我们丝毫没有兴趣。

除了上述整体收购企业，我们也愿意通过协议购买金额很大、但不足以取得控制权的大宗股份，类似于我们持有的Capital Cities和所罗门股份。我们特别有兴趣以长期投资方式购买可转换优先股，就像收购所罗门优先股那样。

1987.english:
---

And now a bit of deja vu.  Most of Berkshire's major stockholders received their shares at yearend 1969 in a liquidating distribution from Buffett Partnership, Ltd.  Some of these former partners will remember that in 1962 I encountered severe managerial problems at Dempster Mill Manufacturing Co., a pump and farm implement manufacturing company that BPL controlled.

At that time, like now, I went to Charlie with problems that were too tough for me to solve.  Charlie suggested the solution might lie in a California friend of his, Harry Bottle, whose special knack was never forgetting the fundamental.  I met Harry in Los Angeles on April 17, 1962, and on April 23 he was in Beatrice, Nebraska, running Dempster.  Our problems disappeared almost immediately.  In my 1962 annual letter to partners, I named Harry "Man of the Year."
1987.chinese:
* * *

现在说一段似曾相识的往事。伯克希尔的大多数主要股东，最初是在1969年末巴菲特合伙企业清算分配时取得股份的。其中一些老合伙人大概还记得，1962年我在德姆普斯特磨坊制造公司（Dempster Mill Manufacturing Co.）遇到了严重的管理问题。那是一家生产泵和农业机械的企业，巴菲特合伙企业当时拥有其控制权。

当时，和现在一样，遇到自己解决不了的难题，我就去找查理。他建议，我们或许可以请加利福尼亚的一位朋友哈里·博特尔帮忙；哈里最大的本事，是永远不忘最根本的问题。1962年4月17日，我在洛杉矶见到哈里；4月23日，他就来到内布拉斯加州比阿特丽斯，开始管理德姆普斯特。我们的问题几乎立即消失。我在1962年致合伙人的年度信中，将哈里评为“年度人物”。

1987.english: Fade to 24 years later: The scene is K & W Products, a small Berkshire subsidiary that produces automotive compounds.  For years K & W did well, but in 1985-86 it stumbled badly, as it pursued the unattainable to the neglect of the achievable. Charlie, who oversees K & W, knew there was no need to consult me.  Instead, he called Harry, now 68 years old, made him CEO, and sat back to await the inevitable.  He didn't wait long.  In 1987 K & W's profits set a record, up more than 300% from 1986. And, as profits went up, capital employed went down: K & W's investment in accounts receivable and inventories has decreased 20%.
1987.chinese: 镜头淡出，24年之后重新亮起。场景变成K & W Products，这家伯克希尔的小型子公司生产汽车化工用品。多年来，K & W经营良好，但1985—1986年陷入困境，因为它忽视了能做到的事情，却一心追逐做不到的东西。主管K & W的查理知道没必要来问我，于是直接打电话给当时68岁的哈里，请他担任首席执行官，然后坐下来等待必然出现的结果。他没有等太久：1987年K & W利润创下纪录，比1986年增加超过300%。与此同时，利润增加，占用资本却下降：K & W投资在应收账款与存货上的资金减少了20%。

1987.english:
If we run into another managerial problem ten or twenty years down the road, you know whose phone will ring.

---

About 97.2% of all eligible shares participated in Berkshire's 1987 shareholder-designated contributions program. Contributions made through the program were $4.9 million, and 2,050 charities were recipients.

A recent survey reported that about 50% of major American companies match charitable contributions made by directors (sometimes by a factor of three to one).  In effect, these representatives of the owners direct funds to their favorite charities, and never consult the owners as to their charitable preferences. (I wonder how they would feel if the process were reversed and shareholders could invade the directors' pockets for charities favored by the shareholders.) When A takes money from B to give to C and A is a legislator, the process is called taxation.  But when A is an officer or director of a corporation, it is called philanthropy.  We continue to believe that contributions, aside from those with quite clear direct benefits to the company, should reflect the charitable preferences of owners rather than those of officers and directors.
1987.chinese:
今后十年或二十年如果再遇到管理问题，你们应该知道谁的电话会响起。

* * *

约97.2%的合资格股份参加了伯克希尔1987年的股东指定捐赠计划。该计划合计捐赠490万美元，受赠慈善机构共有2,050家。

最近一项调查指出，美国约50%的大型企业会为董事个人所作慈善捐赠提供等额配捐（有时高达三倍）。实际上，这意味着股东的代表把公司的钱捐给自己偏爱的慈善机构，却从不询问股东的慈善偏好。（不知道如果反过来，让股东从董事口袋里拿钱捐给自己喜欢的机构，董事们会作何感想。）当A从B那里拿钱给C，而A是一名立法者时，这个过程叫作征税；但当A是一名公司高管或董事时，它就叫慈善。我们依然认为，除非捐赠对公司具有清晰、直接的利益，否则捐赠应当体现所有者而非高管和董事的慈善偏好。

1987.english:
We urge new shareholders to read the description of our shareholder-designated contributions program that appears on pages 54 and 55.  If you wish to participate in future programs, we strongly urge that you immediately make sure your shares are registered in the name of the actual owner, not in "street" name or nominee name.  Shares not so registered on September 30, l988 will be ineligible for the 1988 program.

---

Last year we again had about 450 shareholders at our annual meeting.  The 60 or so questions they asked were, as always, excellent.  At many companies, the annual meeting is a waste of time because exhibitionists turn it into a sideshow.  Ours, however, is different.  It is informative for shareholders and fun for us. (At Berkshire's meetings, the exhibitionists are on the dais.)
1987.chinese:
我们建议新股东阅读年报第54—55页对股东指定捐赠计划的说明。如果希望参与今后的计划，请立即确保股份登记在实际所有人名下，而不是以经纪商代持或名义持有人名义登记。截至1988年9月30日仍未完成这一登记的股份，将无资格参加1988年的计划。

* * *

去年，伯克希尔股东大会再次吸引了大约450人参加。他们提出了约60个问题，和往常一样，都很精彩。许多公司的股东大会都在浪费时间，因为爱表现的人把大会变成了闹剧。但我们的大会不同：对股东有信息价值，对我们也很有趣。（在伯克希尔的大会上，爱表现的人都坐在主席台上。）

1987.english:
This year our meeting will be on May 23, 1988 in Omaha, and we hope that you come.  The meeting provides the forum for you to ask any owner-related questions you may have, and we will keep answering until all (except those dealing with portfolio activities or other proprietary information) have been dealt with.

Last year we rented two buses - for $100 - to take shareholders interested in the trip to the Furniture Mart.  Your actions demonstrated your good judgment: You snapped up about $40,000 of bargains.  Mrs. B regards this expense/sales ratio as on the high side and attributes it to my chronic inattention to costs and generally sloppy managerial practices.  But, gracious as always, she has offered me another chance and we will again have buses available following the meeting.  Mrs. B says you must beat last year's sales figures, and I have told her she won't be disappointed.

Warren E. Buffett February 29, 1988                         Chairman of the Board
1987.chinese:
今年的大会定于1988年5月23日在奥马哈举行，我们希望各位能来。大会为大家提供提出任何与企业所有者有关的问题的机会。我们会一直回答，直到全部相关问题都得到解答（涉及持仓操作或其他专有信息的问题除外）。

去年，我们花100美元租了两辆大巴，接送希望前往家具城的股东。各位的行动证明了自己的判断力：你们买到了约4万美元的实惠商品。B夫人认为这项支出与销售额之比偏高，并将其归咎于我长期不关心成本、管理粗枝大叶。不过，她一向宽宏大量，愿意再给我一次机会，所以我们今年会再次在大会后安排大巴。B夫人说，各位一定要打破去年的销售纪录；我已经告诉她，绝不会让她失望。

**沃伦·E·巴菲特**  
董事会主席  
**1988年2月29日**

1988.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Our gain in net worth during 1988 was $569 million, or 20.0%.  Over the last 24 years (that is, since present management took over), our per-share book value has grown from $19.46 to $2,974.52, or at a rate of 23.0% compounded annually.

We’ve emphasized in past reports that what counts, however, is intrinsic business value - the figure, necessarily an estimate, indicating what all of our constituent businesses are worth.  By our calculations, Berkshire’s intrinsic business value significantly exceeds its book value.  Over the 24 years, business value has grown somewhat faster than book value; in 1988, however, book value grew the faster, by a bit.
1988.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1988年，我们的净资产增加5.69亿美元，增幅20.0%。过去24年，也就是现任管理层接手以来，每股账面价值从19.46美元增至2,974.52美元，年复合增长率为23.0%。

不过，以往报告中我们强调过，真正重要的是企业内在价值，也就是估计我们全部组成业务究竟值多少钱的那个数字；它必然只能是估计值。按我们的计算，伯克希尔内在价值显著高于账面价值。24年来，企业价值增长略快于账面价值；不过，1988年是账面价值稍稍跑得更快。

1988.english:
Berkshire’s past rates of gain in both book value and business value were achieved under circumstances far different from those that now exist.  Anyone ignoring these differences makes the same mistake that a baseball manager would were he to judge the future prospects of a 42-year-old center fielder on the basis of his lifetime batting average.

Important negatives affecting our prospects today are: (1) a less attractive stock market than generally existed over the past 24 years; (2) higher corporate tax rates on most forms of investment income; (3) a far more richly-priced market for the acquisition of businesses; and (4) industry conditions for Capital Cities/ABC, Inc., GEICO Corporation, and The Washington Post Company - Berkshire’s three permanent investments, constituting about one-half of our net worth - that range from slightly to materially less favorable than those existing five to ten years ago.  All of these companies have superb management and strong properties.  But, at current prices, their upside potential looks considerably less exciting to us today than it did some years ago.
1988.chinese:
伯克希尔过去实现账面及企业价值增长时的环境，与如今大不相同。忽视这些差别，就像棒球队经理用一位42岁中外野手整个职业生涯的击球率，来判断他今后的前景，犯的是同一种错误。

如今影响我们前景的重要不利因素是：（1）股市吸引力不如过去24年大多数时候；（2）多数投资收入适用的公司税率提高；（3）收购企业的市场价格昂贵得多；（4）大都会／美国广播公司、GEICO与华盛顿邮报公司——这三项永久投资约占伯克希尔净资产一半——所处的行业环境，比五至十年前差，从略差到明显差都有。这些公司都有出色管理层和优质资产。但按当前价格，它们的上行潜力，在我们看来已远不如几年前那么令人兴奋。

1988.english:
The major problem we face, however, is a growing capital base.  You’ve heard that from us before, but this problem, like age, grows in significance each year. (And also, just as with age, it’s better to have this problem continue to grow rather than to have it “solved.”)

Four years ago I told you that we needed profits of $3.9 billion to achieve a 15% annual return over the decade then ahead.  Today, for the next decade, a 15% return demands profits of $10.3 billion.  That seems like a very big number to me and to Charlie Munger, Berkshire’s Vice Chairman and my partner. (Should that number indeed prove too big, Charlie will find himself, in future reports, retrospectively identified as the senior partner.)
1988.chinese:
不过，最大的难题还是不断扩大的资本基数。这话各位以前听我们说过，但这问题像年龄一样，年年更要紧。（也像年龄一样，宁愿让这问题继续长大，也不愿它被“解决”。）

四年前，我说过，随后十年要实现每年15%的回报，我们需要39亿美元利润。如今，未来十年的15%回报，需要103亿美元利润。伯克希尔副董事长、我的搭档查理·芒格和我，都觉得这数字大得很。（若事实证明它实在太大，今后的报告就会追溯性地把查理认定为资深合伙人。）

1988.english:
As a partial offset to the drag that our growing capital base exerts upon returns, we have a very important advantage now that we lacked 24 years ago.  Then, all our capital was tied up in a textile business with inescapably poor economic characteristics.  Today part of our capital is invested in some really exceptional businesses.

Last year we dubbed these operations the Sainted Seven: Buffalo News, Fechheimer, Kirby, Nebraska Furniture Mart, Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Group, See’s, and World Book.  In 1988 the Saints came marching in.  You can see just how extraordinary their returns on capital were by examining the historical-cost financial statements on page 45, which combine the figures of the Sainted Seven with those of several smaller units.  With no benefit from financial leverage, this group earned about 67% on average equity capital.
1988.chinese:
资本基数增长拖累回报，好在如今我们有一项24年前没有的重要优势，可以部分抵消。当时，全部资本都困在一家经济特性注定糟糕的纺织企业里；今天，部分资本已投进几家真正非凡的企业。

去年，我们把这些业务称为“神圣七杰”：布法罗新闻报、费希海默、柯比、内布拉斯加家具卖场、斯科特与费策制造集团、喜诗和世界图书。1988年，圣徒们列队进场。第45页按历史成本编制的财务报表，把七杰与几家较小单位合并列示；看看就知道，它们的资本回报有多非凡。在没有财务杠杆帮助的情况下，这组企业的平均股权资本回报约为67%。

1988.english:
In most cases the remarkable performance of these units arises partially from an exceptional business franchise; in all cases an exceptional management is a vital factor.  The contribution Charlie and I make is to leave these managers alone.

In my judgment, these businesses, in aggregate, will continue to produce superb returns.  We’ll need these: Without this help Berkshire would not have a chance of achieving our 15% goal.  You can be sure that our operating managers will deliver; the question mark in our future is whether Charlie and I can effectively employ the funds that they generate.
1988.chinese:
这些单位多数拥有非凡的经营优势，这是出色表现的部分来源；而在每一家，非凡的管理层都是关键。查理和我的贡献，是不去干扰他们。

依我判断，这组企业将继续取得出色回报。我们正需要它们：没有这份帮助，伯克希尔根本不可能达到15%的目标。经营经理人会交出成绩，这一点各位尽可放心；未来的问号，是查理和我能否有效运用他们产生的资金。

1988.english:
In that respect, we took a step in the right direction early in 1989 when we purchased an 80% interest in Borsheim’s, a jewelry business in Omaha.  This purchase, described later in this letter, delivers exactly what we look for: an outstanding business run by people we like, admire, and trust.  It’s a great way to start the year.

## Accounting Changes

We have made a significant accounting change that was mandated for 1988, and likely will have another to make in 1990. When we move figures around from year to year, without any change in economic reality, one of our always-thrilling discussions of accounting is necessary.
1988.chinese:
这方面，1989年初我们向正确方向迈出一步：买下奥马哈珠宝企业波仙珠宝（Borsheim’s）80%的股权。后文会介绍这项收购，它完全符合我们的要求：优秀企业，由我们喜欢、敬佩、信任的人经营。这样开年，再好不过。

## 会计变化

我们已作出一项1988年强制要求的重大会计变更，1990年很可能还得再改一项。既然经济实质没变，数字却在年与年之间搬来搬去，就少不了我们那种一向令人兴奋的会计讨论。

1988.english: First, I’ll offer my customary disclaimer: Despite the shortcomings of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), I would hate to have the job of devising a better set of rules. The limitations of the existing set, however, need not be inhibiting: CEOs are free to treat GAAP statements as a beginning rather than an end to their obligation to inform owners and creditors - and indeed they should.  After all, any manager of a subsidiary company would find himself in hot water if he reported barebones GAAP numbers that omitted key information needed by his boss, the parent corporation’s CEO.  Why, then, should the CEO himself withhold information vitally useful to his bosses - the shareholder-owners of the corporation?
1988.chinese: 首先照例声明：公认会计原则（GAAP）虽有缺点，我可不愿接下制定一套更好规则的差事。不过，现有规则的局限不必成为束缚：首席执行官完全可以，也确实应该，把GAAP报表当作向所有者与债权人提供信息的起点，而非终点。毕竟，任何子公司经理人若只报干巴巴的GAAP数字，省掉上司——母公司首席执行官——所需的关键信息，必定麻烦上身。那首席执行官本人，凭什么对自己的老板——公司股东所有者——隐瞒极有用的信息？

1988.english:
What needs to be reported is data - whether GAAP, non-GAAP, or extra-GAAP - that helps financially-literate readers answer three key questions: (1) Approximately how much is this company worth?  (2) What is the likelihood that it can meet its future obligations? and (3) How good a job are its managers doing, given the hand they have been dealt?

In most cases, answers to one or more of these questions are somewhere between difficult and impossible to glean from the minimum GAAP presentation.  The business world is simply too complex for a single set of rules to effectively describe economic reality for all enterprises, particularly those operating in a wide variety of businesses, such as Berkshire.
1988.chinese:
应当报告的数据，无论属于GAAP、非GAAP还是GAAP之外的补充资料，都应帮助具备财务知识的读者回答三个关键问题：（1）这家公司大约值多少？（2）它履行未来义务的可能性有多大？（3）考虑到手里发到的牌，经理人干得怎样？

多数情况下，只凭最低限度的GAAP披露，要找出其中一个或多个问题的答案，不是困难，就是不可能。商业世界太复杂，单一规则体系无法有效描绘所有企业的经济现实，像伯克希尔这样横跨多种业务的企业尤其如此。

1988.english: Further complicating the problem is the fact that many managements view GAAP not as a standard to be met, but as an obstacle to overcome.  Too often their accountants willingly assist them. (“How much,” says the client, “is two plus two?” Replies the cooperative accountant, “What number did you have in mind?”) Even honest and well-intentioned managements sometimes stretch GAAP a bit in order to present figures they think will more appropriately describe their performance.  Both the smoothing of earnings and the “big bath” quarter are “white lie” techniques employed by otherwise upright managements.
1988.chinese: 更复杂的是，许多管理层不把GAAP视为应达到的标准，而视为要越过的障碍。会计师往往还乐意助一臂之力。（客户问：“二加二等于多少？”配合默契的会计师答：“您心里想的是多少？”）即使诚实、善意的管理层，有时也会把GAAP拉伸一点，以列出他们认为更能描述业绩的数字。平滑利润和集中在一个季度“洗大澡”处理损失，都是原本正直的管理层所用的“善意谎言”技巧。

1988.english:
Then there are managers who actively use GAAP to deceive and defraud.  They know that many investors and creditors accept GAAP results as gospel.  So these charlatans interpret the rules “imaginatively” and record business transactions in ways that technically comply with GAAP but actually display an economic illusion to the world.

As long as investors - including supposedly sophisticated institutions - place fancy valuations on reported “earnings” that march steadily upward, you can be sure that some managers and promoters will exploit GAAP to produce such numbers, no matter what the truth may be.  Over the years, Charlie and I have observed many accounting-based frauds of staggering size.  Few of the perpetrators have been punished; many have not even been censured.  It has been far safer to steal large sums with a pen than small sums with a gun.
1988.chinese:
还有些经理人，主动利用GAAP欺骗、诈骗。他们知道，许多投资者与债权人把GAAP结果奉为真理。因此，这些骗子“富于想象地”解释规则，用技术上符合GAAP、实际却向世人展示经济幻象的方式，记录企业交易。

只要投资者，包括那些据说精明的机构，仍给稳步上升的报表“利润”以漂亮估值，就一定有经理人和推销者，不管实情如何，都利用GAAP造出这种数字。多年来，查理和我见过许多规模惊人的会计骗局。作恶者很少受罚，许多人甚至未受谴责。用笔偷巨款，远比拿枪抢小钱安全。

1988.english: Under one major change mandated by GAAP for 1988, we have been required to fully consolidate all our subsidiaries in our balance sheet and earnings statement.  In the past, Mutual Savings and Loan, and Scott Fetzer Financial (a credit company that primarily finances installment sales of World Book and Kirby products) were consolidated on a “one-line” basis.  That meant we (1) showed our equity in their combined net worths as a single- entry asset on Berkshire’s consolidated balance sheet and (2) included our equity in their combined annual earnings as a single-line income entry in our consolidated statement of earnings.  Now the rules require that we consolidate each asset and liability of these companies in our balance sheet and each item of their income and expense in our earnings statement.
1988.chinese: 1988年GAAP强制的一项重大变更，要求我们把全部子公司全面并入资产负债表和利润表。过去，互助储蓄与贷款协会，以及斯科特与费策金融——主要为世界图书和柯比产品的分期销售提供融资的信贷公司——按“单行”方式合并。也就是说：（1）在伯克希尔合并资产负债表中，把我们应享有的两家公司合计净资产列为一项资产；（2）在合并利润表中，把应享有的两家公司合计年度利润列为一项收入。如今，规则要求它们的每一项资产、负债都并入我们的资产负债表，每一项收入、费用都并入利润表。

1988.english:
This change underscores the need for companies also to report segmented data: The greater the number of economically diverse business operations lumped together in conventional financial statements, the less useful those presentations are and the less able investors are to answer the three questions posed earlier.  Indeed, the only reason we ever prepare consolidated figures at Berkshire is to meet outside requirements.  On the other hand, Charlie and I constantly study our segment data.

Now that we are required to bundle more numbers in our GAAP statements, we have decided to publish additional supplementary information that we think will help you measure both business value and managerial performance. (Berkshire’s ability to discharge its obligations to creditors - the third question we listed - should be obvious, whatever statements you examine.) In these supplementary presentations, we will not necessarily follow GAAP procedures, or even corporate structure.  Rather, we will attempt to lump major business activities in ways that aid analysis but do not swamp you with detail.  Our goal is to give you important information in a form that we would wish to get it if our roles were reversed.
1988.chinese:
这项变化凸显了公司同时披露分部数据的必要性：传统财务报表混在一起的经济性质不同的业务越多，报表越没用，投资者越难回答前述三个问题。事实上，我们在伯克希尔编制合并数字，唯一原因是满足外部要求。另一方面，查理和我始终研究分部数据。

既然GAAP报表如今必须捆进更多数字，我们决定公布额外补充资料，帮助各位衡量企业价值与管理表现。（无论看哪种报表，伯克希尔履行债权人义务的能力——我们列出的第三个问题——都应一目了然。）这些补充报表不一定遵循GAAP程序，甚至不一定依照公司组织架构；我们会把主要经营活动以有助分析的方式归并，同时不让细节把各位淹没。我们的目标，是用一种角色互换时自己也愿意收到的形式，提供重要信息。

1988.english: On pages 41-47 we show separate combined balance sheets and earnings statements for: (1) our subsidiaries engaged in finance- type operations, which are Mutual Savings and Scott Fetzer Financial; (2) our insurance operations, with their major investment positions itemized; (3) our manufacturing, publishing and retailing businesses, leaving aside certain non-operating assets and purchase-price accounting adjustments; and (4) an all- other category that includes the non-operating assets (primarily marketable securities) held by the companies in (3) as well as various assets and debts of the Wesco and Berkshire parent companies.
1988.chinese: 第41—47页分别列示以下四类业务的合并资产负债表与利润表：（1）从事金融类业务的子公司，即互助储蓄与贷款协会和斯科特与费策金融；（2）保险业务，其主要投资头寸逐项列出；（3）制造、出版与零售业务，剔除某些非经营性资产及收购价格会计调整；（4）其他全部项目，包括第（3）类企业持有的非经营性资产，主要是可上市交易证券，以及韦斯科、伯克希尔母公司的各种资产和债务。

1988.english:
If you combine the earnings and the net worths of these four segments, you will derive totals matching those shown on our GAAP statements.  However, we want to emphasize that our new presentation does not fall within the purview of our auditors, who in no way bless it. (In fact, they may be horrified; I don’t want to ask.)
