I referred earlier to a major change in GAAP that is expected in 1990.  This change relates to the calculation of deferred taxes, and is both complicated and controversial - so much so that its imposition, originally scheduled for 1989, was postponed for a year.
1988.chinese:
把这四类的利润和净资产相加，就会得到与GAAP报表一致的总额。不过要强调，新列报方式不在审计师审查范围内，他们没有给予任何认可。（事实上，他们可能吓坏了；我可不想问。）

前面提到，预计1990年GAAP会有一项重大变化，涉及递延税款的计算，既复杂又有争议，甚至使原定1989年实施的日期，推迟了一年。

1988.english:
When implemented, the new rule will affect us in various ways.  Most important, we will be required to change the way we calculate our liability for deferred taxes on the unrealized appreciation of stocks held by our insurance companies.

Right now, our liability is layered.  For the unrealized appreciation that dates back to 1986 and earlier years, $1.2 billion, we have booked a 28% tax liability.  For the unrealized appreciation built up since, $600 million, the tax liability has been booked at 34%.  The difference reflects the increase in tax rates that went into effect in 1987.
1988.chinese:
实施后，新规则会从多方面影响我们。最重要的是，我们必须改变保险公司持有股票未实现增值的递延所得税负债计算方式。

目前，这项负债分层计提。追溯到1986年及以前年度形成的12亿美元未实现增值，按28%计提税负；此后形成的6亿美元未实现增值，则按34%计提。差别反映了1987年开始生效的税率提高。

1988.english: It now appears, however, that the new accounting rule will require us to establish the entire liability at 34% in 1990, taking the charge against our earnings.  Assuming no change in tax rates by 1990, this step will reduce our earnings in that year (and thereby our reported net worth) by $71 million.  The proposed rule will also affect other items on our balance sheet, but these changes will have only a minor impact on earnings and net worth.
1988.chinese: 但如今看来，新会计规则会要求我们1990年把整项负债都按34%计提，并把费用计入利润。假设到1990年税率不变，这会使当年利润以及报表净资产减少7100万美元。拟议规则还会影响资产负债表的其他项目，但对利润与净资产的影响很小。

1988.english:
We have no strong views about the desirability of this change in calculation of deferred taxes.  We should point out, however, that neither a 28% nor a 34% tax liability precisely depicts economic reality at Berkshire since we have no plans to sell the stocks in which we have the great bulk of our gains.

To those of you who are uninterested in accounting, I apologize for this dissertation.  I realize that many of you do not pore over our figures, but instead hold Berkshire primarily because you know that: (1) Charlie and I have the bulk of our money in Berkshire; (2) we intend to run things so that your gains or losses are in direct proportion to ours; and (3) the record has so far been satisfactory.  There is nothing necessarily wrong with this kind of “faith” approach to investing.  Other shareholders, however, prefer an “analysis” approach and we want to supply the information they need.  In our own investing, we search for situations in which both approaches give us the same answer.
1988.chinese:
对改变递延税款计算方式是否可取，我们没有强烈看法。不过应指出，无论按28%还是34%计提，都无法精确描绘伯克希尔的经济现实，因为我们并无计划出售那些贡献了绝大部分增值的股票。

对不关心会计的股东，抱歉又作了这番长论。我知道，许多人并不细看数字，持有伯克希尔主要因为知道：（1）查理和我的大部分钱都在伯克希尔；（2）我们打算使各位的得失，与自己的得失成直接比例；（3）迄今记录令人满意。这种“信任式”投资本身没什么错。不过，另一些股东更喜欢“分析式”，我们希望提供他们需要的信息。自己投资时，我们寻找的，是两种方法都给出同一答案的情形。

1988.english:
## Sources of Reported Earnings

In addition to supplying you with our new four-sector accounting material, we will continue to list the major sources of Berkshire’s reported earnings just as we have in the past.

In the following table, amortization of Goodwill and other major purchase-price accounting adjustments are not charged against the specific businesses to which they apply but are instead aggregated and shown separately.  This procedure lets you view the earnings of our businesses as they would have been reported had we not purchased them.  I’ve explained in past reports why this form of presentation seems to us to be more useful to investors and managers than the standard GAAP presentation, which makes purchase-price adjustments on a business-by-business basis.  The total net earnings we show in the table are, of course, identical to the GAAP total in our audited financial statements.
1988.chinese:
## 报表利润的来源

除了新增的四类会计资料，我们会像以往一样，继续列示伯克希尔报表利润的主要来源。

下表没有把商誉摊销及其他重大收购价格会计调整，计入各项相关业务，而是集中单列。这使各位能看到，假如我们未收购这些企业，它们本会报告的利润。以往报告已解释过，为什么我们认为，这比GAAP逐项对企业进行收购价格调整的标准列示方式，对投资者与经理人更有用。当然，表中净利润总额，与经审计财务报表的GAAP总额完全相同。

1988.english: Further information about these businesses is given in the Business Segment section on pages 32-34, and in the Management’s Discussion section on pages 36-40.  In these sections you also will find our segment earnings reported on a GAAP basis.  For information on Wesco’s businesses, I urge you to read Charlie Munger’s letter, which starts on page 52.  It contains the best description I have seen of the events that produced the present savings-and-loan crisis.  Also, take special note of Dave Hillstrom’s performance at Precision Steel Warehouse, a Wesco subsidiary.  Precision operates in an extremely competitive industry, yet Dave consistently achieves good returns on invested capital.  Though data is lacking to prove the point, I think it is likely that his performance, both in 1988 and years past, would rank him number one among his peers.
1988.chinese: 第32—34页的业务分部资料和第36—40页的管理层讨论，还有这些企业的补充信息，也列出GAAP口径的分部利润。想了解韦斯科，请读从第52页开始的查理·芒格股东信。它对导致当前储蓄与贷款危机的事件，作出了我见过的最佳描述。另外，请特别关注韦斯科子公司精密钢铁仓储的戴夫·希尔斯特罗姆的表现。行业竞争极其激烈，他却始终取得良好投入资本回报。虽无数据证明，我仍觉得，他在1988年及往年的表现，很可能都能在同行中排第一。

1988.english:
*Excludes interest expense of Scott Fetzer Financial Group.

The earnings achieved by our operating businesses are superb, whether measured on an absolute basis or against those of their competitors.  For that we thank our operating managers: You and I are fortunate to be associated with them.

At Berkshire, associations like these last a long time.  We do not remove superstars from our lineup merely because they have attained a specified age - whether the traditional 65, or the 95 reached by Mrs. B on the eve of Hanukkah in 1988.  Superb managers are too scarce a resource to be discarded simply because a cake gets crowded with candles.  Moreover, our experience with newly-minted MBAs has not been that great.  Their academic records always look terrific and the candidates always know just what to say; but too often they are short on personal commitment to the company and general business savvy.  It’s difficult to teach a new dog old tricks.
1988.chinese:
*不包括斯科特与费策金融集团的利息费用。

无论按绝对数字，还是与对手相比，我们经营企业赚到的利润都很出色。为此要感谢经营经理人：各位和我能与他们合作，实在幸运。

这样的伙伴关系，在伯克希尔会持续很久。我们不会因为某位明星到了某个年龄，就把他撤出阵容，无论是传统的65岁，还是B夫人在1988年光明节前夕达到的95岁。出色经理人太稀缺，不能仅仅因为蛋糕上的蜡烛太挤，就把人扔掉。而且，我们用刚出炉MBA的经验，并不那么好。他们的学业记录总很漂亮，也总知道该说什么；但对公司的个人投入和全面的经营判断力，往往不足。教新狗学老把戏，也很难。

1988.english:
Here’s an update on our major non-insurance operations:

o At Nebraska Furniture Mart, Mrs. B (Rose Blumkin) and her cart roll on and on.  She’s been the boss for 51 years, having started the business at 44 with $500. (Think what she would have done with $1,000!) With Mrs. B, old age will always be ten years away.

The Mart, long the largest home furnishings store in the country, continues to grow.  In the fall, the store opened a detached 20,000 square foot Clearance Center, which expands our ability to offer bargains in all price ranges.
1988.chinese:
下面更新主要非保险业务的情况：

内布拉斯加家具卖场里，B夫人（罗丝·布卢姆金）和她的小车仍滚滚向前。她44岁时用500美元开业，至今当了51年老板。（想想如果给她1000美元，会干出什么！）对B夫人而言，老年永远还在十年以后。

卖场长期以来一直是全美最大的家居用品单店，如今仍在增长。秋天，它新开了一家独立的20,000平方英尺清仓中心，使我们能在各个价位提供更多便宜好货。

1988.english: Recently Dillard’s, one of the most successful department store operations in the country, entered the Omaha market.  In many of its stores, Dillard’s runs a full furniture department, undoubtedly doing well in this line.  Shortly before opening in Omaha, however, William Dillard, chairman of the company, announced that his new store would not sell furniture.  Said he, referring to NFM: “We don’t want to compete with them.  We think they are about the best there is.”
1988.chinese: 最近，美国最成功的百货公司之一迪拉德进入奥马哈。它的许多门店都有完整的家具部门，在这一业务上无疑做得不错。不过，奥马哈新店开业前不久，公司董事长威廉·迪拉德宣布，新店不卖家具。他谈到家具卖场时说：“我们不想与他们竞争。我们觉得，他们差不多就是最好的。”

1988.english: At the Buffalo News we extol the value of advertising, and our policies at NFM prove that we practice what we preach.  Over the past three years NFM has been the largest ROP advertiser in the Omaha World-Herald. (ROP advertising is the kind printed in the paper, as contrasted to the preprinted-insert kind.) In no other major market, to my knowledge, is a home furnishings operation the leading customer of the newspaper.  At times, we also run large ads in papers as far away as Des Moines, Sioux City and Kansas City - always with good results.  It truly does pay to advertise, as long as you have something worthwhile to offer.
1988.chinese: 我们在《布法罗新闻报》赞扬广告的价值，在家具卖场的政策则证明，自己也照着做。过去三年，家具卖场一直是《奥马哈世界先驱报》最大的ROP广告客户。（ROP指直接印在报纸版面上的广告，与预先印好再夹入报纸的广告不同。）据我所知，其他主要市场没有哪家家居企业，能成为报纸的头号客户。有时，我们也在远至得梅因、苏城及堪萨斯城的报纸刊登大幅广告，效果始终不错。只要确有值得购买的东西，做广告真的划算。

1988.english:
Mrs. B’s son, Louie, and his boys, Ron and Irv, complete the winning Blumkin team.  It’s a joy to work with this family.  All its members have character that matches their extraordinary abilities.

o Last year I stated unequivocally that pre-tax margins at The Buffalo News would fall in 1988.  That forecast would have proved correct at almost any other newspaper our size or larger. But Stan Lipsey - bless him - has managed to make me look foolish.
1988.chinese:
B夫人的儿子卢伊，以及他的儿子罗恩和欧文，共同组成这支获胜的布卢姆金队伍。与这家人合作，是件乐事。每个人的品格，都配得上非凡的能力。

去年，我明确断言，《布法罗新闻报》1988年的税前利润率会下降。换成几乎任何一家同等或更大规模的报纸，这预测都会正确。可斯坦·利普西——愿上天保佑他——偏偏让我显得很傻。

1988.english: Though we increased our prices a bit less than the industry average last year, and though our newsprint costs and wage rates rose in line with industry norms, Stan actually improved margins a tad.  No one in the newspaper business has a better managerial record.  He has achieved it, furthermore, while running a paper that gives readers an extraordinary amount of news.  We believe that our “newshole” percentage - the portion of the paper devoted to news - is bigger than that of any other dominant paper of our size or larger.  The percentage was 49.5% in 1988 versus 49.8% in 1987.  We are committed to keeping it around 50%, whatever the level or trend of profit margins.
1988.chinese: 去年我们的提价略低于行业平均，新闻纸成本和工资涨幅又与行业正常水平一致，斯坦却还是把利润率提高了一点。报业无人有比他更好的管理记录。而且，他经营的报纸，还给读者提供了超乎寻常的大量新闻。我们认为，用于新闻的版面比例，高于任何其他同等或更大规模的主导性报纸。1988年为49.5%，1987年为49.8%。不论利润率多高、趋势如何，我们都承诺保持在50%左右。

1988.english:
Charlie and I have loved the newspaper business since we were youngsters, and we have had great fun with the News in the 12 years since we purchased it.  We were fortunate to find Murray Light, a top-flight editor, on the scene when we arrived and he has made us proud of the paper ever since.

o See’s Candies sold a record 25.1 million pounds in 1988. Prospects did not look good at the end of October, but excellent Christmas volume, considerably better than the record set in 1987, turned the tide.
1988.chinese:
查理和我从小就喜欢报纸生意；收购《新闻报》12年来，我们享受了不少乐趣。接手时，现场已有一流编辑默里·莱特，实属幸运；此后他一直让我们为这份报纸自豪。

喜诗糖果1988年销售2510万磅，创下纪录。10月底前景还不妙，但圣诞节销量优异，远超1987年的纪录，扭转了局面。

1988.english:
As we’ve told you before, See’s business continues to become more Christmas-concentrated.  In 1988, the Company earned a record 90% of its full-year profits in December: $29 million out of $32.5 million before tax. (It’s enough to make you believe in Santa Claus.) December’s deluge of business produces a modest seasonal bulge in Berkshire’s corporate earnings.  Another small bulge occurs in the first quarter, when most World Book annuals are sold.

Charlie and I put Chuck Huggins in charge of See’s about five minutes after we bought the company.  Upon reviewing his record, you may wonder what took us so long.
1988.chinese:
正如以前说过，喜诗业务越来越集中于圣诞节。1988年，全年利润创纪录地有90%在12月赚到：全年税前3250万美元中，2900万美元来自12月。（足以让人相信圣诞老人确实存在。）12月蜂拥而来的生意，使伯克希尔整体利润出现一个小小的季节性高峰。第一季度还有另一个小高峰，因为世界图书年鉴大多在那时售出。

查理和我买下喜诗约五分钟后，就让查克·哈金斯负责。看过他的记录，各位也许会奇怪，我们怎么等了那么久。

1988.english: o At Fechheimer, the Heldmans - Bob, George, Gary, Roger and Fred - are the Cincinnati counterparts of the Blumkins.  Neither furniture retailing nor uniform manufacturing has inherently attractive economics.  In these businesses, only exceptional managements can deliver high returns on invested capital.  And that’s exactly what the five Heldmans do. (As Mets announcer Ralph Kiner once said when comparing pitcher Steve Trout to his father, Dizzy Trout, the famous Detroit Tigers pitcher: “There’s a lot of heredity in that family.”)
1988.chinese: 费希海默的赫尔德曼一家——鲍勃、乔治、加里、罗杰和弗雷德——就是辛辛那提的布卢姆金家族。家具零售和制服制造，本身都没有特别诱人的经济特性；只有非凡管理层，才能在这两门生意里取得高投入资本回报。五位赫尔德曼恰恰办到了。（大都会棒球队播音员拉尔夫·基纳，比较投手史蒂夫·特劳特和他的父亲、著名底特律老虎队投手迪齐·特劳特时说过：“这一家，遗传可真不少。”）

1988.english:
Fechheimer made a fairly good-sized acquisition in 1988. Charlie and I have such confidence in the business savvy of the Heldman family that we okayed the deal without even looking at it.  There are very few managements anywhere - including those running the top tier companies of the Fortune 500 - in which we would exhibit similar confidence.

Because of both this acquisition and some internal growth, sales at Fechheimer should be up significantly in 1989.
1988.chinese:
1988年，费希海默作了一次规模不小的收购。查理和我对赫尔德曼家族的生意判断力如此信任，连交易看都没看，就点头批准。无论哪里，包括《财富》500强中位居最前的公司，能让我们这样信任的管理层，也少得很。

有这项收购，加上一些内部增长，费希海默1989年的销售额应会显著增加。

1988.english:
o All of the operations managed by Ralph Schey - World Book, Kirby, and The Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Group - performed splendidly in 1988.  Returns on the capital entrusted to Ralph continue to be exceptional.

Within the Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Group, particularly fine progress was recorded at its largest unit, Campbell Hausfeld.  This company, the country’s leading producer of small and medium-sized air compressors, has more than doubled earnings since 1986.

Unit sales at both Kirby and World Book were up significantly in 1988, with export business particularly strong. World Book became available in the Soviet Union in September, when that country’s largest American book store opened in Moscow. Ours is the only general encyclopedia offered at the store.
1988.chinese:
拉尔夫·谢伊管理的全部业务——世界图书、柯比、斯科特与费策制造集团——1988年表现都出色。交给拉尔夫的资本，回报继续非同寻常。

斯科特与费策制造集团中，最大的单位坎贝尔·豪斯菲尔德，进展尤其好。它是全国领先的中小型空气压缩机生产商，自1986年以来，利润已增至两倍多。

柯比和世界图书1988年的单位销量都显著增长，出口尤其强劲。9月，苏联最大的美国图书商店在莫斯科开张，世界图书由此进入苏联。这家店提供的综合百科全书，只有我们这一套。

1988.english:
Ralph’s personal productivity is amazing: In addition to running 19 businesses in superb fashion, he is active at The Cleveland Clinic, Ohio University, Case Western Reserve, and a venture capital operation that has spawned sixteen Ohio-based companies and resurrected many others.  Both Ohio and Berkshire are fortunate to have Ralph on their side.

Borsheim’s

It was in 1983 that Berkshire purchased an 80% interest in The Nebraska Furniture Mart.  Your Chairman blundered then by neglecting to ask Mrs. B a question any schoolboy would have thought of: “Are there any more at home like you?” Last month I corrected the error: We are now 80% partners with another branch of the family.
1988.chinese:
拉尔夫的个人生产率令人惊叹：除了出色地经营19家企业，他还积极参与克利夫兰诊所、俄亥俄大学、凯斯西储大学，以及一家风险投资机构的事务；后者已在俄亥俄州催生十六家公司，并使其他许多企业复苏。俄亥俄州和伯克希尔，能有拉尔夫站在自己一边，都是幸运。

## 波仙珠宝（Borsheim’s）

1983年，伯克希尔买下内布拉斯加家具卖场80%的股权。当时各位的董事长犯了个错，忘了问B夫人一个小学生都想得到的问题：“家里还有像您这样的人吗？”上个月，我纠正了这个错误：如今，我们又与家族的另一支合作，持有80%股权。

1988.english: After Mrs. B came over from Russia in 1917, her parents and five siblings followed. (Her two other siblings had preceded her.) Among the sisters was Rebecca Friedman who, with her husband, Louis, escaped in 1922 to the west through Latvia in a journey as perilous as Mrs. B’s earlier odyssey to the east through Manchuria.  When the family members reunited in Omaha they had no tangible assets.  However, they came equipped with an extraordinary combination of brains, integrity, and enthusiasm for work - and that’s all they needed.  They have since proved themselves invincible.
1988.chinese: B夫人1917年从俄国来到美国，随后父母和五位兄弟姐妹也来了。（另两位兄弟姐妹，比她先到。）其中一位姐妹丽贝卡·弗里德曼，与丈夫路易斯在1922年经拉脱维亚向西逃出；旅程的危险，不亚于B夫人早年经满洲向东的那次长途跋涉。全家在奥马哈团聚时，没有有形资产，却带着非凡的头脑、诚信与工作热情；需要的也就这些。后来事实证明，他们无往不利。

1988.english:
In 1948 Mr. Friedman purchased Borsheim’s, a small Omaha jewelry store.  He was joined in the business by his son, Ike, in 1950 and, as the years went by, Ike’s son, Alan, and his sons-in- law, Marvin Cohn and Donald Yale, came in also.

You won’t be surprised to learn that this family brings to the jewelry business precisely the same approach that the Blumkins bring to the furniture business.  The cornerstone for both enterprises is Mrs. B’s creed: “Sell cheap and tell the truth.” Other fundamentals at both businesses are: (1) single store operations featuring huge inventories that provide customers with an enormous selection across all price ranges, (2) daily attention to detail by top management, (3) rapid turnover, (4) shrewd buying, and (5) incredibly low expenses.  The combination of the last three factors lets both stores offer everyday prices that no one in the country comes close to matching.
1988.chinese:
1948年，弗里德曼先生买下奥马哈的小珠宝店波仙。儿子艾克1950年加入，此后艾克的儿子艾伦，以及女婿马文·科恩、唐纳德·耶尔，也陆续进入企业。

各位不会惊讶：这个家族经营珠宝，方法与布卢姆金家族经营家具一模一样。两家企业的基石，都是B夫人的信条：“卖得便宜，说实话。”其他共同的基本做法是：（1）只开一家店，存货庞大，让顾客在所有价位都有极广的选择；（2）最高管理层每天关注细节；（3）周转快；（4）采购精明；（5）费用低得难以置信。后三项结合，使两家店都能天天提供全国无人接近的低价。

1988.english:
Most people, no matter how sophisticated they are in other matters, feel like babes in the woods when purchasing jewelry. They can judge neither quality nor price.  For them only one rule makes sense: If you don’t know jewelry, know the jeweler.

I can assure you that those who put their trust in Ike Friedman and his family will never be disappointed.  The way in which we purchased our interest in their business is the ultimate testimonial.  Borsheim’s had no audited financial statements; nevertheless, we didn’t take inventory, verify receivables or audit the operation in any way.  Ike simply told us what was so - - and on that basis we drew up a one-page contract and wrote a large check.
1988.chinese:
多数人，无论在其他事情上多精明，买珠宝时都像初入森林的孩子，质量与价格都不会判断。对他们而言，只有一条规则有道理：如果不懂珠宝，就得了解卖珠宝的人。

我可以保证，信任艾克·弗里德曼及其家人的人，绝不会失望。我们买入股权的方式，就是最高的背书。波仙没有经审计财报，我们却仍没盘点存货、核实应收账款，也未以任何方式审计经营。艾克只把实情告诉我们，我们便据此拟了一页合同，开出一张大支票。

1988.english:
Business at Borsheim’s has mushroomed in recent years as the reputation of the Friedman family has spread.  Customers now come to the store from all over the country.  Among them have been some friends of mine from both coasts who thanked me later for getting them there.

Borsheim’s new links to Berkshire will change nothing in the way this business is run.  All members of the Friedman family will continue to operate just as they have before; Charlie and I will stay on the sidelines where we belong.  And when we say “all members,” the words have real meaning.  Mr. and Mrs. Friedman, at 88 and 87, respectively, are in the store daily.  The wives of Ike, Alan, Marvin and Donald all pitch in at busy times, and a fourth generation is beginning to learn the ropes.
1988.chinese:
随着弗里德曼家族声誉传播，波仙近年生意飞速增长。顾客如今从全国各地赶来，包括我在东西两岸的一些朋友；他们后来还为我的引荐道谢。

与伯克希尔结缘，不会改变波仙的经营方式。弗里德曼全家会照旧做事，查理和我则留在自己该待的场边。我们说“全家”，可是真话：弗里德曼先生88岁、夫人87岁，仍天天在店。艾克、艾伦、马文与唐纳德的妻子，忙时都来帮忙，第四代也已开始学艺。

1988.english:
It is great fun to be in business with people you have long admired.  The Friedmans, like the Blumkins, have achieved success because they have deserved success.  Both families focus on what’s right for the customer and that, inevitably, works out well for them, also.  We couldn’t have better partners.

1988.chinese:
与长久以来钦佩的人一起做生意，乐趣无穷。弗里德曼和布卢姆金两家都成功，因为他们值得成功。两家都把心思放在对顾客正确的事上，这也必然使他们自己得到好结果。再没有更好的合伙人了。

## 保险业务

下面更新惯常列示的保险行业关键数字：

**保险行业关键数字（变化率及通胀率单位：%；综合成本率按原文数值）**

| 年份 | 签单保费同比变化 | 计入保单持有人红利后的法定综合成本率 | 已发生赔款同比变化 | GNP平减指数通胀率 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1981 | 3.8 | 106.0 | 6.5 | 9.6 |
| 1982 | 3.7 | 109.6 | 8.4 | 6.4 |
| 1983 | 5.0 | 112.0 | 6.8 | 3.8 |
| 1984 | 8.5 | 118.0 | 16.9 | 3.7 |
| 1985 | 22.1 | 116.3 | 16.1 | 3.2 |
| 1986 | 22.2 | 108.0 | 13.5 | 2.7 |
| 1987 | 9.4 | 104.6 | 7.8 | 3.3 |
| 1988（估计） | 3.9 | 105.4 | 4.2 | 3.6 |

1988.english:
Source: A.M. Best Co.

The combined ratio represents total insurance costs (losses incurred plus expenses) compared to revenue from premiums: A ratio below 100 indicates an underwriting profit, and one above 100 indicates a loss.  When the investment income that an insurer earns from holding on to policyholders’ funds (“the float”) is taken into account, a combined ratio in the 107-111 range typically produces an overall break-even result, exclusive of earnings on the funds provided by shareholders.
1988.chinese:
资料来源：A.M. Best Co.。

综合成本率，是保险成本总额（已发生赔款加费用）与保费收入的比率：低于100表示承保盈利，高于100表示亏损。考虑保险公司持有保单持有人资金——即“浮存金”——赚取的投资收入后，综合成本率处于107—111时，通常可实现整体盈亏平衡，不包括股东提供资金所赚的收益。

1988.english: For the reasons laid out in previous reports, we expect the industry’s incurred losses to grow by about 10% annually, even in years when general inflation runs considerably lower.  If premium growth meanwhile materially lags that 10% rate, underwriting losses will mount, though the industry’s tendency to underreserve when business turns bad may obscure their size for a time.  As the table shows, the industry’s underwriting loss grew in 1988. This trend is almost certain to continue - and probably will accelerate - for at least two more years.
1988.chinese: 理由已在以往报告中说明：即使一般通胀率远低于10%，我们仍预计行业已发生赔款每年增长约10%。若保费增速显著落后于这10%，承保亏损会增加，尽管行业在生意转坏时倾向少提准备金，可能暂时掩盖亏损规模。表中可见，1988年行业承保亏损增加。这种趋势几乎肯定至少再持续两年，而且很可能加速。

1988.english:
The property-casualty insurance industry is not only subnormally profitable, it is subnormally popular. (As Sam Goldwyn philosophized: “In life, one must learn to take the bitter with the sour.”) One of the ironies of business is that many relatively-unprofitable industries that are plagued by inadequate prices habitually find themselves beat upon by irate customers even while other, hugely profitable industries are spared complaints, no matter how high their prices.

Take the breakfast cereal industry, whose return on invested capital is more than double that of the auto insurance industry (which is why companies like Kellogg and General Mills sell at five times book value and most large insurers sell close to book).  The cereal companies regularly impose price increases, few of them related to a significant jump in their costs.  Yet not a peep is heard from consumers.  But when auto insurers raise prices by amounts that do not even match cost increases, customers are outraged.  If you want to be loved, it’s clearly better to sell high-priced corn flakes than low-priced auto insurance.
1988.chinese:
财产及意外责任保险业不仅利润低于正常水平，受欢迎程度也低于正常。（正如萨姆·戈德温的人生哲学：“人生必须学会，吃苦的时候，也得把酸的一起咽下。”）商界一大讽刺是：许多因价格不足而利润较低的行业，经常遭愤怒顾客围攻；另一些利润极丰厚的行业，无论价格多高，反倒无人抱怨。

以早餐谷物行业为例，它的投入资本回报，是汽车保险业的两倍多；这也解释了为何家乐氏、通用磨坊这类公司的股价是账面价值五倍，而多数大型保险公司只接近账面价值。谷物公司经常提价，很少与成本显著上涨有关，消费者却一声不吭。汽车保险公司提价，连成本增幅都赶不上，顾客反倒怒不可遏。想讨人喜欢，显然卖高价玉米片，比卖低价汽车保险更好。

1988.english: The antagonism that the public feels toward the industry can have serious consequences: Proposition 103, a California initiative passed last fall, threatens to push auto insurance prices down sharply, even though costs have been soaring.  The price cut has been suspended while the courts review the initiative, but the resentment that brought on the vote has not been suspended: Even if the initiative is overturned, insurers are likely to find it tough to operate profitably in California. (Thank heavens the citizenry isn’t mad at bonbons: If Proposition 103 applied to candy as well as insurance, See’s would be forced to sell its product for $5.76 per pound. rather than the $7.60 we charge - and would be losing money by the bucketful.)
1988.chinese: 公众对行业的敌意，可能有严重后果。去年秋天加州通过的公投提案103，威胁大幅压低汽车保险价格，尽管成本一直飞涨。法院审查期间，降价暂缓执行，但促成投票的怨气可没有暂缓。即使提案被推翻，保险公司在加州想盈利也会艰难。（谢天谢地，市民没恨上糖果：若提案103也适用于糖果，喜诗就得每磅卖5.76美元，而非现在的7.60美元，会一桶桶地亏钱。）

1988.english: The immediate direct effects on Berkshire from the initiative are minor, since we saw few opportunities for profit in the rate structure that existed in California prior to the vote.  However, the forcing down of prices would seriously affect GEICO, our 44%-owned investee, which gets about 10% of its premium volume from California.  Even more threatening to GEICO is the possibility that similar pricing actions will be taken in other states, through either initiatives or legislation.
1988.chinese: 提案对伯克希尔眼前的直接影响很小，因为在投票前的加州费率结构下，我们本就看不到多少盈利机会。不过，强行压价，会严重影响我们持股44%的GEICO；它约10%的保费来自加州。更大的威胁，是其他州也可能通过公投或立法，采取类似定价措施。

1988.english: If voters insist that auto insurance be priced below cost, it eventually must be sold by government.  Stockholders can subsidize policyholders for a short period, but only taxpayers can subsidize them over the long term.  At most property-casualty companies, socialized auto insurance would be no disaster for shareholders.  Because of the commodity characteristics of the industry, most insurers earn mediocre returns and therefore have little or no economic goodwill to lose if they are forced by government to leave the auto insurance business.  But GEICO, because it is a low-cost producer able to earn high returns on equity, has a huge amount of economic goodwill at risk.  In turn, so do we.
1988.chinese: 若选民坚持汽车保险价格低于成本，最终就只能由政府来卖。股东可以短期补贴投保人，长期却只有纳税人能补贴。对多数财产及意外责任保险公司的股东，汽车保险社会化并非灾难：由于行业同质化商品特性，多数公司回报平庸，若被政府迫退出汽车保险，几乎没有经济商誉可损失。但GEICO成本低、股东权益回报高，面临风险的经济商誉极大；我们自然也一样。

1988.english: At Berkshire, in 1988, our premium volume continued to fall, and in 1989 we will experience a large decrease for a special reason: The contract through which we receive 7% of the business of Fireman’s Fund expires on August 31.  At that time, we will return to Fireman’s Fund the unearned premiums we hold that relate to the contract.  This transfer of funds will show up in our “premiums written” account as a negative $85 million or so and will make our third-quarter figures look rather peculiar. However, the termination of this contract will not have a significant effect on profits.
1988.chinese: 伯克希尔1988年保费总额继续下降，1989年还会因一个特殊原因大幅减少：我们分得消防员基金7%业务的合同，将于8月31日到期。届时，所持与合同相关的未到期保费，将退还消防员基金。这笔资金转移，会在“签单保费”科目里体现为约负8500万美元，使第三季度数字显得古怪；不过，合同终止对利润不会有重大影响。

1988.english:
Berkshire’s underwriting results continued to be excellent in 1988.  Our combined ratio (on a statutory basis and excluding structured settlements and financial reinsurance) was 104. Reserve development was favorable for the second year in a row, after a string of years in which it was very unsatisfactory. Details on both underwriting and reserve development appear on pages 36-38.

Our insurance volume over the next few years is likely to run very low, since business with a reasonable potential for profit will almost certainly be scarce.  So be it.  At Berkshire, we simply will not write policies at rates that carry the expectation of economic loss.  We encounter enough troubles when we expect a gain.
1988.chinese:
伯克希尔1988年的承保结果继续出色。综合成本率按法定口径、剔除结构化赔付及金融再保险，为104。此前连续多年赔款准备金后续发展很不理想，如今已连续第二年有利。承保与准备金后续发展的详情，见第36—38页。

未来几年，保险业务量可能很低，因为有合理获利潜力的业务几乎肯定稀少。那就如此吧。在伯克希尔，我们绝不按预期会经济亏损的费率签保单。预期赚钱时，碰到的麻烦已经够多。

1988.english: Despite - or perhaps because of - low volume, our profit picture during the next few years is apt to be considerably brighter than the industry’s.  We are sure to have an exceptional amount of float compared to premium volume, and that augurs well for profits.  In 1989 and 1990 we expect our float/premiums ratio to be at least three times that of the typical property/casualty company.  Mike Goldberg, with special help from Ajit Jain, Dinos Iordanou, and the National Indemnity managerial team, has positioned us well in that respect.
1988.chinese: 虽然业务量低，也许正因为如此，未来几年我们的利润前景，可能比行业亮丽得多。相对保费总额，我们必定拥有异常多的浮存金，这对利润有利。1989及1990年，我们预计浮存金／保费比率至少为典型财产及意外责任保险公司的三倍。迈克·戈德伯格在阿吉特·贾因、迪诺斯·约尔达努及国民赔偿管理团队特别协助下，为此布好了局。

1988.english: At some point - we don’t know when - we will be deluged with insurance business.  The cause will probably be some major physical or financial catastrophe.  But we could also experience an explosion in business, as we did in 1985, because large and increasing underwriting losses at other companies coincide with their recognition that they are far underreserved. in the meantime, we will retain our talented professionals, protect our capital, and try not to make major mistakes.
1988.chinese: 未来某个时候，具体何时不知道，保险业务会向我们蜂拥而来，起因很可能是某场重大灾害或金融灾难。但也可能像1985年一样，其他公司承保亏损大且持续增长，又同时承认准备金远远不足，从而让我们业务爆发。在此之前，我们会留住优秀专业人员，保护资本，努力不犯大错。

1988.english:
## Marketable Securities

In selecting marketable securities for our insurance companies, we can choose among five major categories: (1) long- term common stock investments, (2) medium-term fixed-income securities, (3) long-term fixed-income securities, (4) short-term cash equivalents, and (5) short-term arbitrage commitments.

We have no particular bias when it comes to choosing from these categories. We just continuously search among them for the highest after-tax returns as measured by “mathematical expectation,” limiting ourselves always to investment alternatives we think we understand.  Our criteria have nothing to do with maximizing immediately reportable earnings; our goal, rather, is to maximize eventual net worth.
1988.chinese:
## 可上市交易证券

为保险公司挑选可上市交易证券时，我们可从五大类选择：（1）长期普通股投资；（2）中期固定收益证券；（3）长期固定收益证券；（4）短期现金等价物；（5）短期套利投资。

在这些类别之间，我们没有特别偏好，只是不断寻找按“数学期望”衡量税后回报最高的选择，始终限于自己认为理解的投资。标准与最大化眼下可列报利润无关；目标是最大化最终净资产。

下表列出价值超过1亿美元的普通股持仓，不包括后文讨论的套利投资。其中少量投资属于伯克希尔持股不足100%的子公司。

**普通股持仓（成本及市值单位：千美元；股数按原文；含子公司少数股东的少量权益）**

1988.english:
*Although  nominally a preferred stock, this security is financially equivalent to a common stock.

Our permanent holdings - Capital Cities/ABC, Inc., GEICO Corporation, and The Washington Post Company - remain unchanged. Also unchanged is our unqualified admiration of their managements: Tom Murphy and Dan Burke at Cap Cities, Bill Snyder and Lou Simpson at GEICO, and Kay Graham and Dick Simmons at The Washington Post.  Charlie and I appreciate enormously the talent and integrity these managers bring to their businesses.
1988.chinese:
*虽然名义上是优先股，这种证券在财务上相当于普通股。

我们的永久持股——大都会／美国广播公司、GEICO及华盛顿邮报——没有变化。对管理层毫无保留的赞赏，也一样没变：大都会的汤姆·墨菲、丹·伯克，GEICO的比尔·斯奈德、卢·辛普森，华盛顿邮报的凯·格雷厄姆、迪克·西蒙斯。查理和我极其珍视他们带给企业的才干与诚信。

1988.english:
Their performance, which we have observed at close range, contrasts vividly with that of many CEOs, which we have fortunately observed from a safe distance.  Sometimes these CEOs clearly do not belong in their jobs; their positions, nevertheless, are usually secure.  The supreme irony of business management is that it is far easier for an inadequate CEO to keep his job than it is for an inadequate subordinate.

If a secretary, say, is hired for a job that requires typing ability of at least 80 words a minute and turns out to be capable of only 50 words a minute, she will lose her job in no time. There is a logical standard for this job; performance is easily measured; and if you can’t make the grade, you’re out. Similarly, if new sales people fail to generate sufficient business quickly enough, they will be let go.  Excuses will not be accepted as a substitute for orders.
1988.chinese:
我们近距离观察他们的表现；与此鲜明对照的，是许多首席执行官的表现——幸好，我们在安全距离之外观察。有些首席执行官显然不适任，职位却通常牢不可破。企业管理最大的讽刺，是不称职的首席执行官，比不称职的下属容易保住饭碗得多。

比如，某秘书受聘的岗位要求每分钟至少打80个单词，结果只能打50个，很快就会失业。这份工作有合理标准，表现易于衡量，不达标就走人。同样，新销售人员若不能足够快地带来足量生意，就会被辞退；借口不能代替订单。

1988.english:
However, a CEO who doesn’t perform is frequently carried indefinitely.  One reason is that performance standards for his job seldom exist.  When they do, they are often fuzzy or they may be waived or explained away, even when the performance shortfalls are major and repeated.  At too many companies, the boss shoots the arrow of managerial performance and then hastily paints the bullseye around the spot where it lands.

Another important, but seldom recognized, distinction between the boss and the foot soldier is that the CEO has no immediate superior whose performance is itself getting measured. The sales manager who retains a bunch of lemons in his sales force will soon be in hot water himself.  It is in his immediate self-interest to promptly weed out his hiring mistakes. Otherwise, he himself may be weeded out.  An office manager who has hired inept secretaries faces the same imperative.
1988.chinese:
可是，没成绩的首席执行官却常被无限期养着。原因之一，是他的工作很少有业绩标准；即使有，也常含糊不清，或即便业绩重大而反复地不达标，也能豁免、解释过去。太多公司里，老板先把管理业绩之箭射出去，再赶紧围着落点画靶心。

老板与基层还有一个重要、却鲜有人认识的区别：首席执行官没有一个自身业绩也正受考核的直接上司。销售经理若留着一堆不中用的销售员，很快自己也会有麻烦。赶快剔除招聘错误，直接符合他的自身利益，否则他本人也可能被剔除。雇了无能秘书的办公室经理，同样非处理不可。

1988.english:
But the CEO’s boss is a Board of Directors that seldom measures itself and is infrequently held to account for substandard corporate performance.  If the Board makes a mistake in hiring, and perpetuates that mistake, so what?  Even if the company is taken over because of the mistake, the deal will probably bestow substantial benefits on the outgoing Board members. (The bigger they are, the softer they fall.)

Finally, relations between the Board and the CEO are expected to be congenial.  At board meetings, criticism of the CEO’s performance is often viewed as the social equivalent of belching.  No such inhibitions restrain the office manager from critically evaluating the substandard typist.
1988.chinese:
首席执行官的老板却是董事会，它很少衡量自己，也很少为公司业绩不佳被追责。招聘犯错还一错再错，又怎样？即使公司因此被收购，交易大概还会给离任董事丰厚好处。（位置越高，摔下来垫得越软。）

最后，人们期待董事会与首席执行官相处融洽。董事会上，批评首席执行官业绩，往往在社交上等同于打嗝。办公室经理批评不达标的打字员，可没有这层顾忌。

1988.english:
These points should not be interpreted as a blanket condemnation of CEOs or Boards of Directors: Most are able and hard-working, and a number are truly outstanding.  But the management failings that Charlie and I have seen make us thankful that we are linked with the managers of our three permanent holdings.  They love their businesses, they think like owners, and they exude integrity and ability.

o In 1988 we made major purchases of Federal Home Loan Mortgage Pfd. (“Freddie Mac”) and Coca Cola.  We expect to hold these securities for a long time.  In fact, when we own portions of outstanding businesses with outstanding managements, our favorite holding period is forever.  We are just the opposite of those who hurry to sell and book profits when companies perform well but who tenaciously hang on to businesses that disappoint. Peter Lynch aptly likens such behavior to cutting the flowers and watering the weeds.  Our holdings of Freddie Mac are the maximum allowed by law, and are extensively described by Charlie in his letter.  In our consolidated balance sheet these shares are carried at cost rather than market, since they are owned by Mutual Savings and Loan, a non-insurance subsidiary.
1988.chinese:
这些话并非全盘谴责首席执行官或董事会：大多数人能干、勤奋，不少真正杰出。但查理和我目睹的管理失败，使我们格外感激能与三家永久持股公司的经理人合作。他们热爱企业，像所有者思考，浑身透着诚信与能力。

1988年，我们大量买入联邦住房贷款抵押公司优先股（房地美，Freddie Mac）及可口可乐，预计长期持有。事实上，拥有由优秀管理层经营的优秀企业的一部分时，我们最喜欢的持有期限，是永远。企业表现好就赶紧卖出记利润，表现令人失望却死抱不放的人，与我们正相反。彼得·林奇把这种做法比作拔掉鲜花、浇灌杂草，十分贴切。我们持有房地美的数量，已达法律允许上限，查理的信中有详尽说明。由于这些股票属于非保险子公司互助储蓄与贷款协会，合并资产负债表按成本而非市价列示。

1988.english:
We continue to concentrate our investments in a very few companies that we try to understand well.  There are only a handful of businesses about which we have strong long-term convictions.  Therefore, when we find such a business, we want to participate in a meaningful way.  We agree with Mae West: “Too much of a good thing can be wonderful.”

o We reduced our holdings of medium-term tax-exempt bonds by about $100 million last year.  All of the bonds sold were acquired after August 7, 1986. When such bonds are held by property-casualty insurance companies, 15% of the “tax-exempt” interest earned is subject to tax.
1988.chinese:
我们继续把投资集中在极少几家努力深入了解的公司。让我们对长期前景有强烈信心的企业，只有屈指可数的几家。因此，一旦找到，我们就想有分量地参与。我们赞同梅·韦斯特：“好东西多过头，也可以美妙得很。”

去年，中期免税债券持仓减少约1亿美元。出售的全是在1986年8月7日以后买入的债券。财产及意外责任保险公司持有这类债券时，“免税”利息的15%仍需纳税。

1988.english:
The $800 million position we still hold consists almost entirely of bonds “grandfathered” under the Tax Reform Act of 1986, which means they are entirely tax-exempt.  Our sales produced a small profit and our remaining bonds, which have an average maturity of about six years, are worth modestly more than carrying value.

Last year we described our holdings of short-term and intermediate-term bonds of Texaco, which was then in bankruptcy. During 1988, we sold practically all of these bonds at a pre-tax profit of about $22 million.  This sale explains close to $100 million of the reduction in fixed-income securities on our balance sheet.
1988.chinese:
剩下的8亿美元持仓，几乎全受1986年税改法案的既有持仓保护条款覆盖，因而完全免税。出售产生了少量利润；余下债券平均期限约六年，价值略高于账面金额。

去年，我们介绍过当时处于破产程序中的德士古短期及中期债券持仓。1988年几乎全数卖掉，税前获利约2200万美元。资产负债表固定收益证券减少额中，接近1亿美元就来自这笔出售。

1988.english: We also told you last year about our holdings of another security whose predominant characteristics are those of an intermediate fixed-income issue: our $700 million position in Salomon Inc 9% convertible preferred.  This preferred has a sinking fund that will retire it in equal annual installments from 1995 to 1999.  Berkshire carries this holding at cost.  For reasons discussed by Charlie on page 69, the estimated market value of our holding has improved from moderately under cost at the end of last year to moderately over cost at 1988 year end.
1988.chinese: 去年还介绍了另一项主要具有中期固定收益特性的证券：7亿美元所罗门公司9%可转换优先股。偿债基金安排会在1995—1999年间，逐年等额赎回。伯克希尔按成本列账。查理在第69页讨论了原因：我们估计的市值，从去年年底略低于成本，改善为1988年底略高于成本。

1988.english: The close association we have had with John Gutfreund, CEO of Salomon, during the past year has reinforced our admiration for him.  But we continue to have no great insights about the near, intermediate or long-term economics of the investment banking business: This is not an industry in which it is easy to forecast future levels of profitability.  We continue to believe that our conversion privilege could well have important value over the life of our preferred.  However, the overwhelming portion of the preferred’s value resides in its fixed-income characteristics, not its equity characteristics.
1988.chinese: 过去一年与所罗门首席执行官约翰·古特弗罗恩德密切合作，使我们更敬佩他。不过，对投资银行业短、中、长期经济前景，我们仍无高明洞察；这不是一个容易预测未来盈利水平的行业。我们仍相信，优先股存续期内，转换权很可能有重要价值。但优先股价值的压倒性部分，来自固定收益特性，而非股权特性。

1988.english: o We have not lost our aversion to long-term bonds.  We will become enthused about such securities only when we become enthused about prospects for long-term stability in the purchasing power of money.  And that kind of stability isn’t in the cards: Both society and elected officials simply have too many higher-ranking priorities that conflict with purchasing- power stability.  The only long-term bonds we hold are those of Washington Public Power Supply Systems (WPPSS).  A few of our WPPSS bonds have short maturities and many others, because of their high coupons, are likely to be refunded and paid off in a few years.  Overall, our WPPSS holdings are carried on our balance sheet at $247 million and have a market value of about $352 million.
1988.chinese: 我们对长期债券的厌恶丝毫未减。只有对货币购买力长期稳定的前景兴奋时，才会对这种证券兴奋。而这种稳定看来不会发生：社会与民选官员，都有太多优先级更高、却与购买力稳定冲突的事项。我们唯一持有的长期债券，是华盛顿公共供电系统（WPPSS）债券。其中少数期限短，另有许多因票息高，很可能几年内被再融资赎回。合计账面金额2.47亿美元，市值约3.52亿美元。

1988.english:
We explained the reasons for our WPPSS purchases in the 1983 annual report, and are pleased to tell you that this commitment has worked out about as expected.  At the time of purchase, most of our bonds were yielding around 17% after taxes and carried no ratings, which had been suspended.  Recently, the bonds were rated AA- by Standard & Poor’s.  They now sell at levels only slightly below those enjoyed by top-grade credits.

In the 1983 report, we compared the economics of our WPPSS purchase to those involved in buying a business.  As it turned out, this purchase actually worked out better than did the general run of business acquisitions made in 1983, assuming both are measured on the basis of unleveraged, after tax returns achieved through 1988.
1988.chinese:
1983年年报已解释买入WPPSS的理由。很高兴告诉各位，结果大致符合预期。当初买入时，多数债券的税后收益率约17%，评级因暂停而未列。最近，标准普尔给予AA-评级，如今售价已只略低于最高等级债券的水平。

1983年报告中，我们把买入WPPSS的经济效益，与收购企业相比较。结果证明，若都按截至1988年取得的无杠杆税后回报衡量，它实际上胜过1983年一般企业收购的表现。

1988.english:
Our WPPSS experience, though pleasant, does nothing to alter our negative opinion about long-term bonds.  It only makes us hope that we run into some other large stigmatized issue, whose troubles have caused it to be significantly misappraised by the market.

Arbitrage

In past reports we have told you that our insurance subsidiaries sometimes engage in arbitrage as an alternative to holding short-term cash equivalents. We prefer, of course, to make major long-term commitments, but we often have more cash than good ideas.  At such times, arbitrage sometimes promises much greater returns than Treasury Bills and, equally important, cools any temptation we may have to relax our standards for long- term investments.  (Charlie’s sign off after we’ve talked about an arbitrage commitment is usually: “Okay, at least it will keep you out of bars.”)
1988.chinese:
WPPSS经历虽愉快，并未改变我们对长期债券的负面看法，只让我们希望再遇到某只被污名笼罩的大额债券，因为麻烦而被市场严重误估。

## 套利

以往报告说过，保险子公司有时做套利，替代短期现金等价物。当然，我们更喜欢大额长期投资，可钱常比好主意多。这时，套利有时预示着远高于国库券的回报；同样重要的是，它能冷却我们放松长期投资标准的诱惑。（讨论一笔套利投资后，查理的结束语通常是：“行，至少能让你别去泡酒吧。”）

1988.english:
During 1988 we made unusually large profits from arbitrage, measured both by absolute dollars and rate of return.  Our pre- tax gain was about $78 million on average invested funds of about $147 million.

This level of activity makes some detailed discussion of arbitrage and our approach to it appropriate.  Once, the word applied only to the simultaneous purchase and sale of securities or foreign exchange in two different markets.  The goal was to exploit tiny price differentials that might exist between, say, Royal Dutch stock trading in guilders in Amsterdam, pounds in London, and dollars in New York.  Some people might call this scalping; it won’t surprise you that practitioners opted for the French term, arbitrage.
1988.chinese:
1988年，无论按绝对金额还是回报率，我们的套利利润都异常丰厚。平均投入约1.47亿美元，税前收益约7800万美元。

有了这个业务水平，值得稍详谈套利及我们的做法。这个词最初仅指在两个不同市场同时买卖证券或外汇，利用细微价差获利；例如皇家荷兰股票，在阿姆斯特丹按荷兰盾、伦敦按英镑、纽约按美元交易，价格可能略有不同。有人也许叫它“倒买倒卖”；从业者偏爱法语词arbitrage，各位不会惊讶。

1988.english:
Since World War I the definition of arbitrage - or “risk arbitrage,” as it is now sometimes called - has expanded to include the pursuit of profits from an announced corporate event such as sale of the company, merger, recapitalization, reorganization, liquidation, self-tender, etc.  In most cases the arbitrageur expects to profit regardless of the behavior of the stock market.  The major risk he usually faces instead is that the announced event won’t happen.

Some offbeat opportunities occasionally arise in the arbitrage field.  I participated in one of these when I was 24 and working in New York for Graham-Newman Corp. Rockwood & Co., a Brooklyn based chocolate products company of limited profitability, had adopted LIFO inventory valuation in 1941 when cocoa was selling for 5¢ per pound.  In 1954 a temporary shortage of cocoa caused the price to soar to over 60¢.  Consequently Rockwood wished to unload its valuable inventory - quickly, before the price dropped.  But if the cocoa had simply been sold off, the company would have owed close to a 50% tax on the proceeds.
1988.chinese:
第一次世界大战以来，套利的定义——有时称“风险套利”——已扩大到从已宣布的公司事件获利，例如出售公司、合并、资本重组、业务重整、清算、公司要约回购等。多数情况下，套利者预期不论股市如何都能赚钱；主要风险通常是，宣布的事件最终不发生。

套利领域偶尔也有另类机会。24岁在纽约格雷厄姆—纽曼公司工作时，我参加过一笔。布鲁克林巧克力产品公司洛克伍德（Rockwood & Co.）盈利有限，1941年可可每磅5美分时，采用了后进先出法（LIFO）存货计价。1954年，可可暂时短缺，价格飙至60美分以上，公司想在价格跌前赶紧卖掉宝贵存货。可若直接出售，所得款项须缴接近50%的税。

1988.english: The 1954 Tax Code came to the rescue.  It contained an arcane provision that eliminated the tax otherwise due on LIFO profits if inventory was distributed to shareholders as part of a plan reducing the scope of a corporation’s business.  Rockwood decided to terminate one of its businesses, the sale of cocoa butter, and said 13 million pounds of its cocoa bean inventory was attributable to that activity.  Accordingly, the company offered to repurchase its stock in exchange for the cocoa beans it no longer needed, paying 80 pounds of beans for each share.
1988.chinese: 1954年税法来解围：一项冷僻规定说，若在缩减公司经营范围的计划中，把存货分给股东，本来应付的LIFO利润税就免了。洛克伍德决定终止可可脂销售业务，并称有1300万磅可可豆存货归属于它。于是，公司提出用不再需要的可可豆回购股票，每股付80磅豆子。

1988.english:
For several weeks I busily bought shares, sold beans, and made periodic stops at Schroeder Trust to exchange stock certificates for warehouse receipts.  The profits were good and my only expense was subway tokens.

The architect of Rockwood’s restructuring was an unknown, but brilliant Chicagoan, Jay Pritzker, then 32.  If you’re familiar with Jay’s subsequent record, you won’t be surprised to hear the action worked out rather well for Rockwood’s continuing shareholders also.  From shortly before the tender until shortly after it, Rockwood stock appreciated from 15 to 100, even though the company was experiencing large operating losses.  Sometimes there is more to stock valuation than price-earnings ratios.
1988.chinese:
几周里，我忙着买股票、卖豆子，不时到施罗德信托，把股票凭证换成仓单。利润不错，唯一的费用是地铁票。

设计洛克伍德重组的，是当时32岁、还默默无闻却才华出众的芝加哥人杰伊·普里茨克。若熟悉他后来的记录，各位就不会惊讶，洛克伍德继续持股的股东也获益良多。要约前不久到结束后不久，股价从15涨到100，尽管公司正有巨额经营亏损。有时，股票估值可不只是看市盈率。

1988.english: In recent years, most arbitrage operations have involved takeovers, friendly and unfriendly.  With acquisition fever rampant, with anti-trust challenges almost non-existent, and with bids often ratcheting upward, arbitrageurs have prospered mightily.  They have not needed special talents to do well; the trick, a la Peter Sellers in the movie, has simply been “Being There.” In Wall Street the old proverb has been reworded: “Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day.  Teach him how to arbitrage and you feed him forever.” (If, however, he studied at the Ivan Boesky School of Arbitrage, it may be a state institution that supplies his meals.)
1988.chinese: 近年，多数套利围绕友好及敌意收购。收购狂热蔓延，反垄断挑战几乎没有，报价又常节节升高，套利者大赚。无需特殊才干，诀窍就像彼得·塞勒斯那部电影《Being There》：只要“人在场”就行。华尔街把老谚语改成：“授人以鱼，饱一天；教人套利，饱一生。”（不过，若他毕业于伊万·博斯基套利学院，给他供饭的可能是国家机构。）

1988.english:
To evaluate arbitrage situations you must answer four questions: (1) How likely is it that the promised event will indeed occur? (2) How long will your money be tied up? (3) What chance is there that something still better will transpire - a competing takeover bid, for example? and (4) What will happen if the event does not take place because of anti-trust action, financing glitches, etc.?

Arcata Corp., one of our more serendipitous arbitrage experiences, illustrates the twists and turns of the business. On September 28, 1981 the directors of Arcata agreed in principle to sell the company to Kohlberg, Kravis, Roberts & Co. (KKR), then and now a major leveraged-buy out firm.  Arcata was in the printing and forest products businesses and had one other thing going for it: In 1978 the U.S. Government had taken title to 10,700 acres of Arcata timber, primarily old-growth redwood, to expand Redwood National Park.  The government had paid $97.9 million, in several installments, for this acreage, a sum Arcata was contesting as grossly inadequate.  The parties also disputed the interest rate that should apply to the period between the taking of the property and final payment for it.  The enabling legislation stipulated 6% simple interest; Arcata argued for a much higher and compounded rate.
1988.chinese:
评估套利，必须回答四个问题：（1）承诺的事件真正发生的可能性多大？（2）资金要占用多久？（3）会不会发生更好的事，例如竞争性收购报价？（4）若因反垄断、融资故障等，事件没发生，会怎样？

阿卡塔（Arcata Corp.）是我们比较幸运的一次套利，说明这门生意如何曲折。1981年9月28日，阿卡塔董事会原则同意，把公司卖给当时和现在都很重要的杠杆收购公司科尔伯格—克拉维斯—罗伯茨（KKR）。阿卡塔经营印刷与林产品，另有一项有利因素：1978年，美国政府为扩大红杉国家公园，征收它10,700英亩林地，主要是原始红杉林。政府分几笔支付9790万美元，阿卡塔认为远远不足，提出争议。双方还争论从征地到最终付款期间的利率；授权立法规定6%单利，阿卡塔则主张高得多的复利。

1988.english:
Buying a company with a highly-speculative, large-sized claim in litigation creates a negotiating problem, whether the claim is on behalf of or against the company.  To solve this problem, KKR offered $37.00 per Arcata share plus two-thirds of any additional amounts paid by the government for the redwood lands.

Appraising this arbitrage opportunity, we had to ask ourselves whether KKR would consummate the transaction since, among other things, its offer was contingent upon its obtaining “satisfactory financing.” A clause of this kind is always dangerous for the seller: It offers an easy exit for a suitor whose ardor fades between proposal and marriage.  However, we were not particularly worried about this possibility because KKR’s past record for closing had been good.
1988.chinese:
买一家带有金额巨大、结果很不确定的诉讼索赔的公司，无论公司是索赔方还是被索赔方，谈判都会有难题。为解决它，KKR提出每股37.00美元，外加政府为红杉土地支付的任何额外款项的三分之二。

评估这笔套利时，首先得问KKR会不会完成交易；除了其他条件，报价还以取得“满意融资”为前提。这类条款对卖方总是危险：求婚后、结婚前热情消退的追求者，很容易借此脱身。不过，KKR过去完成交易的记录好，我们不太担心。

1988.english:
We also had to ask ourselves what would happen if the KKR deal did fall through, and here we also felt reasonably comfortable: Arcata’s management and directors had been shopping the company for some time and were clearly determined to sell. If KKR went away, Arcata would likely find another buyer, though of course, the price might be lower.

Finally, we had to ask ourselves what the redwood claim might be worth.  Your Chairman, who can’t tell an elm from an oak, had no trouble with that one: He coolly evaluated the claim at somewhere between zero and a whole lot.
1988.chinese:
还要问，KKR若退出会怎样。这一点也相当放心：阿卡塔管理层与董事已为公司寻找买家一段时间，显然决心出售。KKR走了，很可能另有买家，当然价格也许更低。

最后，得问红杉索赔值多少。各位的董事长连榆树与橡树都分不清，这题却毫无困难：他冷静地估定，价值介于零与一大笔之间。

1988.english:
We started buying Arcata stock, then around $33.50, on September 30 and in eight weeks purchased about 400,000 shares, or 5% of the company.  The initial announcement said that the $37.00 would be paid in January, 1982.  Therefore, if everything had gone perfectly, we would have achieved an annual rate of return of about 40% - not counting the redwood claim, which would have been frosting.

All did not go perfectly.  In December it was announced that the closing would be delayed a bit.  Nevertheless, a definitive agreement was signed on January 4. Encouraged, we raised our stake, buying at around $38.00 per share and increasing our holdings to 655,000 shares, or over 7% of the company.  Our willingness to pay up - even though the closing had been postponed - reflected our leaning toward “a whole lot” rather than “zero” for the redwoods.
1988.chinese:
9月30日，我们开始以当时约33.50美元买入阿卡塔，八周买到约400,000股，占公司5%。最初公告说，37.00美元将在1982年1月支付。因此，若一切完美，年化回报约40%，还不包括红杉索赔，那是额外的糖霜。

可事情没全按完美剧本走。12月宣布交割略有推迟，不过1月4日仍签了正式协议。受此鼓舞，我们以约38.00美元继续买入，持股增至655,000股，超过7%。虽然交割延期仍愿加价，是因为对红杉，我们更偏向“一大笔”而非“零”。

1988.english: Then, on February 25 the lenders said they were taking a “second look” at financing terms “ in view of the severely depressed housing industry and its impact on Arcata’s outlook.” The stockholders’ meeting was postponed again, to April.  An Arcata spokesman said he “did not think the fate of the acquisition itself was imperiled.” When arbitrageurs hear such reassurances, their minds flash to the old saying: “He lied like a finance minister on the eve of devaluation.”
1988.chinese: 接着，2月25日，贷款人表示，“鉴于住宅行业极度低迷及其对阿卡塔前景的影响”，要对融资条件“再看一眼”。股东会又推迟到4月。阿卡塔发言人说，他“不认为收购本身的命运受到威胁”。套利者一听这种保证，就会想起老话：“他说谎，像贬值前夕的财政部长。”

1988.english:
On March 12 KKR said its earlier deal wouldn’t work, first cutting its offer to $33.50, then two days later raising it to $35.00. On March 15, however, the directors turned this bid down and accepted another group’s offer of $37.50 plus one-half of any redwood recovery.  The shareholders okayed the deal, and the $37.50 was paid on June 4.

We received $24.6 million versus our cost of $22.9 million; our average holding period was close to six months.  Considering the trouble this transaction encountered, our 15% annual rate of return excluding any value for the redwood claim - was more than satisfactory.
1988.chinese:
3月12日，KKR说原交易行不通，先把报价降到33.50美元，两天后又提至35.00美元。但3月15日，董事会拒绝，接受另一团体的每股37.50美元，加红杉索赔所得一半的报价。股东批准，37.50美元在6月4日付清。

我们成本2290万美元，收到2460万美元；平均持有期接近六个月。考虑到过程如此曲折，不计红杉索赔价值的15%年化回报，已相当令人满意。

1988.english:
But the best was yet to come.  The trial judge appointed two commissions, one to look at the timber’s value, the other to consider the interest rate questions.  In January 1987, the first commission said the redwoods were worth $275.7 million and the second commission recommended a compounded, blended rate of return working out to about 14%.

In August 1987 the judge upheld these conclusions, which meant a net amount of about $600 million would be due Arcata. The government then appealed.  In 1988, though, before this appeal was heard, the claim was settled for $519 million. Consequently, we received an additional $29.48 per share, or about $19.3 million.  We will get another $800,000 or so in 1989.
1988.chinese:
但最好的还没来。审理法官任命两个委员会，分别研究林木价值与利率问题。1987年1月，第一个认定红杉价值2.757亿美元，第二个建议采用混合复利，折合约14%。

1987年8月，法官维持这些结论，意味着阿卡塔应净收约6亿美元。政府上诉；不过1988年，上诉尚未审理，索赔便以5.19亿美元和解。因此，我们额外收到每股29.48美元，约1930万美元。1989年还会再收到约800,000美元。

1988.english: Berkshire’s arbitrage activities differ from those of many arbitrageurs.  First, we participate in only a few, and usually very large, transactions each year.  Most practitioners buy into a great many deals perhaps 50 or more per year.  With that many irons in the fire, they must spend most of their time monitoring both the progress of deals and the market movements of the related stocks.  This is not how Charlie nor I wish to spend our lives. (What’s the sense in getting rich just to stare at a ticker tape all day?)
1988.chinese: 伯克希尔的套利，与许多套利者有区别。第一，我们每年只参与少数几笔，通常规模很大；多数从业者参与大量交易，或许每年50笔以上。同时烧这么多炉火，大部分时间就得盯交易进展及相关股价。查理和我可不想这样过日子。（致富就为整天盯着行情纸带，有什么意思？）

1988.english:
Because we diversify so little, one particularly profitable or unprofitable transaction will affect our yearly result from arbitrage far more than it will the typical arbitrage operation. So far, Berkshire has not had a really bad experience.  But we will - and when it happens we’ll report the gory details to you.

The other way we differ from some arbitrage operations is that we participate only in transactions that have been publicly announced.  We do not trade on rumors or try to guess takeover candidates.  We just read the newspapers, think about a few of the big propositions, and go by our own sense of probabilities.
1988.chinese:
分散得少，单笔特别赚钱或亏钱的交易，对我们年度套利结果的影响，远大于对一般套利机构的影响。迄今，伯克希尔没经历过真正糟糕的一笔。但总会有，到时会把血淋淋的细节报告各位。

另一项区别，是只参加已经公开宣布的交易。不炒传言，不猜收购目标。我们就读报，对几项大交易想一想，然后按自己的概率判断行动。

1988.english: At yearend, our only major arbitrage position was 3,342,000 shares of RJR Nabisco with a cost of $281.8 million and a market value of $304.5 million.  In January we increased our holdings to roughly four million shares and in February we eliminated our position.  About three million shares were accepted when we tendered our holdings to KKR, which acquired RJR, and the returned shares were promptly sold in the market.  Our pre-tax profit was a better-than-expected $64 million.
1988.chinese: 年末，唯一重大套利持仓，是RJR纳贝斯克3,342,000股，成本2.818亿美元，市值3.045亿美元。1月增至约四百万股，2月清仓。向收购RJR的KKR交付要约股票时，约三百万股获接纳，退回的立即在市场出售。税前利润6400万美元，好于预期。

1988.english:
Earlier, another familiar face turned up in the RJR bidding contest: Jay Pritzker, who was part of a First Boston group that made a tax-oriented offer.  To quote Yogi Berra; “It was deja vu all over again.”

During most of the time when we normally would have been purchasers of RJR, our activities in the stock were restricted because of Salomon’s participation in a bidding group. Customarily, Charlie and I, though we are directors of Salomon, are walled off from information about its merger and acquisition work.  We have asked that it be that way: The information would do us no good and could, in fact, occasionally inhibit Berkshire’s arbitrage operations.
1988.chinese:
此前，RJR竞购中还出现另一张熟面孔：杰伊·普里茨克，参与第一波士顿团体提出的税务导向报价。用约吉·贝拉的话说：“那种似曾相识的感觉，又一次重新上演。”

通常我们会买RJR的大部分时期，因为所罗门参与竞购团体，我们的股票交易受限。尽管查理和我是所罗门董事，通常也与其并购工作信息隔离。这正是我们要求的：信息对我们无益，有时反而会妨碍伯克希尔套利。

1988.english: However, the unusually large commitment that Salomon proposed to make in the RJR deal required that all directors be fully informed and involved.  Therefore, Berkshire’s purchases of RJR were made at only two times: first, in the few days immediately following management’s announcement of buyout plans, before Salomon became involved; and considerably later, after the RJR board made its decision in favor of KKR.  Because we could not buy at other times, our directorships cost Berkshire significant money.
1988.chinese: 但所罗门拟对RJR投入异常巨大的资金，要求全体董事充分知情、参与。因此，伯克希尔只在两个时段买入：最初是管理层宣布收购计划后几天、所罗门尚未参与时；很久以后，是RJR董事会决定接受KKR之后。其他时候不能买，使我们的董事身份让伯克希尔少赚了不少钱。

1988.english:
Considering Berkshire’s good results in 1988, you might expect us to pile into arbitrage during 1989.  Instead, we expect to be on the sidelines.

One pleasant reason is that our cash holdings are down - because our position in equities that we expect to hold for a very long time is substantially up.  As regular readers of this report know, our new commitments are not based on a judgment about short-term prospects for the stock market.  Rather, they reflect an opinion about long-term business prospects for specific companies.  We do not have, never have had, and never will have an opinion about where the stock market, interest rates, or business activity will be a year from now.
1988.chinese:
考虑到1988年结果好，各位也许以为，我们1989年会大举涌入套利。相反，我们预计会站在场边。

一个令人高兴的原因，是现金减少了，因为预计极长期持有的股票头寸大增。常读本报告的股东知道，新投资并非基于对股市短期前景的判断，而是对特定公司长期经营前景的看法。对一年后的股市、利率或经济活动，我们没有过、现在没有、将来也不会有看法。

1988.english:
Even if we had a lot of cash we probably would do little in arbitrage in 1989.  Some extraordinary excesses have developed in the takeover field.  As Dorothy says: “Toto, I have a feeling we’re not in Kansas any more.”

We have no idea how long the excesses will last, nor do we know what will change the attitudes of government, lender and buyer that fuel them.  But we do know that the less the prudence with which others conduct their affairs, the greater the prudence with which we should conduct our own affairs.  We have no desire to arbitrage transactions that reflect the unbridled - and, in our view, often unwarranted - optimism of both buyers and lenders.  In our activities, we will heed the wisdom of Herb Stein: “If something can’t go on forever, it will end.”
1988.chinese:
即使现金很多，1989年套利大概也做得很少。收购领域已有些非同寻常的过度行为。正如多萝茜所说：“托托，我觉得我们已经不在堪萨斯了。”

不知道过度行为会持续多久，也不知道什么会改变助长它们的政府、贷款人与买家的态度。但我们知道，别人做事越不谨慎，我们越该谨慎。对反映买方与贷款人无拘束、而且在我们看来往往毫无根据的乐观情绪的交易，我们不想套利。我们会牢记赫伯·斯坦的智慧：“不能永远继续的事，终会结束。”

1988.english:
## Efficient Market Theory

The preceding discussion about arbitrage makes a small discussion of “efficient market theory” (EMT) also seem relevant. This doctrine became highly fashionable - indeed, almost holy scripture in academic circles during the 1970s.  Essentially, it said that analyzing stocks was useless because all public information about them was appropriately reflected in their prices.  In other words, the market always knew everything.  As a corollary, the professors who taught EMT said that someone throwing darts at the stock tables could select a stock portfolio having prospects just as good as one selected by the brightest, most hard-working security analyst.  Amazingly, EMT was embraced not only by academics, but by many investment professionals and corporate managers as well.  Observing correctly that the market was frequently efficient, they went on to conclude incorrectly that it was always efficient.  The difference between these propositions is night and day.
1988.chinese:
## 有效市场理论

前面的套利讨论，使稍谈“有效市场理论”（EMT）也很相关。20世纪70年代，这套学说极时髦，在学术圈几乎成了圣经。大意是，分析股票没用，因为有关股票的全部公开信息，都已恰当反映在价格中。换言之，市场永远无所不知。于是，教EMT的教授说，向股票行情表掷飞镖选出的组合，前景与最聪明、最勤奋的证券分析师挑出的组合一样好。令人吃惊的是，不仅学者，许多投资专业人士与公司经理人也接受了它。他们正确观察到市场经常有效，却错误推导出市场始终有效。这两个命题，差别如同白昼与黑夜。

1988.english: In my opinion, the continuous 63-year arbitrage experience of Graham-Newman Corp. Buffett Partnership, and Berkshire illustrates just how foolish EMT is. (There’s plenty of other evidence, also.) While at Graham-Newman, I made a study of its earnings from arbitrage during the entire 1926-1956 lifespan of the company.  Unleveraged returns averaged 20% per year. Starting in 1956, I applied Ben Graham’s arbitrage principles, first at Buffett Partnership and then Berkshire.  Though I’ve not made an exact calculation, I have done enough work to know that the 1956-1988 returns averaged well over 20%. (Of course, I operated in an environment far more favorable than Ben’s; he had 1929-1932 to contend with.)
1988.chinese: 我认为，格雷厄姆—纽曼公司、巴菲特合伙企业及伯克希尔连续63年的套利经历，足以说明EMT有多愚蠢，其他证据也很多。在格雷厄姆—纽曼工作时，我研究过它1926—1956年整个存续期的套利收益，平均无杠杆年回报20%。1956年起，我先在巴菲特合伙企业、后在伯克希尔运用本·格雷厄姆的套利原则。虽未精确计算，做过的分析已足以知道，1956—1988年平均回报远超20%。（当然，我的环境比本有利得多，他得应付1929—1932年。）

1988.english: All of the conditions are present that are required for a fair test of portfolio performance: (1) the three organizations traded hundreds of different securities while building this 63- year record; (2) the results are not skewed by a few fortunate experiences; (3) we did not have to dig for obscure facts or develop keen insights about products or managements - we simply acted on highly-publicized events; and (4) our arbitrage positions were a clearly identified universe - they have not been selected by hindsight.
1988.chinese: 公允检验组合表现所需的条件，全都具备：（1）创造63年记录时，三家机构交易了数百种不同证券；（2）结果并未被少数幸运经历扭曲；（3）不必挖冷僻事实，也不用对产品或管理层培养敏锐洞察，我们只对广为报道的事件行动；（4）套利头寸组成了事先清楚界定的样本全集，并非事后挑选。

1988.english:
Over the 63 years, the general market delivered just under a 10% annual return, including dividends.  That means $1,000 would have grown to $405,000 if all income had been reinvested.  A 20% rate of return, however, would have produced $97 million.  That strikes us as a statistically-significant differential that might, conceivably, arouse one’s curiosity.

Yet proponents of the theory have never seemed interested in discordant evidence of this type.  True, they don’t talk quite as much about their theory today as they used to.  But no one, to my knowledge, has ever said he was wrong, no matter how many thousands of students he has sent forth misinstructed.  EMT, moreover, continues to be an integral part of the investment curriculum at major business schools.  Apparently, a reluctance to recant, and thereby to demystify the priesthood, is not limited to theologians.
1988.chinese:
63年里，大盘连股息在内的年回报略低于10%，意味着所有收入再投资，1000美元会增至405,000美元；20%回报却会带来9700万美元。在我们看来，这个差距有统计意义，说不定，多少能勾起一点好奇。

然而，理论支持者似乎从未对这类不合拍的证据感兴趣。不错，如今他们谈理论不如以前多；但即便误导了成千上万的学生，据我所知，也从没有谁说过自己错了。而EMT仍是主要商学院投资课程的组成部分。看来，不愿收回教义、从而揭掉神职阶层神秘面纱的，可不只是神学家。

1988.english:
Naturally the disservice done students and gullible investment professionals who have swallowed EMT has been an extraordinary service to us and other followers of Graham.  In any sort of a contest - financial, mental, or physical - it’s an enormous advantage to have opponents who have been taught that it’s useless to even try.  From a selfish point of view, Grahamites should probably endow chairs to ensure the perpetual teaching of EMT.

All this said, a warning is appropriate.  Arbitrage has looked easy recently.  But this is not a form of investing that guarantees profits of 20% a year or, for that matter, profits of any kind.  As noted, the market is reasonably efficient much of the time: For every arbitrage opportunity we seized in that 63- year period, many more were foregone because they seemed properly-priced.
1988.chinese:
当然，对吞下EMT的学生和轻信的投资专业人士所作的坏事，对我们及其他格雷厄姆追随者，却成了非凡的好事。在任何竞争中，无论财务、智力还是体力，对手若受教认为连试都没用，我们就占了巨大便宜。从自私角度，格雷厄姆信徒大概应该捐资设教授席，确保EMT永远有人教。

说过这些，也该提醒：近来套利看着容易，但它不保证每年20%利润，甚至不保证任何利润。正如已说，市场多数时候相当有效；63年间，每抓住一次套利机会，都有更多机会因为看来定价恰当，而被我们放弃。

1988.english:
An investor cannot obtain superior profits from stocks by simply committing to a specific investment category or style.  He can earn them only by carefully evaluating facts and continuously exercising discipline.  Investing in arbitrage situations, per se, is no better a strategy than selecting a portfolio by throwing darts.

## New York Stock Exchange Listing

Berkshire’s shares were listed on the New York Stock Exchange on November 29, 1988.  On pages 50-51 we reproduce the letter we sent to shareholders concerning the listing.
1988.chinese:
投资者不能只靠选定某种投资类别或风格，就取得超额股票利润；必须认真评估事实，持续保持纪律。单纯投资套利情形，并不比掷飞镖选组合更高明。

## 纽约证券交易所上市

伯克希尔股票于1988年11月29日在纽约证交所上市。第50—51页重印了我们就此写给股东的信。

1988.english:
Let me clarify one point not dealt with in the letter: Though our round lot for trading on the NYSE is ten shares, any number of shares from one on up can be bought or sold.

As the letter explains, our primary goal in listing was to reduce transaction costs, and we believe this goal is being achieved.  Generally, the spread between the bid and asked price on the NYSE has been well below the spread that prevailed in the over-the-counter market.
1988.chinese:
那封信未谈的一点，在此说明：虽然我们在纽交所交易的一整手为十股，但一股及以上的任何股数，都可买卖。

信中说过，上市主要为降低交易成本，我们相信正实现这个目标。一般而言，纽交所买卖报价的价差，远小于原来场外市场的价差。

1988.english: Henderson Brothers, Inc., the specialist in our shares, is the oldest continuing specialist firm on the Exchange; its progenitor, William Thomas Henderson, bought his seat for $500 on September 8, 1861. (Recently, seats were selling for about $625,000.) Among the 54 firms acting as specialists, HBI ranks second in number of stocks assigned, with 83.  We were pleased when Berkshire was allocated to HBI, and have been delighted with the firm’s performance.  Jim Maguire, Chairman of HBI, personally manages the trading in Berkshire, and we could not be in better hands.
1988.chinese: 负责我们股票的专营商亨德森兄弟公司，是纽交所持续经营最久的专营商。创始人威廉·托马斯·亨德森于1861年9月8日，花500美元买下席位。（最近席位售价约625,000美元。）54家专营商中，它获分配83种股票，按数量排第二。伯克希尔分配给它时，我们很高兴；之后的表现，更令人满意。董事长吉姆·马圭尔亲自管理伯克希尔交易，再没有更可靠的人选。

1988.english: In two respects our goals probably differ somewhat from those of most listed companies.  First, we do not want to maximize the price at which Berkshire shares trade.  We wish instead for them to trade in a narrow range centered at intrinsic business value (which we hope increases at a reasonable - or, better yet, unreasonable - rate).  Charlie and I are bothered as much by significant overvaluation as significant undervaluation. Both extremes will inevitably produce results for many shareholders that will differ sharply from Berkshire’s business results.  If our stock price instead consistently mirrors business value, each of our shareholders will receive an investment result that roughly parallels the business results of Berkshire during his holding period.
1988.chinese: 在两点上，我们的目标可能与多数上市公司不同。第一，不求伯克希尔交易价格最高，而希望围绕企业内在价值，在窄幅内交易；内在价值则希望以合理、最好不合理地高的速度增长。查理和我对显著高估与显著低估，同样不安。两种极端都必然使许多股东的结果，远离伯克希尔经营结果。若股价始终反映企业价值，每位股东的投资结果，就会与持有期间伯克希尔经营结果大致平行。

1988.english:
Second, we wish for very little trading activity.  If we ran a private business with a few passive partners, we would be disappointed if those partners, and their replacements, frequently wanted to leave the partnership.  Running a public company, we feel the same way.

Our goal is to attract long-term owners who, at the time of purchase, have no timetable or price target for sale but plan instead to stay with us indefinitely.  We don’t understand the CEO who wants lots of stock activity, for that can be achieved only if many of his owners are constantly exiting.  At what other organization - school, club, church, etc. - do leaders cheer when members leave? (However, if there were a broker whose livelihood depended upon the membership turnover in such organizations, you could be sure that there would be at least one proponent of activity, as in: “There hasn’t been much going on in Christianity for a while; maybe we should switch to Buddhism next week.“)
1988.chinese:
第二，希望交易活动极少。若我们经营私人企业，只有几位不参与日常经营的合伙人，而他们及后来的接替者总想退出，我们会失望。经营上市公司，感觉也相同。

目标是吸引长期所有者：买入时没有出售时间表或目标价格，而打算无限期与我们同行。我们不理解那些希望股票交易热闹的首席执行官，因为只有许多所有者不断退出，才会热闹。学校、俱乐部、教会等其他组织，哪里有领导在人离开时欢呼？（不过，若有经纪人靠这些组织的会员换手谋生，至少会有一个人支持活跃：“基督教好一阵没什么动静了，下周也许该换佛教。”）

1988.english: Of course, some Berkshire owners will need or want to sell from time to time, and we wish for good replacements who will pay them a fair price.  Therefore we try, through our policies, performance, and communications, to attract new shareholders who understand our operations, share our time horizons, and measure us as we measure ourselves.  If we can continue to attract this sort of shareholder - and, just as important, can continue to be uninteresting to those with short-term or unrealistic expectations - Berkshire shares should consistently sell at prices reasonably related to business value.
1988.chinese: 当然，有些伯克希尔股东不时会需要或想要出售，我们希望有好接替者付公允价格。因此，我们通过政策、业绩与沟通，吸引理解业务、认同时间尺度，并用与我们相同标准衡量我们的新股东。若能继续吸引这种人，同时同样重要地，继续让短期或不切实际的期待者感到无趣，伯克希尔股价就应始终与企业价值合理相连。

1988.english:
## David L. Dodd

Dave Dodd, my friend and teacher for 38 years, died last year at age 93.  Most of you don’t know of him.  Yet any long- time shareholder of Berkshire is appreciably wealthier because of the indirect influence he had upon our company.

Dave spent a lifetime teaching at Columbia University, and he co-authored Security Analysis with Ben Graham.  From the moment I arrived at Columbia, Dave personally encouraged and educated me; one influence was as important as the other. Everything he taught me, directly or through his book, made sense.  Later, through dozens of letters, he continued my education right up until his death.
1988.chinese:
## 戴维·L.多德

戴夫·多德是我38年的朋友与老师，去年93岁去世。多数股东不认识他，但他对公司的间接影响，使每一位长期股东都富有了不少。

戴夫一生在哥伦比亚大学教学，与本·格雷厄姆合著《证券分析》。我一到哥大，他就亲自鼓励、教导，二者同样重要。他直接或通过书教给我的一切，都有道理。后来，他又用数十封信继续教我，直到离世。

1988.english:
I have known many professors of finance and investments but I have never seen any, except for Ben Graham, who was the match of Dave.  The proof of his talent is the record of his students: No other teacher of investments has sent forth so many who have achieved unusual success.

When students left Dave’s classroom, they were equipped to invest intelligently for a lifetime because the principles he taught were simple, sound, useful, and enduring.  Though these may appear to be unremarkable virtues, the teaching of principles embodying them has been rare.
1988.chinese:
我认识许多金融及投资教授，除本·格雷厄姆之外，从未见谁比得上戴夫。他的才干，有学生记录为证：没有其他投资教师，培养过这么多成就非凡的学生。

学生离开戴夫课堂时，已拥有一生明智投资所需的装备，因为他教的原则简单、稳健、有用、长久。这些优点看似平常，教授具备这些优点的原则，却一直稀少。

1988.english:
It’s particularly impressive that Dave could practice as well as preach. just as Keynes became wealthy by applying his academic ideas to a very small purse, so, too, did Dave.  Indeed, his financial performance far outshone that of Keynes, who began as a market-timer (leaning on business and credit-cycle theory) and converted, after much thought, to value investing.  Dave was right from the start.

In Berkshire’s investments, Charlie and I have employed the principles taught by Dave and Ben Graham.  Our prosperity is the fruit of their intellectual tree.
1988.chinese:
尤其令人敬佩的是，戴夫不仅能讲，也能做。正如凯恩斯用学术思想管理一笔很小的资金，后来致富，戴夫也如此；而且财务表现远胜凯恩斯。凯恩斯起初依靠商业与信贷周期理论择时，深思后才转向价值投资；戴夫从一开始就对了。

伯克希尔投资中，查理和我运用了戴夫及本·格雷厄姆教的原则。我们的富足，是他们思想之树结出的果实。

1988.english:
Miscellaneous

We hope to buy more businesses that are similar to the ones we have, and we can use some help.  If you have a business that fits the following criteria, call me or, preferably, write.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

(1) large purchases (at least $10 million of after-tax earnings),

(2) demonstrated consistent earning power (future projections are of little interest to us, nor are “turnaround” situations),

(3) businesses earning good returns on equity while employing little or no debt,
1988.chinese:
## 其他事项

我们希望多收购一些类似现有业务的企业，需要各位帮忙。若有符合以下条件的企业，请来电，最好来信。

我们寻找：

（1）大额收购，税后利润至少1000万美元；

（2）已证明的持续盈利能力；对未来预测兴趣不大，对“困境反转”也一样；

（3）几乎不借债或完全不借债，却赚取良好股东权益回报的企业；

1988.english:
(4) management in place (we can’t supply it),

(5) simple businesses (if there’s lots of technology, we won’t understand it),

(6) an offering price (we don’t want to waste our time or that of the seller by talking, even preliminarily, about a transaction when price is unknown).

We will not engage in unfriendly takeovers.  We can promise complete confidentiality and a very fast answer - customarily within five minutes - as to whether we’re interested.  We prefer to buy for cash, but will consider issuing stock when we receive as much in intrinsic business value as we give.
1988.chinese:
（4）现成管理层，我们提供不了；

（5）简单的生意，技术太多，我们看不懂；

（6）明确报价，价格不明就谈交易，哪怕初谈，我们也不愿浪费自己及卖方的时间。

我们不做敌意收购。保证完全保密，通常五分钟内就迅速回答有无兴趣。偏好现金购买；但若所得企业内在价值不少于付出，也会考虑发行股票。

1988.english: Our favorite form of purchase is one fitting the Blumkin- Friedman-Heldman mold.  In cases like these, the company’s owner- managers wish to generate significant amounts of cash, sometimes for themselves, but often for their families or inactive shareholders.  However, these managers also wish to remain significant owners who continue to run their companies just as they have in the past.  We think we offer a particularly good fit for owners with these objectives and invite potential sellers to check us out by contacting people with whom we have done business in the past.
1988.chinese: 最喜欢的收购，符合布卢姆金—弗里德曼—赫尔德曼模式：所有者兼经理人想变现一大笔钱，有时为自己，更多为家人或不参与经营的股东；但又希望继续当重要所有者，并照过去方式经营。我们认为，这类目标与我们特别相配；欢迎潜在卖方向过去与我们交易过的人打听我们。

1988.english:
Charlie and I frequently get approached about acquisitions that don’t come close to meeting our tests: We’ve found that if you advertise an interest in buying collies, a lot of people will call hoping to sell you their cocker spaniels.  Our interest in new ventures, turnarounds, or auction-like sales can best be expressed by another Goldwynism: “Please include me out.”

Besides being interested in the purchase of businesses as described above, we are also interested in the negotiated purchase of large, but not controlling, blocks of stock comparable to those we hold in Cap Cities and Salomon.  We have a special interest in purchasing convertible preferreds as a long- term investment, as we did at Salomon.
1988.chinese:
查理和我常接到完全不符标准的收购邀请。我们发现，登广告说想买牧羊犬，许多人却打电话，希望卖给您可卡犬。我们对新创企业、困境反转和拍卖式出售的兴趣，最好用另一句戈德温语录表达：“请把我算在外头。”

除上述企业收购，也有兴趣协商买入大笔但不控股的股份，类似大都会及所罗门持仓。尤其有兴趣像所罗门那样，买可转换优先股作长期投资。

1988.english:
---

We received some good news a few weeks ago: Standard & Poor’s raised our credit rating to AAA, which is the highest rating it bestows.  Only 15 other U.S. industrial or property- casualty companies are rated AAA, down from 28 in 1980.

Corporate bondholders have taken their lumps in the past few years from “event risk.” This term refers to the overnight degradation of credit that accompanies a heavily-leveraged purchase or recapitalization of a business whose financial policies, up to then, had been conservative.  In a world of takeovers inhabited by few owner-managers, most corporations present such a risk.  Berkshire does not.  Charlie and I promise bondholders the same respect we afford shareholders.
1988.chinese:
* * *

几周前有个好消息：标准普尔把我们的信用评级升至最高的AAA。其他美国工业或财产及意外责任保险公司中，仅15家是AAA，1980年还有28家。

过去几年，公司债持有人被“事件风险”伤得不轻。这个词指原本财务政策保守的公司，因高杠杆收购或资本重组，一夜之间信用恶化。在所有者兼经理人很少的收购世界，大多数公司都有这种风险，伯克希尔没有。查理和我承诺，像尊重股东一样尊重债券持有人。

1988.english:
---

About 97.4% of all eligible shares participated in Berkshire’s 1988 shareholder-designated contributions program. Contributions made through the program were $5 million, and 2,319 charities were recipients.  If we achieve reasonable business results, we plan to increase the per-share contributions in 1989.

We urge new shareholders to read the description of our shareholder-designated contributions program that appears on pages 48-49.  If you wish to participate in future programs, we strongly urge that you immediately make sure your shares are registered in the name of the actual owner, not in the nominee name of a broker, bank or depository.  Shares not so registered on September 30, 1989 will be ineligible for the 1989 program.
1988.chinese:
* * *

伯克希尔1988年股东指定捐赠计划，约97.4%的合资格股份参与，捐出500万美元，惠及2,319家慈善机构。若经营结果合理，我们计划1989年提高每股捐赠额。

请新股东阅读第48—49页的计划说明。如想参加未来计划，强烈建议立即确认，股份登记在实际所有者名下，而非经纪商、银行或托管机构的名义持有人名下。截至1989年9月30日未如此登记的股份，不得参加1989年计划。

1988.english:
---

Berkshire’s annual meeting will be held in Omaha on Monday, April 24, 1989, and I hope you will come.  The meeting provides the forum for you to ask any owner-related questions you may have, and we will keep answering until all (except those dealing with portfolio activities or other proprietary information) have been dealt with.

After the meeting we will have several buses available to take you to visit Mrs. B at The Nebraska Furniture Mart and Ike Friedman at Borsheim’s.  Be prepared for bargains.
1988.chinese:
* * *

伯克希尔年会将于1989年4月24日星期一，在奥马哈举行，希望各位来。年会是提出所有与企业所有者相关问题的论坛，我们会一直回答，直到全部答完；涉及投资组合活动或其他专有信息的除外。

会后有几辆巴士，带各位去内布拉斯加家具卖场看B夫人，以及去波仙珠宝看艾克·弗里德曼。请准备好捡便宜。

1988.english:
Out-of-towners may prefer to arrive early and visit Mrs. B during the Sunday store hours of noon to five. (These Sunday hours seem ridiculously short to Mrs. B, who feels they scarcely allow her time to warm up; she much prefers the days on which the store remains open from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m.) Borsheims, however, is not open on Sunday.

Ask Mrs. B the secret of her astonishingly low carpet prices.  She will confide to you - as she does to everyone - how she does it: “I can sell so cheap ‘cause I work for this dummy who doesn’t know anything about carpet.”

Warren E. Buffett February 28, 1989                        Chairman of the Board
1988.chinese:
外地股东也许愿意提前来，周日中午到下午五点，去店里看B夫人。（她觉得这周日营业时间短得荒唐，几乎还没热身就结束了；更喜欢上午10点开到晚上9点的日子。）不过，波仙周日不开门。

问问B夫人，地毯价格低得惊人的秘诀。她会像对每个人一样，悄悄告诉您：“我能卖这么便宜，因为我替一个对地毯一窍不通的傻瓜打工。”

沃伦·E.巴菲特

董事长

1989年2月28日

1989.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Our gain in net worth during 1989 was $1.515 billion, or 44.4%. Over the last 25 years (that is, since present management took over) our per-share book value has grown from $19.46 to $4,296.01, or at a rate of 23.8% compounded annually.

What counts, however, is intrinsic value - the figure indicating what all of our constituent businesses are rationally worth. With perfect foresight, this number can be calculated by taking all future cash flows of a business - in and out - and discounting them at prevailing interest rates. So valued, all businesses, from manufacturers of buggy whips to operators of cellular phones, become economic equals.
1989.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1989年，我们的净资产增加15.15亿美元，增幅44.4%。过去25年，也就是现任管理层接手以来，每股账面价值从19.46美元增至4,296.01美元，年复合增长率为23.8%。

不过，真正重要的是内在价值——这个数字表示，组成我们集团的全部企业，合理地说究竟值多少钱。如果拥有完美的预见能力，就可以把一家企业未来所有现金流入及流出，按当时适用的利率折现，算出这个数字。用这种方法估值，无论是马车鞭制造商，还是移动电话运营商，所有企业便都站到了同一把经济尺子下面。

1989.english: Back when Berkshire's book value was $19.46, intrinsic value was somewhat less because the book value was entirely tied up in a textile business not worth the figure at which it was carried. Now most of our businesses are worth far more than their carrying values. This agreeable evolution from a discount to a premium means that Berkshire's intrinsic business value has compounded at a rate that somewhat exceeds our 23.8% annual growth in book value.
1989.chinese: 当伯克希尔账面价值还是19.46美元时，内在价值略低，因为全部账面价值都困在一家纺织企业里，而这家企业不值其列账金额。如今，多数业务的价值远高于账面金额。从折价到溢价的这段愉快演变，意味着伯克希尔企业内在价值的年复合增长率，略高于账面价值每年23.8%的增长。

1989.english: The rear-view mirror is one thing; the windshield is another. A large portion of our book value is represented by equity securities that, with minor exceptions, are carried on our balance sheet at current market values. At yearend these securities were valued at higher prices, relative to their own intrinsic business values, than has been the case in the past. One reason is the buoyant 1989 stock market. More important, the virtues of these businesses have been widely recognized. Whereas once their stock prices were inappropriately low, they are not now.
1989.chinese: 后视镜是一回事，挡风玻璃又是另一回事。我们账面价值中很大一部分，由股票证券构成；除少数例外，它们都按当前市价列在资产负债表上。年末，这些证券相对于各自企业内在价值的价格，比过去更高。原因之一，是1989年股市兴旺；更重要的是，这些企业的优点已经得到广泛认识。过去，它们的股价低得不合理；如今已不是如此。

1989.english: We will keep most of our major holdings, regardless of how they are priced relative to intrinsic business value.
