This 'til- death-do-us-part attitude, combined with the full prices these holdings command, means that they cannot be expected to push up Berkshire's value in the future as sharply as in the past. In other words, our performance to date has benefited from a double- dip: (1) the exceptional gains in intrinsic value that our portfolio companies have achieved; (2) the additional bonus we realized as the market appropriately "corrected" the prices of these companies, raising their valuations in relation to those of the average business. We will continue to benefit from good gains in business value that we feel confident our portfolio companies will make. But our "catch-up" rewards have been realized, which means we'll have to settle for a single-dip in the future.
1989.chinese: 无论相对于企业内在价值的价格如何，多数主要持股我们都会保留。这种“至死不渝”的态度，加上这些股票如今已获充分估价，意味着不能指望它们今后还像过去那样，大幅推高伯克希尔的价值。换句话说，迄今我们的成绩享受了双份好处：（1）投资组合中的公司，内在价值取得了非凡增长；（2）市场恰当地“修正”了这些公司的价格，提高了它们相对于一般企业的估值，我们因此又得到一份额外奖励。我们仍将受益于企业价值的良好增长，而且相信这些公司能做到。不过，“补涨”的奖励已经到手，今后我们只能满足于单份了。

1989.english:
We face another obstacle: In a finite world, high growth rates must self-destruct. If the base from which the growth is taking place is tiny, this law may not operate for a time. But when the base balloons, the party ends: A high growth rate eventually forges its own anchor.

```text
     Carl Sagan has entertainingly described this phenomenon,
musing about the destiny of bacteria that reproduce by dividing
into two every 15 minutes. Says Sagan: "That means four doublings
an hour, and 96 doublings a day. Although a bacterium weighs only
about a trillionth of a gram, its descendants, after a day of
wild asexual abandon, will collectively weigh as much as a
mountain...in two days, more than the sun - and before very long,
everything in the universe will be made of bacteria." Not to
worry, says Sagan:  Some obstacle always impedes this kind of
exponential growth. "The bugs run out of food, or they poison
each other, or they are shy about reproducing in public."
```
1989.chinese:
还有一道障碍：有限世界里，高增长率必然自我终结。基数很小时，这条法则也许暂不起作用；可基数膨胀，宴会便结束。高增长率最终会给自己铸出一只锚。

卡尔·萨根曾妙趣横生地描述这种现象，思索每15分钟一分为二的细菌会怎样。他说：“这就是每小时翻四次、每天翻96次。虽然一只细菌只有约一万亿分之一克，一天肆无忌惮的无性繁殖后，后代合计就有一座山重……两天后超过太阳；不多久，宇宙一切都由细菌组成。”别担心，萨根说，总有障碍阻止这种指数增长：“它们没食物了，或互相毒死了，或不好意思当众繁殖。”

1989.english: Even on bad days, Charlie Munger (Berkshire's Vice Chairman and my partner) and I do not think of Berkshire as a bacterium. Nor, to our unending sorrow, have we found a way to double its net worth every 15 minutes. Furthermore, we are not the least bit shy about reproducing - financially - in public. Nevertheless, Sagan's observations apply. From Berkshire's present base of $4.9 billion in net worth, we will find it much more difficult to average 15% annual growth in book value than we did to average 23.8% from the $22 million we began with.
1989.chinese: 即使在糟糕日子里，伯克希尔副董事长、我的搭档查理·芒格和我，也不觉得伯克希尔是细菌。令我们无尽遗憾的是，也没找到每15分钟让净资产翻倍的方法。而且我们丝毫不羞于公开地——在财务上——繁殖。不过，萨根的观察仍适用。从目前49亿美元净资产的基数，要平均每年增加15%账面价值，会远比当初以2200万美元起步、平均增加23.8%困难。

1989.english:
Taxes

Our 1989 gain of $1.5 billion was achieved after we took a charge of about $712 million for income taxes. In addition, Berkshire's share of the income taxes paid by its five major investees totaled about $175 million.

Of this year's tax charge, about $172 million will be paid currently; the remainder, $540 million, is deferred. Almost all of the deferred portion relates to the 1989 increase in unrealized profits in our common stock holdings. Against this increase, we have reserved a 34% tax.
1989.chinese:
## 税务

1989年15亿美元增值，是在计入约7.12亿美元所得税费用之后取得的。此外，五家主要被投资公司支付的所得税中，归属于伯克希尔持股份额的部分，合计约1.75亿美元。

本年税款费用中，约1.72亿美元当期支付，其余5.40亿美元递延。递延部分几乎全与普通股持仓1989年新增未实现利润有关；对此增值，我们按34%计提税款。

1989.english:
We also carry reserves at that rate against all unrealized profits generated in 1987 and 1988. But, as we explained last year, the unrealized gains we amassed before 1987 - about $1.2 billion - carry reserves booked at the 28% tax rate that then prevailed.

A new accounting rule is likely to be adopted that will require companies to reserve against all gains at the current tax rate, whatever it may be. With the rate at 34%, such a rule would increase our deferred tax liability, and decrease our net worth, by about $71 million - the result of raising the reserve on our pre-1987 gain by six percentage points. Because the proposed rule has sparked widespread controversy and its final form is unclear, we have not yet made this change.
1989.chinese:
对于1987及1988年产生的全部未实现利润，我们也按这一税率计提准备。但正如去年解释过的，1987年以前积累的未实现收益，约12亿美元，仍按当时适用的28%税率计提准备入账。

很可能会采用一项新会计规则，要求对全部收益按届时现行税率计提。若为34%，这会使递延所得税负债增加、净资产减少约7100万美元，因为1987年前收益的准备税率提高六个百分点。拟议规则引起广泛争议，最终形式未明，所以尚未变更。

1989.english: As you can see from our balance sheet on page 27, we would owe taxes of more than $1.1 billion were we to sell all of our securities at year-end market values. Is this $1.1 billion liability equal, or even similar, to a $1.1 billion liability payable to a trade creditor 15 days after the end of the year? Obviously not - despite the fact that both items have exactly the same effect on audited net worth, reducing it by $1.1 billion.
1989.chinese: 第27页资产负债表显示，若按年末市价卖掉全部证券，我们须付超过11亿美元税。这11亿美元负债，与年末后15天就得付给商业债权人的11亿美元负债，相等甚至相似吗？显然不，虽然两者对经审计净资产的影响完全一样，都使其减少11亿美元。

1989.english:
On the other hand, is this liability for deferred taxes a meaningless accounting fiction because its payment can be triggered only by the sale of stocks that, in very large part, we have no intention of selling?  Again, the answer is no.

In economic terms, the liability resembles an interest-free loan from the U.S. Treasury that comes due only at our election (unless, of course, Congress moves to tax gains before they are realized). This "loan" is peculiar in other respects as well: It can be used only to finance the ownership of the particular, appreciated stocks and it fluctuates in size - daily as market prices change and periodically if tax rates change. In effect, this deferred tax liability is equivalent to a very large transfer tax that is payable only if we elect to move from one asset to another. Indeed, we sold some relatively small holdings in 1989, incurring about $76 million of "transfer" tax on $224 million of gains.
1989.chinese:
反过来，既然只有出售股票才会触发缴税，而绝大部分股票我们根本不打算卖，这项递延所得税负债，就是没有意义的会计虚构吗？答案仍然是否。

从经济上说，这项负债像是美国财政部给的一笔无息贷款，只有我们自己选择时才到期；当然，除非国会改为在收益尚未实现时就征税。这笔“贷款”还有其他特别之处：它只能用于持有那些已经升值的特定股票；金额每天随市价变化，也会不时随着税率变化而调整。实际上，这项递延所得税负债，相当于一笔很大的资产转移税，只有我们决定从一种资产转向另一种时才须缴纳。事实上，1989年我们卖出了一些相对较小的持仓，2.24亿美元收益产生了约7600万美元的“转移”税。

1989.english:
Because of the way the tax law works, the Rip Van Winkle style of investing that we favor - if successful - has an important mathematical edge over a more frenzied approach. Let's look at an extreme comparison.

Imagine that Berkshire had only $1, which we put in a security that doubled by yearend and was then sold. Imagine further that we used the after-tax proceeds to repeat this process in each of the next 19 years, scoring a double each time. At the end of the 20 years, the 34% capital gains tax that we would have paid on the profits from each sale would have delivered about $13,000 to the government and we would be left with about $25,250. Not bad. If, however, we made a single fantastic investment that itself doubled 20 times during the 20 years, our dollar would grow to $1,048,576. Were we then to cash out, we would pay a 34% tax of roughly $356,500 and be left with about $692,000.
1989.chinese:
由于税法这样的运作方式，我们偏爱的里普·凡·温克尔式投资——只要投资成功——比更狂热的做法有一项重要的数学优势。来看一个极端的比较。

假设伯克希尔只有1美元，投进一只到年底翻倍的证券，然后卖出。再假设随后19年，每年都把税后所得拿来重复，每次都翻倍。20年末，对每次出售利润支付的34%资本利得税，会让政府拿到约13,000美元，我们剩约25,250美元。不坏。但若作一次绝妙投资，20年内自身翻倍20次，1美元就变成1,048,576美元。此时若兑现，按34%交约356,500美元税，剩约692,000美元。

1989.english:
The sole reason for this staggering difference in results would be the timing of tax payments. Interestingly, the government would gain from Scenario 2 in exactly the same 27:1 ratio as we - taking in taxes of $356,500 vs. $13,000 - though, admittedly, it would have to wait for its money.

We have not, we should stress, adopted our strategy favoring long-term investment commitments because of these mathematics. Indeed, it is possible we could earn greater after- tax returns by moving rather frequently from one investment to another. Many years ago, that's exactly what Charlie and I did.
1989.chinese:
结果相差如此惊人，唯一的原因，就是纳税时点。有意思的是，在第二种情形下，政府与我们受益的比例也恰好一样，都是27∶1：它收到356,500美元税款，而不是13,000美元。当然，得承认，它必须等钱到账。

须强调，我们并非因为这套算术，才偏爱长期投资。实际上，经常从一种投资转到另一种，可能取得更高税后回报；很多年前，查理和我正是这样做。

1989.english: Now we would rather stay put, even if that means slightly lower returns. Our reason is simple: We have found splendid business relationships to be so rare and so enjoyable that we want to retain all we develop.  This decision is particularly easy for us because we feel that these relationships will produce good - though perhaps not optimal - financial results. Considering that, we think it makes little sense for us to give up time with people we know to be interesting and admirable for time with others we do not know and who are likely to have human qualities far closer to average. That would be akin to marrying for money - a mistake under most circumstances, insanity if one is already rich.
1989.chinese: 如今，我们宁愿不动，即使回报略低。原因简单：出色的商业伙伴关系如此稀少、如此愉快，我们想保留每一段已建立的关系。又相信这些关系会带来良好、虽未必最优的财务结果，所以决定尤其容易。既然如此，放弃与已知有趣、令人敬佩的人相处的时间，换成与不认识、且人品大概更接近平均水平者相处，实在没道理。这像为钱结婚：多数情况下是错误，已经富有时则是疯狂。

1989.english:
## Sources of Reported Earnings

The table below shows the major sources of Berkshire's reported earnings. In this presentation, amortization of Goodwill and other major purchase-price accounting adjustments are not charged against the specific businesses to which they apply, but are instead aggregated and shown separately. This procedure lets you view the earnings of our businesses as they would have been reported had we not purchased them. I've explained in past reports why this form of presentation seems to us to be more useful to investors and managers than one utilizing generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), which require purchase- price adjustments to be made on a business-by-business basis. The total net earnings we show in the table are, of course, identical to the GAAP total in our audited financial statements.
1989.chinese:
## 报表利润的来源

下表列出伯克希尔报表利润的主要来源。在这里，商誉摊销及其他重大收购价格会计调整，不计入各自对应的具体企业，而是汇总后单独列示。这让各位能看到，假如我们没有买下这些企业，它们原本会报告怎样的利润。我在过去的报告中已解释过，为何我们认为，对投资者和经理人而言，这种列报方式比公认会计原则（GAAP）要求的逐企业收购价格调整，更有用。当然，表中列出的净利润总额，与经审计财务报表中的GAAP总额完全相同。

1989.english: Further information about these businesses is given in the Business Segment section on pages 37-39, and in the Management's Discussion section on pages 40-44. In these sections you also will find our segment earnings reported on a GAAP basis. For information on Wesco's businesses, I urge you to read Charlie Munger's letter, which starts on page 54. In addition, we have reprinted on page 71 Charlie's May 30, 1989 letter to the U. S. League of Savings Institutions, which conveyed our disgust with its policies and our consequent decision to resign.
1989.chinese: 第37—39页业务分部资料、40—44页管理层讨论，还有业务补充信息及GAAP口径分部利润。韦斯科情况，请读第54页开始的查理·芒格股东信。另外，第71页重印了他1989年5月30日致美国储蓄机构联盟的信，表达我们对其政策的厌恶，以及因此决定退出。

1989.english:
*Excludes interest expense of Scott Fetzer Financial Group and Mutual Savings & Loan.

We refer you also to pages 45-51, where we have rearranged Berkshire's financial data into four segments. These correspond to the way Charlie and I think about the business and should help you calculate Berkshire's intrinsic value. Shown on these pages are balance sheets and earnings statements for:  (1) our insurance operations, with their major investment positions itemized; (2) our manufacturing, publishing and retailing businesses, leaving aside certain non-operating assets and purchase-price accounting adjustments; (3) our subsidiaries engaged in finance-type operations, which are Mutual Savings and Scott Fetzer Financial; and (4) an all-other category that includes the non-operating assets (primarily marketable securities) held by the companies in segment (2), all purchase price accounting adjustments, and various assets and debts of the Wesco and Berkshire parent companies.
1989.chinese:
*不包括斯科特与费策金融集团及互助储蓄与贷款协会的利息费用。

也请读第45—51页，我们把伯克希尔财务数据重排为四类，符合查理和我的思考方式，应有助各位计算内在价值。那里列出四类资产负债表及利润表：（1）保险业务，主要投资头寸逐项列示；（2）制造、出版及零售业务，剔除某些非经营资产及收购价格会计调整；（3）金融类子公司，即互助储蓄及斯科特与费策金融；（4）其他全部项目，包括第（2）类持有的非经营资产，主要为可交易证券，全部收购价格会计调整，以及韦斯科、伯克希尔母公司的各类资产及债务。

1989.english:
If you combine the earnings and net worths of these four segments, you will derive totals matching those shown on our GAAP statements. However, I want to emphasize that this four-category presentation does not fall within the purview of our auditors, who in no way bless it.

In addition to our reported earnings, we also benefit from significant earnings of investees that standard accounting rules do not permit us to report. On page 15, we list five major investees from which we received dividends in 1989 of about $45 million, after taxes. However, our share of the retained earnings of these investees totaled about $212 million last year, not counting large capital gains realized by GEICO and Coca-Cola. If this $212 million had been distributed to us, our own operating earnings, after the payment of additional taxes, would have been close to $500 million rather than the $300 million shown in the table.
1989.chinese:
把四类利润与净资产相加，就得到与GAAP报表相同的总额。但要强调，这套四分类列报不在审计师审查范围内，他们没有给予任何认可。

除报表利润，我们还受益于被投资企业的大笔利润，标准会计规则却不允许报告。第15页列出五家主要被投资公司，1989年我们从中收到约4500万美元税后股息；但归属于我们的留存利润，去年合计约2.12亿美元，还未计入GEICO与可口可乐实现的大额资本利得。若这2.12亿美元分给我们，支付额外税后，我们的经营利润就接近5亿美元，而非表中的3亿美元。

1989.english: The question you must decide is whether these undistributed earnings are as valuable to us as those we report. We believe they are - and even think they may be more valuable. The reason for this a-bird-in-the-bush-may-be-worth-two-in-the-hand conclusion is that earnings retained  by these  investees will be deployed  by talented,  owner-oriented  managers  who sometimes have better uses for these funds in their own businesses than we would have in ours. I would not make such a generous assessment of most managements, but it is appropriate in these cases.
1989.chinese: 各位必须判断：这些未分配利润，对我们是否与报表上的利润同样有价值？我们认为是，甚至觉得可能更有价值。之所以得出这个“林中一鸟可能抵过手中两鸟”的结论，是因为被投资公司留存的利润，会由有才干、以所有者利益为重的经理人运用。有时，这些资金放在他们自己的企业里，比放在我们这里有更好的用途。我不会对多数管理层作如此慷慨的评价，但在这些情况下，这样评价恰当。

1989.english: In our view, Berkshire's fundamental earning power is best measured by a "look-through" approach, in which we append our share of the operating earnings retained by our investees to our own reported operating earnings, excluding capital gains in both instances. For our intrinsic business value to grow at an average of 15% per year, our "look-through" earnings must grow at about the same pace. We'll need plenty of help from our present investees, and also need to add a new one from time to time, in order to reach this 15% goal.
1989.chinese: 我们认为，最好用“穿透”法衡量伯克希尔根本盈利能力：把应享有的被投资公司留存经营利润，加到自己的报表经营利润上，两边都剔除资本利得。内在价值若要平均每年增长15%，穿透利润也须大致同速增长。达到15%目标，既要现有被投资公司多多帮忙，也须不时添一家新的。

1989.english:
## Non-Insurance Operations

In the past, we have labeled our major manufacturing, publishing and retail operations "The Sainted Seven." With our acquisition of Borsheim's early in 1989, the challenge was to find a new title both alliterative and appropriate. We failed: Let's call the group "The Sainted Seven Plus One."

This divine assemblage - Borsheim's, The Buffalo News, Fechheimer Bros., Kirby, Nebraska Furniture Mart, Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Group, See's Candies, World Book - is a collection of businesses with economic characteristics that range from good to superb. Its managers range from superb to superb.
1989.chinese:
## 非保险业务

过去，我们把主要的制造、出版及零售业务称为“神圣七杰”。1989年初收购波仙珠宝之后，难题是想出一个既押头韵、又贴切的新名字。我们失败了：就叫它“神圣七杰加一”吧。

这支神圣队伍——波仙、布法罗新闻报、费希海默兄弟、柯比、内布拉斯加家具卖场、斯科特与费策制造集团、喜诗糖果、世界图书——经济特性从良好到出色；经理人的水平，则从出色到出色。

1989.english: Most of these managers have no need to work for a living; they show up at the ballpark because they like to hit home runs. And that's exactly what they do. Their combined financial statements (including those of some smaller operations), shown on page 49, illustrate just how outstanding their performance is. On an historical accounting basis, after-tax earnings of these operations were 57% on average equity capital. Moreover, this return was achieved with no net leverage: Cash equivalents have matched funded debt. When I call off the names of our managers - the Blumkin, Friedman and Heldman families, Chuck Huggins, Stan Lipsey, and Ralph Schey - I feel the same glow that Miller Huggins must have experienced when he announced the lineup of his 1927 New York Yankees.
1989.chinese: 这些经理人大多无须为生计工作；他们上球场，是因为喜欢打本垒打，而他们也确实这么做。第49页列出的合并财务报表，还包括几项规模较小的业务，足以说明他们的表现有多出众。按历史会计基础计算，这些业务的税后利润，相当于平均股权资本的57%。而且，这一回报是在没有净杠杆的情况下取得的：现金等价物与有息债务相当。每当报出经理人名单——布卢姆金、弗里德曼、赫尔德曼三家，以及查克·哈金斯、斯坦·利普西和拉尔夫·谢伊——我就像米勒·哈金斯宣布1927年纽约扬基队阵容时那样，满心喜悦。

1989.english:
Let's take a look, business by business:

o     In its first year with Berkshire, Borsheim's met all expectations. Sales rose significantly and are now considerably better than twice what they were four years ago when the company moved to its present location. In the six years prior to the move, sales had also doubled. Ike Friedman, Borsheim's managing genius - and I mean that - has only one speed: fast-forward.

If you haven't been there, you've never seen a jewelry store like Borsheim's. Because of the huge volume it does at one location, the store can maintain an enormous selection across all price ranges. For the same reason, it can hold its expense ratio to about one-third that prevailing at jewelry stores offering comparable merchandise. The store's tight control of expenses, accompanied by its unusual buying power, enable it to offer prices far lower than those of other jewelers. These prices, in turn, generate even more volume, and so the circle goes 'round and 'round. The end result is store traffic as high as 4,000 people on seasonally-busy days.
1989.chinese:
下面一家一家来看：

加入伯克希尔的第一年，波仙达到所有预期，销售大幅增长，如今远超过四年前搬到现址时的两倍；搬家前六年，销售也翻过一倍。艾克·弗里德曼是经营天才，我是认真的；他只有一个档位：快进。

如果你没去过，就从未见过波仙这样的珠宝店。由于单店销量庞大，它可以在各个价位保持极丰富的选择。同一个原因，也让费用率能够维持在售卖类似商品的珠宝店通常水平的约三分之一。严格的费用控制，加上非同寻常的采购实力，使售价远低于其他珠宝商；这样的价格又带来更多销量，于是这个循环一圈又一圈转下去。最终，旺季繁忙日的客流可高达4000人。

1989.english:
Ike Friedman is not only a superb businessman and a great showman but also a man of integrity. We bought the business without an audit, and all of our surprises have been on the plus side. "If you don't know jewelry, know your jeweler" makes sense whether you are buying the whole business or a tiny diamond.

A story will illustrate why I enjoy Ike so much: Every two years I'm part of an informal group that gathers to have fun and explore a few subjects. Last September, meeting at Bishop's Lodge in Santa Fe, we asked Ike, his wife Roz, and his son Alan to come by and educate us on jewels and the jewelry business.
1989.chinese:
艾克·弗里德曼不但是出色的商人、善于把场面办得精彩的人，也是一位诚信之人。买下企业时，我们没有做审计，事后的意外却全是好消息。“不懂珠宝，就得了解你的珠宝商”，无论买的是整家企业，还是一颗小钻石，都有道理。

一个故事能说明我为何如此喜欢艾克。我每两年参加一次非正式聚会，大家玩乐、探讨几个话题。去年9月在圣菲主教山庄聚会，我们请艾克、夫人罗兹和儿子艾伦来，教教珠宝及珠宝生意。

1989.english: Ike decided to dazzle the group, so he brought from Omaha about $20 million of particularly fancy merchandise. I was somewhat apprehensive - Bishop's Lodge is no Fort Knox - and I mentioned my concern to Ike at our opening party the evening before his presentation. Ike took me aside. "See that safe?" he said. "This afternoon we changed the combination and now even the hotel management doesn't know what it is." I breathed easier. Ike went on: "See those two big fellows with guns on their hips? They'll be guarding the safe all night." I now was ready to rejoin the party. But Ike leaned closer: "And besides, Warren," he confided, "the jewels aren't in the safe."
1989.chinese: 艾克打算让大家眼花缭乱，从奥马哈带来约2000万美元的精美商品。我有点担心，主教山庄可不是诺克斯堡金库；演讲前夜的开场聚会上，我把忧虑告诉他。他拉我到一边：“看见那保险柜了吗？下午我们改了密码，如今连酒店管理层都不知道。”我松口气。他又说：“看见那两个腰间带枪的大块头了吗？他们整夜守柜子。”我正准备回聚会，艾克又凑近，悄声说：“再说了，沃伦，珠宝根本不在柜子里。”

1989.english:
How can we miss with a fellow like that - particularly when he comes equipped with a talented and energetic family, Alan, Marvin Cohn, and Don Yale.

o     At See's Candies we had an 8% increase in pounds sold, even though 1988 was itself a record year. Included in the 1989 performance were excellent same-store poundage gains, our first in many years.

Advertising played an important role in this outstanding performance. We increased total advertising expenditures from $4 million to $5 million and also got copy from our agency, Hal Riney & Partners, Inc., that was 100% on the money in conveying the qualities that make See's special.
1989.chinese:
有这样的人，我们怎会失手？尤其是他还带着一个才干出众、精力充沛的家庭团队：艾伦、马文·科恩和唐·耶尔。

喜诗销售磅数增加8%，尽管1988年本已创纪录。1989年的表现，还包括同店磅数出色增长，这是多年来第一次。

广告在这次出色表现中发挥了重要作用。我们把广告总支出从400万美元增至500万美元；代理商哈尔·赖尼及伙伴公司提供的文案，也百分之百准确地传达了喜诗与众不同的那些品质。

1989.english: In our media businesses, such as the Buffalo News, we sell advertising. In other businesses, such as See's, we are buyers. When we buy, we practice exactly what we preach when we sell. At See's, we more than tripled our expenditures on newspaper advertising last year, to the highest percentage of sales that I can remember. The payoff was terrific, and we thank both Hal Riney and the power of well-directed newspaper advertising for this result.
1989.chinese: 布法罗新闻报等媒体业务卖广告，喜诗等业务买广告。买时，我们完全照卖时所讲的去做。去年喜诗报纸广告支出增至三倍多，占销售比例达到我记忆中的最高。效果极好，感谢哈尔·赖尼，以及投放得当的报纸广告的力量。

1989.english: See's splendid performances have become routine. But there is nothing routine about the management of Chuck Huggins: His daily involvement with all aspects of production and sales imparts a quality-and-service message to the thousands of employees we need to produce and distribute over 27 million pounds of candy annually. In a company with 225 shops and a massive mail order and phone business, it is no small trick to run things so that virtually every customer leaves happy. Chuck makes it look easy.
1989.chinese: 喜诗的出色表现，已成常态；查克·哈金斯的管理却绝不平常。他每天参与生产与销售各方面，向数千员工传达质量、服务的信念；这些员工每年生产及分销超过2700万磅糖果。225家店，加上庞大邮购及电话业务，还能使几乎每个顾客满意离开，绝非易事。查克却让它看起来很容易。

1989.english:
o     The Nebraska Furniture Mart had record sales and excellent earnings in 1989, but there was one sad note. Mrs. B - Rose Blumkin, who started the company 52 years ago with $500 - quit in May, after disagreeing with other members of the Blumkin family/management about the remodeling and operation of the carpet department.

Mrs. B probably has made more smart business decisions than any living American, but in this particular case I believe the other members of the family were entirely correct: Over the past three years, while the store's other departments increased sales by 24%, carpet sales declined by 17% (but not because of any lack of sales ability by Mrs. B, who has always personally sold far more merchandise than any other salesperson in the store).
1989.chinese:
内布拉斯加家具卖场1989年销售创纪录，利润出色，却有件伤心事。52年前用500美元创办公司的B夫人罗丝·布卢姆金，因地毯部门改造及经营，与其他家族管理成员意见不合，5月离职。

B夫人作出的精明经营决定，可能比任何在世美国人都多；但这一次，我认为其他家人完全正确：过去三年，店内其他部门销售增长24%，地毯却下降17%。这绝不是B夫人销售能力不足，她个人售出的商品，一向远超店内其他任何销售员。

1989.english:
You will be pleased to know that Mrs. B continues to make Horatio Alger's heroes look like victims of tired blood. At age 96 she has started a new business selling - what else? - carpet and furniture. And as always, she works seven days a week.

At the Mart Louie, Ron, and Irv Blumkin continue to propel what is by far the largest and most successful home furnishings store in the country. They are outstanding merchants, outstanding managers, and a joy to be associated with. One reading on their acumen: In the fourth quarter of 1989, the carpet department registered a 75.3% consumer share in the Omaha market, up from 67.7% a year earlier and over six times that of its nearest competitor.
1989.chinese:
各位会高兴地知道，B夫人依旧能让霍雷肖·阿尔杰笔下的英雄，看起来像一群有气无力的人。96岁的她，又开了一家新店，卖的还能是什么？地毯和家具。而且照旧，每周工作七天。

在家具卖场，卢伊、罗恩和欧文·布卢姆金，继续推动这家遥遥领先的全美最大、最成功的家居单店。他们是出色的商人、出色的经理人，也是让人愉快的合作伙伴。看一个体现他们经营本领的指标：1989年第四季度，地毯部门在奥马哈市场的消费者份额为75.3%，高于一年前的67.7%，并且超过最接近竞争对手的六倍。

1989.english:
NFM and Borsheim's follow precisely the same formula for success: (1) unparalleled depth and breadth of merchandise at one location; (2) the lowest operating costs in the business; (3) the shrewdest of buying, made possible in part by the huge volumes purchased; (4) gross margins, and therefore prices, far below competitors'; and (5) friendly personalized service with family members on hand at all times.

Another plug for newspapers: NFM increased its linage in the local paper by over 20% in 1989 - off a record 1988 - and remains the paper's largest ROP advertiser by far. (ROP advertising is the kind printed in the paper, as opposed to that in preprinted inserts.) To my knowledge, Omaha is the only city in which a home furnishings store is the advertising leader. Many retailers cut space purchases in 1989; our experience at See's and NFM would indicate they made a major mistake.
1989.chinese:
家具卖场与波仙，遵循完全相同的成功公式：（1）单一地点，商品深度广度无可比拟；（2）业内最低经营成本；（3）最精明采购，部分得益于庞大采购量；（4）毛利率、从而售价，远低于对手；（5）友善、个性化服务，家族成员始终在场。

再替报纸说句好话：1988年广告已创纪录，家具卖场1989年在当地报纸的广告行数又增逾20%，仍是遥遥领先的最大ROP客户，即直接印于报纸、非预印夹页的广告。据我所知，只有奥马哈由家居店领跑报纸广告。许多零售商1989年削减版面采购，喜诗和家具卖场的经验表明，他们犯了大错。

1989.english: o     The Buffalo News continued to star in 1989 in three important ways: First, among major metropolitan papers, both daily and Sunday, the News is number one in household penetration - the percentage of local households that purchase it each day. Second, in "news hole" - the portion of the paper devoted to news - the paper stood at 50.1% in 1989 vs. 49.5% in 1988, a level again making it more news-rich than any comparable American paper. Third, in a year that saw profits slip at many major papers, the News set its seventh consecutive profit record.
1989.chinese: 1989年，布法罗新闻报继续在三个重要方面表现出色。第一，在大都市主要报纸中，无论日报还是周日版，它的家庭渗透率都居第一；这个指标，是指当地家庭每天购买该报的比例。第二，“新闻版面”即用于刊登新闻的版面比例，1989年为50.1%，1988年为49.5%，再次高于美国任何可比报纸。第三，在许多大报利润下滑的一年，新闻报却连续第七年创下利润纪录。

1989.english: To some extent, these three factors are related, though obviously a high-percentage news hole, by itself, reduces profits significantly. A large and intelligently-utilized news hole, however, attracts a wide spectrum of readers and thereby boosts penetration. High penetration, in turn, makes a newspaper particularly valuable to retailers since it allows them to talk to the entire community through a single "megaphone." A low- penetration paper is a far less compelling purchase for many advertisers and will eventually suffer in both ad rates and profits.
1989.chinese: 三者有一定联系，尽管新闻版面比例高，本身显然会显著减少利润。但版面充足且使用聪明，会吸引各类读者，提高渗透率；高渗透又使报纸对零售商格外有价值，因为只需一个“扩音器”，就能对全社区说话。低渗透报纸，对许多广告主吸引力小得多，最终广告费率及利润都会受损。

1989.english: It should be emphasized that our excellent penetration is neither an accident nor automatic. The population of Erie County, home territory of the News, has been falling - from 1,113,000 in 1970 to 1,015,000 in 1980 to an estimated 966,000 in 1988. Circulation figures tell a different story. In 1975, shortly before we started our Sunday edition, the Courier-Express, a long-established Buffalo paper, was selling 207,500 Sunday copies in Erie County. Last year - with population at least 5% lower - the News sold an average of 292,700 copies. I believe that in no other major Sunday market has there been anything close to that increase in penetration.
1989.chinese: 须强调，高渗透既非偶然，也非自动。新闻报本地市场伊利县人口，1970年1,113,000、1980年1,015,000，1988年估计966,000，持续下降；发行却不同。1975年，我们周日版创办前不久，老牌布法罗《信使快报》在县内每周日卖207,500份。去年人口至少少5%，新闻报却平均卖292,700份。我相信，其他主要周日市场，都没有接近这种渗透率提升的记录。

1989.english: When this kind of gain is made - and when a paper attains an unequaled degree of acceptance in its home town - someone is doing something right. In this case major credit clearly belongs to Murray Light, our long-time editor who daily creates an informative, useful, and interesting product. Credit should go also to the Circulation and Production Departments: A paper that is frequently late, because of production problems or distribution weaknesses, will lose customers, no matter how strong its editorial content.
1989.chinese: 有这样的增长，报纸在家乡得到无可匹敌的认可，必然有人把事情做对了。此处主要功劳显然归长期主编默里·莱特，他每天创造信息丰富、有用、有趣的产品。发行和生产部门也有功：因生产问题或分销弱点常迟到的报纸，内容再好也会丢顾客。

1989.english: Stan Lipsey, publisher of the News, has produced profits fully up to the strength of our product. I believe Stan's managerial skills deliver at least five extra percentage points in profit margin compared to the earnings that would be achieved by an average manager given the same circumstances. That is an amazing performance, and one that could only be produced by a talented manager who knows - and cares - about every nut and bolt of the business.
1989.chinese: 发行人斯坦·利普西，创造了与产品实力完全相称的利润。我认为，同等条件下，他的管理本领使利润率比普通经理人至少多五个百分点。只有有才干、又了解并在乎业务每颗螺丝钉的经理人，才做得出这种惊人表现。

1989.english: Stan's knowledge and talents, it should be emphasized, extend to the editorial product. His early years in the business were spent on the news side and he played a key role in developing and editing a series of stories that in 1972 won a Pulitzer Prize for the Sun Newspaper of Omaha. Stan and I have worked together for over 20 years, through some bad times as well as good, and I could not ask for a better partner.
1989.chinese: 还须强调，斯坦的知识与才干，也包括报纸的新闻编辑工作。他入行早年从事新闻，在策划和编辑一组报道时起过关键作用，帮助奥马哈《太阳报》于1972年获得普利策奖。斯坦和我已合作20多年，既经历过顺境，也经历过逆境；我不可能要求有更好的伙伴。

1989.english:
o     At Fechheimer, the Heldman clan - Bob, George, Gary, Roger and Fred - continue their extraordinary performance. Profits in 1989 were down somewhat because of problems the business experienced in integrating a major 1988 acquisition. These problems will be ironed out in time. Meanwhile, return on invested capital at Fechheimer remains splendid.

Like all of our managers, the Heldmans have an exceptional command of the details of their business. At last year's annual meeting I mentioned that when a prisoner enters San Quentin, Bob and George probably know his shirt size. That's only a slight exaggeration: No matter what area of the country is being discussed, they know exactly what is going on with major customers and with the competition.
1989.chinese:
费希海默的赫尔德曼家族，鲍勃、乔治、加里、罗杰、弗雷德，继续非凡表现。因整合1988年一项重大收购遇到问题，1989年利润略降。问题终会解决；同时，投入资本回报仍出色。

和所有经理人一样，赫尔德曼一家对业务细节掌握非凡。去年年会，我说，囚犯一进圣昆廷监狱，鲍勃与乔治大概就知道他的衬衫尺码。只稍微夸张：无论谈全国哪一处，他们都清楚主要客户及对手在做什么。

1989.english:
Though we purchased Fechheimer four years ago, Charlie and I have never visited any of its plants or the home office in Cincinnati. We're much like the lonesome Maytag repairman: The Heldman managerial product is so good that a service call is never needed.

o     Ralph Schey continues to do a superb job in managing our largest group - World Book, Kirby, and the Scott Fetzer Manufacturing Companies. Aggregate earnings of these businesses have increased every year since our purchase and returns on invested capital continue to be exceptional. Ralph is running an enterprise large enough, were it standing alone, to be on the Fortune 500. And he's running it in a fashion that would put him high in the top decile, measured by return on equity.
1989.chinese:
我们四年前买下费希海默，查理和我却从未去过它的任何工厂，或辛辛那提总部。我们很像那位寂寞的美泰克维修工：赫尔德曼一家的管理产品太好，根本不用上门维修。

拉尔夫·谢伊继续出色管理我们最大的集团：世界图书、柯比、斯科特与费策制造企业。收购以来，合计利润年年增加，投入资本回报继续出众。企业规模，单列就足以上《财富》500强；按股东权益回报衡量，他的经营表现又足以排在前十分之一中的靠前位置。

1989.english:
For some years, World Book has operated out of a single location in Chicago's Merchandise Mart. Anticipating the imminent expiration of its lease, the business is now decentralizing into four locations. The expenses of this transition are significant; nevertheless profits in 1989 held up well. It will be another year before costs of the move are fully behind us.

Kirby's business was particularly strong last year, featuring large gains in export sales. International business has more than doubled in the last two years and quintupled in the past four; its share of unit sales has risen from 5% to 20%. Our largest capital expenditures in 1989 were at Kirby, in preparation for a major model change in 1990.
1989.chinese:
世界图书多年集中在芝加哥商品市场一处办公。租约即将到期，正分散至四处，转移费用很大，但1989年利润仍保持良好。再过一年，搬迁成本才全成过去。

柯比去年尤其强，出口销售大增。国际业务过去两年增至两倍多，四年增至五倍，占单位销量比例从5%升至20%。1989年最大资本开支在柯比，为1990年一次主要型号更换做准备。

1989.english: Ralph's operations contribute about 40% of the total earnings of the non-insurance group whose results are shown on page 49. When we bought Scott Fetzer at the start of 1986, our acquisition of Ralph as a manager was fully as important as our acquisition of the businesses. In addition to generating extraordinary earnings, Ralph also manages capital extremely well. These abilities have produced funds for Berkshire that, in turn, have allowed us to make many other profitable commitments.
1989.chinese: 拉尔夫业务贡献第49页非保险集团总利润约40%。1986年初买斯科特与费策，得到拉尔夫这位经理人，与得到企业同样重要。他不仅带来非凡利润，资本也管得极好。这些能力，为伯克希尔创造资金，又使我们能作许多其他有利投资。

1989.english:
And that completes our answer to the 1927 Yankees.

## Insurance Operations

Shown below is an updated version of our usual table presenting key figures for the property-casualty insurance industry:

```text
                   Statutory
Yearly Change    Combined Ratio    Yearly Change   Inflation Rate
 in Premiums   After Policyholder   in Incurred      Measured by
 Written (%)       Dividends         Losses (%)   GNP Deflator (%)
-------------  ------------------  -------------  ----------------
```

```text
1981           3.8              106.0             6.5              9.6
1982           3.7              109.6             8.4              6.5
1983           5.0              112.0             6.8              3.8
1984           8.5              118.0            16.9              3.8
1985          22.1              116.3            16.1              3.0
1986          22.2              108.0            13.5              2.6
1987           9.4              104.6             7.8              3.1
1988           4.4              105.4             5.5              3.3
1989 (Est.)    2.1              110.4             8.7              4.2
```

Source: A.M. Best Co.

The combined ratio represents total insurance costs (losses incurred plus expenses) compared to revenue from premiums: A ratio below 100 indicates an underwriting profit, and one above 100 indicates a loss. When the investment income that an insurer earns from holding policyholders' funds ("the float") is taken into account, a combined ratio in the 107-111 range typically produces an overall breakeven result, exclusive of earnings on the funds provided by shareholders.
1989.chinese:
资料来源：A.M. Best Co.。

综合成本率，是保险成本总额（已发生赔款加费用）与保费收入之比；低于100是承保盈利，高于100是亏损。考虑保险公司持有保户资金，即浮存金，所赚投资收入后，综合成本率107—111，通常能使整体盈亏平衡，不含股东提供资金的收益。

1989.english: For the reasons laid out in previous reports, we expect the industry's incurred losses to grow by about 10% annually, even in years when general inflation runs considerably lower. (Actually, over  the last 25 years, incurred  losses have  grown at a still faster rate, 11%.) If premium growth meanwhile materially lags that 10% rate, underwriting losses will mount, though the industry's tendency to underreserve when business turns bad may obscure their size for a time.
1989.chinese: 基于过去报告中列明的理由，我们预计，即使总体通胀低得多，行业已发生赔款仍会每年增长约10%。（事实上，过去25年增长得更快，为11%。）如果保费增幅明显落后于这个10%的水平，承保亏损便会增加；只不过，行业在生意转坏时往往少提准备金，可能暂时掩盖亏损规模。

1989.english:
Last year we said the climb in the combined ratio was "almost certain to continue - and probably will accelerate - for at least two more years." This year we will not predict acceleration, but otherwise must repeat last year's forecast. Premium growth is running far below the 10% required annually. Remember also that a 10% rate would only stabilize the combined ratio, not bring it down.

The increase in the combined ratio in 1989 was a little more than we had expected because catastrophes (led by Hurricane Hugo) were unusually severe. These abnormalities probably accounted for about two points of the increase. If 1990 is more of a "normal" year, the combined ratio should rise only minimally from the catastrophe-swollen base of 1989. In 1991, though, the ratio is apt to climb by a greater degree.
1989.chinese:
去年说，综合成本率上升“几乎肯定至少再持续两年，而且很可能加速”。今年不预测加速，其余仍得重复。保费增幅远低于每年所需的10%；还要记住，10%也只稳定综合成本率，不会降低它。

1989年综合成本率增幅略超预期，因为以雨果飓风为首的巨灾异常严重，大概贡献了两个百分点。若1990年较正常，从被巨灾抬高的1989年基数出发，成本率应仅略升；但1991年可能升得更多。

1989.english:
Commentators frequently discuss the "underwriting cycle" and speculate about its next turn. If that term is used to connote rhythmic qualities, it is in our view a misnomer that leads to faulty thinking about the industry's fundamental economics.

The term was appropriate some decades ago when the industry and regulators cooperated  to conduct the  business  in cartel fashion. At that  time, the combined ratio fluctuated rhythmically for two reasons, both related to lags. First, data from the past were analyzed and then used to set new "corrected" rates, which were subsequently put into effect by virtually all insurers. Second, the fact that almost all policies were then issued for a one-to three-year term - which meant that it took a considerable time for mispriced policies to expire - delayed the impact of new rates on revenues. These two lagged responses made combined ratios behave much like alternating current. Meanwhile, the absence of significant price competition guaranteed that industry profits, averaged out over the cycle, would be satisfactory.
1989.chinese:
评论者常谈“承保周期”，猜下次转折。如果用这个词表示有规律的节奏，我们认为是误称，会导致对行业基本经济特性的错误思考。

几十年前，行业与监管者合作，以卡特尔方式经营，这词合适。当时综合成本率因两项滞后而规律起伏：先分析历史数据，制定新的“修正”费率，几乎全体保险公司随后实施；又因当时几乎所有保单期限一至三年，错价保单很久才到期，新费率对收入的影响便延后。两层滞后使综合成本率像交流电。与此同时，没有明显价格竞争，保证周期平均利润令人满意。

1989.english:
The cartel period is long gone. Now the industry has hundreds of participants selling a commodity-like product at independently-established prices. Such a configuration - whether the product being sold is steel or insurance policies - is certain to cause subnormal profitability in all circumstances but one: a shortage of usable capacity. Just how often these periods occur and how long they last determines the average profitability of the industry in question.

In most industries, capacity is described in physical terms. In the insurance world, however, capacity is customarily described in financial terms; that is, it's considered appropriate for a company to write no more than X dollars of business if it has Y dollars of net worth. In practice, however, constraints of this sort have proven ineffective. Regulators, insurance brokers, and customers are all slow to discipline companies that strain their resources. They also acquiesce when companies grossly overstate their true capital. Hence, a company can write a great deal of business with very little capital if it is so inclined. At bottom, therefore, the amount of industry capacity at any particular moment primarily depends on the mental state of insurance managers.
1989.chinese:
卡特尔时代早已结束。如今，行业里有数百家参与者，各自独立定价，销售近似同质商品的产品。无论卖的是钢材还是保单，这样的结构都会使盈利低于正常水平，只有一种情况例外：可用产能短缺。短缺出现得有多频繁、持续多久，决定了相应行业的平均盈利水平。

多数行业用实物单位描述产能。但保险业通常用财务语言：一家公司的净资产若有Y美元，承保业务一般就不应超过X美元。然而，实践已证明，这类约束不起作用。对过度消耗自身资源的公司，监管者、保险经纪人和客户都迟迟不加约束；公司严重夸大真实资本时，他们也默许。因此，只要愿意，一家公司用很少资本，也能承保大量业务。归根结底，行业在任何时点的承保能力，主要取决于保险经理人的心理状态。

1989.english:
All this understood, it is not very difficult to prognosticate the industry's profits. Good profits will be realized only when there is a shortage of capacity. Shortages will occur only when insurers are frightened. That happens rarely - and most assuredly is not happening now.

Some analysts have argued that the more onerous taxes recently imposed on the insurance industry and 1989's catastrophes - Hurricane Hugo and the California earthquake - will cause prices to strengthen significantly. We disagree. These adversities have not destroyed the eagerness of insurers to write business at present prices. Therefore, premium volume won't grow by 10% in 1990, which means the negative underwriting trend will not reverse.
1989.chinese:
明白这些，预测行业利润并不难：只有产能短缺才有好利润；只有保险人害怕才会短缺。害怕罕见，如今更肯定没有。

有人认为，近期更重的税，加1989年雨果飓风及加州地震，会使价格明显走强。我们不同意。这些逆境没消灭保险公司按现价承揽的热情。因此，1990年保费不会增10%，承保的不利趋势也就不会逆转。

1989.english:
The industry will meantime say it needs higher prices to achieve profitability matching that of the average American business. Of course it does. So does the steel business. But needs and desires have nothing to do with the long-term profitability of industries. Instead, economic fundamentals determine the outcome. Insurance profitability will improve only when virtually all insurers are turning away business despite higher prices. And we're a long way from that point.

Berkshire's premium volume may drop to $150 million or so in 1990 (from a high of $1 billion in 1986), partly because our traditional business continues to shrink and partly because the contract under which we received 7% of the business of Fireman's Fund expired last August. Whatever the size of the drop, it will not disturb us. We have no interest in writing insurance that carries a mathematical expectation of loss; we experience enough disappointments doing transactions we believe to carry an expectation of profit.
1989.chinese:
行业同时会说，需要更高价格，才能取得美国一般企业的盈利水平。当然需要，钢铁业也需要。但需要、愿望，与行业长期利润无关，结果由经济基础决定。只有几乎所有保险人，尽管价格提高仍拒绝接业务，盈利才会改善。离那一步还远。

伯克希尔1990年保费可能降至约1.5亿美元，1986年高点为10亿美元。部分因传统业务继续缩小，部分因分得消防员基金7%业务的合同去年8月已到期。下降多少都不困扰我们。没有兴趣承保数学期望亏损的业务；做自以为期望盈利的交易，失望已经够多。

1989.english: However, our appetite for appropriately-priced business is ample, as one tale from 1989 will tell. It concerns "CAT covers," which are reinsurance contracts that primary insurance companies (and also reinsurers themselves) buy to protect themselves against a single catastrophe, such as a tornado or hurricane, that produces losses from a large number of policies. In these contracts, the primary insurer might retain the loss from a single event up to a maximum of, say, $10 million, buying various layers of reinsurance above that level. When losses exceed the retained amount, the reinsurer typically pays 95% of the excess up to its contractual limit, with the primary insurer paying the remainder. (By requiring the primary insurer to keep 5% of each layer, the reinsurer leaves him with a financial stake in each loss settlement and guards against his throwing away the reinsurer's money.)
1989.chinese: 不过，对定价合适的业务，胃口很大，1989年的故事可证。“巨灾保障”（CAT covers），是直接保险公司乃至再保险公司为保护自己而买的再保险，针对龙卷风、飓风等单次巨灾引发的大量保单赔款。比如直接保险人自留一次事件最初1000万美元损失，其上买多层再保险。超过自留额，再保险人通常在合同上限内付超额的95%，直接保险人付其余。要求每层留5%，让其对每笔理赔都有切身利益，避免拿再保险人的钱乱花。

1989.english: CAT covers are usually one-year policies that also provide for one automatic reinstatement, which requires a primary insurer whose coverage has been exhausted by a catastrophe to buy a second cover for the balance of the year in question by paying another premium. This provision protects the primary company from being "bare" for even a brief period after a first catastrophic event. The duration of "an event" is usually limited by contract to any span of 72 hours designated by the primary company. Under this definition, a wide-spread storm, causing damage for three days, will be classified as a single event if it arises from a single climatic cause. If the storm lasts four days, however, the primary company will file a claim carving out the 72 consecutive hours during which it suffered the greatest damage. Losses that occurred outside that period will be treated as arising from a separate event.
1989.chinese: 巨灾保障通常一年期，约定一次自动恢复保障：首次巨灾耗尽额度，直接保险人须再付保费，买本年余下期间的第二份保障，以免第一次巨灾后哪怕短时“裸奔”。合同通常把“一次事件”定义为直接保险人指定的任意连续72小时。同一气候原因造成的广泛风暴，若持续三天，算一次；若四天，就挑损失最重的连续72小时索赔，之外的损失作为另一次事件。

1989.english: In 1989, two unusual things happened. First, Hurricane Hugo generated $4 billion or more of insured loss, at a pace, however, that caused the vast damage in the Carolinas to occur slightly more than 72 hours after the equally severe damage in the Caribbean. Second, the California earthquake hit within weeks, causing insured damage that was difficult to estimate, even well after the event. Slammed by these two - or possibly three - major catastrophes, some primary insurers, and also many reinsurers that had themselves bought CAT protection, either used up their automatic second cover or became uncertain as to whether they had done so.
1989.chinese: 1989年发生了两件异常的事。第一，雨果飓风造成至少40亿美元的保险损失；不过，它的移动节奏，使卡罗来纳地区的巨大损失，发生在加勒比海同样严重的损失之后略多于72小时。第二，几周之内，加州地震又来了；即使事隔很久，保险损失仍难以估算。受到这两次、也可能算三次重大灾害冲击，有些直接保险公司，以及许多自己也买了巨灾保障的再保险公司，要么已经用尽自动恢复的第二份保障，要么拿不准是否用尽。

1989.english:
At that point sellers of CAT policies had lost a huge amount of money - perhaps twice because of the reinstatements - and not taken in much in premiums. Depending upon many  variables, a CAT premium  might generally have run 3% to 15% of the amount of protection purchased. For some years, we've thought premiums of that kind inadequate and have stayed away from the business.

But because the 1989 disasters left many insurers either actually or possibly bare, and also left most CAT writers licking their wounds, there was an immediate shortage after the earthquake of much-needed catastrophe coverage. Prices instantly became attractive, particularly for the reinsurance that CAT writers themselves buy. Just as instantly, Berkshire Hathaway offered to write up to $250 million of catastrophe coverage, advertising that proposition in trade publications. Though we did not write all the business we sought, we did in a busy ten days book a substantial amount.
1989.chinese:
此时，CAT卖方已亏巨款，因恢复保障可能亏两次，收到的保费却不多。取决于多种因素，保费通常只是保障额的3%—15%。多年来，我们认为这种保费不足，一直避开。

但1989年的灾害，让许多保险人实际或可能裸露，CAT承保人多数也在舔伤口，地震后急需的巨灾保障立刻短缺。价格立即诱人，CAT承保人自己买的再保险尤其如此。伯克希尔同样立即宣布愿承保最多2.5亿美元，并在行业刊物登广告。虽未拿到所有想要的业务，繁忙的十天里，仍签了相当数量。

1989.english: Our willingness to put such a huge sum on the line for a loss that could occur tomorrow sets us apart from any reinsurer in the world. There are, of course, companies that sometimes write $250 million or even far more of catastrophe coverage. But they do so only when they can, in turn, reinsure a large percentage of the business with other companies. When they can't "lay off" in size, they disappear from the market.
1989.chinese: 愿为明天可能发生的损失，押这么大的钱，让我们区别于全球任何再保险公司。有些公司偶尔也承保2.5亿美元甚至更多巨灾，但前提是能把很大比例再保给其他公司；若不能大量分出去，它们就从市场消失。

1989.english:
Berkshire's policy, conversely, is to retain the business we write rather than lay it off. When rates carry an expectation of profit, we want to assume as much risk as is prudent. And in our case, that's a lot.

We will accept more reinsurance risk for our own account than any other company because of two factors: (1) by the standards of regulatory accounting, we have a net worth in our insurance companies of about $6 billion - the second highest amount in the United States; and (2) we simply don't care what earnings we report quarterly, or even annually, just as long as the decisions leading to those earnings (or losses) were reached intelligently.
1989.chinese:
伯克希尔相反，政策是把承保业务自留，不分出去。费率预示盈利，就想承担审慎范围内尽可能多的风险；对我们，这个量很大。

比任何其他公司承担更多自留再保险风险，有两个原因：（1）按监管会计标准，保险公司净资产约60亿美元，全美第二；（2）只要产生利润或亏损的决定作得明智，我们根本不在意季度、甚至年度报告利润多少。

1989.english: Obviously, if we write $250 million of catastrophe coverage and retain it all ourselves, there is some probability that we will lose the full $250 million in a single quarter. That probability is low, but it is not zero. If we had a loss of that magnitude, our after-tax cost would be about $165 million. Though that is far more than Berkshire normally earns in a quarter, the damage would be a blow only to our pride, not to our well-being.
1989.chinese: 显然，如果承保2.5亿美元巨灾保障，并且全部自行保留，就有一定概率在一个季度内亏掉整整2.5亿美元。概率虽低，却不是零。若发生这么大的损失，税后成本约为1.65亿美元。这远超过伯克希尔通常一个季度的利润，不过打击的只会是我们的自尊，不会伤及我们的安稳。

1989.english: This posture is one few insurance managements will assume. Typically, they are willing to write scads of business on terms that almost guarantee them mediocre returns on equity. But they do not want to expose themselves to an embarrassing single- quarter loss, even if the managerial strategy that causes the loss promises, over time, to produce superior results. I can understand their thinking: What is best for their owners is not necessarily best for the managers. Fortunately Charlie and I have both total job security and financial interests that are identical with those of our shareholders. We are willing to look foolish as long as we don't feel we have acted foolishly.
1989.chinese: 很少保险管理层肯采取这种姿态。通常，他们愿大量承保几乎注定股东权益回报平庸的业务，却不愿冒单季巨亏丢脸的风险，即使导致该损失的管理战略长期预示更好结果。我能理解：最有利于所有者，未必最有利于经理人。幸好查理和我饭碗完全稳固，经济利益又与股东一致。只要不觉得自己做事愚蠢，愿意看起来愚蠢。

1989.english: Our method of operation, incidentally, makes us a stabilizing force in the industry. We add huge capacity when capacity is short and we become less competitive only when capacity is abundant. Of course, we don't follow this policy in the interest of stabilization - we follow it because we believe it to be the most sensible and profitable course of action. Nevertheless, our behavior steadies the  market. In  this case, Adam  Smith's  invisible  hand works as advertised.
1989.chinese: 顺便说，这种经营方式使我们成为行业里一股稳定力量。承保能力短缺时，我们大量增加供给；只有在供给充足时，才不那么积极竞争。当然，我们不是为了稳定行业才这样做，而是相信这是最明智、最赚钱的做法。不过，我们的行为确实稳定了市场。在这里，亚当·斯密那只看不见的手，效果果然名不虚传。

1989.english:
Currently, we hold an exceptional amount of float compared to premium volume. This circumstance should produce quite favorable insurance results for us during the next few years as it did in 1989. Our underwriting losses should be tolerable and our investment income from policyholder funds large. This pleasant situation, however, will gradually deteriorate as our float runs off.

At some point, however, there will be an opportunity for us to write large amounts of profitable business. Mike Goldberg and his management team of Rod Eldred, Dinos Iordanou, Ajit Jain, Phil Urban, and Don Wurster continue to position us well for this eventuality.
1989.chinese:
目前，相对保费总额，我们持有异常多的浮存金，未来几年应像1989年一样带来不错结果：承保亏损可承受，保户资金投资收入丰厚。但浮存金逐渐流出，这种愉快局面会渐渐恶化。

不过，总会出现大量承保有利润业务的机会。迈克·戈德伯格及团队罗德·埃尔德雷德、迪诺斯·约尔达努、阿吉特·贾因、菲尔·厄本、唐·沃斯特，继续为那一天做好准备。

1989.english:
## Marketable Securities

In selecting marketable securities for our insurance companies, we generally choose among five major categories: (1) long-term common stock investments, (2) medium-term fixed income securities, (3) long-term fixed income securities, (4) short-term cash equivalents, and (5) short-term arbitrage commitments.

We have no particular bias when it comes to choosing from these categories; we just continuously search among them for the highest after-tax returns as measured by "mathematical expectation," limiting ourselves always to investment alternatives we think we understand. Our criteria have nothing to do with maximizing immediately reportable earnings; our goal, rather, is to maximize eventual net worth.
1989.chinese:
## 有价证券

为保险公司选择有价证券时，我们通常在五大类中挑选：（1）长期持有的普通股投资；（2）中期固定收益证券；（3）长期固定收益证券；（4）短期现金等价物；（5）短期套利头寸。

选择这些类别时，我们没有什么特别偏好，只是不断从中寻找按“数学期望”衡量的最高税后回报，而且始终只考虑我们自认为懂得的投资选择。我们的标准与把眼前可报告的利润做得最高毫不相干；目标是让最终的净资产尽可能大。

1989.english:
o     Below we list our common stock holdings having a value of over $100 million. A small portion of these investments belongs to subsidiaries of which Berkshire owns less than 100%.

1989.chinese:
以下列出市值超过1亿美元的普通股持仓。其中一小部分投资属于伯克希尔持股不足100%的子公司。

**1989年12月31日普通股持仓（成本及市值单位：千美元；股数不省略）**

| 持有股数 | 公司 | 成本 | 市值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3,000,000 | 大都会／美国广播公司（Capital Cities/ABC, Inc.） | 517,500 | 1,692,375 |
| 23,350,000 | 可口可乐公司（The Coca-Cola Co.） | 1,023,920 | 1,803,787 |
