With Tony at the helm, it is reaching levels of performance that the organization would only a few years ago have thought impossible.
1996.chinese:
## 盖可及其他直接保险业务

去年年初全面收购盖可时，我们抱有很高的期待，如今实际表现超过了所有这些期待。无论从业务角度还是从个人合作的角度看，都是如此。盖可的经营负责人托尼·奈斯利（Tony Nicely），既是出色的管理者，也是令人愉快的合作伙伴。几乎在任何情况下，盖可都会是一项极有价值的资产；而在托尼掌舵之下，它正在达到几年前连公司自己都认为不可能达到的业绩水平。

1996.english: There's nothing esoteric about GEICO's success:  The company's competitive strength flows directly from its position as a low-cost operator.  Low costs permit low prices, and low prices attract and retain good policyholders.  The final segment of a virtuous circle is drawn when policyholders recommend us to their friends.  GEICO gets more than one million referrals annually and these produce more than half of our new business,  an advantage that gives us enormous savings in acquisition expenses - and that makes our costs still lower.
1996.chinese: 盖可的成功没有什么神秘之处。公司的竞争力，直接来自低成本经营的地位。低成本使低价格成为可能，低价格又吸引并留住优质投保人。当这些客户把盖可推荐给朋友时，良性循环的最后一环也就接上了。盖可每年获得超过100万次客户推荐，由此带来的业务占新增业务的一半以上。这一优势让我们大幅节省获客费用，又进一步降低了成本。

1996.english: This formula worked in spades for GEICO in 1996:  Its voluntary auto policy count grew 10%.  During the previous 20 years, the company's best- ever growth for a year had been 8%, a rate achieved only once.  Better yet, the growth in voluntary policies accelerated during the year, led by major gains in the nonstandard market, which has been an underdeveloped area at GEICO.  I focus here on voluntary policies because the involuntary business we get from assigned risk pools and the like is unprofitable.  Growth in that sector is most unwelcome.
1996.chinese: 1996年，这套模式在盖可取得了显著成效：自愿承保的汽车保单数量增长10%。在此前20年里，公司最高的单年增长率是8%，而且只达到过一次。更可喜的是，年内自愿承保保单的增长还在加速，主要由非标准风险市场的大幅增长带动，这块市场此前在盖可开发得还很不充分。我之所以强调自愿承保保单，是因为我们从指定风险分配机制等渠道获得的非自愿承保业务并不盈利。这类业务的增长最不受欢迎。

1996.english:
GEICO's growth would mean nothing if it did not produce reasonable underwriting profits.  Here, too, the news is good:  Last year we hit our underwriting targets and then some.  Our goal, however, is not to widen our profit margin but rather to enlarge the price advantage we offer customers. Given that strategy, we believe that 1997's growth will easily top that of last year.

We expect new competitors to enter the direct-response market, and some of our existing competitors are likely to expand geographically. Nonetheless, the economies of scale we enjoy should allow us to maintain or even widen the protective moat surrounding our economic castle.  We do best on costs in geographical areas in which we enjoy high market penetration. As our policy count grows, concurrently delivering gains in penetration, we expect to drive costs materially lower.  GEICO's sustainable cost advantage is what attracted me to the company way back in 1951, when the entire business was valued at $7 million.  It is also why I felt Berkshire should pay $2.3 billion last year for the 49% of the company that we didn't then own.
1996.chinese:
如果不能带来合理的承保利润，盖可的增长就毫无意义。在这方面，也有好消息：去年，我们不仅达到了承保目标，还超额完成。不过，我们的目标不是扩大利润率，而是扩大给客户提供的价格优势。基于这一策略，我们相信1997年的增长将轻松超过去年。

我们预计，会有新的竞争者进入直销保险市场，现有的一些对手也可能扩大经营地域。即便如此，我们享有的规模经济，应能让我们保持、甚至加宽围绕这座经济城堡的护城河。在市场渗透率较高的地区，我们的成本表现最好。随着保单数量和市场渗透率同步提高，我们预计可以大幅压低成本。早在1951年，盖可可持续的成本优势就吸引了我，当时整家公司的估值只有700万美元。也正因为如此，我认为伯克希尔去年应当支付23亿美元，买下我们此前尚未持有的49%股权。

1996.english:
Maximizing the results of a wonderful business requires management and focus.  Lucky for us, we have in Tony a superb manager whose business focus never wavers.  Wanting also to get the entire GEICO organization concentrating as he does, we needed a compensation plan that was itself sharply focused - and immediately after our purchase, we put one in.

Today, the bonuses received by dozens of top executives, starting with Tony, are based upon only two key variables:  (1) growth in voluntary auto policies and (2) underwriting profitability on "seasoned" auto business (meaning policies that have been on the books for more than one year).  In addition, we use the same yardsticks to calculate the annual contribution to the company's profit-sharing plan.  Everyone at GEICO knows what counts.
1996.chinese:
要把一家优秀企业的潜力充分发挥出来，需要管理，也需要专注。我们很幸运，托尼是一位卓越的管理者，而且始终专注于业务。为了让盖可全体员工像他一样集中精力，我们需要一套同样聚焦的薪酬方案。收购刚完成，我们就实施了这套方案。

如今，从托尼开始，数十位高管的奖金只取决于两个核心变量：一是自愿承保汽车保单的增长；二是“成熟”汽车保险业务的承保盈利能力，即已承保超过一年的保单。此外，公司每年向利润分享计划缴付多少资金，也使用同一套指标计算。盖可的每个人都知道，什么才是重要的。

1996.english: The GEICO plan exemplifies Berkshire's incentive compensation principles:  Goals should be (1) tailored to the economics of the specific operating business; (2) simple in character so that the degree to which they are being realized can be easily measured; and (3) directly related to the daily activities of plan participants.  As a corollary, we shun "lottery ticket" arrangements, such as options on Berkshire shares, whose ultimate value - which could range from zero to huge - is totally out of the control of the person whose behavior we would like to affect.  In our view, a system that produces quixotic payoffs will not only be wasteful for owners but may actually discourage the focused behavior we value in managers.
1996.chinese: 盖可的方案体现了伯克希尔的激励薪酬原则。目标应当满足三个条件：第一，适合具体经营业务的经济特性；第二，简单明了，便于衡量完成程度；第三，与参与者的日常工作直接相关。相应地，我们避免那些像“彩票”一样的安排，例如伯克希尔股票期权。期权的最终价值可能为零，也可能极其巨大，却完全不在我们希望激励的那个人的控制范围内。在我们看来，一套报酬结果难以捉摸的制度，不仅浪费股东的钱，还可能削弱我们所看重的管理者对业务的专注。

1996.english: Every quarter, all 9,000 GEICO associates can see the results that determine our profit-sharing plan contribution.  In 1996, they enjoyed the experience because the plan literally went off the chart that had been constructed at the start of the year.  Even I knew the answer to that problem:  Enlarge the chart.  Ultimately, the results called for a record contribution of 16.9% ($40 million), compared to a five-year average of less than 10% for the comparable plans previously in effect.  Furthermore, at Berkshire, we never greet good work by raising the bar.  If GEICO's performance continues to improve, we will happily keep on making larger charts.
1996.chinese: 每个季度，盖可的全部9,000名员工都能看到决定公司向利润分享计划缴款金额的业绩数据。1996年，这对他们来说是件开心事，因为业绩真的超过了年初设计的奖励表格的最高档。连我都知道该怎么办：把表格往上扩。最终，按业绩计算出的缴付比例达到创纪录的16.9%，金额为4,000万美元；而此前类似计划的五年平均比例还不到10%。此外，在伯克希尔，我们从不通过提高门槛来“回报”出色工作。如果盖可的业绩继续改善，我们会很高兴地不断扩大表格。

1996.english: Lou Simpson continues to manage GEICO's money in an outstanding manner:  Last year, the equities in his portfolio outdid the S&P 500 by 6.2 percentage points.  In Lou's part of GEICO's operation, we again tie compensation to performance - but to investment performance over a four- year period, not to underwriting results nor to the performance of GEICO as a whole.  We think it foolish for an insurance company to pay bonuses that are tied to overall corporate results when great work on one side of the business - underwriting or investment - could conceivably be completely neutralized by bad work on the other.  If you bat .350 at Berkshire, you can be sure you will get paid commensurately even if the rest of the team bats .200.  In Lou and Tony, however, we are lucky to have Hall-of-Famers in both key positions.
1996.chinese: 卢·辛普森（Lou Simpson）继续以出色的方式管理盖可的资金。去年，他管理的股票组合跑赢标准普尔500指数6.2个百分点。在卢负责的业务中，我们同样把薪酬与业绩挂钩，但挂钩的是四年期投资表现，而非承保结果，也不是盖可的整体表现。在我们看来，一家保险公司如果按整体业绩发奖金，是不明智的：承保或投资一端的优秀成绩，很可能被另一端的糟糕表现完全抵消。在伯克希尔，如果你的打击率达到0.350，即使队友只有0.200，你也能得到相称的报酬。而有卢和托尼在，我们很幸运，两个关键位置都坐着名人堂级别的选手。

1996.english:
---

Though they are, of course, smaller than GEICO, our other primary insurance operations turned in equally stunning results last year. National Indemnity's traditional business had a combined ratio of 74.2 and, as usual, developed a large amount of float compared to premium volume. Over the last three years, this segment of our business, run by Don Wurster, has had an average combined ratio of 83.0.  Our homestate operation, managed by Rod Eldred, recorded a combined ratio of 87.1 even though it absorbed the expenses of expanding to new states.  Rod's three- year combined ratio is an amazing 83.2.  Berkshire's workers' compensation business, run out of California by Brad Kinstler, has now moved into six other states and, despite the costs of that expansion, again achieved an excellent underwriting profit.  Finally, John Kizer, at Central States Indemnity, set new records for premium volume while generating good earnings from underwriting.  In aggregate, our smaller insurance operations (now including Kansas Bankers Surety) have an underwriting record virtually unmatched in the industry.  Don, Rod, Brad and John have all created significant value for Berkshire, and we believe there is more to come.
1996.chinese:
* * *

我们的其他直接保险业务，规模当然不及盖可，但去年同样取得了惊人的成绩。国民赔偿保险公司（National Indemnity）的传统业务，综合成本率为74.2%；与往常一样，相对于保费收入，它产生了大量浮存金。过去三年，这项由唐·沃斯特（Don Wurster）负责的业务，平均综合成本率为83.0%。罗德·埃尔德雷德（Rod Eldred）管理的Homestate保险业务，即使承担了向新州扩张的费用，综合成本率仍为87.1%；其三年综合成本率低至83.2%，令人惊叹。布拉德·金斯特勒（Brad Kinstler）在加州负责的工伤赔偿保险业务，如今已扩展至另外六个州；虽然为此承担了扩张成本，仍再次实现了出色的承保利润。最后，中央各州赔偿保险公司（Central States Indemnity）的约翰·凯泽（John Kizer），在创造良好承保利润的同时，也刷新了保费收入纪录。总体而言，我们这些较小的保险业务，如今还包括KBS，其承保业绩在业内几乎无人能及。唐、罗德、布拉德和约翰都为伯克希尔创造了重要价值，我们相信，未来还会有更多。

1996.english:
Taxes

In 1961, President Kennedy said that we should ask not what our country can do for us, but rather ask what we can do for our country.  Last year we decided to give his suggestion a try - and who says it never hurts to ask?  We were told to mail $860 million in income taxes to the U.S. Treasury.

Here's a little perspective on that figure:  If an equal amount had been paid by only 2,000 other taxpayers, the government would have had a balanced budget in 1996 without needing a dime of taxes - income or Social Security or what have you - from any other American.  Berkshire shareholders can truly say, "I gave at the office."
1996.chinese:
## 税款

1961年，肯尼迪总统说，我们不应该问国家能为我们做什么，而应该问自己能为国家做什么。去年，我们决定照他的建议试一试——谁说问问又不会有什么损失？我们得到的答复是：请向美国财政部寄去8.6亿美元所得税。

把这个数字放到背景中看：如果再有2,000名纳税人各缴同样金额，1996年联邦政府就能实现预算平衡，而无须向其他任何美国人再收一分钱，无论是所得税、社会保障税，还是其他什么税。伯克希尔的股东完全可以说：“我已经通过公司捐过了。”

1996.english:
Charlie and I believe that large tax payments by Berkshire are entirely fitting.  The contribution we thus make to society's well-being is at most only proportional to its contribution to ours.  Berkshire prospers in America as it would nowhere else.

## Sources of Reported Earnings

The table that follows shows the main sources of Berkshire's reported earnings.  In this presentation, purchase-accounting adjustments are not assigned to the specific businesses to which they apply, but are instead aggregated and shown separately.  This procedure lets you view the earnings of our businesses as they would have been reported had we not purchased them.  For the reasons discussed on pages 65 and 66, this form of presentation seems to us to be more useful to investors and managers than one utilizing generally-accepted accounting principles (GAAP), which require purchase-premiums to be charged off business-by-business.  The total earnings we show in the table are, of course, identical to the GAAP total in our audited financial statements.
1996.chinese:
查理和我认为，伯克希尔缴纳巨额税款完全合适。我们以此为社会福祉作出的贡献，充其量也不过与社会对我们福祉的贡献相称。伯克希尔在美国能够如此兴旺，在其他任何地方都不会如此。

## 财报利润的来源

下表列出伯克希尔财报利润的主要来源。在这张表中，收购会计调整并未分摊到各自对应的业务，而是汇总后单独列示。这样，各位就能看到：假如我们没有收购这些企业，它们本来会报告怎样的利润。由于第65和66页所讨论的原因，我们认为，这种列示方法比一般公认会计原则（GAAP）要求将收购溢价逐项计入各业务费用的方法，对投资者和管理者更有用。当然，表中的总利润，与我们经审计财务报表中的GAAP总利润完全一致。

1996.english:
In this section last year, I discussed three businesses that reported a decline in earnings - Buffalo News, Shoe Group and World Book.  All, I'm happy to say, recorded gains in 1996.

World Book, however, did not find it easy:  Despite the operation's new status as the only direct-seller of encyclopedias in the country (Encyclopedia Britannica exited the field last year), its unit volume fell. Additionally, World Book spent heavily on a new CD-ROM product that began to take in revenues only in early 1997, when it was launched in association with IBM.  In the face of these factors, earnings would have evaporated had World Book not revamped distribution methods and cut overhead at headquarters, thereby dramatically reducing its fixed costs.  Overall, the company has gone a long way toward assuring its long-term viability in both the print and electronic marketplaces.
1996.chinese:
去年，在这一节中，我谈到了三项利润下降的业务：布法罗新闻报、鞋业集团和世界图书百科全书。很高兴告诉各位，它们在1996年都取得了利润增长。

不过，世界图书百科全书的进步来之不易。虽然大英百科全书去年退出了直销市场，使它成为美国唯一一家通过直销方式销售百科全书的公司，但其销量仍在下降。此外，公司在一款新的CD-ROM光盘产品上投入了大量资金，直到1997年年初与IBM合作推出时，才开始获得收入。在这些因素的影响下，若不是公司改革销售渠道、削减总部管理费用，从而大幅降低固定成本，利润本来可能全部消失。总体而言，公司在确保自己于纸质和电子出版市场长期生存方面，已经取得了很大进展。

1996.english:
Our only disappointment last year was in jewelry:  Borsheim's did fine, but Helzberg's suffered a material decline in earnings.  Its expense levels had been geared to a sizable increase in same-store sales, consistent with the gains achieved in recent years.  When sales were instead flat, profit margins fell.  Jeff Comment, CEO of Helzberg's, is addressing the expense problem in a decisive manner, and the company's earnings should improve in 1997.

Overall, our operating businesses continue to perform exceptionally, far outdoing their industry norms.  For this, Charlie and I thank our managers.  If you should see any of them at the Annual Meeting, add your thanks as well.
1996.chinese:
去年唯一让我们失望的是珠宝业务。波仙珠宝（Borsheim’s）表现良好，但赫尔兹伯格（Helzberg’s）的利润大幅下降。它原先按照近年来的增长势头，预期同店销售额将显著增加，并据此安排了费用；结果销售额却持平，利润率便下降了。首席执行官杰夫·科门特（Jeff Comment）正在果断处理费用问题，公司1997年的利润应该会改善。

总体而言，我们的经营业务继续表现出色，远远超过各自行业的通常水平。为此，查理和我感谢所有管理者。如果各位在股东大会上遇到他们，也请向他们表达谢意。

1996.english: More information about our various businesses is given on pages 36- 46, where you will also find our segment earnings reported on a GAAP basis.  In addition, on pages 51-57, we have rearranged Berkshire's financial data into four segments on a non-GAAP basis, a presentation that corresponds to the way Charlie and I think about the company. 1996.english:
## "Look-Through" Earnings

Reported earnings are a poor measure of economic progress at Berkshire, in part because the numbers shown in the table presented earlier include only the dividends we receive from investees - though these dividends typically represent only a small fraction of the earnings attributable to our ownership.  Not that we mind this division of money, since on balance we regard the undistributed earnings of investees as more valuable to us than the portion paid out.  The reason is simple: Our investees often have the opportunity to reinvest earnings at high rates of return.  So why should we want them paid out?
1996.chinese:
## 穿透利润

财报利润并不能很好地衡量伯克希尔在经济上的进展。部分原因是，前面表格中的数字只计入了被投资公司向我们支付的股息，而这些股息通常只占我们按持股比例应享有利润的一小部分。我们并不介意这种资金分配方式，因为总体而言，我们认为，被投资公司留存的利润，比已经分给我们的那部分更有价值。原因很简单：它们往往有机会以较高回报率将利润再投资。既然如此，我们为什么非要它们分出来？

1996.english: To depict something closer to economic reality at Berkshire than reported earnings, though, we employ the concept of "look-through" earnings.  As we calculate these, they consist of: (1) the operating earnings reported in the previous section, plus; (2) our share of the retained operating earnings of major investees that, under GAAP accounting, are not reflected in our profits, less; (3) an allowance for the tax that would be paid by Berkshire if these retained earnings of investees had instead been distributed to us.  When tabulating "operating earnings" here, we exclude purchase-accounting adjustments as well as capital gains and other major non-recurring items.
1996.chinese: 为了比财报利润更接近地反映伯克希尔的经济实况，我们使用“穿透利润”（look-through earnings）这一概念。我们的计算方法是：第一，取上一节报告的经营利润；第二，加上我们按持股比例应享有的主要被投资公司的留存经营利润，这部分按GAAP并未反映在我们的利润中；第三，扣除一笔估计税款，即假设被投资公司把这些留存利润分给我们，伯克希尔需要支付的税款。这里计算“经营利润”时，我们剔除了收购会计调整、资本利得及其他重大的非经常性项目。

Our portfolio shows little change:  We continue to make more money when snoring than when active.

Inactivity strikes us as intelligent behavior.  Neither we nor most business managers would dream of feverishly trading highly-profitable subsidiaries because a small move in the Federal Reserve's discount rate was predicted or because some Wall Street pundit had reversed his views on the market.  Why, then, should we behave differently with our minority positions in wonderful businesses?  The art of investing in public companies successfully is little different from the art of successfully acquiring subsidiaries.  In each case you simply want to acquire, at a sensible price, a business with excellent economics and able, honest management.  Thereafter, you need only monitor whether these qualities are being preserved.
1996.chinese:
* 成本按税务基础计算，合计比GAAP成本低12亿美元。

我们的投资组合变化不大：我们仍然是打呼噜时赚的钱，比忙碌时更多。

在我们看来，按兵不动是一种明智的行为。无论我们，还是大多数企业管理者，都不会仅仅因为有人预测美联储将小幅调整贴现率，或某位华尔街评论家改变了对市场的看法，就疯狂买卖旗下盈利丰厚的子公司。那么，对优秀企业的少数股权，我们为什么要采取不同的做法？成功投资上市公司的技巧，与成功收购子公司的技巧相差无几。无论哪一种，你想要的都是以合理的价格，买到一家经济特性优秀、管理者诚实能干的企业。此后，只需观察这些品质是否仍然存在。

1996.english: When carried out capably, an investment strategy of that type will often result in its practitioner owning a few securities that will come to represent a very large portion of his portfolio.  This investor would get a similar result if he followed a policy of purchasing an interest in, say, 20% of the future earnings of a number of outstanding college basketball stars.  A handful of these would go on to achieve NBA stardom, and the investor's take from them would soon dominate his royalty stream. To suggest that this investor should sell off portions of his most successful investments simply because they have come to dominate his portfolio is akin to suggesting that the Bulls trade Michael Jordan because he has become so important to the team.
1996.chinese: 如果执行得当，这种投资策略往往会让投资者最终持有少数几只占组合很大比重的股票。假设他购买一批优秀大学篮球明星未来收入的20%，也会得到类似的结果：其中少数人日后成为NBA明星，投资者从他们身上得到的分成，很快便会占总分成的大部分。仅仅因为最成功的投资占了组合的大头，就建议投资者卖掉其中一部分，无异于建议公牛队交易迈克尔·乔丹，理由是他对球队太重要了。

1996.english: In studying the investments we have made in both subsidiary companies and common stocks, you will see that we favor businesses and industries unlikely to experience major change.  The reason for that is simple:  Making either type of purchase, we are searching for operations that we believe are virtually certain to possess enormous competitive strength ten or twenty years from now.  A fast-changing industry environment may offer the chance for huge wins, but it precludes the certainty we seek.
1996.chinese: 研究我们对子公司和普通股的投资，就会发现，我们偏爱不太可能发生重大变化的企业和行业。理由很简单：无论哪种购买方式，我们寻找的都是那些我们认为在十年或二十年后，几乎肯定仍拥有强大竞争力的业务。快速变化的行业环境可能带来大获全胜的机会，却无法提供我们所追求的确定性。

1996.english:
I should emphasize that, as citizens, Charlie and I welcome change: Fresh ideas, new products, innovative processes and the like cause our country's standard of living to rise, and that's clearly good.  As investors, however, our reaction to a fermenting industry is much like our attitude toward space exploration:  We applaud the endeavor but prefer to skip the ride.

Obviously all businesses change to some extent.  Today, See's is different in many ways from what it was in 1972 when we bought it:  It offers a different assortment of candy, employs different machinery and sells through different distribution channels.  But the reasons why people today buy boxed chocolates, and why they buy them from us rather than from someone else, are virtually unchanged from what they were in the 1920s when the See family was building the business.  Moreover, these motivations are not likely to change over the next 20 years, or even 50.
1996.chinese:
我要强调，作为公民，查理和我欢迎变化。新思想、新产品、新工艺等，会提高我们国家的生活水平，这显然是好事。但作为投资者，我们面对剧烈变动的行业，就像面对太空探索：我们为这项事业鼓掌，却更愿意不上那艘飞船。

当然，所有企业多少都会变化。如今的喜诗糖果，与我们1972年收购时相比，许多方面都不一样了：糖果品种不同，生产设备不同，销售渠道也不同。但今天人们为什么购买盒装巧克力，以及为什么向我们而非其他人购买，这些原因与20世纪20年代喜诗家族创办这门生意时几乎没有变化。而且，在未来20年、甚至50年里，这些动机也不太可能改变。

1996.english: We look for similar predictability in marketable securities.  Take Coca-Cola:  The zeal and imagination with which Coke products are sold has burgeoned under Roberto Goizueta, who has done an absolutely incredible job in creating value for his shareholders.  Aided by Don Keough and Doug Ivester, Roberto has rethought and improved every aspect of the company.  But the fundamentals of the business - the qualities that underlie Coke's competitive dominance and stunning economics - have remained constant through the years.
1996.chinese: 在上市证券投资中，我们同样寻找这样的可预测性。以可口可乐为例：在罗伯托·戈伊苏埃塔（Roberto Goizueta）的领导下，产品营销中的热情和想象力大幅提升，他为股东创造价值的成绩令人难以置信。在唐·基奥（Don Keough）和道格·艾维斯特（Doug Ivester）协助下，罗伯托重新审视并改进了公司的各个方面。但这门生意的基本要素，即支撑可口可乐竞争优势和卓越经济效益的那些特征，多年来始终没有改变。

1996.english: I was recently studying the 1896 report of Coke (and you think that you are behind in your reading!).  At that time Coke, though it was already the leading soft drink, had been around for only a decade.  But its blueprint for the next 100 years was already drawn.  Reporting sales of $148,000 that year, Asa Candler, the company's president, said:  "We have not lagged in our efforts to go into all the world teaching that Coca-Cola is the article, par excellence, for the health and good feeling of all people."  Though "health" may have been a reach, I love the fact that Coke still relies on Candler's basic theme today - a century later. Candler went on to say, just as Roberto could now, "No article of like character has ever so firmly entrenched itself in public favor."  Sales of syrup that year, incidentally, were 116,492 gallons versus about 3.2 billion in 1996.
1996.chinese: 最近，我在研读可口可乐1896年的年报。各位还觉得自己的阅读进度落后吗？那时，可口可乐虽然已经是领先的软饮料，但问世不过十年，未来一百年的蓝图却已画好。公司当年销售额为148,000美元，总裁阿萨·坎德勒（Asa Candler）说：“我们始终努力走向全世界，告诉大家，可口可乐是增进所有人健康与愉悦感受的卓越产品。”虽然“健康”一说可能有点牵强，但一百年后，可口可乐依旧围绕坎德勒的基本主题经营，这让我很喜欢。坎德勒还说过一句今天罗伯托也完全可以说的话：“没有任何同类产品，能像它这样深深赢得公众的喜爱。”顺带一提，当年的糖浆销量是116,492加仑，而1996年约为32亿加仑。

1996.english:
I can't resist one more Candler quote:  "Beginning this year about March 1st . . . we employed ten traveling salesmen by means of which, with systematic correspondence from the office, we covered almost the territory of the Union."  That's my kind of sales force.

Companies such as Coca-Cola and Gillette might well be labeled "The Inevitables."  Forecasters may differ a bit in their predictions of exactly how much soft drink or shaving-equipment business these companies will be doing in ten or twenty years.  Nor is our talk of inevitability meant to play down the vital work that these companies must continue to carry out, in such areas as manufacturing, distribution, packaging and product innovation.  In the end, however, no sensible observer - not even these companies' most vigorous competitors, assuming they are assessing the matter honestly - questions that Coke and Gillette will dominate their fields worldwide for an investment lifetime.  Indeed, their dominance will probably strengthen.  Both companies have significantly expanded their already huge shares of market during the past ten years, and all signs point to their repeating that performance in the next decade.
1996.chinese:
我忍不住再引用坎德勒的一句话：“今年大约从3月1日起……我们雇用了十名巡回推销员，配合总部有系统的函件联系，业务几乎覆盖整个联邦。”这才是我喜欢的销售队伍。

可口可乐和吉列这样的公司，或许可以称为“胜局笃定者”（The Inevitables）。预测者可能对它们十年或二十年后究竟能卖出多少软饮料或剃须用品有些分歧。我们所说的笃定，也并非要淡化这些公司在制造、分销、包装和产品创新等方面必须持续开展的重要工作。但归根结底，任何理性的观察者，即使是它们最强劲的竞争对手，只要诚实评估，都不会怀疑：在一个投资者的一生中，可口可乐和吉列仍将在各自领域主导全球市场。事实上，这种主导地位很可能进一步加强。过去十年，它们在原本已经很大的市场份额基础上，又显著扩大了份额；各种迹象表明，未来十年还会重演这一表现。

1996.english:
Obviously many companies in high-tech businesses or embryonic industries will grow much faster in percentage terms than will The Inevitables.  But I would rather be certain of a good result than hopeful of a great one.

Of course, Charlie and I can identify only a few Inevitables, even after a lifetime of looking for them.  Leadership alone provides no certainties:  Witness the shocks some years back at General Motors, IBM and Sears, all of which had enjoyed long periods of seeming invincibility.  Though some industries or lines of business exhibit characteristics that endow leaders with virtually insurmountable advantages, and that tend to establish Survival of the Fattest as almost a natural law, most do not.  Thus, for every Inevitable, there are dozens of Impostors, companies now riding high but vulnerable to competitive attacks.  Considering what it takes to be an Inevitable, Charlie and I recognize that we will never be able to come up with a Nifty Fifty or even a Twinkling Twenty.  To the Inevitables in our portfolio, therefore, we add a few "Highly Probables."
1996.chinese:
显然，许多高科技公司或新兴行业中的企业，增长百分比会远高于这些“胜局笃定者”。但我宁愿确定地得到一个好结果，也不愿只寄希望于一个极好的结果。

当然，即使花了一辈子寻找，查理和我能识别出的“胜局笃定者”也只有少数几家。仅仅领先，并不能提供确定性。看看几年前通用汽车、IBM和西尔斯遭受的冲击就知道了：它们都曾长期显得不可战胜。有些行业或业务确实具有某些特征，能赋予领先者几乎无法逾越的优势，让“最壮者生存”近乎成为自然法则；但大多数行业并非如此。因此，每出现一家真正的“胜局笃定者”，就有几十家冒牌货：如今风头正劲，却经不起竞争冲击。考虑到达到这一标准所需的条件，查理和我知道，我们永远凑不齐“漂亮五十”，甚至连“闪亮二十”也凑不齐。因此，除了那些胜局笃定的公司，我们也会在组合中加入几家“胜算很高”的公司。

1996.english:
You can, of course, pay too much for even the best of businesses. The overpayment risk surfaces periodically and, in our opinion, may now be quite high for the purchasers of virtually all stocks, The Inevitables included.  Investors making purchases in an overheated market need to recognize that it may often take an extended period for the value of even an outstanding company to catch up with the price they paid.

A far more serious problem occurs when the management of a great company gets sidetracked and neglects its wonderful base business while purchasing other businesses that are so-so or worse.  When that happens, the suffering of investors is often prolonged.  Unfortunately, that is precisely what transpired years ago at both Coke and Gillette.  (Would you believe that a few decades back they were growing shrimp at Coke and exploring for oil at Gillette?)  Loss of focus is what most worries Charlie and me when we contemplate investing in businesses that in general look outstanding.  All too often, we've seen value stagnate in the presence of hubris or of boredom that caused the attention of managers to wander.  That's not going to happen again at Coke and Gillette, however - not given their current and prospective managements.
1996.chinese:
当然，即使是最优秀的企业，你也可能买得太贵。支付过高价格的风险会周期性出现。在我们看来，目前几乎所有股票的买家，包括那些购买“胜局笃定者”的人，都可能面临相当高的这一风险。在过热的市场里买入，投资者必须认识到：即使是一家出色的公司，其价值要追上自己付出的价格，往往也需要很长时间。

更严重的问题是，一家优秀公司的管理层偏离了方向，忽视原本出色的核心业务，却去收购平庸甚至更差的业务。发生这种情况时，投资者的痛苦往往会持续很久。不幸的是，可口可乐和吉列多年前就经历过这种事情。你能相信吗？几十年前，可口可乐曾经养虾，吉列曾经勘探石油。当查理和我考虑投资那些整体看来很优秀的企业时，最担心的就是失去专注。我们太常看到，管理者因为自负，或因为无聊而分心，导致企业价值停滞。不过，考虑到可口可乐和吉列现任及未来的管理班子，这种事不会再在它们身上发生了。

1996.english:
---

Let me add a few thoughts about your own investments.  Most investors, both institutional and individual, will find that the best way to own common stocks is through an index fund that charges minimal fees. Those following this path are sure to beat the net results (after fees and expenses) delivered by the great majority of investment professionals.

Should you choose, however, to construct your own portfolio, there are a few thoughts worth remembering.  Intelligent investing is not complex, though that is far from saying that it is easy.  What an investor needs is the ability to correctly evaluate selected businesses. Note that word "selected":  You don't have to be an expert on every company, or even many.  You only have to be able to evaluate companies within your circle of competence.  The size of that circle is not very important; knowing its boundaries, however, is vital.
1996.chinese:
* * *

关于各位自己的投资，我再补充几点想法。大多数投资者，无论机构还是个人，都会发现，持有普通股的最好方式，是买入收费极低的指数基金。沿着这条路走，取得的净回报，在扣除费用和开支之后，必定能够超过绝大多数投资专业人士。

不过，如果你选择自己构建投资组合，有几件事值得牢记。明智的投资并不复杂，但这绝不意味着它容易。投资者需要的，是正确评估某些选定企业的能力。请注意“选定”这个词：你不必成为每家公司的专家，甚至不必精通很多家公司。你只需要能够评估自己能力圈内的企业。这个圈有多大，并不是特别重要；清楚它的边界在哪里，才至关重要。

1996.english: To invest successfully, you need not understand beta, efficient markets, modern portfolio theory, option pricing or emerging markets. You may, in fact, be better off knowing nothing of these.  That, of course, is not the prevailing view at most business schools, whose finance curriculum tends to be dominated by such subjects.  In our view, though, investment students need only two well-taught courses - How to Value a Business, and How to Think About Market Prices.
1996.chinese: 要成功投资，你不必懂贝塔系数、有效市场、现代投资组合理论、期权定价或新兴市场。事实上，对这些一无所知，可能反而对你更有利。当然，这并不是大多数商学院的主流看法，它们的金融课程往往以这些内容为主。但在我们看来，学习投资的人只需要把两门课学好：如何评估企业价值，以及如何看待市场价格。

1996.english: Your goal as an investor should simply be to purchase, at a rational price, a part interest in an easily-understandable business whose earnings are virtually certain to be materially higher five, ten and twenty years from now.  Over time, you will find only a few companies that meet these standards - so when you see one that qualifies, you should buy a meaningful amount of stock.  You must also resist the temptation to stray from your guidelines:  If you aren't willing to own a stock for ten years, don't even think about owning it for ten minutes. Put together a portfolio of companies whose aggregate earnings march upward over the years, and so also will the portfolio's market value.
1996.chinese: 作为投资者，你的目标其实很简单：以合理的价格，买入一家容易理解的企业的部分股权，而且你几乎可以肯定，这家企业在五年、十年和二十年后的盈利会显著高于今天。随着时间推移，你会发现，符合这些标准的公司只有少数几家。因此，一旦遇到合格的企业，就应该买入足够有分量的股份。你还必须抵御偏离这些准则的诱惑：如果你不愿意持有一只股票十年，就连持有十分钟也不要考虑。把一批总盈利能逐年增长的公司组合起来，组合的市场价值也会随之增长。

1996.english:
Though it's seldom recognized, this is the exact approach that has produced gains for Berkshire shareholders:  Our look-through earnings have grown at a good clip over the years, and our stock price has risen correspondingly.  Had those gains in earnings not materialized, there would have been little increase in Berkshire's value.

The greatly enlarged earnings base we now enjoy will inevitably cause our future gains to lag those of the past.  We will continue, however, to push in the directions we always have.  We will try to build earnings by running our present businesses well - a job made easy because of the extraordinary talents of our operating managers - and by purchasing other businesses, in whole or in part, that are not likely to be roiled by change and that possess important competitive advantages.
1996.chinese:
这一点虽然很少被人认识到，却恰恰是伯克希尔股东取得收益的方法。多年来，我们的穿透利润增长很快，股价也相应上涨。如果这些利润增长没有发生，伯克希尔的价值也不会有多少增加。

我们如今大幅扩大的盈利基础，必然会使未来的增长落后于过去。不过，我们会继续沿着一贯的方向前进。一方面，把现有企业经营好，努力增加利润；由于经营管理者才华出众，这项工作变得容易。另一方面，我们会继续整体或部分收购其他企业，这些企业应当不易受到剧烈变革的冲击，并且拥有重要的竞争优势。

1996.english:
USAir

When Richard Branson, the wealthy owner of Virgin Atlantic Airways, was asked how to become a millionaire, he had a quick answer:  "There's really nothing to it.  Start as a billionaire and then buy an airline." Unwilling to accept Branson's proposition on faith, your Chairman decided in 1989 to test it by investing $358 million in a 9.25% preferred stock of USAir.

I liked and admired Ed Colodny, the company's then-CEO, and I still do.  But my analysis of USAir's business was both superficial and wrong. I was so beguiled by the company's long history of profitable operations, and by the protection that ownership of a senior security seemingly offered me, that I overlooked the crucial point:  USAir's revenues would increasingly feel the effects of an unregulated, fiercely- competitive market whereas its cost structure was a holdover from the days when regulation protected profits.  These costs, if left unchecked, portended disaster, however reassuring the airline's past record might be.  (If history supplied all of the answers, the Forbes 400 would consist of librarians.)
1996.chinese:
## 全美航空

有人问维珍大西洋航空的富豪老板理查德·布兰森（Richard Branson），怎样才能成为百万富翁。他立即答道：“一点也不难。先成为亿万富翁，再买一家航空公司。”你们的董事长不愿仅凭别人的话就相信这一观点，于是在1989年拿出3.58亿美元，买入股息率9.25%的全美航空（USAir）优先股，亲自验证一番。

我当时很喜欢，也很敬重公司时任首席执行官埃德·科洛德尼（Ed Colodny），现在仍然如此。但我对全美航空业务的分析，既肤浅又错误。公司长期盈利的历史，以及持有优先级较高证券似乎带来的保护，让我着了迷，以致忽略了关键问题：它的收入将越来越受到放松管制后激烈竞争的市场影响，成本结构却仍然沿袭自管制保护利润的年代。不论过去的业绩多么令人安心，这些成本若不加以控制，都预示着灾难。如果历史能够提供全部答案，《福布斯》400富豪榜上就应该全是图书管理员。

1996.english: To rationalize its costs, however, USAir needed major improvements in its labor contracts - and that's something most airlines have found it extraordinarily difficult to get, short of credibly threatening, or actually entering, bankruptcy.  USAir was to be no exception. Immediately after we purchased our preferred stock, the imbalance between the company's costs and revenues began to grow explosively.  In the 1990- 1994 period, USAir lost an aggregate of $2.4 billion, a performance that totally wiped out the book equity of its common stock.
1996.chinese: 然而，要让成本合理化，全美航空必须大幅改善劳资合同条款。大多数航空公司都发现，除非能够可信地以破产相威胁，或真正进入破产程序，否则这件事极难做到。全美航空也不例外。我们买入优先股后不久，公司的成本与收入之间的失衡就开始急剧扩大。1990年至1994年，全美航空累计亏损24亿美元，普通股的账面股东权益被彻底亏光。

1996.english:
For much of this period, the company paid us our preferred dividends, but in 1994 payment was suspended.  A bit later, with the situation looking particularly gloomy, we wrote down our investment by 75%, to $89.5 million.  Thereafter, during much of 1995, I offered to sell our shares at 50% of face value.  Fortunately, I was unsuccessful.

Mixed in with my many mistakes at USAir was one thing I got right: Making our investment, we wrote into the preferred contract a somewhat unusual provision stipulating that "penalty dividends" - to run five percentage points over the prime rate - would be accrued on any arrearages.  This meant that when our 9.25% dividend was omitted for two years, the unpaid amounts compounded at rates ranging between 13.25% and 14%.
1996.chinese:
这段时间中的大部分时候，公司仍向我们支付优先股股息，但在1994年停止支付。又过了一段时间，形势显得格外黯淡，我们把这项投资的账面价值减记75%，降至8,950万美元。此后，在1995年的大部分时间里，我一直愿意以面值的一半出售这些股份。幸运的是，没能卖成。

在全美航空这项投资上，我犯了许多错误，但有一件事做对了。投资时，我们在优先股合同中加入一项不太常见的条款：对任何拖欠股息，按银行最优惠贷款利率加五个百分点计提“惩罚性股息”。这意味着，在9.25%的股息被拖欠两年期间，未付金额以13.25%至14%的利率复利累积。

1996.english: Facing this penalty provision, USAir had every incentive to pay arrearages just as promptly as it could.  And in the second half of 1996, when USAir turned profitable, it indeed began to pay, giving us $47.9 million.  We owe Stephen Wolf, the company's CEO, a huge thank-you for extracting a performance from the airline that permitted this payment. Even so, USAir's performance has recently been helped significantly by an industry tailwind that may be cyclical in nature.  The company still has basic cost problems that must be solved.
1996.chinese: 面对这项惩罚条款，全美航空有充分动力尽快清偿拖欠款。1996年下半年，公司转为盈利后，确实开始付款，向我们支付了4,790万美元。我们应当非常感谢首席执行官斯蒂芬·沃尔夫（Stephen Wolf），他带领公司取得了足以完成这笔付款的业绩。即便如此，全美航空近期的表现，也很大程度上得益于整个行业的有利环境，而这种顺风可能具有周期性。公司仍有根本性的成本问题需要解决。

1996.english:
In any event, the prices of USAir's publicly-traded securities tell us that our preferred stock is now probably worth its par value of $358 million, give or take a little.  In addition, we have over the years collected an aggregate of $240.5 million in dividends (including $30 million received in 1997).

Early in 1996, before any accrued dividends had been paid, I tried once more to unload our holdings - this time for about $335 million. You're lucky:  I again failed in my attempt to snatch defeat from the jaws of victory.
1996.chinese:
无论如何，从全美航空公开交易证券的价格来看，我们的优先股现在很可能已经恢复到3.58亿美元面值附近。此外，多年来，我们累计收到2.405亿美元股息，其中包括1997年收到的3,000万美元。

1996年年初，在任何拖欠股息尚未得到支付之前，我又试图出售这项持股，这次要价约3.35亿美元。各位真幸运：我又一次没能把眼看就要到手的胜利，硬生生变成失败。

1996.english:
In another context, a friend once asked me:  "If you're so rich, why aren't you smart?"  After reviewing my sorry performance with USAir, you may conclude he had a point.

Financings

We wrote four checks to Salomon Brothers last year and in each case were delighted with the work for which we were paying.  I've already described one transaction: the FlightSafety purchase in which Salomon was the initiating investment banker.  In a second deal, the firm placed a small debt offering for our finance subsidiary.
1996.chinese:
在另一个场合，一位朋友曾问我：“你既然这么有钱，怎么还这么不聪明？”回顾我在全美航空上的糟糕表现，各位可能会觉得，他说得有道理。

## 融资

去年，我们向所罗门兄弟公司开了四张支票，每一次都对付费获得的服务十分满意。其中一项交易我已经介绍过：收购飞安国际，所罗门是发起这笔交易的投资银行。另一项交易，是它为我们的金融子公司安排了一笔小规模债券发行。

1996.english: Additionally, we made two good-sized offerings through Salomon, both with interesting aspects.  The first was our sale in May of 517,500 shares of Class B Common, which generated net proceeds of $565 million. As I have told you before, we made this sale in response to the threatened creation of unit trusts that would have marketed themselves as Berkshire look-alikes.  In the process, they would have used our past, and definitely nonrepeatable, record to entice naive small investors and would have charged these innocents high fees and commissions.
1996.chinese: 此外，我们还通过所罗门完成了两笔相当规模的发行，各有值得一谈的地方。第一笔是5月出售517,500股B类普通股，净募集资金5.65亿美元。正如我此前告诉各位的，我们之所以发行B类股，是为了应对一些拟设立的单位信托基金。它们打算把自己包装成伯克希尔的替代品，利用我们过去的、而且肯定无法重现的业绩，吸引缺乏经验的小额投资者，再向这些人收取高额费用和佣金。

1996.english: I think it would have been quite easy for such trusts to have sold many billions of dollars worth of units, and I also believe that early marketing successes by these trusts would have led to the formation of others.  (In the securities business, whatever can be sold will be sold.) The trusts would have meanwhile indiscriminately poured the proceeds of their offerings into a supply of Berkshire shares that is fixed and limited.  The likely result: a speculative bubble in our stock.  For at least a time, the price jump would have been self-validating, in that it would have pulled new waves of naive and impressionable investors into the trusts and set off still more buying of Berkshire shares.
1996.chinese: 我认为，这些信托很容易就能卖出数十亿美元的份额；早期的销售成功，还会引来更多同类信托。在证券行业，只要卖得出去的东西，就一定会有人卖。与此同时，这些信托会不计价格地把募集资金投入供给固定而有限的伯克希尔股票。很可能出现的结果，就是我们的股票形成投机泡沫。至少在一段时间内，股价上涨会显得自我印证：上涨吸引新一批缺乏经验、容易受影响的投资者买入信托，再引发更多对伯克希尔股票的买入。

1996.english:
Some Berkshire shareholders choosing to exit might have found that outcome ideal, since they could have profited at the expense of the buyers entering with false hopes.  Continuing shareholders, however, would have suffered once reality set in, for at that point Berkshire would have been burdened with both hundreds of thousands of unhappy, indirect owners (trustholders, that is) and a stained reputation.

Our issuance of the B shares not only arrested the sale of the trusts, but provided a low-cost way for people to invest in Berkshire if they still wished to after hearing the warnings we issued.  To blunt the enthusiasm that brokers normally have for pushing new issues - because that's where the money is - we arranged for our offering to carry a commission of only 1.5%, the lowest payoff that we have ever seen in a common stock underwriting.  Additionally, we made the amount of the offering open-ended, thereby repelling the typical IPO buyer who looks for a short-term price spurt arising from a combination of hype and scarcity.
1996.chinese:
一些准备退出的伯克希尔股东，可能觉得这种结果理想极了，因为他们可以靠那些抱着不切实际希望入场的买家获利。但继续持有的股东，等现实重新显露时，就要承受损害。届时，伯克希尔不仅要面对数十万不满的间接持有人，也就是信托份额持有人，还得背负受损的声誉。

发行B类股，既阻止了这些信托的销售，也为那些听完我们的提醒、仍然希望投资伯克希尔的人，提供了一条低成本途径。经纪人通常热衷推销新股，因为这里最有钱赚。为了降低这种热情，我们把发行佣金定为仅1.5%，这是我们见过的普通股承销中最低的佣金水平。此外，我们没有给发行数量设置上限，以此避开那些典型的新股投机买家：他们指望炒作加上稀缺供给，带来短期股价急升。

1996.english:
Overall, we tried to make sure that the B stock would be purchased only by investors with a long-term perspective.  Those efforts were generally successful:  Trading volume in the B shares immediately following the offering - a rough index of "flipping" - was far below the norm for a new issue.  In the end we added about 40,000 shareholders, most of whom we believe both understand what they own and share our time horizons.

Salomon could not have performed better in the handling of this unusual transaction.  Its investment bankers understood perfectly what we were trying to achieve and tailored every aspect of the offering to meet these objectives.  The firm would have made far more money - perhaps ten times as much - if our offering had been standard in its make-up.  But the investment bankers involved made no attempt to tweak the specifics in that direction.  Instead they came up with ideas that were counter to Salomon's financial interest but that made it much more certain Berkshire's goals would be reached.  Terry Fitzgerald captained this effort, and we thank him for the job that he did.
1996.chinese:
总体上，我们努力确保买入B类股的人具有长期眼光。这些努力大体成功了。发行后不久，B类股的成交量远低于新股发行后的通常水平，而成交量大致可以反映短线转手的程度。最终，我们增加了约40,000名股东。我们相信，其中大多数既理解自己持有的是什么，也与我们拥有相同的投资期限。

所罗门处理这笔不同寻常的交易，表现无可挑剔。它的投资银行家完全理解我们的目标，并据此量身安排发行的每一个环节。如果采用常规发行方式，所罗门本可以赚得多得多，也许是十倍。但参与交易的银行家，并未试图把条款往那个方向调整。相反，他们提出了一些不利于所罗门自身经济利益、却能更有把握帮助伯克希尔实现目标的主意。特里·菲茨杰拉德（Terry Fitzgerald）带领了这项工作，我们感谢他的付出。

1996.english: Given that background, it won't surprise you to learn that we again went to Terry when we decided late in the year to sell an issue of Berkshire notes that can be exchanged for a portion of the Salomon shares that we hold.  In this instance, once again, Salomon did an absolutely first-class job, selling $500 million principal amount of five-year notes for $447.1 million.  Each $1,000 note is exchangeable into 17.65 shares and is callable in three years at accreted value.  Counting the original issue discount and a 1% coupon, the securities will provide a yield of 3% to maturity for holders who do not exchange them for Salomon stock.  But it seems quite likely that the notes will be exchanged before their maturity.  If that happens, our interest cost will be about 1.1% for the period prior to exchange.
1996.chinese: 了解这一背景之后，各位就不会惊讶：年底我们决定发行一批伯克希尔票据，允许持有人将其交换为我们持有的部分所罗门股票时，再次找到了特里。这一次，所罗门仍然表现一流，以4.471亿美元的价格，售出了本金总额5亿美元的五年期票据。每1,000美元面值票据，可交换17.65股所罗门股票；三年后，伯克希尔可按计入应计增值后的金额赎回。把发行折价和1%的票面利率算在一起，对于不选择换股的持有人，这批票据的到期收益率为3%。不过，票据很可能在到期前就被换成股票。如果如此，换股前这段期间我们的利息成本约为1.1%。

1996.english: In recent years, it has been written that Charlie and I are unhappy about all investment-banking fees.  That's dead wrong.  We have paid a great many fees over the last 30 years - beginning with the check we wrote to Charlie Heider upon our purchase of National Indemnity in 1967 - and we are delighted to make payments that are commensurate with performance.  In the case of the 1996 transactions at Salomon Brothers, we more than got our money's worth.
1996.chinese: 近几年，有人撰文说，查理和我对所有投资银行费用都不满意。这完全错了。过去30年，我们支付过大量费用，从1967年收购国民赔偿保险公司时付给查理·海德（Charlie Heider）的那张支票开始，只要报酬与服务表现相称，我们都很乐意付款。至于1996年所罗门兄弟经手的这些交易，我们获得的价值超过了付出的费用。

1996.english:
Miscellaneous

Though it was a close decision, Charlie and I have decided to enter the 20th Century.  Accordingly, we are going to put future quarterly and annual reports of Berkshire on the Internet, where they can be accessed via http://www.berkshirehathaway.com.  We will always "post" these reports on a Saturday so that anyone interested will have ample time to digest the information before trading begins.  Our publishing schedule for the next 12 months is May 17, 1997, August 16, 1997, November 15, 1997, and March 14, 1998.  We will also post any press releases that we issue.
1996.chinese:
## 其他事项

虽然纠结了好一阵，查理和我最终还是决定迈入20世纪。因此，今后伯克希尔的季报和年报将放到互联网上，各位可以通过 http://www.berkshirehathaway.com 查阅。我们总会选择在星期六“发布”报告，让所有感兴趣的人都有充足时间，在交易开始前消化信息。未来12个月的发布日程为：1997年5月17日、1997年8月16日、1997年11月15日和1998年3月14日。公司发布的新闻稿也会放到网上。

1996.english:
At some point, we may stop mailing our quarterly reports and simply post these on the Internet.  This move would eliminate significant costs. Also, we have a large number of "street name" holders and have found that the distribution of our quarterlies to them is highly erratic:  Some holders receive their mailings weeks later than others.

The drawback to Internet-only distribution is that many of our shareholders lack computers.  Most of these holders, however, could easily obtain printouts at work or through friends.  Please let me know if you prefer that we continue mailing quarterlies.  We want your input - starting with whether you even read these reports - and at a minimum will make no change in 1997.  Also, we will definitely keep delivering the annual report in its present form in addition to publishing it on the Internet.
1996.chinese:
未来某个时候，我们可能停止邮寄季报，只在网上发布，这样可以节省相当多的成本。此外，我们有大量以经纪商等名义登记持股的股东，而季报送达他们的情况很不稳定：有些人收到邮件的时间，比另一些人晚几个星期。

只在网上发布的缺点，是许多股东没有电脑。不过，其中大多数人可以在工作场所，或通过朋友，方便地取得打印件。如果各位希望我们继续邮寄季报，请告诉我。我们想听听意见，首先是各位到底读不读这些报告。至少在1997年，我们不会作出改变。另外，年报除了上网发布，也一定会继续按现有形式寄送。

1996.english:
---

About 97.2% of all eligible shares participated in Berkshire's 1996 shareholder-designated contributions program.  Contributions made were $13.3 million, and 3,910 charities were recipients.  A full description of the shareholder-designated contributions program appears on pages 48- 49.

Every year a few shareholders miss out on the program because they don't have their shares registered in their own names on the prescribed record date or because they fail to get the designation form back to us within the 60-day period allowed.  This is distressing to Charlie and me. But if replies are received late, we have to reject them because we can't make exceptions for some shareholders while refusing to make them for others.
1996.chinese:
* * *

1996年，约97.2%的合资格股份参加了伯克希尔的股东指定捐赠计划。捐赠总额为1,330万美元，受赠慈善机构共3,910家。关于这一计划的完整说明，见第48和49页。

每年，总有少数股东错过这项计划：有的是因为在规定登记日，没有把股份登记在本人名下；有的是未能在允许的60天期限内寄回指定捐赠表格。这让查理和我很遗憾。但如果回复逾期，我们就必须拒绝，因为不能为某些股东破例，却不肯为另一些股东破例。

1996.english:
To participate in future programs, you must own Class A shares that are registered in the name of the actual owner, not the nominee name of a broker, bank or depository.  Shares not so registered on August 31, 1997, will be ineligible for the 1997 program.  When you get the form, return it promptly so that it does not get put aside or forgotten.

## The Annual Meeting

Our capitalist's version of Woodstock -the Berkshire Annual Meeting- will be held on Monday, May 5.  Charlie and I thoroughly enjoy this event, and we hope that you come.  We will start at 9:30 a.m., break for about 15 minutes at noon (food will be available - but at a price, of course), and then continue talking to hard-core attendees until at least 3:30.  Last year we had representatives from all 50 states, as well as Australia, Greece, Israel, Portugal, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.  The annual meeting is a time for owners to get their business-related questions answered, and therefore Charlie and I will stay on stage until we start getting punchy.  (When that happens, I hope you notice a change.)
1996.chinese:
要参加未来的计划，各位必须持有A类股，并登记在实际所有人名下，而不能登记在经纪商、银行或托管机构的代持名下。1997年8月31日尚未按此登记的股份，将无资格参加1997年的计划。收到表格后，请尽快寄回，以免搁置一旁后忘记。

## 股东大会

我们资本家版本的伍德斯托克——伯克希尔股东大会——将于5月5日星期一举行。查理和我都非常喜欢这一活动，也希望各位前来。会议上午9点30分开始，中午休息约15分钟，现场提供食物，当然要付钱。之后，我们会继续与最投入的与会者交谈，至少到下午3点30分。去年，与会者来自美国全部50个州，以及澳大利亚、希腊、以色列、葡萄牙、新加坡、瑞典、瑞士和英国。股东大会是让所有者就企业相关问题得到解答的机会，所以查理和我会一直待在台上，直到累得有点晕头转向。但愿到时候，各位能看出我们和平时的区别。

1996.english: Last year we had attendance of 5,000 and strained the capacity of the Holiday Convention Centre, even though we spread out over three rooms.  This year, our new Class B shares have caused a doubling of our stockholder count, and we are therefore moving the meeting to the Aksarben Coliseum, which holds about 10,000 and also has a huge parking lot.  The doors will open for the meeting at 7:00 a.m., and at 8:30 we will - upon popular demand - show a new Berkshire movie produced by Marc Hamburg, our CFO.  (In this company, no one gets by with doing only a single job.)
1996.chinese: 去年有5,000人参加。即使我们用了三个房间，假日会议中心的容量仍然吃紧。今年，新发行的B类股让股东人数翻了一倍，因此会议将移到约可容纳10,000人、并拥有大型停车场的阿克萨本体育馆。会场早上7点开门。应大家要求，8点30分将播放一部新的伯克希尔影片，由首席财务官马克·汉堡（Marc Hamburg）制作。在我们公司，谁也不能只干一份活就交差。

1996.english: Overcoming our legendary repugnance for activities even faintly commercial, we will also have an abundant array of Berkshire products for sale in the halls outside the meeting room.  Last year we broke all records, selling 1,270 pounds of See's candy, 1,143 pairs of Dexter shoes, $29,000 of World Books and related publications, and 700 sets of knives manufactured by our Quikut subsidiary.  Additionally, many shareholders made inquiries about GEICO auto policies.  If you would like to investigate possible insurance savings, bring your present policy to the meeting.  We estimate that about 40% of our shareholders can save money by insuring with us.  (We'd like to say 100%, but the insurance business doesn't work that way:  Because insurers differ in their underwriting judgments, some of our shareholders are currently paying rates that are lower than GEICO's.)
1996.chinese: 尽管我们向来以厌恶哪怕一丁点商业气息而闻名，还是决定克服这种“厌恶”，在会议室外的大厅里摆出琳琅满目的伯克希尔产品供各位购买。去年，我们打破了所有纪录：卖出1,270磅喜诗糖果、1,143双德克斯特鞋、价值29,000美元的世界图书百科全书及相关出版物，以及子公司Quikut制造的700套刀具。此外，许多股东询问了盖可汽车保险。如果想看看能否省下保费，请把现有保单带到会场。我们估计，约40%的股东通过向我们投保，可以节省费用。我们很想说100%，但保险业并不是这样运作的：各家保险公司的承保判断不同，因此有些股东目前支付的保费，确实低于盖可的报价。

1996.english: An attachment to the proxy material enclosed with this report explains how you can obtain the card you will need for admission to the meeting.  We expect a large crowd, so get both plane and hotel reservations promptly.  American Express (800-799-6634) will be happy to help you with arrangements.  As usual, we will have buses servicing the larger hotels to take you to and from the meeting, and also to take you to Nebraska Furniture Mart, Borsheim's and the airport after it is over.
1996.chinese: 随本报告附上的委托投票材料中，有一份附件说明了如何取得入场证。我们预计人数会很多，请尽快预订机票和酒店。美国运通很乐意协助安排，电话为800-799-6634。和往年一样，我们会安排巴士往返各大酒店与会场，并在会议结束后，接送各位前往内布拉斯加家具城、波仙珠宝和机场。

1996.english: NFM's main store, located on a 75-acre site about a mile from Aksarben, is open from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekdays, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturdays, and noon to 6 p.m. on Sundays.  Come by and say hello to "Mrs. B" (Rose Blumkin).  She's 103 now and sometimes operates with an oxygen mask that is attached to a tank on her cart.  But if you try to keep pace with her, it will be you who needs oxygen.  NFM did about $265 million of business last year - a record for a single-location home furnishings operation - and you'll see why once you check out its merchandise and prices.
1996.chinese: 内布拉斯加家具城（NFM）的主店占地75英亩，距阿克萨本约一英里。工作日营业时间为上午10点至晚上9点，星期六上午10点至下午6点，星期日中午至下午6点。请来向“B夫人”罗丝·布拉姆金（Rose Blumkin）问好。她如今103岁，有时戴着氧气面罩工作，氧气瓶就放在她的代步车上。不过，如果你想跟上她的步伐，恐怕需要氧气的会是你。NFM去年营业额约2.65亿美元，创下单一营业地点家居用品企业的纪录；看过商品和价格，各位就会明白原因。

1996.english: Borsheim's normally is closed on Sunday but will be open for shareholders from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on May 4th.  Last year on "Shareholder Sunday" we broke every Borsheim's record in terms of tickets, dollar volume and, no doubt, attendees per square inch.  Because we expect a capacity crowd this year as well, all shareholders attending on Sunday must bring their admission cards.  Shareholders who prefer a somewhat less frenzied experience will get the same special treatment on Saturday, when the store is open from 10 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., or on Monday between 10 a.m. and 8 p.m.  Come by at any time this year and let Susan Jacques, Borsheim's CEO, and her skilled associates perform a painless walletectomy on you.
1996.chinese: 波仙珠宝通常星期日不营业，但5月4日会专门为股东开放，时间为上午10点至下午6点。去年“股东星期日”，无论成交笔数、销售金额，还是毫无疑问的每平方英寸到场人数，我们都打破了波仙的所有纪录。由于今年预计仍会满场，星期日前来的股东都必须携带入场证。如果希望逛得不那么拥挤，也可以在星期六上午10点至下午5点30分，或星期一上午10点至晚上8点前来，享受同样的特别待遇。今年任何时候都欢迎光临，让波仙首席执行官苏珊·雅克（Susan Jacques）和她技艺娴熟的同事，给各位做一场无痛的“钱包切除术”。

1996.english: My favorite steakhouse, Gorat's, was sold out last year on the weekend of the annual meeting, even though it added an additional seating at 4 p.m. on Sunday.  You can make reservations beginning on April 1st (but not earlier) by calling 402-551-3733.  I will be at Gorat's on Sunday after Borsheim's, having my usual rare T-bone and double order of hashbrowns.  I can also recommend - this is the standard fare when Debbie Bosanek, my invaluable assistant, and I go to lunch - the hot roast beef sandwich with mashed potatoes and gravy.  Mention Debbie's name and you will be given an extra boat of gravy.
1996.chinese: 我最喜欢的牛排馆Gorat’s，去年股东大会周末全部订满，尽管星期日下午4点还加开了一轮。各位可以从4月1日起拨打402-551-3733预订，但不要提前。我会在星期日逛完波仙之后去Gorat’s，照例点一份偏生的T骨牛排和双份煎土豆丝饼。我还推荐热烤牛肉三明治，配土豆泥和肉汁；这是我与不可或缺的助理黛比·博萨内克（Debbie Bosanek）一起吃午饭时的惯常选择。提到黛比的名字，店里还会多给你一壶肉汁。

1996.english:
The Omaha Royals and Indianapolis Indians will play baseball on Saturday evening, May 3rd, at Rosenblatt Stadium.  Pitching in my normal rotation - one throw a year - I will start.

Though Rosenblatt is normal in appearance, it is anything but:  The field sits on a unique geological structure that occasionally emits short gravitational waves causing even the most smoothly-delivered pitch to sink violently.  I have been the victim of this weird phenomenon several times in the past but am hoping for benign conditions this year.  There will be lots of opportunities for photos at the ball game, but you will need incredibly fast reflexes to snap my fast ball en route to the plate.

Our proxy statement includes information about obtaining tickets to the game.  We will also provide an information packet listing restaurants that will be open on Sunday night and describing various things that you can do in Omaha on the weekend.  The entire gang at Berkshire looks forward to seeing you.

Warren E. Buffett February 28, 1997				Chairman of the Board
1996.chinese:
5月3日星期六晚上，奥马哈皇家队与印第安纳波利斯印第安人队将在罗森布拉特球场比赛。按照我的常规轮值安排——每年投一球——我将担任先发投手。

罗森布拉特看上去和普通球场一样，实际上却大不相同。球场坐落在一种独特的地质结构上，偶尔会释放短暂的引力波，让即使投得最流畅的球，也突然猛烈下坠。过去，我曾多次成为这种奇异现象的受害者，但希望今年情况好一些。球赛中会有很多拍照机会，不过，要想抓拍我飞向本垒板的快速球，各位的反应必须极快才行。

我们的委托投票说明书中，包含如何获取球赛门票的信息。我们还会提供一份资料，列出星期日晚上营业的餐馆，并介绍周末在奥马哈可以参加的各项活动。伯克希尔全体同仁都期待与各位见面。

沃伦·E·巴菲特

董事长

1997年2月28日

1997.english:
BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

1997 Chairman's Letter

To the Shareholders of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.:

Our gain in net worth during 1997 was $8.0 billion, which increased the per-share book value of both our Class A and Class B stock by 34.1%. Over the last 33 years (that is, since present management took over) per-share book value has grown from $19 to $25,488, a rate of 24.1% compounded annually.(1)

1.  All figures used in this report apply to Berkshire's A shares, the successor to the only stock that the company had outstanding before 1996.  The B shares have an economic interest equal to 1/30th that of the A.
1997.chinese:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司

1997年度董事长致股东信

致伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的股东：

1997年，我们的净资产增加80亿美元，使A类股和B类股的每股账面价值都增长了34.1%。过去33年，也就是现任管理层接手以来，每股账面价值从19美元增至25,488美元，年复合增长率为24.1%。（1）

（1）本报告使用的全部每股数字，均适用于伯克希尔A类股；它是公司1996年以前唯一流通股票的延续。每股B类股享有的经济权益，等于每股A类股的三十分之一。

1997.english: Given our gain of 34.1%, it is tempting to declare victory and move on. But last year's performance was no great triumph: Any investor can chalk up large returns when stocks soar, as they did in 1997. In a bull market, one must avoid the error of the preening duck that quacks boastfully after a torrential rainstorm, thinking that its paddling skills have caused it to rise in the world. A right-thinking duck would instead compare its position after the downpour to that of the other ducks on the pond.
1997.chinese: 增长34.1%，很容易让人想宣布胜利，然后往下讲。不过，去年的表现算不上什么大捷：股票像1997年那样飞涨时，任何投资者都能拿到高回报。牛市中，务必别犯那只得意鸭子的错误：一场暴雨过后，它神气活现地嘎嘎夸口，以为自己在世上步步高升，全靠划水本领。头脑清醒的鸭子，应该比较一下，雨后自己在池塘里的位置，与别的鸭子有何不同。

1997.english:
So what's our duck rating for 1997? The table on the facing page shows that though we paddled furiously last year, passive ducks that simply invested in the S&P Index rose almost as fast as we did. Our appraisal of 1997's performance, then: Quack.

When the market booms, we tend to suffer in comparison with the S&P Index. The Index bears no tax costs, nor do mutual funds, since they pass through all tax liabilities to their owners. Last year, on the other hand, Berkshire paid or accrued $4.2 billion for federal income tax, or about 18% of our beginning net worth.
1997.chinese:
那么，1997年我们这只鸭子，该打几分？对页的表说明，尽管去年我们拼命划水，那些什么也不干、只投资标普指数的鸭子，上升得几乎与我们一样快。所以，对1997年表现的评价是：嘎。

市场大涨时，与标普指数相比，我们往往吃亏。指数不承担税收成本；共同基金也不承担，因为它们把所有纳税义务传给投资者。伯克希尔则不同，去年支付或计提的联邦所得税为42亿美元，约相当于年初净资产的18%。

1997.english: Berkshire will always have corporate taxes to pay, which means it needs to overcome their drag in order to justify its existence. Obviously, Charlie Munger, Berkshire's Vice Chairman and my partner, and I won't be able to lick that handicap every year. But we expect over time to maintain a modest advantage over the Index, and that is the yardstick against which you should measure us. We will not ask you to adopt the philosophy of the Chicago Cubs fan who reacted to a string of lackluster seasons by saying, "Why get upset? Everyone has a bad century now and then."
1997.chinese: 伯克希尔始终要缴公司税，因此，必须克服税收的拖累，才能证明自己存在得有道理。显然，伯克希尔副董事长、我的合伙人查理·芒格和我，不可能年年战胜这个不利条件。不过，我们希望长期仍能小幅领先指数，各位应当用这把尺子衡量我们。我们不会请各位信奉那位芝加哥小熊队球迷的哲学：接连几个赛季表现平平，他却说：“何必生气？谁还没有偶尔倒霉一个世纪的时候。”

1997.english:
Gains in book value are, of course, not the bottom line at Berkshire. What truly counts are gains in per-share intrinsic business value. Ordinarily, though, the two measures tend to move roughly in tandem, and in 1997 that was the case: Led by a blow-out performance at GEICO, Berkshire's intrinsic value (which far exceeds book value) grew at nearly the same pace as book value.

For more explanation of the term, intrinsic value, you may wish to refer to our Owner's Manual, reprinted on pages 62 to 71. This manual sets forth our owner-related business principles, information that is important to all of Berkshire's shareholders.
1997.chinese:
当然，账面价值增长，并非伯克希尔最终要紧的成绩。真正重要的，是每股内在商业价值的增长。不过，通常这两个指标大致同步，1997年也是如此。在GEICO爆发式优异表现的带动下，伯克希尔远高于账面价值的内在价值，增长速度与账面价值几乎相同。

关于“内在价值”的进一步解释，各位可以参阅重印在第62—71页的《所有者手册》。手册列出我们与所有者相关的经营原则，这些资料，对所有伯克希尔股东都很重要。

1997.english: In our last two annual reports, we furnished you a table that Charlie and I believe is central to estimating Berkshire's intrinsic value. In the updated version of that table, which follows, we trace our two key components of value. The first column lists our per-share ownership of investments (including cash and equivalents) and the second column shows our per-share earnings from Berkshire's operating businesses before taxes and purchase-accounting adjustments (discussed on pages 69 and 70), but after all interest and corporate expenses. The second column excludes all dividends, interest and capital gains that we realized from the investments presented in the first column. In effect, the columns show what Berkshire would look like were it split into two parts, with one entity holding our investments and the other operating all of our businesses and bearing all corporate costs.
1997.chinese: 过去两份年报中，我们提供了一张表，查理和我认为，它是估计伯克希尔内在价值的关键。下面的更新版，追踪两项核心价值组成。第一栏列出每股拥有的投资，包括现金与现金等价物；第二栏列出伯克希尔各经营业务的每股利润，口径为税前、购买会计调整前，相关调整见第69—70页，但已扣除全部利息和公司费用。第二栏剔除了第一栏投资产生的全部股息、利息和资本利得。实际上，这两栏说明：如果把伯克希尔一分为二，一家持有投资，另一家经营全部业务、承担全部公司费用，会是什么样子。

1997.english:
Pre-tax Earnings Per Share Investments          Excluding All Income from Year             Per Share                   Investments

```text
1967             $    41                      $  1.09
1977                 372                        12.44
1987               3,910                       108.14
1997              38,043                       717.82
```

Pundits who ignore what our 38,000 employees contribute to the company, and instead simply view Berkshire as a de facto investment company, should study the figures in the second column. We made our first business acquisition in 1967, and since then our pre-tax operating earnings have grown from $1 million to $888 million. Furthermore, as noted, in this exercise we have assigned all of Berkshire's corporate expenses -- overhead of $6.6 million, interest of $66.9 million and shareholder contributions of $15.4 million -- to our business operations, even though a portion of these could just as well have been assigned to the investment side.
1997.chinese: 那些忽略38,000名员工对公司贡献、只把伯克希尔视为一家事实上的投资公司的评论家，应该研究第二栏数字。我们1967年首次收购企业，此后，税前营业利润从100万美元增至8.88亿美元。而且，如前所述，在这项分析中，我们把伯克希尔全部公司费用——总部费用660万美元、利息6,690万美元，以及股东指定捐款1,540万美元——都计入经营业务，尽管其中一部分，同样可以分配给投资一边。

1997.english:
Here are the growth rates of the two segments by decade:

Pre-tax Earnings Per Share Investments          Excluding All Income from Decade Ending            Per Share                  Investments

```text
     1977                   24.6%                       27.6%
     1987                   26.5%                       24.1%
     1997                   25.5%                       20.8%
Annual Growth
```
